words.enDefinition: Upper portion of the abdominopelvic cavity situated below the diaphragm

examples.en: The abdominal cavity occupies the upper part of the model's abdominopelvic space.
examples.zh: 「腹腔」占据模型中腹盆腔的上部。

examples.en: The diagram outlines the abdominal cavity separately from the smaller space farther down.
examples.zh: 示意图分别勾勒出「腹腔」和下方较小空间的轮廓。

collocations: upper part of the abdominal cavity

words.enDefinition: One of four abdominal areas defined by crossing vertical and horizontal lines

examples.en: We labeled each abdominal quadrant after drawing a cross centered on the navel.
examples.zh: 我们先以肚脐为中心画出十字线，再标出各「腹部象限」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks which abdominal quadrant contains the dot shown on the body outline.
examples.zh: 习题问，人体轮廓上的圆点位于哪个「腹部象限」。

words.enDefinition: Combined abdominal and pelvic compartment below the diaphragm in the trunk

examples.en: The abdominopelvic cavity includes the spaces shown in both lower sections of the diagram.
examples.zh: 「腹盆腔」包括图中下方两部分所示的空间。

examples.en: We shaded the abdominopelvic cavity below the diaphragm on the same trunk model.
examples.zh: 我们在同一个躯干模型上给横隔以下的「腹盆腔」涂上阴影。

words.enDefinition: Movement away from the body's midline, or away from the reference digit in the hand or foot.

examples.en: The arm model shows abduction as it moves out to the side of the torso.
examples.zh: 上肢模型向躯干侧方移动时，示范的是「外展」。

examples.en: We marked abduction with an outward arrow on the front view of the skeleton.
examples.zh: 我们在骨骼正视图上用向外的箭头标出「外展」。

words.enDefinition: Classification of blood according to A and B markers on red cells

examples.en: The ABO blood group system chart groups four fictional examples by their red cell markers.
examples.zh: 「ABO血型系统」图表按红细胞表面标志给四个虚构示例分组。

examples.en: We filled the four labels of the ABO blood group system on our classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂习题上填写了「ABO血型系统」的四个类别标签。

collocations: classes of the ABO blood group system
diagram of the ABO blood group system
labels in the ABO blood group system

words.enDefinition: the interval around an action potential during which another action potential cannot be initiated in the same membrane region

examples.en: In the model, no second spike followed a pulse given during the absolute refractory period.
examples.zh: 在模型中，在「绝对不应期」施加脉冲后没有出现第二个尖峰。

examples.en: We marked the absolute refractory period where the model could not initiate a second action potential.
examples.zh: 我们将模型无法启动第二个动作电位的时段标为「绝对不应期」。

collocations: length of the absolute refractory period

words.enDefinition: The probability that an individual in a defined group experiences a specified event over a stated period.

examples.en: The absolute risk is given separately for each group in the fictional follow-up results table.
examples.zh: 虚构随访结果表为各组分别给出「绝对风险」。

examples.en: We recorded the time period alongside the absolute risk before comparing the classroom outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们先在「绝对风险」旁记下时段，再比较课堂结局。

collocations: absolute risk over a specified period

words.enDefinition: Structure that assists digestion without belonging to the main passage for food

examples.en: The liver is labeled as an accessory digestive organ beside the digestive tract model.
examples.zh: 消化道模型旁的肝脏被标为「消化附属器官」。

examples.en: The worksheet traces a duct from an accessory digestive organ to the small intestine.
examples.zh: 习题描出了从「消化附属器官」通往小肠的一条导管。

collocations: function of an accessory digestive organ

words.enDefinition: the process by which the eye changes the shape of its lens to focus at different distances

examples.en: The classroom animation shows accommodation of the eye when the model shifts focus to a nearer object.
examples.zh: 模型把焦点转向较近物体时，课堂动画显示了「眼的调节」。

examples.en: We compared the lens outlines to see how accommodation of the eye changed the ray diagram.
examples.zh: 我们对照两个晶状体轮廓，观察「眼的调节」怎样改变光路图。

collocations: role of the lens in accommodation of the eye

words.enDefinition: Coenzyme A carrying an acetyl group that can enter central metabolic pathways.

examples.en: The diagram shows acetyl-CoA carrying a two-carbon group into the citric acid cycle in a human cell.
examples.zh: 图中显示，「乙酰辅酶 A」将一个二碳基团带入人体细胞的柠檬酸循环。

examples.en: We found acetyl-CoA where arrows from two different sources met on the classroom map of metabolism.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂代谢图上两个不同来源的箭头交汇处找到了「乙酰辅酶 A」。

collocations: acetyl-CoA entering the citric acid cycle
transfer of an acetyl group from acetyl-CoA

words.enDefinition: The tendon connecting major calf muscles, including the gastrocnemius and soleus, to the heel bone.

examples.en: The Achilles tendon reaches the heel bone in the side view of the classroom ankle model.
examples.zh: 课堂踝部模型侧视图上，「跟腱」延伸至跟骨。

examples.en: We traced the Achilles tendon from the calf muscles to the heel on the anatomy chart.
examples.zh: 我们在解剖挂图上沿「跟腱」从小腿后侧肌肉查看到足跟。

words.enDefinition: An amino acid side chain with a group that can donate a proton and often carries negative charge.

examples.en: The diagram labels the negatively charged group of an acidic side chain in the folded protein.
examples.zh: 图中标出了折叠蛋白质中一条「酸性侧链」带负电的基团。

examples.en: We located the additional carboxyl group on the acidic side chain in the classroom structure chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂结构图中，找到了「酸性侧链」上额外的羧基。

collocations: a negatively charged acidic side chain
an acidic side chain in a protein

words.enDefinition: a region of reduced ultrasound echoes behind a structure that strongly attenuates or reflects the sound beam

examples.en: The image shows an acoustic shadow extending deep to the bright modeled object in the classroom display.
examples.zh: 课堂显示的图像上，「声影」从明亮模型物体的深面延展开来。

examples.en: We distinguished the acoustic shadow from the object that blocked much of the sound reaching the deeper region.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「声影」与阻止多数声波到达深部区域的物体。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic that develops through experience or environmental influence during an individual's lifetime.

examples.en: The class discussed an acquired trait using the simple example of learning a new skill.
examples.zh: 全班用学会一项新技能这个例子讨论「后天获得性状」。

examples.en: We compared an acquired trait with a characteristic labelled as inherited in the fictional worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「后天获得性状」与虚构练习中标为遗传的特征作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome whose centromere lies close to one end, leaving a much shorter arm.

examples.en: The acrocentric chromosome has a short stub above the marked constriction in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「近端着丝粒染色体」在标出的缢缩部位上方只有很短一段。

examples.en: We identified an acrocentric chromosome by checking the centromere position on the supplied textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们查看给定教材图上的着丝粒位置，认出一条「近端着丝粒染色体」。

collocations: short arm of an acrocentric chromosome

words.enDefinition: a brief regenerative change in membrane voltage that can propagate along an excitable cell membrane

examples.en: The action potential appears as a brief spike moving from one segment of the model axon to another.
examples.zh: 「动作电位」以短暂尖峰的形式，在模型轴突中从一个节段传到另一个节段。

examples.en: We compared the action potential with the shorter-range voltage changes marked near the simulated input.
examples.zh: 我们将「动作电位」与模拟输入附近标出的传播范围更短的电压变化比较。

words.enDefinition: The energy barrier that a reaction must overcome to proceed along a given pathway.

examples.en: The diagram draws activation energy as the height of a barrier above the starting level.
examples.zh: 图中用起始水平上方能垒的高度表示「活化能」。

examples.en: We compared activation energy on two schematic paths that led to the same final product.
examples.zh: 我们比较通向同一最终产物的两条示意路径上各自的「活化能」。

collocations: the activation energy of a reaction

words.enDefinition: A comparison intervention expected to have an active effect in the study's setting.

examples.en: The active comparator is a different reminder format already used in the fictional study setting.
examples.zh: 「活性对照」是虚构研究场景中已经使用的另一种提醒格式。

examples.en: We identified the active comparator by reading the description of the second group in the report.
examples.zh: 我们阅读报告对第二组的描述，找出「活性对照」。

words.enDefinition: Defense that targets specific antigens and can produce lasting cellular memory

examples.en: The adaptive immunity diagram follows one selected cell group through several possible outcomes.
examples.zh: 「适应性免疫」图沿着一个被选择的细胞群展示了几种可能的后续情况。

examples.en: We highlighted the memory phase in the classroom model of adaptive immunity.
examples.zh: 我们在「适应性免疫」课堂模型中高亮标出了记忆阶段。

words.enDefinition: Movement toward the body's midline, or toward the reference digit in the hand or foot.

examples.en: The arm model shows adduction as it moves from the side toward the torso.
examples.zh: 上肢模型从侧面靠近躯干时，示范的是「内收」。

examples.en: We drew an inward arrow for adduction on the worksheet's front view of the body.
examples.zh: 我们在练习纸的人体正视图上用向内的箭头标出「内收」。

words.enDefinition: A nucleotide with two phosphate groups that can be converted to ATP in cells.

examples.en: The diagram shows adenosine diphosphate beside a separate phosphate group after the reaction in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型反应完成后，图中把「二磷酸腺苷」画在一个独立的磷酸基团旁边。

examples.en: We identified adenosine diphosphate by counting two phosphate groups in the classroom drawing of the molecule.
examples.zh: 我们数出课堂分子图中有两个磷酸基团，据此认出「二磷酸腺苷」。

collocations: adenosine diphosphate in a reaction diagram
the phosphate groups of adenosine diphosphate

words.enDefinition: A nucleotide with three phosphate groups that couples energy-releasing and energy-requiring processes in cells.

examples.en: The textbook labels adenosine triphosphate beside the arrow linking an energy source to a cellular task.
examples.zh: 教材在连接能量来源与一项细胞活动的箭头旁标出「三磷酸腺苷」。

examples.en: We counted three phosphate groups on adenosine triphosphate in the enlarged molecular diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 我们数出课堂放大分子图上的「三磷酸腺苷」有三个磷酸基团。

collocations: the phosphate groups of adenosine triphosphate

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue rich in cells storing fat, often used for insulation

examples.en: The cutaway model shows a layer of adipose tissue beneath the skin.
examples.zh: 剖切模型展示了皮肤下方的一层「脂肪组织」。

examples.en: We marked the large rounded cells of adipose tissue in the atlas figure.
examples.zh: 我们在图谱上标出了「脂肪组织」中的大型圆形细胞。

words.enDefinition: Outer region of an adrenal gland that produces steroid hormones

examples.en: The adrenal cortex forms the outer band of the gland in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，「肾上腺皮质」形成腺体的外带。

examples.en: We placed the hormone labels beside the adrenal cortex on the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们把激素标签放在课堂图中「肾上腺皮质」的旁边。

words.enDefinition: Endocrine organ on top of each kidney with an outer and inner region

examples.en: The adrenal gland appears above the kidney in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型正视图中，「肾上腺」位于肾脏上方。

examples.en: We marked the adrenal gland separately from the larger organ beneath it.
examples.zh: 我们把「肾上腺」和它下方较大的器官分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Inner region of an adrenal gland that releases epinephrine and related signals

examples.en: The adrenal medulla occupies the inner region of the sliced model gland.
examples.zh: 「肾上腺髓质」占据剖开腺体模型的内部区域。

examples.en: We colored the adrenal medulla differently from the gland's outer band.
examples.zh: 我们用不同颜色区分「肾上腺髓质」和腺体外带。

words.enDefinition: Anterior pituitary signal stimulating the adrenal cortex, particularly its cortisol secretion

examples.en: The chart shows adrenocorticotropic hormone traveling from the pituitary to the adrenal cortex.
examples.zh: 图表显示「促肾上腺皮质激素」从垂体到达肾上腺皮质。

examples.en: We marked the gland that responds to adrenocorticotropic hormone in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型中标出了对「促肾上腺皮质激素」作出响应的腺体。

words.enDefinition: An unfavourable medical occurrence in a study participant, without requiring a causal link to the intervention.

examples.en: The fictional study table lists each adverse event separately from judgements about its possible cause.
examples.zh: 虚构研究表将各「不良事件」与对可能原因的判断分开列出。

examples.en: We checked the denominator for the adverse event counts reported in each group of the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对练习中报告各组「不良事件」计数所用的分母。

words.enDefinition: Small artery bringing blood into the glomerular capillary tuft

examples.en: The arrow from the afferent arteriole points into the capillary tuft in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中从「入球小动脉」出发的箭头指向毛细血管团。

examples.en: We labeled the afferent arteriole on the incoming side of the corpuscle.
examples.zh: 我们在肾小体的血流流入侧标出了「入球小动脉」。

words.enDefinition: Channel carrying lymph into a lymph node from nearby tissues or vessels

examples.en: The arrow in an afferent lymphatic vessel points toward the node in our drawing.
examples.zh: 图中「输入淋巴管」内的箭头指向淋巴结。

examples.en: We marked each afferent lymphatic vessel entering the curved surface of the model node.
examples.zh: 我们标出了从模型淋巴结曲面进入的各根「输入淋巴管」。

collocations: flow through an afferent lymphatic vessel
diagram of an afferent lymphatic vessel

words.enDefinition: the period following a spike in which the membrane voltage is more negative than its resting level

examples.en: The shallow dip after the simulated action potential represents afterhyperpolarization before the voltage returns to baseline.
examples.zh: 模拟动作电位之后的浅凹表示「后超极化」，之后电压才恢复到基线。

examples.en: We shaded afterhyperpolarization where the example trace fell below the baseline following the main spike.
examples.zh: 我们将示例曲线在主要尖峰后低于基线的一段涂色，标出「后超极化」。

words.enDefinition: The rate computed for people within a specified age group.

examples.en: The age-specific rate uses only the relevant age band's event counts and observation time in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「年龄别率」只用对应年龄段的事件数和观察时长计算。

examples.en: We compared each age-specific rate before reading the combined rate for the fictional population as a whole.
examples.zh: 我们先比较各「年龄别率」，再读取整个虚构总体的合计率。

words.enDefinition: A rate adjusted for age composition so populations can be compared on a common age basis.

examples.en: The age-standardised rate uses a common age distribution for comparing the two synthetic populations in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「年龄标准化率」使用同一年龄分布比较两个合成总体。

examples.en: We checked which reference population was used before comparing the age-standardised rate across classroom tables.
examples.zh: 我们先核对采用的参考总体，再比较课堂各表中的「年龄标准化率」。

collocations: reference population for an age-standardised rate

words.enDefinition: Clustering of cells when antibodies link their matching surface markers

examples.en: The textbook depicts agglutination as several red cell drawings linked together.
examples.zh: 教材用相互连接的几个红细胞图形表示「凝集」。

examples.en: We labeled agglutination in the illustration where the cells form visible groups.
examples.zh: 我们将插图中细胞形成可见团簇的现象标为「凝集」。

words.enDefinition: A muscle that produces or contributes directly to a particular movement.

examples.en: The agonist muscle shortens in the simple elbow flexion animation used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂的简化肘部屈曲动画中，「主动肌」缩短。

examples.en: We identified the agonist muscle after the exercise specified which movement to study.
examples.zh: 练习明确了要研究的动作后，我们指出了「主动肌」。

words.enDefinition: White blood cell lacking the prominent granules characteristic of granulocytes

examples.en: The agranulocyte figure lacks the prominent dots shown in the neighboring image.
examples.zh: 这幅「无粒白细胞」图没有相邻图像中那些醒目的小点。

examples.en: We labeled both examples of the agranulocyte group on the comparison chart.
examples.zh: 我们在对比图上标出了「无粒白细胞」组的两个例子。

words.enDefinition: a rounded image feature caused by a trapped air bubble in or above a mounted specimen

examples.en: The circular air bubble artifact overlapped the tissue edge without belonging to the structure in the reference image.
examples.zh: 参考图中，圆形的「气泡伪影」与组织边缘重叠，实际并非该结构的一部分。

examples.en: We labeled the bright ring as an air bubble artifact on the classroom slide image.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂玻片图像上，将那道明亮的圆环标作「气泡伪影」。

collocations: outline of an air bubble artifact
view obstructed by an air bubble artifact

words.enDefinition: opposition to airflow through the respiratory passages, expressed as pressure difference divided by airflow under stated conditions

examples.en: The narrower branch had greater airway resistance than the wider branch in the simplified model.
examples.zh: 在简化模型中，较窄分支的「气道阻力」比更宽分支大。

examples.en: We compared airway resistance by finding the pressure difference needed for the same flow in both models.
examples.zh: 我们求出两种模型达到相同流量所需的压差，从而比较「气道阻力」。

words.enDefinition: Adrenal hormone promoting sodium reabsorption and potassium secretion in the kidney

examples.en: The flowchart links aldosterone to sodium movement in the later tubular segments.
examples.zh: 流程图把「醛固酮」与后段肾小管里的钠转运联系起来。

examples.en: We placed aldosterone among the signals leaving the adrenal cortex on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中将「醛固酮」列入肾上腺皮质释放的信号。

words.enDefinition: One of the alternative forms of a gene or genetic sequence at a particular locus.

examples.en: The allele is represented by a letter in the simple inheritance table for the class.
examples.zh: 课堂简化遗传表用一个字母表示「等位基因」。

examples.en: We compared each allele at the marked locus using the symbolic chromosome diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用符号染色体图比较标记位点上的各个「等位基因」。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of all counted copies at a locus represented by a particular allele.

examples.en: The allele frequency uses the total number of copies at the locus as its denominator.
examples.zh: 「等位基因频率」用该位点的副本总数作为分母。

examples.en: We calculated allele frequency from the symbolic counts in the synthetic classroom dataset.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂合成数据里的符号计数计算「等位基因频率」。

words.enDefinition: The separation of paired alleles into different gametes as their chromosome copies are distributed during meiosis.

examples.en: The diagram shows allele segregation when the two labelled copies end up in separate model gametes.
examples.zh: 两份带标记的副本分别进入不同模型配子时，图中展示的是「等位基因分离」。

examples.en: We traced allele segregation by matching the symbols from each chromosome to the final panel.
examples.zh: 我们把各条染色体的符号对应到最后一幅图，追踪「等位基因分离」。

words.enDefinition: Keeping upcoming assignments from those enrolling participants until the moment each assignment is made.

examples.en: The report discusses allocation concealment separately from whether participants knew their groups after assignment in class.
examples.zh: 课堂报告分别讨论「分配隐藏」和参与者分配后是否知道自己所在组别。

examples.en: We read the allocation concealment statement before reviewing how the fictional trial describes its recruitment.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「分配隐藏」说明，再查看虚构试验对招募的描述。

words.enDefinition: An increase in enzyme activity caused by binding at a regulatory site distinct from the active site.

examples.en: The regulatory arrow in the textbook links allosteric activation to higher activity in the human enzyme model.
examples.zh: 教材中的调节箭头将「变构激活」与人体酶模型中更高的活性联系起来。

examples.en: We found allosteric activation where a regulatory shape bound away from the enzyme's active site.
examples.zh: 我们在调节分子形状结合于酶活性位点以外的位置，找到了「变构激活」的标示。

collocations: allosteric activation of a metabolic enzyme

words.enDefinition: Control of enzyme activity through binding at a site distinct from the active site.

examples.en: The classroom figure illustrates allosteric regulation by showing a change at one site after binding elsewhere.
examples.zh: 课堂图展示某处结合后另一处发生变化，以此说明「变构调节」。

examples.en: We traced the arrow linking the regulatory site to a change in activity during allosteric regulation.
examples.zh: 我们顺着箭头观察「变构调节」如何将调节位点与活性变化联系起来。

collocations: allosteric regulation of a metabolic enzyme

words.enDefinition: A regulatory binding site separate from an enzyme's active site.

examples.en: The diagram marks an allosteric site away from the enzyme pocket that binds the substrate.
examples.zh: 图中在与底物结合的酶凹槽之外，标出一个「变构位点」。

examples.en: We used different colors for the allosteric site and the active site in our classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 课堂草图里，我们用不同颜色表示「变构位点」和活性位点。

collocations: a molecule bound at an allosteric site
the location of an allosteric site

words.enDefinition: The carbon next to the carboxyl group that bears the amino group in a protein-forming amino acid.

examples.en: The molecular picture places the amino group and the side chain around the same alpha carbon.
examples.zh: 分子图中，氨基和侧链都连接在同一个「α碳原子」上。

examples.en: We counted the groups attached to the alpha carbon of glycine in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型中数出甘氨酸「α碳原子」连接的基团。

collocations: a side chain on the alpha carbon
the groups around an alpha carbon

words.enDefinition: A common coiled protein backbone structure stabilized by hydrogen bonds within the same chain segment.

examples.en: The alpha helix was drawn as a coil in one region of the simplified protein model.
examples.zh: 在简化的蛋白质模型中，有一个区域画成卷曲状，表示「α螺旋」。

examples.en: We traced the repeating backbone pattern around the alpha helix in the chapter's close-up drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在本章的放大图上沿「α螺旋」辨认重复的骨架排列。

collocations: an alpha helix in a protein
backbone bonds within an alpha helix

words.enDefinition: a small passage in the respiratory zone with alveoli opening along much of its length

examples.en: In the model, the alveolar duct is lined by openings leading into several small air spaces.
examples.zh: 模型中，「肺泡管」沿线排列着通向多个小气腔的开口。

examples.en: We traced the alveolar duct from a respiratory bronchiole to the air spaces at its end.
examples.zh: 我们从呼吸性细支气管沿「肺泡管」追踪到管末端的气腔。

words.enDefinition: the pressure within the gas spaces of the alveoli

examples.en: The alveolar pressure briefly fell below the plotted atmospheric reference when air entered the model lung.
examples.zh: 空气进入模型肺时，「肺泡压」短暂低于图上标出的参考大气压。

examples.en: We checked when alveolar pressure returned to atmospheric pressure at the end of the simulated breath.
examples.zh: 我们核对了模拟呼吸末段「肺泡压」何时恢复到大气压。

words.enDefinition: a cluster of alveoli opening into a common space at the end of an alveolar duct

examples.en: The model shows several alveoli sharing the common space of one alveolar sac at the branch end.
examples.zh: 模型显示，分支末端的几个肺泡共用同一个「肺泡囊」内的气腔。

examples.en: We drew a bracket around the cluster to mark the alveolar sac on the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图的成簇结构外画上括号，标出「肺泡囊」。

words.enDefinition: the volume of fresh air reaching alveoli available for gas exchange per unit time

examples.en: The model used alveolar ventilation to track fresh air delivered to exchanging regions per minute.
examples.zh: 模型用「肺泡通气量」表示每分钟送入气体交换区的新鲜空气量。

examples.en: At equal minute ventilation and fixed dead space per breath, deeper breaths gave greater alveolar ventilation.
examples.zh: 在每分钟通气量相同、每次呼吸的无效腔容积恒定时，较深呼吸产生更高的「肺泡通气量」。

words.enDefinition: Removal of an amino group from an amino acid, sometimes releasing ammonium.

examples.en: The diagram labels amino acid deamination at the step where a nitrogen group leaves the molecule.
examples.zh: 图中在含氮基团离开分子的一步标出了「氨基酸脱氨」。

examples.en: We compared amino acid deamination with the separate transfer reaction shown elsewhere on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们把「氨基酸脱氨」与课堂图中另一处画出的转移反应作了比较。

collocations: an example of amino acid deamination
nitrogen released during amino acid deamination
a diagram of amino acid deamination

words.enDefinition: An organic compound with amino and carboxyl groups, serving as a protein building block in this context.

examples.en: The textbook shows an amino acid beside a short chain made from several linked units.
examples.zh: 教材把一个「氨基酸」与由若干单元相连的短链画在一起。

examples.en: We identified each amino acid on the chart by comparing the groups attached to its central carbon.
examples.zh: 我们比较各分子中心碳原子所连的基团，辨认表上的各种「氨基酸」。

collocations: the structure of an amino acid
an amino acid in a protein chain

words.enDefinition: The part of an amino acid that forms a unit of a peptide or protein chain.

examples.en: We labeled one amino acid residue in the classroom drawing of a longer human protein chain.
examples.zh: 我们在较长的人体蛋白质链课堂图中标出一个「氨基酸残基」。

examples.en: The chart identifies each amino acid residue by its side chain and position in the sequence.
examples.zh: 图表按侧链和序列位置辨认各个「氨基酸残基」。

collocations: an amino acid residue in a chain
the side chain of an amino acid residue

words.enDefinition: The variable group attached to an amino acid's alpha carbon that distinguishes it from other amino acids.

examples.en: The chart distinguishes each amino acid side chain while drawing the shared backbone in the same way.
examples.zh: 图表以相同方式绘出共同的骨架，分别标示各个「氨基酸侧链」。

examples.en: We highlighted one amino acid side chain to explain why two residues behave differently near water.
examples.zh: 我们高亮一条「氨基酸侧链」，解释两个残基靠近水时为何表现不同。

collocations: identify an amino acid side chain
a charged amino acid side chain
interactions of an amino acid side chain

words.enDefinition: A nitrogen-containing group of the form NH2, which may carry a proton in aqueous environments.

examples.en: The illustration labels the amino group at one side of the central carbon in the free molecule.
examples.zh: 插图在游离分子中心碳原子的一侧标出了「氨基」。

examples.en: We circled the amino group on the free amino acid before looking at the peptide diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先圈出游离氨基酸上的「氨基」，再看肽的示意图。

collocations: an amino group on an amino acid

words.enDefinition: The end of a polypeptide corresponding to the first residue's backbone amino group.

examples.en: The textbook starts the sequence at the amino terminus and reads toward the other end.
examples.zh: 教材从「氨基端」开始写序列，依次读到另一端。

examples.en: We marked the amino terminus on the protein diagram before tracing the chain into the folded region.
examples.zh: 我们在蛋白质图上先标出「氨基端」，再沿链观察折叠区。

collocations: the amino terminus of a polypeptide

words.enDefinition: A molecule containing both water-interacting and water-avoiding regions.

examples.en: We classified the phospholipid as an amphipathic molecule because its head and tails interact differently with water.
examples.zh: 磷脂头部和尾部与水的相互作用不同，因此我们把它归为「两亲性分子」。

examples.en: The tutor colored both regions of the amphipathic molecule to explain its orientation in the membrane sketch.
examples.zh: 辅导老师为「两亲性分子」的两个区域着色，解释它在膜草图中的朝向。

collocations: an amphipathic molecule in a membrane
the regions of an amphipathic molecule

words.enDefinition: Cellular metabolism that builds larger or more complex molecules and typically requires an energy input.

examples.en: The map lists glycogen formation under anabolism because the cell builds a larger storage molecule.
examples.zh: 代谢图把糖原形成归为「合成代谢」，因为细胞形成了较大的储存分子。

examples.en: We used the direction of the arrows to identify anabolism on the classroom diagram of metabolism.
examples.zh: 我们根据箭头方向，在课堂代谢图中辨认「合成代谢」。

words.enDefinition: ATP production by glycolysis without requiring oxygen, with pyruvate reduced to lactate to regenerate NAD+.

examples.en: The muscle cell diagram shows anaerobic glycolysis supplying ATP while the pathway converts pyruvate to lactate.
examples.zh: 肌细胞图显示，「无氧糖酵解」供应 ATP，此时途径将丙酮酸转化为乳酸根。

examples.en: We identified anaerobic glycolysis from the branch ending in lactate on the classroom energy map.
examples.zh: 我们根据课堂能量图中终点为乳酸根的分支，辨认「无氧糖酵解」。

words.enDefinition: The meiotic stage when homologous chromosomes move apart while sister chromatids generally remain joined.

examples.en: The homologues move toward opposite sides during anaphase I in the staged classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂分阶段图中，同源染色体在「减数第一次分裂后期」移向相反两侧。

examples.en: We traced its two joined chromatids as one chromosome moves during anaphase I in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们追踪一条染色体在「减数第一次分裂后期」移动时仍相连的两条染色单体。

words.enDefinition: The stage when sister chromatids separate and move toward opposite sides of the cell.

examples.en: The sister chromatids separate during anaphase II in the final division shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸显示的最后一次分裂中，姐妹染色单体在「减数第二次分裂后期」分离。

examples.en: We followed the two copies moving apart during anaphase II on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上追踪「减数第二次分裂后期」两个副本分开移动的过程。

words.enDefinition: Slice showing structures across the long axis of a body part

examples.en: The anatomical cross section shows rings in a structure that looks long from the side.
examples.zh: 从侧面看很长的结构，在其「解剖横截面」上呈现环形。

examples.en: We compared an anatomical cross section with another view drawn along the structure's length.
examples.zh: 我们将「解剖横截面」与沿结构纵向绘制的另一幅图作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the volume of the conducting airways where no exchange of respiratory gases takes place

examples.en: The model colors the anatomical dead space from the nose down to the last purely conducting branches.
examples.zh: 模型为从鼻部到最后一级单纯传导分支的「解剖无效腔」着色。

examples.en: We subtracted anatomical dead space from tidal volume when estimating fresh air entering alveoli in the ideal model.
examples.zh: 在理想模型中估算进入肺泡的新鲜空气时，我们从潮气量中减去「解剖无效腔」容积。

words.enDefinition: Recognizable bodily feature used to describe the location of nearby structures

examples.en: We used a visible notch as an anatomical landmark on the body model.
examples.zh: 我们把人体模型上的一个可见切迹用作「解剖标志」。

examples.en: The diagram marks an anatomical landmark before locating the smaller structure beside it.
examples.zh: 示意图先标出一个「解剖标志」，再定位它旁边较小的结构。

words.enDefinition: Imaginary line marking the middle of the body in the reference position

examples.en: The dashed anatomical midline runs down the exact center of the front view.
examples.zh: 虚线所示的「人体正中线」沿正视图的中央向下延伸。

examples.en: We used the anatomical midline as a reference for comparing right and left.
examples.zh: 我们以「人体正中线」为参照比较人体的左侧和右侧。

words.enDefinition: a letter or symbol showing how an image corresponds to an anatomical side or direction

examples.en: We checked the anatomical orientation marker before identifying the right side on the reversed-looking anatomy image.
examples.zh: 我们在外观似乎左右相反的解剖图上辨认右侧前，先核对「解剖方位标记」。

examples.en: One anatomical orientation marker indicated the front of the body in the classroom example of a cross section.
examples.zh: 在课堂横切面示例中，有一个「解剖方位标记」指明人体前方。

collocations: position of an anatomical orientation marker

words.enDefinition: Imaginary flat surface used to describe a division through the body

examples.en: The transparent anatomical plane crosses the model from its front to its back.
examples.zh: 透明的「解剖平面」从模型前面穿到后面。

examples.en: We chose an anatomical plane before describing which structures appeared in the section.
examples.zh: 描述切面中出现哪些结构之前，我们先选定了一个「解剖平面」。

words.enDefinition: Upright reference posture with feet and palms forward and arms at sides

examples.en: The chart places the model in anatomical position with both palms facing forward.
examples.zh: 图表中的模型采用双掌朝前的「解剖学姿势」。

examples.en: Directional labels use anatomical position even when the model itself is lying down.
examples.zh: 即使模型本身平躺，方位标注仍以「解剖学姿势」为参照。

words.enDefinition: Difference in bodily structure among individuals within the range being described

examples.en: The atlas illustrates anatomical variation by showing two common versions of one structure.
examples.zh: 图谱展示同一结构的两种常见形态，以说明「解剖变异」。

examples.en: Our lecturer discussed anatomical variation before comparing the outlines in two teaching images.
examples.zh: 老师在比较两张教学图像中的轮廓之前，讨论了「解剖变异」。

words.enDefinition: an ultrasound region showing no detectable internal echoes under the stated imaging conditions

examples.en: The anechoic region appeared dark within the simple fluid model shown on the teaching page.
examples.zh: 在教学页所示的简单含液模型内部，「无回声区」呈暗色。

examples.en: We distinguished the anechoic region from a nearby area that still showed some faint internal echoes.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「无回声区」和邻近仍显示微弱内部回声的区域。

words.enDefinition: An abnormal chromosome complement with one or more individual chromosomes extra or missing, rather than a change in whole sets.

examples.en: The aneuploidy example shows an extra chromosome while the other groups in the synthetic diagram are unchanged.
examples.zh: 「非整倍性」示例显示多出一条染色体，合成图里的其他分组不变。

examples.en: We distinguished aneuploidy from a change involving whole chromosome sets in the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中，将「非整倍性」与整套染色体数目变化区分开。

words.enDefinition: A muscle whose action opposes the movement produced by another muscle at a joint.

examples.en: The antagonist muscle acts in the opposite direction from the prime mover in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「拮抗肌」的作用方向与主要主动肌相反。

examples.en: We identified the antagonist muscle after the example movement changed from flexion to extension.
examples.zh: 示例动作由屈曲变为伸展后，我们指出了「拮抗肌」。

words.enDefinition: Area at the front of the elbow where the arm bends

examples.en: The antecubital region is marked where the elbow bends in the front view.
examples.zh: 正视图中，肘部弯曲处被标为「肘前区」。

examples.en: We labeled the antecubital region before turning the arm model to show its back.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肘前区」，再转动手臂模型展示其背面。

collocations: anterior view of the antecubital region

words.enDefinition: Front portion of the pituitary that produces and secretes several hormones

examples.en: The anterior pituitary is the larger front region in our simplified gland model.
examples.zh: 在简化腺体模型中，「垂体前叶」是前面较大的一部分。

examples.en: We labeled several signals originating in the anterior pituitary on our endocrine chart.
examples.zh: 我们在内分泌图表中标出了几个由「垂体前叶」产生的信号。

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the front of the human body than another structure

examples.en: The chest wall is anterior to the heart in the side view of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型的侧视图里，胸壁位于心脏「前方」。

examples.en: In the diagram, the nose is anterior to the ear on the same side.
examples.zh: 图中鼻子位于同侧耳朵的「前方」。

words.enDefinition: an X-ray projection in which the beam passes through the body from front to back

examples.en: The arrow for the anteroposterior projection enters the front of the torso outline on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂图上，「前后位投照」的箭头从躯干轮廓前侧进入。

examples.en: We checked the label of the anteroposterior projection before comparing it with the reverse beam direction.
examples.zh: 在与相反射线方向作比较前，我们先核对「前后位投照」的标记。

collocations: compare anteroposterior projection with posteroanterior projection

words.enDefinition: Antibody that recognizes the A antigen found on some red cells

examples.en: The diagram matches an anti-A antibody with the A marker shape on a cell.
examples.zh: 示意图把「抗A抗体」与细胞上的 A 标志形状配对。

examples.en: We labeled the anti-A antibody separately from the surface marker in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在图中分别标出了「抗A抗体」和细胞表面标志。

words.enDefinition: Antibody that recognizes the B antigen found on some red cells

examples.en: The model shows an anti-B antibody next to its matching red cell marker.
examples.zh: 模型把一个「抗B抗体」画在与之对应的红细胞标志旁。

examples.en: We used a distinct color for the anti-B antibody in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中用单独一种颜色表示「抗B抗体」。

words.enDefinition: Protein produced by B-lineage cells that binds a particular antigen structure

examples.en: The diagram represents an antibody with two arms and a stem.
examples.zh: 示意图用两条臂和一个柄表示「抗体」。

examples.en: We labeled the antibody beside the cell that secretes it in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中分泌「抗体」的细胞旁标出了这种蛋白。

words.enDefinition: Hormone released from the posterior pituitary that increases kidney water reabsorption

examples.en: The flowchart connects antidiuretic hormone with water movement in the collecting duct.
examples.zh: 流程图将「抗利尿激素」与集合管中的水分转运联系起来。

examples.en: We marked the release site for antidiuretic hormone on the simplified pituitary diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化垂体图中标出了「抗利尿激素」的释放部位。

words.enDefinition: Molecular structure that can be recognized by an antibody or lymphocyte receptor

examples.en: The worksheet uses a colored shape to represent an antigen.
examples.zh: 习题用有颜色的形状表示一个「抗原」。

examples.en: We marked an antigen on the surface of the illustrated cell.
examples.zh: 我们在图示细胞的表面标出了一个「抗原」。

words.enDefinition: Part of an antibody or receptor that contacts its corresponding antigen

examples.en: We highlighted the antigen-binding site at the end of one illustrated antibody arm.
examples.zh: 我们在图示抗体一条臂的末端高亮标出了「抗原结合位点」。

examples.en: The textbook shows the antigen-binding site as a small area within the larger outline.
examples.zh: 教材将「抗原结合位点」画成较大轮廓内的一小片区域。

words.enDefinition: Display of antigen fragments on a cell surface for T cell recognition

examples.en: The figure illustrates antigen presentation using a small symbol on the outer membrane.
examples.zh: 图中用外膜上的一个小符号说明「抗原呈递」。

examples.en: We marked antigen presentation just before recognition in the textbook's simplified sequence.
examples.zh: 我们在教材的简化顺序图中将「抗原呈递」标在识别之前。

words.enDefinition: Cell displaying antigen fragments on its surface for recognition by T cells

examples.en: The drawing shows an antigen-presenting cell facing a T cell across a narrow space.
examples.zh: 图中「抗原呈递细胞」与一个 T 细胞隔着窄隙相对。

examples.en: We located the antigen-presenting cell on the display side of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中呈递抗原的一侧找到了「抗原呈递细胞」。

words.enDefinition: the curved portion of the aorta between its ascending and descending portions

examples.en: The classroom drawing shows several arteries branching from the upper surface of the aortic arch.
examples.zh: 课堂图画出了从「主动脉弓」上缘分出的几条动脉。

examples.en: We followed the aortic arch backward and leftward before continuing down the descending aorta on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上沿「主动脉弓」向后、向左追踪，然后沿降主动脉向下。

words.enDefinition: the semilunar valve between the left ventricle and the aorta

examples.en: The aortic valve closes to limit backward flow as the left ventricle relaxes in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 在课堂动画中，左心室舒张时，「主动脉瓣」关闭以限制血液回流。

examples.en: We placed the aortic valve label at the outlet from the chamber with the thicker wall.
examples.zh: 我们把「主动脉瓣」标签放在壁较厚的心室的出口处。

words.enDefinition: a control in the illumination path that limits the angles of the light reaching a microscope specimen

examples.en: The aperture diaphragm narrows the light cone drawn beneath the slide in the classroom optics diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂光学图中的「孔径光阑」使玻片下方所绘的光锥变窄。

examples.en: We labeled the aperture diaphragm near the condenser in the illustrated transmitted-light microscope assembly.
examples.zh: 我们在透射光显微镜组件图中，在聚光镜附近标出了「孔径光阑」。

collocations: light cone limited by the aperture diaphragm

words.enDefinition: Side of an epithelial cell facing a lumen or exposed space

examples.en: The apical surface faces the open space at the center of the tube.
examples.zh: 「顶端面」朝向管道中央的开放空间。

examples.en: We drew the apical surface along the side that faces the free space.
examples.zh: 我们沿朝向开放空间的一侧画出了「顶端面」。

collocations: apical surface of an epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: a skin gland in certain body regions that generally opens into a hair follicle

examples.en: In the underarm skin diagram, the apocrine sweat gland empties into a hair follicle through its duct.
examples.zh: 腋窝皮肤图中，「大汗腺」经导管开口于毛囊。

examples.en: We compared the location of the apocrine sweat gland opening with the one reaching the skin surface directly.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「大汗腺」开口位置与直接到达皮肤表面的另一处开口位置。

collocations: opening of an apocrine sweat gland

words.enDefinition: The protein part of an enzyme without its required cofactor.

examples.en: The first panel labels the apoenzyme before the required nonprotein component appears in the next frame.
examples.zh: 第一幅图标出「脱辅基酶」，所需的非蛋白组分在下一帧才出现。

examples.en: We compared the apoenzyme with the complete enzyme shown beside it in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们把「脱辅基酶」与课堂图中旁边的完整酶进行了比较。

words.enDefinition: A broad, flat tendon connecting a muscle to a bone or to another structure.

examples.en: The aponeurosis appears as a broad sheet at the end of the muscle in the labelled anatomy diagram.
examples.zh: 带标注的解剖图上，「腱膜」表现为肌肉末端的一片宽阔薄层。

examples.en: We compared an aponeurosis with the narrower tendon on the neighbouring tissue diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「腱膜」与相邻组织图中较窄的肌腱作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Body region consisting of the upper and lower limbs

examples.en: The appendicular region includes the arms and legs in the colored model.
examples.zh: 在彩色模型中，「附肢部」包括双臂和双腿。

examples.en: We used a separate color for the appendicular region on both sides.
examples.zh: 我们用另一种颜色标出了人体两侧的「附肢部」。

words.enDefinition: The division of the skeleton consisting of the limb bones and the shoulder and pelvic girdles.

examples.en: The appendicular skeleton includes the arm bones marked in green on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 「附肢骨骼」包括课堂示意图上用绿色标出的上肢骨。

examples.en: We classified the shoulder girdle under the appendicular skeleton before labelling the individual bones.
examples.zh: 我们先把肩带归入「附肢骨骼」，再标注各块骨。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which evidence is relevant to a specified population, setting, or decision context.

examples.en: The applicability of evidence depends on whether the fictional study setting matches the one in the question.
examples.zh: 「证据适用性」取决于虚构研究的场景是否与问题中的场景相匹配。

examples.en: We discussed applicability of evidence after reading the participant characteristics in the classroom review.
examples.zh: 我们阅读课堂综述里的参与者特征后，讨论了「证据适用性」。

words.enDefinition: the middle meningeal layer lying between the dura and pia and covering the subarachnoid space

examples.en: The classroom drawing places the arachnoid mater inside the dura but above the fluid-filled space.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「蛛网膜」位于硬膜内侧、充有液体的间隙上方。

examples.en: We labeled the arachnoid mater before tracing the space beneath it around the model of the brain.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「蛛网膜」，再追踪它下方围绕脑模型的间隙。

words.enDefinition: Common loose connective tissue containing scattered cells and several loosely arranged fiber types

examples.en: The diagram labels areolar connective tissue beneath the epithelial surface in the teaching model.
examples.zh: 图中在教学模型的上皮表面下方标注了「蜂窝状结缔组织」。

examples.en: We located scattered cells among the fibers of areolar connective tissue in the enlarged image.
examples.zh: 我们在放大图中找到了散布于「蜂窝状结缔组织」纤维之间的细胞。

words.enDefinition: a small band of smooth muscle attached to a hair follicle whose contraction raises the hair

examples.en: We identified the arrector pili muscle as a slanted band linking the follicle to superficial dermis in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将连接毛囊与浅层真皮的一束斜走结构标为「竖毛肌」。

examples.en: The animation shows how contraction of an arrector pili muscle changes the angle of the modeled hair.
examples.zh: 动画显示，一处「竖毛肌」收缩时，模型中毛发的角度怎样改变。

collocations: attach to an arrector pili muscle

words.enDefinition: a small arterial vessel that leads toward capillaries and regulates resistance to blood flow

examples.en: The diagram shows an arteriole branching before the blood reaches the narrow capillary network in the tissue.
examples.zh: 图中显示，血液到达组织中狭窄的毛细血管网络前，一条「微动脉」先发生分支。

examples.en: We identified the smooth muscle surrounding the arteriole on the larger image supplied for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习给出的放大图中辨认出包围「微动脉」的平滑肌。

words.enDefinition: A smooth layer of cartilage covering bone surfaces that meet within a joint.

examples.en: The articular cartilage is drawn as a smooth layer on the end of the bone.
examples.zh: 「关节软骨」画成覆盖骨端的一层光滑结构。

examples.en: We traced the articular cartilage along both joint surfaces in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图示上沿两个关节面查看「关节软骨」。

collocations: articular cartilage covering a joint surface

words.enDefinition: An analysis grouping participants by the intervention they actually received, regardless of original assignment.

examples.en: The as-treated analysis groups the fictional participants by the diary format they used during follow-up.
examples.zh: 「按实际干预分析」按虚构参与者随访期间实际使用的日志版式分组。

examples.en: We compared the as-treated analysis with the table organised by original assignment in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「按实际干预分析」与按原分配组整理的表格作比较。

words.enDefinition: the first segment of the aorta, rising from the aortic valve to the aortic arch

examples.en: We traced the ascending aorta from the valve to the point where it began arching backward.
examples.zh: 我们从瓣膜沿「升主动脉」追踪到它开始向后弯曲的位置。

examples.en: The first coronary branches arise near the beginning of the ascending aorta in the labeled illustration.
examples.zh: 在标注图中，最初的冠状动脉分支起于「升主动脉」的起始段附近。

words.enDefinition: Part of the colon running upward along the body's right side

examples.en: The ascending colon runs upward on the right side of the model's body.
examples.zh: 模型中，「升结肠」沿人体右侧向上延伸。

examples.en: We traced the ascending colon from the pouch toward the upper bend.
examples.zh: 我们沿「升结肠」从盲肠囊状处向上描到弯曲处。

collocations: upper end of the ascending colon

words.expression: ascending limb of the nephron loop
words.lemma: ascending limb of the nephron loop
words.enDefinition: Part of the hairpin-shaped tubule carrying fluid back toward the kidney cortex
acceptedEnVariants: ascending limb of the nephron loop
ascending limb of the loop of Henle

examples.en: The ascending limb of the nephron loop returns toward the kidney's outer part in the diagram.
examples.zh: 在图中，「肾单位袢升支」折返并朝肾脏外部的皮质方向延伸。

examples.en: We colored the ascending limb of the nephron loop after labeling the downward segment.
examples.zh: 我们给向下的一段加注名称后，为「肾单位袢升支」上色。

collocations: identify the ascending limb of the nephron loop
flow through the ascending limb of the nephron loop
diagram of the ascending limb of the nephron loop

words.enDefinition: A specified time at which an outcome or other study measurement is recorded.

examples.en: The assessment time point for the outcome is marked at the end of the fictional calendar.
examples.zh: 结局的「评估时点」标在虚构日程的末尾。

examples.en: We checked the assessment time point because the two classroom tables describe different follow-up visits.
examples.zh: 我们核对「评估时点」，因为两张课堂表描述的是不同的随访时点。

words.enDefinition: a central nervous system glial cell that helps maintain the environment around neurons and blood vessels

examples.en: The teaching diagram shows an astrocyte with processes reaching toward neurons and a nearby blood vessel.
examples.zh: 教学图上的「星形胶质细胞」伸出突起，接近神经元和一根邻近血管。

examples.en: We linked the astrocyte to maintenance of the extracellular environment in the classroom tissue model.
examples.zh: 我们将「星形胶质细胞」与课堂组织模型中细胞外环境的维持联系起来。

words.enDefinition: The cleavage of ATP by water, often yielding ADP and inorganic phosphate.

examples.en: The model shows ATP hydrolysis producing ADP and inorganic phosphate during normal activity in a human cell.
examples.zh: 模型显示，人体细胞正常活动时，「ATP 水解」生成 ADP 和无机磷酸盐。

examples.en: We located ATP hydrolysis on the energy diagram before following the next coupled reaction in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先在能量图中找出「ATP 水解」，再看紧随其后的偶联反应。

words.enDefinition: The enzyme that makes ATP using energy from protons moving across a membrane.

examples.en: The mitochondrial drawing labels ATP synthase where protons return across the inner membrane toward the matrix.
examples.zh: 线粒体图在质子跨内膜回到基质的位置标出了「ATP 合酶」。

examples.en: We identified ATP synthase next to the arrow showing the formation of ATP in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中表示 ATP 形成的箭头旁找到了「ATP 合酶」。

words.enDefinition: The continual consumption and regeneration of ATP in cells, often described as a rate.

examples.en: The lecture linked ATP turnover to the continual use and replacement of ATP in an active muscle cell.
examples.zh: 课程把「ATP 周转」与活动肌细胞中 ATP 持续消耗和再生联系起来。

examples.en: The two arrows represent ATP turnover even when the amount present stays similar in the model.
examples.zh: 即使模型中的 ATP 含量保持大致不变，两个箭头仍表示「ATP 周转」。

words.enDefinition: the spread of electrical activation across the atrial muscle before atrial contraction

examples.en: The first small wave in the drawing represents atrial depolarization before the atria contract in the model.
examples.zh: 模型图中的第一个小波表示心房收缩前的「心房去极化」。

examples.en: The classroom animation highlights the spread of atrial depolarization from the right atrium across both upper chambers.
examples.zh: 课堂动画突出显示「心房去极化」从右心房向两个上方心腔传播。

collocations: atrial depolarization on an ECG trace

words.enDefinition: the part of a heartbeat when the atria contract and add blood to the ventricles

examples.en: The animation shows atrial systole adding the last portion of blood to the ventricles before they contract.
examples.zh: 动画中，「心房收缩期」在心室收缩前将最后一部分血液送入心室。

examples.en: We marked atrial systole after the atrial electrical wave on the timeline of the heartbeat.
examples.zh: 我们在心跳时间线的心房电活动波形后面标出了「心房收缩期」。

words.enDefinition: the conduction pathway carrying impulses from the atrioventricular node toward the ventricular bundle branches

examples.en: The arrow from the node follows the atrioventricular bundle into the upper ventricular septum in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，从结点出发的箭头沿「房室束」进入室间隔上部。

examples.en: We labeled the atrioventricular bundle before showing its division into two branches in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型上，我们先标出「房室束」，再展示它分为两支。

words.enDefinition: the conduction tissue that normally delays signals from the atria before they reach the ventricles

examples.en: The atrioventricular node delays electrical conduction briefly between atrial and ventricular activation in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 在课堂动画中，房室之间的电传导在「房室结」处有短暂延迟。

examples.en: We identified the atrioventricular node near the lower part of the interatrial septum on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中房间隔下部附近找到了「房室结」。

words.enDefinition: a valve between an atrium and a ventricle that helps prevent flow back into the atrium

examples.en: The diagram shows an atrioventricular valve opening as blood flows from an atrium into its ventricle.
examples.zh: 图中显示，血液从心房流向相应心室时，所示「房室瓣」打开。

examples.en: We identified each atrioventricular valve by locating the junction between its atrium and ventricle.
examples.zh: 我们在每组心房与心室的连接处辨认出相应的「房室瓣」。

words.enDefinition: Systematic distortion arising when missing or incomplete follow-up information affects the comparison of outcomes.

examples.en: The fictional review considers attrition bias after many records were missing from one follow-up group.
examples.zh: 虚构综述发现一个随访组缺失许多记录后，对「失访偏倚」进行了考虑。

examples.en: We read the reasons for missing observations before describing the risk of attrition bias in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读观测缺失的原因，再描述「失访偏倚」风险。

words.enDefinition: a sensory cell of the cochlea that converts movement of its hair bundle into an electrical response

examples.en: The diagram shows an auditory hair cell responding when its hair bundle bends in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型图显示，毛束弯曲时，「听觉毛细胞」发生响应。

examples.en: We marked the auditory hair cell within the receptor layer shown in the magnified section of the cochlea.
examples.zh: 我们在耳蜗放大切面所示感受器层中标出「听觉毛细胞」。

collocations: hair bundle of an auditory hair cell

words.enDefinition: the three small middle-ear bones that transmit vibration from the eardrum to the inner ear

examples.en: The classroom ear model shows three auditory ossicles forming a short chain beyond the eardrum.
examples.zh: 课堂耳部模型显示，三块「听小骨」在鼓膜之后连成短链。

examples.en: We followed the direction of vibration through the auditory ossicles before identifying the inner ear entrance.
examples.zh: 我们沿「听小骨」追踪振动传递的方向，然后辨认通向内耳的开口。

words.enDefinition: the system that regulates internal organs through neural control of smooth muscle, heart muscle and glands

examples.en: The model uses the autonomic nervous system to represent changes in heart activity during a posture shift.
examples.zh: 模型用「自主神经系统」表示姿势改变时心脏活动发生的变化。

examples.en: We followed a pathway from the autonomic nervous system to a gland in the lecture drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在讲义图上沿「自主神经系统」的一条通路追踪到一处腺体。

collocations: divisions of the autonomic nervous system
control by the autonomic nervous system

words.enDefinition: Transmission of a trait associated with one copy of a dominant allele at an autosomal locus.

examples.en: The worksheet models autosomal dominant inheritance using a numbered chromosome and one labelled allele copy.
examples.zh: 练习用编号的染色体和一份带标记的等位基因展示「常染色体显性遗传」。

examples.en: We identified autosomal dominant inheritance from the stated rules in the fictional family exercise.
examples.zh: 我们依据虚构家系练习的给定规则识别「常染色体显性遗传」。

words.enDefinition: Transmission of a trait expressed when both copies of an autosomal gene have relevant recessive variants.

examples.en: The exercise uses autosomal recessive inheritance to explain why two labelled copies are needed in this model.
examples.zh: 练习用「常染色体隐性遗传」说明为什么此模型中需要两份带标记的副本。

examples.en: We followed autosomal recessive inheritance across the three generations drawn for the fictional family.
examples.zh: 我们沿虚构家系图的三代追踪「常染色体隐性遗传」。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome other than a sex chromosome.

examples.en: The autosome in the figure belongs to one of the numbered pairs in the human set.
examples.zh: 图中的「常染色体」属于人类染色体中用数字编号的某一对。

examples.en: We identified the autosome before reading the separate labels for the sex chromosomes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先辨认这条「常染色体」，再读性染色体单独的标签。

words.enDefinition: Central body region comprising the head, neck, and trunk

examples.en: The atlas shades the axial region from the head down through the trunk.
examples.zh: 图谱用阴影标出从头部向下贯穿躯干的「中轴部」。

examples.en: We marked the axial region before identifying the parts extending from the trunk.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「中轴部」，再识别从躯干伸出的部分。

words.enDefinition: The division of the skeleton that includes the bones of the head and neck, vertebral column, ribs, and sternum.

examples.en: The axial skeleton is shaded blue in the front view of the anatomy model.
examples.zh: 解剖模型的正视图中，「中轴骨骼」涂成蓝色。

examples.en: We identified the ribs as part of the axial skeleton on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂挂图上指出肋骨属于「中轴骨骼」。

words.enDefinition: the neuronal process specialized for conducting action potentials from their initiation region toward target cells

examples.en: The animation shows an electrical signal traveling along the axon toward its branches at the far end.
examples.zh: 动画显示，电信号沿「轴突」向远端的各个分支传播。

examples.en: We marked the axon after locating the long process leaving the cell body in the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先找到教学图中从胞体延出的一条长突起，再将它标记为「轴突」。

words.enDefinition: the tapered part of a neuronal cell body that joins it to the start of the axon

examples.en: The axon hillock appears as a narrowing at the junction between the cell body and axon.
examples.zh: 在胞体与轴突的交界处，「轴丘」表现为逐渐变窄的一段。

examples.en: We shaded the axon hillock separately from the adjoining initial segment in the enlarged classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的课堂图中，用不同的颜色分别标出「轴丘」和邻接的轴突起始段。

words.enDefinition: the first specialized segment of an axon where action potentials typically begin

examples.en: The animated signal first became an action potential in the axon initial segment of the model neuron.
examples.zh: 在模型神经元的动画里，信号最先在「轴突起始段」变成动作电位。

examples.en: We labeled the axon initial segment just beyond the taper of the cell body on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中胞体逐渐变细的位置之后标出「轴突起始段」。

collocations: action potential initiation at the axon initial segment

words.enDefinition: the end of an axon branch that communicates with a target cell at a synapse

examples.en: The drawing places the axon terminal close to the target cell without a visible connection between their membranes.
examples.zh: 图中「轴突末梢」靠近靶细胞，两者的细胞膜之间没有画出直接连接。

examples.en: We followed the signal down the branch to the axon terminal in the classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 在课堂模拟中，我们沿分支追踪信号直到「轴突末梢」。

words.enDefinition: Adaptive immune cell that can give rise to antibody-secreting and memory cells

examples.en: The worksheet follows a B lymphocyte toward two different outcomes in the chart.
examples.zh: 习题沿图表追踪一个「B淋巴细胞」的两种不同后续情况。

examples.en: We marked the B lymphocyte before labeling the antibody-producing descendant beside it.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「B淋巴细胞」，再标注旁边产生抗体的后代细胞。

words.enDefinition: a two-dimensional ultrasound view in which brightness represents the processed strength of returning echoes

examples.en: The B-mode ultrasound image displays relatively strong echoes as bright marks in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的「B型超声图像」用亮点显示较强的回声。

examples.en: We compared the two dimensions shown in a B-mode ultrasound image with the underlying classroom anatomical drawing.
examples.zh: 我们对照「B型超声图像」所显示的二维截面与对应的课堂解剖图。

collocations: brightness on a B-mode ultrasound image
B-mode ultrasound image of a section

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint in which a rounded bone head fits a cup-shaped depression and moves about several axes.

examples.en: The ball-and-socket joint lets the thigh bone model move in several directions at the hip.
examples.zh: 「球窝关节」让股骨模型可以在髋部向多个方向活动。

examples.en: We identified the rounded head and cup of the ball-and-socket joint in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型上找出「球窝关节」的圆形骨端和杯状关节窝。

words.enDefinition: a short-term feedback response in which arterial stretch receptors help regulate blood pressure

examples.en: The classroom model of the baroreceptor reflex includes signals traveling from stretched arteries toward the brainstem.
examples.zh: 课堂的「压力感受性反射」模型包含从受到牵张的动脉传向脑干的信号。

examples.en: We discussed the baroreceptor reflex after the animation showed a sudden change in modeled arterial pressure.
examples.zh: 动画展示模型动脉压发生突变之后，我们讨论了「压力感受性反射」。

words.enDefinition: groups of deep gray matter in the hemispheres that participate in circuits for movement and other functions

examples.en: The basal nuclei appear as dark gray regions beneath the cortex in the classroom brain section.
examples.zh: 课堂用的脑切面中，「基底核」是皮层下方的几处深灰色区域。

examples.en: We followed motor circuit arrows through the basal nuclei before they returned toward the cortex.
examples.zh: 我们先沿运动环路的箭头经过「基底核」，再返回皮层方向。

collocations: role of the basal nuclei in movement

words.enDefinition: Cell side facing the supporting layer beneath an epithelial sheet

examples.en: We labeled the basal surface where the epithelial cells meet the supporting layer.
examples.zh: 我们在上皮细胞与支撑层相接的位置标出了「基底面」。

examples.en: The figure shows the basal surface opposite the side facing the open space.
examples.zh: 图中「基底面」位于朝向开放空间的一面的对侧。

collocations: basal surface of an epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: A table describing the study groups at the start using relevant measured participant characteristics.

examples.en: The baseline characteristics table describes the fictional participants before their follow-up records are summarised in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「基线特征表」描述虚构参与者的起始特征，后面才汇总其随访记录。

examples.en: We read the baseline characteristics table to understand who was included in each study group.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「基线特征表」，了解各研究组纳入的是哪些人。

collocations: variables in a baseline characteristics table
group summaries in a baseline characteristics table

words.enDefinition: Thin extracellular layer supporting and anchoring an overlying epithelial sheet

examples.en: The basement membrane appears as a thin boundary beneath the row of epithelial cells.
examples.zh: 「基底膜」在成排上皮细胞下方呈现为一条薄薄的边界。

examples.en: We traced the basement membrane between the epithelium and the underlying connective tissue.
examples.zh: 我们描出了位于上皮与下方结缔组织之间的「基底膜」。

words.enDefinition: An amino acid side chain with a group that can accept a proton.

examples.en: The textbook showed one basic side chain carrying a positive charge at the stated cellular pH.
examples.zh: 教材显示，在所给的细胞 pH 条件下，一条「碱性侧链」带正电。

examples.en: We compared a basic side chain with the uncharged polar group drawn beside it in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「碱性侧链」与旁边画出的不带电极性基团相比较。

collocations: a positively charged basic side chain
a basic side chain in a protein

words.enDefinition: the membrane in the cochlea that supports the organ of Corti and vibrates in a frequency-dependent pattern

examples.en: The animation shows the basilar membrane moving most strongly at different positions for two simulated tones.
examples.zh: 对两个模拟音调，动画所示「耳蜗基底膜」振动最强的位置不同。

examples.en: We traced the basilar membrane beneath the hair cell region in the enlarged cross section of the cochlea.
examples.zh: 我们在耳蜗放大横切面里，沿毛细胞区域下方追踪「耳蜗基底膜」。

collocations: frequency response of the basilar membrane

words.enDefinition: Circulating granulocyte with dark granules containing histamine and other signaling substances

examples.en: The atlas depicts a basophil with dark granules across much of the cell.
examples.zh: 图谱展示一个「嗜碱性粒细胞」，其大部分区域可见深色颗粒。

examples.en: We located the basophil on the chart of circulating immune cells.
examples.zh: 我们在循环中的免疫细胞图表上找到了「嗜碱性粒细胞」。

words.enDefinition: staining of tissue components with affinity for basic dyes, often associated with nucleic acid-rich structures

examples.en: The basophilic staining was most prominent in the dark nuclei of the cells shown in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 在教学图所示细胞中，深色细胞核的「嗜碱性着色」最明显。

examples.en: We marked basophilic staining separately from the pink regions in our description of the section.
examples.zh: 我们在切片描述中将「嗜碱性着色」与粉色区域分别标记。

words.enDefinition: A protein backbone structure formed by neighboring strands linked by backbone hydrogen bonds.

examples.en: The beta sheet looked like several arrows arranged side by side in the classroom ribbon drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂丝带图上的「β折叠」看起来像几个并排的箭头。

examples.en: We compared the strand directions within the beta sheet shown in the textbook's labeled model.
examples.zh: 我们比较了教材标注模型中「β折叠」内各条链段的方向。

collocations: identify a beta sheet in a protein

words.enDefinition: A two-headed muscle at the front of the upper arm that helps flex the elbow and supinate the forearm.

examples.en: The biceps brachii is shown at the front of the upper arm in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图把「肱二头肌」画在上臂前侧。

examples.en: We labelled biceps brachii before following the model of elbow bending and palm rotation.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肱二头肌」，再看示范屈肘和前臂旋转的模型。

words.enDefinition: Disc-shaped form with a depression in the middle of both surfaces

examples.en: The side view shows the red cell as a biconcave disc in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们的侧视图把红细胞画成「双凹圆盘」。

examples.en: We used a biconcave disc to represent the cell's shape in the model.
examples.zh: 我们用「双凹圆盘」表示模型中这种细胞的形状。

words.enDefinition: Present or described on both the right and left sides

examples.en: The drawing shows a bilateral arrangement with a matching component on each side.
examples.zh: 该图显示了左右两侧都有相应组成部分的「双侧」排列。

examples.en: We added bilateral labels for structures shown on both sides of the body.
examples.zh: 我们给图中在人体左右两边都出现的结构加上了「双侧」标注。

words.enDefinition: Liquid made by the liver that assists fat digestion in the intestine

examples.en: The lecture shows bile entering the first part of the small intestine.
examples.zh: 课堂图示中，「胆汁」流入小肠的第一段。

examples.en: We used different arrows for bile and other digestive secretions in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中用不同的箭头区分「胆汁」和其他消化分泌物。

words.enDefinition: A natural macromolecule made of covalently linked units derived from smaller molecules.

examples.en: The textbook depicts glycogen as a biological polymer whose glucose units form a branched structure.
examples.zh: 教材把糖原画成一种「生物聚合物」，其葡萄糖单元形成分支结构。

examples.en: We compared the backbone of a biological polymer with the separate building blocks in the labeled drawing.
examples.zh: 在标注图中，我们将「生物聚合物」的主链与单独的构成单元进行了比较。

collocations: the building blocks of a biological polymer

words.enDefinition: A molecule that occurs in living systems and participates in their structure or function.

examples.en: The first diagram shows glucose as a biomolecule used in the energy metabolism of human cells.
examples.zh: 第一幅图把葡萄糖列为参与人体细胞能量代谢的「生物分子」。

examples.en: The class compared one small biomolecule with a much larger protein in the chapter's introductory illustration.
examples.zh: 看本章的导读图时，我们将一种小「生物分子」与一种大得多的蛋白质作比较。

words.enDefinition: Triangular internal region between the two ureter openings and the urethral opening

examples.en: Three marked openings outline the bladder trigone in our classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图上三个标出的开口勾勒出「膀胱三角」。

examples.en: The guide shades the bladder trigone at the bottom of the bladder model.
examples.zh: 导图在膀胱模型底部用阴影表示「膀胱三角」。

words.enDefinition: the selective barrier at brain microvessels that regulates movement of substances from blood into nervous tissue

examples.en: The diagram shows tightly joined vessel cells contributing to the blood-brain barrier in the brain capillary model.
examples.zh: 在脑毛细血管模型中，图示紧密相接的血管细胞参与组成「血脑屏障」。

examples.en: We used the blood-brain barrier to explain why different substances cross the illustrated vessel wall at different rates.
examples.zh: 我们用「血脑屏障」解释为何不同物质穿过图示血管壁的速率不同。

words.enDefinition: Linked reactions converting soluble fibrinogen into a fibrin network

examples.en: The blood coagulation diagram ends with threads of fibrin around the platelet group.
examples.zh: 「血液凝固」示意图的末尾显示血小板团簇周围出现纤维蛋白丝。

examples.en: The blood coagulation flowchart begins with soluble substances and ends with a fibrin network.
examples.zh: 「血液凝固」流程图从可溶性物质开始，最终形成纤维蛋白网。

words.enDefinition: Category based on the presence or absence of specified red cell markers

examples.en: The fictional card lists a blood group beside its surface marker symbols.
examples.zh: 虚构教学卡片在表面标志符号旁列出一种「血型」。

examples.en: We matched each blood group label to its red cell drawing in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上把各个「血型」标签与对应的红细胞示意图配对。

words.enDefinition: Liquid portion of circulating blood carrying dissolved substances and suspended formed elements

examples.en: The drawing shows blood plasma surrounding the cells in the illustrated vessel.
examples.zh: 图中「血浆」包围着所示血管里的血细胞。

examples.en: We shaded blood plasma as the fluid portion in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中用阴影表示液体部分，也就是「血浆」。

words.enDefinition: The liquid remaining after blood has clotted, depleted of fibrinogen and other components consumed or retained in the clot.

examples.en: The textbook labels blood serum as the liquid remaining after the illustrated clot forms.
examples.zh: 教材把图示血凝块形成后剩余的液体标为「血清」。

examples.en: We compared blood serum with plasma on the chart of blood components.
examples.zh: 我们在血液成分图上比较了「血清」和血浆。

words.enDefinition: Internal compartment in the body that contains or surrounds an anatomical structure

examples.en: We shaded each body cavity in the cutaway drawing of the torso.
examples.zh: 我们在躯干剖视图中给每个「体腔」涂上了阴影。

examples.en: The tutor asked which body cavity contained the highlighted structure in the diagram.
examples.zh: 老师问，图中高亮结构位于哪个「体腔」。

words.enDefinition: Part of the body distinguished by where its water and solutes reside

examples.en: We gave each body fluid compartment a different color in our distribution diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在体液分布图中给每个「体液区室」分配了不同颜色。

examples.en: The model places a cell membrane along one body fluid compartment boundary.
examples.zh: 模型将细胞膜画成其中一个「体液区室」的边界。

collocations: volume of a body fluid compartment

words.enDefinition: the reduction in hemoglobin's oxygen affinity as carbon dioxide rises or pH falls, favoring oxygen release

examples.en: The model illustrates the Bohr effect with a lower oxygen saturation at the same oxygen pressure after acidification.
examples.zh: 模型通过酸度增加后同一氧分压下的饱和度降低，展示了「波尔效应」。

examples.en: We used the Bohr effect to explain why the modeled hemoglobin released more oxygen at lower pH.
examples.zh: 我们用「波尔效应」解释模拟血红蛋白在 pH 较低时为何释放更多氧。

collocations: oxygen release associated with the Bohr effect

words.enDefinition: a CT display setting that emphasizes differences in attenuation within and around bone

examples.en: The bone window showed fine differences in the light bone region on the supplied classroom image.
examples.zh: 在给出的课堂图像上，「骨窗」显示出较亮骨区里的细微差异。

examples.en: We used the bone window example to distinguish display settings from changes to the underlying scan itself.
examples.zh: 我们用「骨窗」示例区分显示设置变化与原有扫描数据本身的变化。

collocations: image shown in a bone window

words.enDefinition: A muscle beneath the biceps brachii that flexes the elbow.

examples.en: The brachialis is marked beneath the biceps in the cutaway view of the upper arm.
examples.zh: 上臂剖面图把「肱肌」标在肱二头肌的深面。

examples.en: We compared the location of brachialis with the more superficial muscle in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上比较「肱肌」与一块较浅层的肌肉的位置。

words.enDefinition: the stalk-like part of the brain containing the midbrain, pons and medulla and connecting to the spinal cord

examples.en: The brainstem joins the spinal cord at the lower end of the classroom model's central section.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中央切面的下端，「脑干」与脊髓相连。

examples.en: We bracketed three labeled regions together to identify the brainstem on the midsagittal illustration in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在正中矢状面图上用括号圈出三个有标注的区域，把它们归为「脑干」。

words.enDefinition: An amino acid with a branched aliphatic side chain, such as leucine, isoleucine, or valine.

examples.en: We identified leucine as a branched-chain amino acid by tracing the carbon branch in its structure.
examples.zh: 我们沿结构图观察亮氨酸的碳链分支，将它归为「支链氨基酸」。

examples.en: The chart placed valine in the branched-chain amino acid group beside two other similar molecules.
examples.zh: 图表将缬氨酸放入「支链氨基酸」一组，旁边列出另外两个相似分子。

collocations: an example of a branched-chain amino acid

words.enDefinition: microscopy in which transmitted light gives a bright background against which absorbing structures appear darker

examples.en: The example uses brightfield microscopy to show a stained tissue section against a light background.
examples.zh: 该示例用「明场显微术」在明亮背景上呈现染色组织切片。

examples.en: We identified brightfield microscopy from the bright open regions surrounding the darker structures in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们依据教学图中围绕较暗结构的明亮空白区域，辨认出「明场显微术」。

words.enDefinition: a small airway branch in the lungs that lacks cartilage in its wall

examples.en: The model highlights a bronchiole as a narrow continuation of a larger branch within the lung.
examples.zh: 模型突出显示「细支气管」是肺内较大分支向前延伸的一条细小通道。

examples.en: We compared the wall of a bronchiole with that of a cartilage-supported bronchus in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们比较了图谱中「细支气管」管壁与有软骨支撑的支气管管壁。

words.enDefinition: The thin layer containing white blood cells and platelets between the plasma and red-cell layers of separated blood.

examples.en: The buffy coat appears as a thin band between two much wider layers.
examples.zh: 「白膜层」在两个宽得多的层之间呈现为一条细带。

examples.en: We marked the buffy coat on the textbook diagram of separated blood components.
examples.zh: 我们在教材的血液成分分层图上标出了「白膜层」。

words.enDefinition: one of the right or left pathways conducting impulses down the ventricular septum toward the ventricles

examples.en: The diagram marks each bundle branch on its own side of the interventricular septum in the model.
examples.zh: 图中在室间隔相应的一侧标出了各条「束支」。

examples.en: We followed a bundle branch down the septum before tracing the network spreading through the ventricular wall.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「束支」下行到室间隔深处，接着追踪分布于心室壁的传导网络。

words.enDefinition: A small fluid-filled sac that reduces friction between nearby moving structures.

examples.en: The bursa sits between the moving structures shown in the classroom shoulder cutaway diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂肩部剖面图把「滑囊」画在两个可相对移动的结构之间。

examples.en: We located a bursa by matching its label to the picture on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用练习纸上的图片核对标签，找到一处「滑囊」。

words.enDefinition: The large tarsal bone forming the bony part of the heel.

examples.en: The calcaneus forms the heel in the side view of the classroom foot model.
examples.zh: 课堂足部模型的侧视图上，「跟骨」构成足跟。

examples.en: We labelled the calcaneus before comparing the shapes of two neighbouring bones in the foot.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「跟骨」，再比较足部两块相邻骨的形状。

words.enDefinition: Hormone from thyroid cells that can reduce calcium release from bone

examples.en: The worksheet lists calcitonin as a signal from cells between thyroid follicles.
examples.zh: 习题把「降钙素」列为甲状腺滤泡之间细胞所产生的一种信号。

examples.en: We labeled calcitonin separately from the other thyroid signals on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们在图表中将「降钙素」与甲状腺的其他信号分开标注。

words.enDefinition: a network of capillaries through which blood passes to exchange substances with surrounding tissues

examples.en: The capillary bed appears as many narrow vessels connecting the arterial and venous ends of the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中的「毛细血管床」由连接动脉侧和静脉侧的许多细小血管组成。

examples.en: We traced how the capillary bed distributes blood through different parts of the classroom tissue model.
examples.zh: 我们追踪「毛细血管床」如何把血液分配到课堂组织模型的不同部位。

collocations: blood flow through a capillary bed

words.enDefinition: The acidic group containing a carbonyl and a hydroxyl on the same carbon, often present as carboxylate in cells.

examples.en: We recognized the carboxyl group by the two oxygen atoms attached to the same carbon in the illustration.
examples.zh: 我们看到插图中同一碳原子连着两个氧原子，据此找出「羧基」。

examples.en: The chart marks the carboxyl group at one end of the isolated amino acid drawing.
examples.zh: 图表在单独画出的氨基酸一端标出了「羧基」。

collocations: the charge associated with a carboxyl group

words.enDefinition: The end of a polypeptide corresponding to the final residue's backbone carboxyl group.

examples.en: The carboxyl terminus appears at the final residue of the chain in our classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「羧基端」位于链的最后一个残基。

examples.en: We traced the protein backbone to the carboxyl terminus on the right side of the figure.
examples.zh: 我们沿蛋白质骨架追踪到图中右侧的「羧基端」。

collocations: the carboxyl terminus of a polypeptide

words.enDefinition: the mechanical load a ventricle must overcome to eject blood during contraction

examples.en: The exercise used arterial pressure as a simple proxy for cardiac afterload on the left ventricle.
examples.zh: 练习把动脉压力作为左心室「心脏后负荷」的一个简化替代指标。

examples.en: Greater cardiac afterload reduced the amount of blood ejected in the model when other inputs stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 其他输入不变时，较大的「心脏后负荷」使模型射出的血液减少。

words.enDefinition: the pointed inferior tip of the heart, formed mainly by the left ventricle

examples.en: The cardiac apex points downward and to the left in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型的前视图中，「心尖」指向左下方。

examples.en: We rotated the heart model until the cardiac apex and the broad base were both visible.
examples.zh: 我们转动心脏模型，直到「心尖」和较宽的心底都可见。

words.enDefinition: the network of specialized cardiac cells that initiates and spreads electrical activity to coordinate the heartbeat

examples.en: The cardiac conduction system diagram arrows run from the upper chamber region toward the ventricular walls.
examples.zh: 「心脏传导系统」图中的箭头从上方心腔区域指向心室壁。

examples.en: We traced the cardiac conduction system on a separate illustration before discussing how the heart chambers contract.
examples.zh: 我们先在单独的图中追踪「心脏传导系统」，再讨论心腔如何收缩。

collocations: activation of the cardiac conduction system

words.enDefinition: the sequence of electrical and mechanical events from the start of one heartbeat to the start of the next

examples.en: The cardiac cycle chart aligns valve movements, pressure changes and electrical activity on a shared time axis.
examples.zh: 「心动周期」图在同一时间轴上对齐瓣膜运动、压力变化与电活动。

examples.en: We compared ventricular volume at two labeled points within a single cardiac cycle in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂动画中同一个「心动周期」的两个标记时刻对应的心室容积。

words.enDefinition: Striated muscle of the heart composed of branching cells that contract together

examples.en: The diagram highlights branching fibers within the model of cardiac muscle tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图在「心肌组织」模型中突出显示了分支纤维。

examples.en: We compared cardiac muscle tissue with the long parallel fibers of the skeletal example.
examples.zh: 我们将「心肌组织」与骨骼肌示例中平行的长纤维作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an indentation along the anterior border of the left lung that makes room for the heart

examples.en: The cardiac notch forms a visible indentation along the front edge of the left lung model.
examples.zh: 「心切迹」在左肺模型的前缘形成一个可见的凹陷。

examples.en: We matched the position of the cardiac notch with the nearby outline of the heart in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「心切迹」的位置与图中相邻的心脏轮廓对应起来。

collocations: cardiac notch of the left lung

words.enDefinition: the volume of blood pumped by one ventricle per unit time, usually per minute

examples.en: We calculated cardiac output by multiplying stroke volume by heart rate in the classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 在课堂模拟中，我们用每搏输出量乘心率求「心输出量」。

examples.en: The model's cardiac output increased when the heart rate rose and the stroke volume remained unchanged.
examples.zh: 心率上升、每搏输出量保持不变时，模型的「心输出量」增加。

words.enDefinition: the stretch or load on ventricular muscle at the end of filling before contraction begins

examples.en: The model used end-diastolic volume as an indirect indicator of cardiac preload in the simplified comparison.
examples.zh: 在这项简化比较中，模型用舒张末期容积作为「心脏前负荷」的间接指标。

examples.en: The worksheet shows greater cardiac preload when the ventricular muscle starts from a more stretched state.
examples.zh: 练习表显示，心室肌在起始时拉伸得更多，对应更大的「心脏前负荷」。

collocations: effect of filling on cardiac preload

words.enDefinition: the organ system of the heart and blood vessels that circulates blood through the lungs and body tissues

examples.en: The cardiovascular system chart shows how blood moves between the heart, lungs and the rest of the body.
examples.zh: 「心血管系统」图显示血液如何在心脏、肺和全身其他部位之间流动。

examples.en: Our lecturer used colored arrows to show the two major circuits of the cardiovascular system.
examples.zh: 老师用彩色箭头在「心血管系统」图中表示两大循环。

words.enDefinition: the internal ridge at the point where the trachea divides into the two main bronchi

examples.en: The carina of the trachea marks the internal ridge between the branches on our enlarged model.
examples.zh: 在放大的模型中，「气管隆嵴」标示出两个分支之间的内部嵴。

examples.en: We placed the label for the carina of the trachea at the airway's first large division.
examples.zh: 我们把「气管隆嵴」标签放在气道的第一个大分叉处。

collocations: identify the carina of the trachea
locate the carina of the trachea
branching at the carina of the trachea

words.enDefinition: One of the small bones that make up the wrist between the forearm and the hand.

examples.en: Each carpal bone sits in one of two rows on the classroom wrist model.
examples.zh: 在课堂腕部模型上，每块「腕骨」位于两排骨中的一排。

examples.en: We matched a carpal bone to the outline shown on the drawing of the wrist.
examples.zh: 我们将一块「腕骨」与腕部图上所示的轮廓对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A joint in which neighbouring bones are united by cartilage without a synovial cavity.

examples.en: The cartilaginous joint has a layer of cartilage between the marked bones in the illustration.
examples.zh: 图示的「软骨性关节」在标记的骨之间有一层软骨。

examples.en: We classified the cartilaginous joint by looking at the tissue connecting its bones in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据连接两块骨的组织对「软骨性关节」分类。

words.enDefinition: An observational design that samples people with and without the outcome of interest and compares their prior exposures.

examples.en: The case-control study compares previously recorded activity patterns among fictional participants with different outcome statuses.
examples.zh: 「病例对照研究」比较不同结局状态的虚构参与者先前记录的活动模式。

examples.en: We labelled the outcome groups first when reading the case-control study diagram in our workbook.
examples.zh: 我们阅读练习册上的「病例对照研究」图时，先标出各结局组。

words.enDefinition: A detailed account of the observations and course of one individual case.

examples.en: The case report follows one fictional participant's activity scores across the visits described in the article.
examples.zh: 「病例报告」记录一名虚构参与者在文中所述各次访视中的活动评分。

examples.en: We checked the timeline in the case report before discussing the limits of the observation.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「病例报告」中的时间线，再讨论该观察的局限。

words.enDefinition: A description of observations in several cases grouped by a shared characteristic, usually without a formal comparator.

examples.en: The case series describes several fictional participants who share the same activity pattern in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「病例系列」描述了练习中活动模式相同的几名虚构参与者。

examples.en: We identified the case series by the way the report grouped individual accounts with similar features.
examples.zh: 我们依据报告把具有相似特征的个体叙述归组的方式，辨认出「病例系列」。

words.enDefinition: Cellular metabolism that breaks down substances, often providing energy for other activities.

examples.en: The textbook uses glucose breakdown to illustrate catabolism in the chapter on how human cells obtain energy.
examples.zh: 教材在人体细胞如何获取能量一章用葡萄糖分解说明「分解代谢」。

examples.en: We identified catabolism where the pathway diagram showed a large storage molecule yielding smaller units.
examples.zh: 我们在代谢图上大储存分子分解为较小单元的位置，辨认「分解代谢」。

words.enDefinition: The capacity of an enzyme to speed a particular reaction under stated conditions.
