examples.en: The lesson interpreted catalytic activity using two simulated traces for the same human enzyme reaction.
examples.zh: 课程用同一人体酶反应的两条模拟曲线来解读「催化活性」。

examples.en: We read the chart's description of catalytic activity before comparing the slopes shown on its graph.
examples.zh: 比较图中斜率之前，我们先读了图表关于「催化活性」的说明。

collocations: the catalytic activity of an enzyme

words.enDefinition: Pouch at the beginning of the large intestine that receives ileal contents

examples.en: The cecum appears as a pouch below the ileal opening in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，「盲肠」呈囊状，位于回肠开口的下方。

examples.en: We labeled the cecum before tracing the colon upward on the model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「盲肠」，再在模型上沿结肠向上描画。

words.enDefinition: Adaptive defense mediated mainly by T cells and their effects on other cells

examples.en: The figure groups the T cell effects under cell-mediated immunity in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图将 T 细胞的多种作用归到「细胞介导免疫」之下。

examples.en: We followed the cell-mediated immunity branch to the body cells shown in the model.
examples.zh: 我们沿「细胞介导免疫」分支追踪到模型中所示的人体细胞。

words.enDefinition: The membrane-bound compartment that contains most of the DNA in a human cell that has a nucleus.

examples.en: The cell nucleus is shaded purple in the model of a typical human skin cell.
examples.zh: 典型人类皮肤细胞模型中，「细胞核」用紫色表示。

examples.en: We identified the cell nucleus before looking at how chromosomes are arranged in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「细胞核」，再看示意图中染色体如何排列。

words.enDefinition: the shape, size and structural appearance of a cell as seen in an image or specimen

examples.en: We described cellular morphology in the exercise by comparing flattened cells with the taller neighboring cells.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们比较扁平细胞和邻近的较高细胞，用以描述「细胞形态」。

examples.en: The atlas uses paired drawings to show how cellular morphology changes across layers of the normal tissue.
examples.zh: 图谱用成对的图展示在正常组织不同层中「细胞形态」的变化。

words.enDefinition: In humans, the collection of processes extracting energy from nutrients and ultimately transferring electrons to oxygen.

examples.en: The cellular respiration chart connects energy from nutrients to ATP production in an ordinary human cell.
examples.zh: 「细胞呼吸」图将营养物质提供的能量与普通人体细胞生成 ATP 联系起来。

examples.en: We used the cellular respiration diagram to distinguish the cytoplasmic stage from reactions inside the mitochondrion.
examples.zh: 我们用「细胞呼吸」图辨别细胞质中的阶段与线粒体内部的反应。

words.enDefinition: the part of the nervous system formed by the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The diagram colors the brain and spinal cord together to show the central nervous system in the model.
examples.zh: 图中将脑和脊髓涂成相同颜色，以表示模型里的「中枢神经系统」。

examples.en: We traced sensory signals toward the central nervous system on the classroom map of nervous pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂神经通路图上沿感觉信号追踪到「中枢神经系统」。

collocations: signals entering the central nervous system

words.enDefinition: the prominent cerebral groove separating the frontal and parietal lobes

examples.en: We traced the central sulcus between the two labeled lobes on the side view of the hemisphere.
examples.zh: 我们在大脑半球侧视图上，沿两个有标注的脑叶之间追踪「中央沟」。

examples.en: The model uses the central sulcus as the landmark between the primary motor and somatosensory areas.
examples.zh: 模型用「中央沟」作为初级运动区与初级躯体感觉区之间的解剖标志。

words.enDefinition: A specialized region of a chromosome that helps hold sister chromatids together and organizes their attachment during division.

examples.en: The centromere is marked at the narrow region where the sister chromatids meet in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中在姐妹染色单体相接的狭窄处标出了「着丝粒」。

examples.en: We checked the position of the centromere before identifying the longer arm of the example chromosome.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「着丝粒」的位置，再指出示例染色体较长的臂。

words.enDefinition: the structure behind the brainstem that contributes to coordination, balance and motor learning

examples.en: The cerebellum is shown behind the brainstem and beneath the back of the cerebrum in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「小脑」位于脑干后方、大脑后部的下方。

examples.en: We linked the cerebellum with timing and coordination of movements on the lecture diagram of motor pathways.
examples.zh: 在讲义的运动通路图中，我们把「小脑」与运动时序和协调联系起来。

words.enDefinition: a narrow channel through the midbrain connecting the third and fourth ventricles

examples.en: The cerebral aqueduct is the thin passage between the third and fourth ventricles in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，「中脑导水管」是第三、第四脑室之间的狭长通道。

examples.en: We traced the cerebral aqueduct through the midbrain to show the direction of fluid movement on our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们沿「中脑导水管」穿过中脑，在图上显示脑脊液的流动方向。

words.enDefinition: the outer layer of gray matter covering the cerebral hemispheres

examples.en: The cerebral cortex follows the ridges and grooves along the brain surface in the sectioned model.
examples.zh: 切开的模型中，「大脑皮层」沿着脑表面的隆起和沟槽分布。

examples.en: We compared the cerebral cortex with white matter under it in the labeled classroom brain section.
examples.zh: 我们在有标注的课堂脑切面图中，对照「大脑皮层」与下方白质。

words.enDefinition: a ridge or fold of cerebral cortex bordered by grooves

examples.en: The shaded cerebral gyrus appears as a raised fold between neighboring grooves on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，着色的「大脑回」是两条相邻脑沟之间一处隆起的皮层皱褶。

examples.en: We traced a cerebral gyrus across the brain surface before comparing the adjoining cortical areas in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先沿脑表面追踪一条「大脑回」，再比较邻近的皮层区域。

words.enDefinition: one of the two halves of the cerebrum, each containing cortex and deeper structures

examples.en: The model separates one cerebral hemisphere from the other to expose the surface along the midline.
examples.zh: 模型将一侧「大脑半球」与另一侧分开，以露出沿正中线的表面。

examples.en: We marked the major lobes of the left cerebral hemisphere on the classroom brain diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂脑部图上标出左「大脑半球」的主要脑叶。

words.enDefinition: a groove on the cerebral surface that separates neighboring folds or regions

examples.en: The pointer lies in a cerebral sulcus between two raised folds on the classroom brain model.
examples.zh: 课堂脑模型上，指针位于两个隆起脑回之间的「大脑沟」里。

examples.en: We used the cerebral sulcus as a landmark when comparing the outlines of two cortical regions.
examples.zh: 我们用「大脑沟」作为标志，对照两个皮层区域的轮廓。

words.enDefinition: the clear fluid in brain ventricles and around the brain and spinal cord that helps cushion nervous tissue

examples.en: The arrows in the classroom drawing show cerebrospinal fluid moving between connected cavities within the brain.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的箭头显示「脑脊液」在脑内彼此连通的腔室之间流动。

examples.en: We followed the cerebrospinal fluid pathway from the internal ventricles toward spaces around the model brain.
examples.zh: 我们从内部脑室沿「脑脊液」通路追踪到模型脑周围的空间。

words.enDefinition: Confidence that the body of evidence supports an estimated effect or answer within a specified question.

examples.en: The certainty of evidence is shown beside each fictional outcome in the classroom review table.
examples.zh: 课堂综述表在每项虚构结局旁标出「证据确定性」。

examples.en: We compared certainty of evidence across outcomes after reading the reasons for each rating in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读各评级的原因，再比较不同结局的「证据确定性」。

words.enDefinition: Body region occupied by the neck between the head and trunk

examples.en: The label for the cervical region points to the neck on the model.
examples.zh: 「颈区」的标注指向模型的颈部。

examples.en: Our side view shows the cervical region between the head and upper chest.
examples.zh: 侧视图显示了位于头部与上胸部之间的「颈区」。

words.enDefinition: One of the seven vertebrae that form the neck region of the vertebral column.

examples.en: The cervical vertebra is placed above the rib-bearing vertebrae on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型上，「颈椎骨」放置在与肋骨相连的椎骨上方。

examples.en: We compared the shape of one cervical vertebra with a bone from the lumbar region.
examples.zh: 我们把一块「颈椎骨」的形状与一块腰椎骨作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The difference between a follow-up measurement and the corresponding starting measurement for a participant or group.

examples.en: The change from baseline is calculated by subtracting each fictional starting score from its follow-up score.
examples.zh: 「较基线的变化」用每名虚构参与者的随访评分减去其起始评分来计算。

examples.en: We checked the scoring direction before interpreting change from baseline in the classroom comparison table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对评分方向，再解读课堂对照表中的「较基线的变化」。

words.enDefinition: a junction at which a cell releases chemical signals that act on a neighboring target cell

examples.en: The chemical synapse model shows messenger molecules crossing the narrow gap toward receptors on the receiving cell.
examples.zh: 「化学突触」模型显示信使分子跨过狭窄间隙，移向接收细胞上的受体。

examples.en: We identified the chemical synapse by its labeled messenger molecules and separate cell membranes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们依据图中标注的信使分子和彼此分开的细胞膜辨认出「化学突触」。

words.enDefinition: Type of signaling protein that guides the movement of responsive cells

examples.en: The chart uses a chemokine arrow to show why cells gather there.
examples.zh: 图表用「趋化因子」箭头说明细胞为何在图示位置聚集。

examples.en: We marked the source of the chemokine in the illustrated tissue.
examples.zh: 我们在图示组织中标出了「趋化因子」的来源。

words.enDefinition: a sensory cell or ending that detects the concentration or presence of particular chemicals

examples.en: The worksheet models a chemoreceptor that changes its activity when the local chemical concentration changes.
examples.zh: 练习模拟了一种「化学感受器」，其活动会随局部化学物质浓度改变。

examples.en: We used a chemoreceptor in the taste diagram to illustrate the detection of dissolved substances.
examples.zh: 我们用味觉图中的「化学感受器」展示如何检测溶解物质。

words.enDefinition: A point where homologous chromosomes remain visibly connected following an exchange between nonsister chromatids.

examples.en: The chiasma is marked where the chromosomes still appear connected in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图在两条染色体看起来仍相连的位置标出「交叉点」。

examples.en: We identified a chiasma on the paired chromosome diagram before following the separated homologues.
examples.zh: 我们先在配对染色体图上认出一处「交叉点」，再查看分离后的同源染色体。

words.enDefinition: fibrous cords connecting atrioventricular valve leaflets to papillary muscles in the ventricles

examples.en: The chordae tendineae connect the valve leaflets to small muscular projections in the ventricular model.
examples.zh: 在心室模型中，「腱索」把瓣叶连到肌肉形成的小突起上。

examples.en: In the animation, the chordae tendineae limit backward bulging of the leaflets as ventricular pressure rises.
examples.zh: 动画中，心室压力升高时，「腱索」限制瓣叶向后膨出。

words.enDefinition: vascular tissue and specialized epithelium within a brain ventricle that produce much of the cerebrospinal fluid

examples.en: The model shows a choroid plexus as folded tissue projecting into the fluid space of a ventricle.
examples.zh: 模型将一处「脉络丛」画成突入脑室液腔的褶皱状组织。

examples.en: We linked the choroid plexus to cerebrospinal fluid production on the summary diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂总结图上，我们将「脉络丛」与脑脊液的生成联系起来。

collocations: fluid produced by the choroid plexus

words.enDefinition: The complex of DNA and associated proteins that makes up chromosomes in the cell nucleus.

examples.en: The chromatin is shown loosely arranged in the classroom diagram of the cell between divisions.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，细胞处于两次分裂之间时，「染色质」画得较为疏松。

examples.en: We compared the appearance of chromatin in the two labelled panels of the textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们比较教材图中两个已标注小图里的「染色质」外观。

words.enDefinition: The absence of a chromosome segment relative to its corresponding reference structure.

examples.en: The chromosomal deletion appears as a missing coloured block in the simplified diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂用的简化图把「染色体缺失」画成少了一块彩色区段。

examples.en: We identified a chromosomal deletion by comparing the two fictional diagrams with the reference drawing.
examples.zh: 我们将两张虚构图与参考图对照，找出「染色体缺失」。

collocations: segment absent in a chromosomal deletion

words.enDefinition: The presence of an extra copy of part of a chromosome relative to its reference structure.

examples.en: The chromosomal duplication is represented by a repeated labelled block in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，一个带标签的区段重复出现，表示「染色体重复」。

examples.en: We marked the chromosomal duplication before counting how many copies of the block are shown.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「染色体重复」，再数图中带有几份该区段的副本。

collocations: extra copy in a chromosomal duplication

words.enDefinition: A rearrangement in which a chromosome segment has the reverse orientation relative to its reference structure.

examples.en: The chromosomal inversion changes the order of the marked coloured blocks in the supplied diagram.
examples.zh: 给定图中，「染色体倒位」改变了标记彩色区段的顺序。

examples.en: We recognised the chromosomal inversion by following the two arrows that show opposite orientations in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们沿表示相反朝向的两支箭头辨认出「染色体倒位」。

words.enDefinition: A rearrangement in which a chromosome segment is moved to a different location, commonly on another chromosome.

examples.en: The chromosomal translocation is represented by a labelled block appearing on another chromosome in the model.
examples.zh: 模型用一个标记区段出现在另一条染色体上来表示「染色体易位」。

examples.en: We compared the chromosomal translocation with the reversed segment shown in the separate classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们把「染色体易位」与另一幅课堂图所示的倒转区段进行对比。

words.enDefinition: A structure of DNA and associated proteins that carries genetic information.

examples.en: The chromosome is drawn separately so the class can identify both arms and the central junction.
examples.zh: 图中单独画出一条「染色体」，方便全班辨认两条臂和中间连接处。

examples.en: We matched each chromosome in the classroom illustration with its counterpart in the paired view.
examples.zh: 我们把课堂图示中每条「染色体」与成对视图中的对应染色体配对。

words.enDefinition: A section of a chromosome extending from the centromere to an end.

examples.en: Each chromosome arm is marked from the constricted region to the tip on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图将每条「染色体臂」标为从缢缩部位到末端的一段。

examples.en: We compared the two ends before putting a label on each chromosome arm in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先比较两端，再为各条「染色体臂」添加标签。

words.enDefinition: A distinguishable region in the patterned appearance of a chromosome on a prepared image or diagram.

examples.en: The chromosome band is marked as a dark strip in the supplied teaching image.
examples.zh: 给定的教学图像把「染色体区带」标为一条深色条纹。

examples.en: We used the chromosome band labels to match the marked regions in two textbook figures.
examples.zh: 我们根据「染色体区带」标签，对应两幅教材图中的标记区域。

words.enDefinition: The compaction of chromatin into more tightly packed and distinct chromosomes during cell division.

examples.en: Chromosome condensation makes individual chromosomes more distinct in the staged diagrams used in our lesson.
examples.zh: 课上按阶段展示的图中，「染色体凝缩」使各条染色体更容易区分。

examples.en: We compared two panels showing different degrees of chromosome condensation in the teaching figure.
examples.zh: 我们比较教学图中「染色体凝缩」程度不同的两幅小图。

words.enDefinition: The count of distinct chromosomes in a cell, treating a joined pair of sister chromatids as one chromosome before separation.

examples.en: The chromosome number remains unchanged while sister copies are still joined in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，姐妹副本仍相连时，「染色体数目」保持不变。

examples.en: We recorded the chromosome number beside the stage shown in the simplified cell division chart.
examples.zh: 我们在简化细胞分裂图的对应阶段旁记录了「染色体数目」。

words.enDefinition: One complete set of chromosomes, including one chromosome of each autosome type and a sex chromosome in a typical human gamete.

examples.en: The worksheet shows one chromosome set with one of each autosome type and one sex chromosome.
examples.zh: 练习用每种常染色体各一条，再加一条性染色体，展示一套「染色体组」。

examples.en: We counted each chromosome set before labelling the classroom cells as haploid or diploid.
examples.zh: 我们先数出各细胞模型的「染色体组」数，再标上单倍体或二倍体。

words.enDefinition: Milky lymph carrying absorbed fats from the small intestine

examples.en: The classroom chart labels chyle on the path leaving the small intestine.
examples.zh: 课堂图表在离开小肠的淋巴通路上标出了「乳糜」。

examples.en: We colored chyle differently to represent its fat content in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们用不同颜色表示示意图中的「乳糜」，以突出其中含有脂肪。

words.enDefinition: Semifluid mixture formed when stomach secretions mix with partially digested food

examples.en: The diagram depicts chyme after the stomach mixes its contents thoroughly.
examples.zh: 示意图展示了胃充分混合内容物后形成的「食糜」。

examples.en: Our model shows chyme passing into the first part of the small intestine.
examples.zh: 我们的模型显示「食糜」进入小肠的第一段。

collocations: passage of chyme into the duodenum

words.enDefinition: Epithelial tissue bearing tiny hairlike cilia on its exposed cell surfaces

examples.en: In the illustration, tiny projections line the upper edge of the ciliated epithelium.
examples.zh: 图中「纤毛上皮」的上缘有一排细小突起。

examples.en: We looked for a fringe on the exposed side to recognize the ciliated epithelium.
examples.zh: 我们观察朝外的一侧是否有细缘，以辨认「纤毛上皮」。

words.enDefinition: A sequence of joint movements in which the far end of a limb traces a circle or similar loop.

examples.en: The model arm traces a circle during circumduction as the shoulder remains in place.
examples.zh: 模型上肢做「环转」时，远端画出一圈，而肩部保持原位。

examples.en: We used the animated skeleton to distinguish circumduction from rotation around a single axis.
examples.zh: 我们用动画骨骼把「环转」与绕单一轴的旋转区分开。

words.enDefinition: A double bond with the specified reference groups on the same side, as in many natural fatty acids.

examples.en: The classroom drawing showed a cis double bond bending the fatty acid chain away from its straight path.
examples.zh: 课堂图显示，「顺式双键」让脂肪酸链偏离原本的直线走向。

examples.en: We recognized the cis double bond where the two continuing chain segments lay on the same side.
examples.zh: 图中双键两侧继续延伸的链段位于同侧，我们由此认出「顺式双键」。

collocations: a cis double bond in a fatty acid
a bend at a cis double bond

words.enDefinition: Enlarged collecting region near the lower end of the thoracic duct

examples.en: The cisterna chyli appears as a widened segment low in the illustrated trunk.
examples.zh: 「乳糜池」出现在图示躯干下部，呈现为一段变宽的结构。

examples.en: We marked the cisterna chyli just before the thoracic pathway begins to rise.
examples.zh: 我们在胸导管通路开始上行之前的位置标出了「乳糜池」。

words.enDefinition: The ion of citric acid, formed at the entry to the citric acid cycle.

examples.en: The figure places citrate after the step that combines an acetyl group with a four-carbon compound.
examples.zh: 图中把「柠檬酸」标在乙酰基与一个四碳化合物结合的步骤之后。

examples.en: We circled citrate on the pathway map beside the drawing of its six carbon atoms.
examples.zh: 我们在代谢图上六个碳原子的示意结构旁圈出了「柠檬酸」。

collocations: citrate in the citric acid cycle

words.enDefinition: A mitochondrial cycle that oxidizes acetyl groups, releases carbon dioxide, and transfers electrons to carriers.

examples.en: The circular diagram of the citric acid cycle shows how several intermediates are converted and regenerated.
examples.zh: 「柠檬酸循环」的环形图展示了若干中间产物如何转化和再生。

examples.en: We traced the citric acid cycle while noting which steps transferred electrons to the depicted carriers.
examples.zh: 我们沿「柠檬酸循环」观察，同时记下哪些步骤将电子转移给图示载体。

collocations: an intermediate of the citric acid cycle
reactions of the citric acid cycle

words.enDefinition: The long, curved bone that connects the sternum to the scapula in the shoulder girdle.

examples.en: The clavicle runs across the front of the upper chest in the classroom skeleton model.
examples.zh: 在课堂骨骼模型上，「锁骨」横跨上胸前方。

examples.en: We labelled the clavicle from the sternum to the outer part of the shoulder model.
examples.zh: 我们从胸骨到肩部模型的外侧标注「锁骨」。

words.enDefinition: Differences between studies in participant populations, interventions, or outcomes.

examples.en: The clinical heterogeneity reflects different fictional participant groups and outcome definitions across the included studies.
examples.zh: 「临床异质性」反映纳入研究在虚构参与者分组和结局定义上的差别。

examples.en: We discussed clinical heterogeneity after comparing who was included in the two example studies.
examples.zh: 我们比较两项示例研究纳入的人群后，讨论了「临床异质性」。

words.enDefinition: Research involving people or human data to answer a health-related question, whether observational or interventional.

examples.en: The clinical study in the textbook records changes in comfort reported during the fictional follow-up period.
examples.zh: 教材里的「临床研究」记录虚构随访期间参与者报告的舒适度变化。

examples.en: We read the clinical study summary to determine whether the researchers assigned anything to participants.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「临床研究」摘要，确认研究者是否为参与者分配了某种干预。

words.enDefinition: A study that prospectively assigns people to one or more interventions to evaluate health-related outcomes.

examples.en: The fictional clinical trial compares two diary formats using a simulated outcome about activity reporting.
examples.zh: 虚构「临床试验」用一项模拟的活动记录结局比较两种日志版式。

examples.en: We identified the clinical trial because the study assigned an intervention and evaluated a health outcome.
examples.zh: 这项研究分配了干预并评估健康结局，因此我们判断它属于「临床试验」。

words.enDefinition: Preferential activation of lymphocytes whose receptors recognize a particular antigen

examples.en: The chart illustrates clonal selection by highlighting one matching cell among several options.
examples.zh: 图表通过高亮多个候选细胞中一个匹配的细胞来说明「克隆选择」。

examples.en: We placed clonal selection before the increase in matching cells on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中将「克隆选择」标在相匹配的细胞数量增加之前。

words.enDefinition: Compaction of a formed clot through contractions exerted by its platelets

examples.en: The animation represents clot retraction by showing the clot become more compact.
examples.zh: 动画用血凝块逐渐变紧实来表示「血凝块回缩」。

examples.en: We placed clot retraction after the fibrin network had formed in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中将「血凝块回缩」标在纤维蛋白网形成之后。

words.enDefinition: A trial that randomly assigns groups of people, rather than individual people, to study interventions.

examples.en: The cluster-randomised trial assigns fictional classrooms to diary formats rather than assigning the students individually.
examples.zh: 「整群随机试验」以虚构班级为单位分配日志格式。

examples.en: We identified the unit of assignment in the classroom summary of the cluster-randomised trial report.
examples.zh: 我们在「整群随机试验」报告的课堂摘要中找出分配单位。

words.enDefinition: Series in which clotting factors activate successive factors during fibrin formation

examples.en: Our diagram of the coagulation cascade shows several arrows meeting toward the end.
examples.zh: 我们的「凝血级联反应」图显示几支箭头在接近末尾的位置汇合。

examples.en: We followed a branch of the coagulation cascade through the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们沿着课堂图中的「凝血级联反应」一路查看其中一条分支。

words.enDefinition: Protein or other component participating in reactions that promote blood clotting

examples.en: The textbook chart labels a coagulation factor using its conventional Roman numeral.
examples.zh: 教材图用约定的罗马数字标注一种「凝血因子」。

examples.en: We followed one coagulation factor through the shaded section of the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们沿示意图的阴影区查看了一种「凝血因子」在图中的位置。

words.enDefinition: the microscope control that produces relatively large movements to bring the image toward focus

examples.en: The coarse focus knob is drawn as the larger control on the side of the classroom microscope.
examples.zh: 课堂显微镜侧面的较大控制件标为「粗调焦旋钮」。

examples.en: We compared the movements associated with the coarse focus knob and the fine control in the animation.
examples.zh: 我们在动画中比较了「粗调焦旋钮」和微调控制件所产生的移动。

collocations: movement from the coarse focus knob

words.enDefinition: The small bone at the lower end of the vertebral column, below the sacrum.

examples.en: The coccyx is the small lower part of the spine marked on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「尾骨」是课堂模型上标出的脊柱末端小骨。

examples.en: We located the coccyx by following the outline down from the sacrum on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图上从骶骨沿轮廓向下，找到「尾骨」。

words.enDefinition: the spiral structure in the inner ear that contains the sensory organ for hearing

examples.en: The cochlea is drawn as a spiral beside the balance structures in the classroom ear model.
examples.zh: 在课堂耳部模型中，「耳蜗」被画成一个螺旋结构，位于平衡器官旁。

examples.en: We traced the modeled sound vibration into the cochlea before discussing how the sensory cells respond.
examples.zh: 我们先沿模型中的声振动追踪至「耳蜗」，再讨论感觉细胞如何响应。

words.enDefinition: A relationship in which the effects of both alleles can be observed in a heterozygote.

examples.en: The codominance example shows both labelled features in a fictional individual with two different alleles.
examples.zh: 「共显性」示例的虚构人物有两种不同等位基因，并同时表现两个标记特征。

examples.en: We used the trait labels to distinguish codominance from an intermediate phenotype in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用性状标签区分「共显性」与中间表型。

words.enDefinition: An organic cofactor involved in an enzyme-catalyzed reaction, often carrying a group or electrons.

examples.en: The pathway drawing shows a coenzyme carrying electrons from one step of human metabolism to another.
examples.zh: 代谢图显示，「辅酶」将电子从人体代谢的一个步骤带到另一个步骤。

examples.en: We identified the coenzyme symbol before following its change between the two reaction arrows in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先辨认「辅酶」符号，再观察它在两个反应箭头之间的变化。

words.enDefinition: An observational design that examines outcomes over time in a defined group, often across exposure categories.

examples.en: The cohort study follows the same group through several fictional assessments of daily activity and comfort.
examples.zh: 「队列研究」跟踪同一组参与者，进行数次虚构的日常活动和舒适度评估。

examples.en: We identified when follow-up began for each group in the classroom cohort study diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂「队列研究」图上确定各组开始随访的时间。

words.enDefinition: Bundles of collagen that help tissues resist stretching forces

examples.en: The atlas shows thick bundles of collagen fibers running in one main direction.
examples.zh: 图谱显示粗大的「胶原纤维」束沿同一主要方向延伸。

examples.en: We labeled the long bundles of collagen fibers in a simplified tendon image.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的肌腱图中标出了长长的「胶原纤维」束。

words.enDefinition: Tubular passage receiving fluid from several nephrons and carrying it onward

examples.en: Several small pathways join one collecting duct in the simplified model.
examples.zh: 在简化模型中，几条小通路汇入同一根「集合管」。

examples.en: We traced the collecting duct toward the inner tip of the pyramid.
examples.zh: 我们沿「集合管」描画到肾锥体朝内的尖端。

words.enDefinition: Larger vessel receiving fluid from smaller lymphatic channels and carrying it onward

examples.en: Several small vessels join one collecting lymphatic vessel in the textbook diagram.
examples.zh: 教材图中，几根较小的淋巴管汇入一根「集合淋巴管」。

examples.en: We followed the collecting lymphatic vessel toward a node shown farther along the path.
examples.zh: 我们沿「集合淋巴管」追踪到通路上更远处的淋巴结。

collocations: branches of a collecting lymphatic vessel
diagram of a collecting lymphatic vessel

words.enDefinition: Major section of the large intestine extending from cecum toward rectum

examples.en: The colon is shown in four labeled sections on our chart.
examples.zh: 我们的图表把「结肠」画成四个标有名称的肠段。

examples.en: We followed the colon around the loops of small intestine in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上沿「结肠」观察它如何围绕小肠的各段肠襻。

words.enDefinition: Tall epithelial cell whose height exceeds its width in side view

examples.en: A columnar epithelial cell is taller than it is wide in our labeled diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们标注的示意图中，「柱状上皮细胞」的高度大于宽度。

examples.en: The arrow points to one columnar epithelial cell in the row lining the tube.
examples.zh: 箭头指向管壁内衬那一排中的一个「柱状上皮细胞」。

collocations: shape of a columnar epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: Passage formed by the union of the common hepatic and cystic ducts

examples.en: The common bile duct continues downward toward the duodenum in our simplified model.
examples.zh: 在简化模型中，「胆总管」继续向下通往十二指肠。

examples.en: We traced the common bile duct below the point where its two branches join.
examples.zh: 我们沿着两条胆管汇合处下方描出了「胆总管」。

collocations: course of the common bile duct
flow through the common bile duct

words.enDefinition: Final shared portion of the classical clotting scheme leading to fibrin formation

examples.en: Both classroom branches join before the common coagulation pathway shown near the bottom.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中的两个分支在靠近底部的「共同凝血途径」之前汇合。

examples.en: We labeled fibrin formation at the end of the common coagulation pathway diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在「共同凝血途径」示意图的末端标出了纤维蛋白的形成。

collocations: diagram of the common coagulation pathway
factors in the common coagulation pathway
end of the common coagulation pathway

words.enDefinition: Duct formed by the main right and left ducts draining the liver

examples.en: The common hepatic duct begins where the right and left hepatic ducts join.
examples.zh: 「肝总管」起自左、右肝管汇合处。

examples.en: We labeled the common hepatic duct above its junction with the cystic duct.
examples.zh: 我们在与胆囊管汇合位置的上方标出了「肝总管」。

collocations: formation of the common hepatic duct
common hepatic duct in a biliary diagram

words.enDefinition: Dense bone tissue forming the outer layer of bones and much of a long bone shaft.

examples.en: The compact bone forms the dense outer layer in the classroom section of the long bone.
examples.zh: 课堂长骨切面上，「密质骨」构成致密的外层。

examples.en: We compared compact bone with the open network shown farther inside the specimen drawing.
examples.zh: 我们把「密质骨」与标本图中更靠内部的网状结构作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Reversible inhibition in which a substrate and inhibitor cannot bind to the same enzyme simultaneously.

examples.en: The diagram illustrates competitive inhibition with two shapes competing for the same pocket on the model enzyme.
examples.zh: 示意图用两个形状竞争模型酶上的同一个凹槽，来展示「竞争性抑制」。

examples.en: We identified competitive inhibition in the conceptual drawing because the two shapes could bind only in turn.
examples.zh: 概念图中，两个形状不能同时结合，我们据此辨认出「竞争性抑制」。

words.enDefinition: Group of circulating and surface proteins that cooperate in immune responses

examples.en: The chart groups several interacting proteins under the title complement system.
examples.zh: 图表将几种相互作用的蛋白归到「补体系统」这个标题下。

examples.en: We distinguished the complement system from the immune cells in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中区分了「补体系统」和免疫细胞。

words.enDefinition: A relationship in which the heterozygote has the same studied phenotype as one homozygous genotype.

examples.en: Complete dominance gives the two labelled genotypes the same observable category in the simplified exercise.
examples.zh: 在简化练习中，「完全显性」使两种标记基因型表现为同一可观察类别。

examples.en: We applied complete dominance only because the worksheet explicitly stated it for the fictional trait.
examples.zh: 由于练习明确给虚构性状设定了「完全显性」，我们才用了这一规则。

words.enDefinition: A single endpoint combining two or more specified component events or outcomes.

examples.en: The composite endpoint combines two events in the fictional table and presents them as one result.
examples.zh: 「复合终点」将虚构表中的两项事件合在一起，作为一个结果报告。

examples.en: We checked the components of the composite endpoint to see which event occurred most often.
examples.zh: 我们核对「复合终点」的各组成项，查看哪项事件出现得最多。

words.enDefinition: Having two different variants in the same gene, one on each homologous copy.

examples.en: The diagram describes this genotype as compound heterozygous because the two copies carry different labelled variants.
examples.zh: 图中的两份同源副本带有不同标记变异，因此将该基因型描述为「复合杂合的」。

examples.en: We marked the compound heterozygous example before comparing the positions of its two variants.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「复合杂合的」示例，再比较其中两个变异的位置。

words.enDefinition: an instrument that uses visible light and separate objective and viewing lenses to magnify small structures

examples.en: The diagram of a compound light microscope shows where light passes through the prepared teaching slide.
examples.zh: 「复式光学显微镜」的示意图显示了光线从哪里穿过已制好的教学玻片。

examples.en: The instructor used a compound light microscope to display the outline of a human skin section.
examples.zh: 老师用「复式光学显微镜」展示人体皮肤切片的轮廓。

collocations: parts of a compound light microscope
view a slide through a compound light microscope

words.enDefinition: a method that reconstructs cross-sectional images from X-ray measurements taken at many angles

examples.en: The classroom example uses computed tomography to display a stack of slices through the same anatomical model.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「计算机断层成像」显示穿过同一解剖模型的一组切层。

examples.en: We compared computed tomography with a projection image to see how deeper structures are separated in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们对照「计算机断层成像」与投影图，观察图中怎样将深处的结构区分开。

words.enDefinition: An active muscle action in which the muscle shortens while producing tension.

examples.en: The concentric contraction is shown by the shortening muscle in the classroom elbow animation.
examples.zh: 课堂肘部动画用缩短的肌肉显示「向心收缩」。

examples.en: We marked concentric contraction on the part of the timeline where the active muscle shortens.
examples.zh: 我们在时间轴上标出主动发力的肌肉缩短所对应的「向心收缩」区段。

words.enDefinition: A comparison group observed during the same period as the group under study.

examples.en: The concurrent control completed its final questionnaire during the same week as the other fictional group.
examples.zh: 「同期对照」组在与另一虚构组相同的一周内完成了最终问卷。

examples.en: We identified the concurrent control by comparing the dates in the classroom participant flow chart.
examples.zh: 我们对照课堂参与者流程图上的日期，找出「同期对照」。

words.enDefinition: a lens or lens assembly that directs illuminating light onto the specimen in a microscope

examples.en: The condenser lens sits below the specimen and directs light upward in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「聚光镜」位于标本下方，将光线引向上方。

examples.en: We traced the light path through the condenser lens before it reached the prepared section.
examples.zh: 光线还未到达已制好的切片时，我们在图中追踪其穿过「聚光镜」的路径。

collocations: light passing through a condenser lens

words.enDefinition: the air passages that carry air toward and away from the respiratory zone without participating in pulmonary gas exchange

examples.en: The conducting zone ends at the terminal bronchioles on the map of the airways used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂使用的气道图上，「传导区」止于终末细支气管。

examples.en: We shaded the nasal cavity and trachea as two examples of structures in the conducting zone.
examples.zh: 我们为鼻腔与气管着色，把它们作为「传导区」结构的两个示例。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint with an oval convex surface fitting a corresponding depression and permitting movement about two axes.

examples.en: The condyloid joint on the classroom wrist model can move about two main axes.
examples.zh: 课堂腕部模型上的「椭圆关节」可以绕两个主要轴活动。

examples.en: We matched the oval joint surface to the condyloid joint drawing on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把椭圆形关节面与练习纸上的「椭圆关节」图对应起来。

words.enDefinition: a retinal sensory cell contributing to color vision and fine detail under sufficient light

examples.en: The cone photoreceptor belongs to one of three classes with different wavelength sensitivities in the human retina.
examples.zh: 人的视网膜中，「视锥感光细胞」分为三类，所示细胞属于其中一类，各类对波长的敏感性不同。

examples.en: We marked a cone photoreceptor in the tightly packed region at the center of the retinal model.
examples.zh: 我们在视网膜模型中央细胞密集的区域标出一个「视锥感光细胞」。

words.enDefinition: optical microscopy that rejects much of the out-of-focus light to improve imaging of a selected depth

examples.en: The confocal microscopy image showed a single depth within the thick educational specimen more clearly.
examples.zh: 「共聚焦显微术」图像使较厚教学标本内某一深度的结构显示得更清楚。

examples.en: We compared confocal microscopy with conventional imaging using the provided drawings of in-focus and out-of-focus rays.
examples.zh: 我们用给出的合焦和离焦光线图，对照「共聚焦显微术」与普通成像。

words.enDefinition: Confounding in an observational comparison when the reason for giving an intervention also predicts the outcome.

examples.en: The fictional review discusses confounding by indication because starting characteristics influenced both support and later scores.
examples.zh: 虚构综述讨论「适应证混杂」，因为起始特征同时影响是否获得支持以及后续评分。

examples.en: We marked confounding by indication as a limitation when reading the example observational study in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读观察性研究示例时，将「适应证混杂」标为一项局限。

words.enDefinition: Tissue whose cells and surrounding matrix support, link, or separate structures

examples.en: The atlas shows connective tissue below the dark surface layer in cross section.
examples.zh: 横截面图谱显示，深色表层下方是「结缔组织」。

examples.en: We recognized connective tissue by the visible material separating its cells in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们根据图中细胞之间可见的物质辨认出「结缔组织」。

words.enDefinition: A reporting guideline with a checklist and participant flow diagram for completed randomised trials.

examples.en: CONSORT 2025 is named beside the fictional trial report's checklist in the classroom reading exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂阅读练习在虚构试验报告的清单旁注明「CONSORT 2025 报告规范」。

examples.en: We consulted CONSORT 2025 to identify which details the sample randomised trial report should describe.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「CONSORT 2025 报告规范」，确认随机试验报告示例应描述哪些细节。

words.enDefinition: Situated on the opposite side of the body from another structure

examples.en: The left hand is contralateral to the right foot in this diagram.
examples.zh: 在此图中，左手位于右脚的「对侧」。

examples.en: Our exercise pairs each marked shoulder with the contralateral side of the model.
examples.zh: 习题将每个有标记的肩部与模型的「对侧」配成一对。

words.enDefinition: A difference in the number of copies of a genomic segment relative to another genome or reference.

examples.en: The copy number variation is shown as a different count of blocks in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图用积木块数目的差别表示「拷贝数变异」。

examples.en: We counted the blocks before labelling copy number variation on the fictional chromosome drawing.
examples.zh: 我们先数清积木块，再在虚构染色体图上标出「拷贝数变异」。

collocations: copy number variation of a genomic segment

words.enDefinition: an artery arising from the aorta that supplies blood to heart muscle and related structures

examples.en: The coronary artery branches across the surface of the heart in the illustration beside the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型旁的图中，「冠状动脉」在心脏表面分支。

examples.en: We separated the drawing of each coronary artery from the veins returning blood from the heart wall.
examples.zh: 我们把各「冠状动脉」与从心壁回流血液的静脉分开绘制。

words.enDefinition: the flow of blood through vessels supplying and draining the tissues of the heart itself

examples.en: The lecture diagram distinguishes coronary circulation from the blood passing through the chambers of the heart.
examples.zh: 讲义图区分了「冠状循环」与流经心脏各腔的血流。

examples.en: We traced coronary circulation from an aortic branch to small vessels within the heart wall.
examples.zh: 我们从主动脉的一个分支追踪到心壁内的小血管，观察「冠状循环」。

words.enDefinition: a large venous channel that collects most of the heart's venous blood and empties into the right atrium

examples.en: The rear view of the model marks the coronary sinus where several cardiac veins converge.
examples.zh: 模型的后视图在几条心静脉汇合处标出了「冠状窦」。

examples.en: We followed blood from the coronary sinus into the right atrium at the end of the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习最后，我们追踪血液从「冠状窦」进入右心房。

words.enDefinition: the large bundle of nerve fibers connecting corresponding and other regions of the two cerebral hemispheres

examples.en: The corpus callosum appears as a curved central band in the midsagittal view of the classroom brain model.
examples.zh: 课堂脑模型的正中矢状面上，「胼胝体」表现为中央的弧形带。

examples.en: We traced fibers of the corpus callosum across the midline in the diagram of both hemispheres.
examples.zh: 在双侧大脑半球的图中，我们沿「胼胝体」纤维跨过正中线。

collocations: regions connected by the corpus callosum

words.enDefinition: Nephron with corpuscle in the outer cortex and a relatively short loop

examples.en: The cortical nephron shown on the left has the shorter loop.
examples.zh: 左侧图中的「皮质肾单位」具有较短的肾单位袢。

examples.en: We located the corpuscle of the cortical nephron near the kidney's outer edge.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近肾脏外缘的位置找到了这个「皮质肾单位」的肾小体。

words.enDefinition: Adrenal cortex hormone involved in regulating metabolism and responses to stress

examples.en: The endocrine chart shows cortisol as an output of the adrenal cortex.
examples.zh: 内分泌图表将「皮质醇」表示为肾上腺皮质的一项输出信号。

examples.en: We marked cortisol on the feedback arrow in the synthetic diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「皮质醇」标在合成示意图的反馈箭头上。

words.enDefinition: The hyaline cartilage at the anterior end of a rib that helps connect it with the chest framework.

examples.en: The costal cartilage is coloured differently from the bony part of the rib on the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，「肋软骨」与肋骨的骨性部分颜色不同。

examples.en: We identified the costal cartilage at the front end of the marked rib in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在标记肋骨的前端指出了「肋软骨」。

words.enDefinition: The process in nephron loops that builds a medullary concentration gradient through opposing flows and different transport properties in the two limbs.

examples.en: The countercurrent multiplication diagram shows fluid traveling in opposite directions along neighboring limbs.
examples.zh: 「逆流倍增」示意图显示相邻袢支内的液体朝相反方向流动。

examples.en: We used colors to show the gradient created by countercurrent multiplication in the model.
examples.zh: 我们用颜色表示模型中由「逆流倍增」建立的梯度。

words.enDefinition: an additional stain that gives contrasting color to structures that are less visible with the primary stain

examples.en: The counterstain colored surrounding structures pink in the example, making the blue nuclei easier to distinguish.
examples.zh: 示例中的「复染剂」将周围结构染成粉色，使蓝色细胞核更容易分辨。

examples.en: We read the caption to identify the counterstain responsible for the lighter background color in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读图注，辨认产生较浅背景颜色的「复染剂」。

words.enDefinition: a thin transparent piece placed over a microscope specimen on a slide

examples.en: The drawing shows a cover slip as a thin transparent layer directly above the prepared tissue section.
examples.zh: 图中，「盖玻片」是紧贴已制好组织切片上方的一层薄的透明材料。

examples.en: We distinguished the cover slip from the thicker slide supporting the section in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「盖玻片」与图中承托切片的较厚载玻片。

words.enDefinition: Space within the skull containing the brain and its surrounding coverings

examples.en: The cranial cavity is highlighted inside the skull in our section diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们的剖面图中，颅骨内部的「颅腔」被高亮标出。

examples.en: The tutor outlined the cranial cavity before showing the structures it contains.
examples.zh: 老师先勾勒「颅腔」的轮廓，再展示里面的结构。

words.enDefinition: one of the paired nerves associated directly with the brain, many emerging from the brainstem

examples.en: The model shows a cranial nerve leaving the brainstem on either side at the marked level.
examples.zh: 模型显示，在标出的位置各有一条「脑神经」从脑干的两侧出发。

examples.en: We traced one cranial nerve toward a structure of the face on the classroom chart of pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂神经通路图上，沿一条「脑神经」追踪到面部的一处结构。

words.enDefinition: A fibrous joint between neighbouring bones of the skull.

examples.en: The cranial suture appears as an irregular line between two bones on the skull model.
examples.zh: 头骨模型上，「颅缝」表现为两块骨之间的一条不规则线。

examples.en: We traced the cranial suture across the top of the labelled teaching model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们沿带标注教学模型的顶部查看「颅缝」。

words.enDefinition: An observational study measuring characteristics and outcomes at one time or over a short defined period.

examples.en: The cross-sectional study reports fictional comfort scores and activity categories measured during the same survey week.
examples.zh: 「横断面研究」报告在同一调查周测得的虚构舒适度评分和活动类别。

examples.en: We read the cross-sectional study summary to see which measures were recorded at the same time.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「横断面研究」摘要，确认哪些指标是在同一时间记录的。

words.enDefinition: The reciprocal exchange of corresponding chromosome segments between nonsister chromatids of homologous chromosomes during meiosis.

examples.en: Crossing over is represented by two matching segments changing places in the coloured classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂彩色图用两个对应区段互换位置表示「交叉互换」。

examples.en: We compared the chromosome colours before and after crossing over in the supplied teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 我们比较给定教学图中「交叉互换」前后的染色体颜色。

words.enDefinition: A trial in which each participant receives more than one intervention in different periods, commonly in an assigned order.

examples.en: The crossover trial compares two fictional questionnaire layouts across two periods for the same participants.
examples.zh: 「交叉试验」让同一批参与者在两个时段比较两种虚构问卷版式。

examples.en: We checked the order of the formats in the classroom diagram of the crossover trial.
examples.zh: 我们核对课堂「交叉试验」图中使用不同版式的顺序。

collocations: study periods in a crossover trial

words.enDefinition: An overall rate calculated directly for a population without adjustment for differences in its composition.

examples.en: The crude rate uses the combined records for every age group in the fictional classroom population.
examples.zh: 「粗率」使用课堂虚构总体各年龄组的合计记录。

examples.en: We compared the crude rate with the adjusted figure in the next column of the table.
examples.zh: 我们将「粗率」和表格下一列的调整后数值作比较。

words.enDefinition: in CT, the reconstructed measure of how strongly material in a region reduces transmitted X-ray intensity

examples.en: The teaching diagram displays different CT attenuation values for air and bone in the same reconstructed image.
examples.zh: 教学图在同一幅重建图像中为气体和骨显示不同的「CT衰减值」。

examples.en: We compared the CT attenuation of two labeled regions using the values provided beside the image.
examples.zh: 我们用图像旁给出的数值比较两个标注区域的「CT衰减值」。

words.enDefinition: a cross-sectional image representing one reconstructed layer of a computed tomography volume

examples.en: The uppermost CT slice in the teaching stack shows a different outline than the section immediately beneath it.
examples.zh: 教学图组的最上方「CT层面图」显示的轮廓与紧邻下方的层面不同。

examples.en: We followed the same labeled structure from one CT slice to the next in the supplied anatomy example.
examples.zh: 我们在给定解剖示例中，从一张「CT层面图」追踪同一标注结构到下一张。

words.enDefinition: the range of CT attenuation values, centered on a chosen window level, mapped across the available display shades

examples.en: Changing the CT window made subtle shades easier to distinguish within the soft tissue in the example.
examples.zh: 更改「CT显示窗」后，示例中软组织内的细微灰度差异更容易辨认。

examples.en: We compared two CT window settings on the same slice to see which shades became easier to separate.
examples.zh: 我们比较同一层面的两种「CT显示窗」设置，观察哪些灰度更容易区分。

words.enDefinition: Epithelial cell approximately as tall as it is wide in section

examples.en: The cuboidal epithelial cell looks roughly square in the side view of the atlas.
examples.zh: 在图谱侧视图中，「立方上皮细胞」看起来近似方形。

examples.en: We measured the height and width of a cuboidal epithelial cell in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在图中量了一个「立方上皮细胞」的高度和宽度。

collocations: shape of a cuboidal epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: the protective interface of the skin, especially the outer epidermis, that limits water loss and entry of external substances

examples.en: The model illustrates the cutaneous barrier as a continuous outer layer separating internal tissues from the environment.
examples.zh: 模型把「皮肤屏障」画成分隔内部组织和外部环境的一层连续外层。

examples.en: We used the cutaneous barrier diagram to explain why layers of flattened epidermal cells are important.
examples.zh: 我们用「皮肤屏障」图解释扁平表皮细胞构成的层为什么重要。

collocations: outer layer of the cutaneous barrier

words.enDefinition: Body covering consisting of an outer epithelial layer and underlying connective tissue

examples.en: The cutaneous membrane covers the outward surface of the full body model.
examples.zh: 「皮肤膜」覆盖全身模型的外表面。

examples.en: We identified both layers of the cutaneous membrane in a simplified skin diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化皮肤图中辨认了「皮肤膜」的两层结构。

words.enDefinition: Passage connecting the gallbladder with the main ducts carrying bile

examples.en: The cystic duct connects the gallbladder to the other ducts in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「胆囊管」把胆囊和其他胆管连接起来。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the cystic duct while tracing the route between liver and gallbladder.
examples.zh: 老师在沿肝脏到胆囊的路径讲解时标出了「胆囊管」。

words.enDefinition: Small signaling protein that helps coordinate the behavior of nearby or distant cells

examples.en: The illustration uses a small arrow to represent a cytokine between cells.
examples.zh: 插图用一个小箭头表示细胞之间传递的「细胞因子」。

examples.en: We labeled one cytokine on the classroom diagram of immune communication.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂免疫信号交流图中标出了一种「细胞因子」。

words.enDefinition: T lymphocyte that can recognize and eliminate certain abnormal body cells

examples.en: The chart places a cytotoxic T cell next to the abnormal body cell.
examples.zh: 图表把一个「细胞毒性T细胞」画在异常人体细胞旁。

examples.en: We labeled the cytotoxic T cell separately from the helper cell in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中分别标出了「细胞毒性T细胞」和辅助性 T 细胞。

collocations: role of a cytotoxic T cell
diagram of a cytotoxic T cell

words.enDefinition: microscopy that excludes direct illumination from the image so scattered light shows objects on a dark background

examples.en: The example of darkfield microscopy shows bright boundaries against a nearly black background in the optics handout.
examples.zh: 光学讲义中「暗场显微术」的示例显示，明亮边界衬在近黑色背景上。

examples.en: We compared darkfield microscopy and brightfield images of the same classroom test pattern in the tutorial.
examples.zh: 我们在教程中比较同一课堂测试图案的「暗场显微术」图像和明场图像。

words.zhGloss: 数据与安全监察委员会
words.enDefinition: An independent group that reviews accumulating study information and advises on a trial's conduct and participant safety.
acceptedZhAnswers: 数据与安全监察委员会

examples.en: The data and safety monitoring board appears on the oversight chart for the fictional trial.
examples.zh: 虚构试验的监督图上列出了「数据与安全监察委员会」。

examples.en: We distinguished the data and safety monitoring board from the committee that reviews research ethics in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分「数据与安全监察委员会」与审查研究伦理的委员会。

collocations: independent data and safety monitoring board
report from a data and safety monitoring board
remit of a data and safety monitoring board

words.enDefinition: A report section explaining how supporting study data can be accessed or why access is limited.

examples.en: The data availability statement explains which synthetic tables accompany the classroom study report for readers.
examples.zh: 「数据可用性声明」向读者说明课堂研究报告随附哪些合成表格。

examples.en: We checked the data availability statement before looking for the fictional study's supporting data summary.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「数据可用性声明」，再找虚构研究的支持数据摘要。

collocations: restrictions in a data availability statement

words.enDefinition: A variant newly arising in the individual or in a parental reproductive cell, rather than inherited as an established variant in a parent.

examples.en: The de novo variant is represented by a new symbol in one branch of the fictional diagram.
examples.zh: 在虚构示意图的一个分支里，「新发变异」用新符号表示。

examples.en: We distinguished the de novo variant from the symbol shown in the previous generation.
examples.zh: 我们将「新发变异」与前一代显示的符号区分开。

collocations: arise as a de novo variant
example of a de novo variant

examples.en: We subtracted end-systolic volume from the volume before contraction to find how much blood the model ejected.
examples.zh: 我们从收缩前的容积减去「收缩末期容积」，求出模型的射血量。

words.enDefinition: the smooth inner lining of the chambers of the heart, continuous with the lining of blood vessels

examples.en: The endocardium lines the ventricular cavity in the labeled section of the classroom heart model.
examples.zh: 在有标记的课堂心脏模型切面上，「心内膜」衬在心室腔里面。

examples.en: We followed the endocardium from the chamber wall onto the surface of a valve leaflet.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「心内膜」从心腔壁看到瓣叶表面。

words.enDefinition: Linked series of endocrine tissues coordinating a sequence of hormonal signals

examples.en: The worksheet shows an endocrine axis linking three levels of hormonal regulation.
examples.zh: 习题显示一条将三个激素调节层级连接起来的「内分泌轴」。

examples.en: We followed the endocrine axis from the brain region to the peripheral gland.
examples.zh: 我们沿「内分泌轴」从脑区追踪到外周腺体。

words.enDefinition: Gland releasing hormones into surrounding fluid for transport in the circulation

examples.en: The model shows an endocrine gland next to a network of blood vessels.
examples.zh: 模型显示一个「内分泌腺」位于一片血管网旁边。

examples.en: We labeled the endocrine gland that releases its signal into the surrounding fluid.
examples.zh: 我们标出了将信号释放到周围液体中的「内分泌腺」。

words.enDefinition: Regulation where a hormonal response reduces the signaling that originally produced it

examples.en: The endocrine negative feedback diagram shows a signal limiting its upstream stimulus.
examples.zh: 「内分泌负反馈」示意图显示一个信号限制其上游刺激。

examples.en: We used a backward arrow to mark endocrine negative feedback on the classroom flowchart.
examples.zh: 我们用一个反向箭头在课堂流程图上标出了「内分泌负反馈」。

words.enDefinition: Hormone-producing pancreatic tissue organized into small groups of cells called islets

examples.en: The atlas shows the endocrine pancreas as small clusters within the larger gland.
examples.zh: 图谱把「胰腺内分泌部」画成这座较大腺体内的小细胞簇。

examples.en: We colored the endocrine pancreas separately from the tissue connected to the ducts.
examples.zh: 我们分别给「胰腺内分泌部」和连有导管的组织涂上不同的颜色。

words.enDefinition: Release of a hormonal signal into internal fluid for transport to targets

examples.en: The drawing represents endocrine secretion with arrows pointing from cells toward nearby vessels.
examples.zh: 示意图用从细胞指向附近血管的箭头表示「内分泌」。

examples.en: We grouped endocrine secretion separately from secretion through a duct in the chart.
examples.zh: 我们在图表中将「内分泌」与经导管排出的分泌方式分开归类。

words.enDefinition: Collection of tissues that release chemical signals into the body's internal fluids

examples.en: The endocrine system diagram highlights glands in several regions of the body.
examples.zh: 「内分泌系统」示意图突出标出了多个体区的腺体。

examples.en: We traced signals between two organs in the classroom endocrine system model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂「内分泌系统」模型中追踪两个器官之间的信号。

words.enDefinition: Cell able to respond to an endocrine signal through compatible receptors

examples.en: The example marks one endocrine target cell with receptors matching the illustrated signal.
examples.zh: 示例标出了一个「内分泌靶细胞」，它带有与图示信号对应的受体。

examples.en: We colored the endocrine target cell separately from the cells releasing the hormone.
examples.zh: 我们分别给「内分泌靶细胞」和释放激素的细胞涂上不同颜色。

collocations: receptor on an endocrine target cell
response of an endocrine target cell

words.enDefinition: A thin cellular lining on internal bone surfaces, including the marrow cavity and trabecular surfaces.

examples.en: The endosteum lines the inside of the marrow space on the labelled long bone drawing.
examples.zh: 带标注的长骨图上，「骨内膜」衬在骨髓腔内侧。

examples.en: We used the cutaway model to compare the location of the endosteum with the outer covering.
examples.zh: 我们用剖面模型比较「骨内膜」与外层覆盖组织的位置。

words.enDefinition: Linking a favorable process to an unfavorable one so their net free energy change favors both proceeding together.

examples.en: The schematic explains energy coupling by showing ATP hydrolysis driving a reaction that requires energy.
examples.zh: 示意图展示 ATP 水解如何推动一个需要能量的反应，以解释「能量偶联」。

examples.en: We marked the arrow that showed energy coupling between the two processes in the human cell model.
examples.zh: 我们在人体细胞模型里标出两种过程发生「能量偶联」的箭头。

words.enDefinition: the networks of neurons in the walls of the digestive tract that regulate local function

examples.en: The enteric nervous system appears as a network between muscle layers in the enlarged intestinal wall drawing.
examples.zh: 放大的肠壁图显示，「肠神经系统」在肌层之间形成网络。

examples.en: We linked the enteric nervous system to coordinated movement of the gut in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 我们把「肠神经系统」与课堂动画中肠道协调的运动联系起来。

collocations: control by the enteric nervous system
role of the enteric nervous system

words.enDefinition: The part of an enzyme where a substrate binds and catalysis takes place.

examples.en: The drawing marks the enzyme active site as the pocket where the substrate fits in the model.
examples.zh: 图中用凹槽标出模型中的「酶活性位点」，底物可在这里结合。

examples.en: We identified the enzyme active site before mapping it to the corresponding reaction on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们先辨认「酶活性位点」，再把它与图表上相应的反应对应起来。

collocations: substrate binding at an enzyme active site
a pocket at an enzyme active site

words.enDefinition: A nonprotein component, such as a metal ion or organic molecule, required for an enzyme's activity.

examples.en: The diagram shows an enzyme cofactor as a separate component next to the folded protein chain.
examples.zh: 图中在折叠蛋白质链旁画出一个独立组分，表示「酶辅因子」。

examples.en: We labeled the enzyme cofactor before comparing the complete structure with the protein alone in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出「酶辅因子」，再把完整结构与单独的蛋白质作比较。

collocations: the function of an enzyme cofactor

words.enDefinition: A biological catalyst, usually a protein, that speeds a reaction without being consumed overall.

examples.en: The diagram labels each enzyme above the reaction arrow it helps the human cell carry out.
examples.zh: 图中在各个反应箭头上方标出帮助人体细胞完成该反应的「酶」。

examples.en: The lecturer described an enzyme as a catalyst while tracing the sequence on the metabolism map.
examples.zh: 老师沿代谢图讲解反应顺序时，将「酶」描述为催化剂。

collocations: an enzyme in a human cell

words.enDefinition: The study of how fast enzyme-catalyzed reactions occur and what affects their rates.

examples.en: The enzyme kinetics chapter uses a simulated graph to relate substrate concentration to reaction rate.
examples.zh: 「酶动力学」一章用模拟图说明底物浓度与反应速率的关系。

examples.en: We used enzyme kinetics to interpret why the two labeled curves rose at different rates in the model.
examples.zh: 我们用「酶动力学」解释模型中两条标记曲线为何以不同速率上升。

words.enDefinition: A high-substrate condition in a simple enzyme model where substrate occupies nearly all active sites and the reaction rate approaches its limiting rate.

examples.en: In the model, enzyme saturation appeared as a plateau where the rate increased very little.
examples.zh: 模型中的「酶饱和」表现为一个平台，此处反应速率增加很少。

examples.en: We linked enzyme saturation to the sketch showing most active sites occupied at the same time.
examples.zh: 我们将「酶饱和」联系到草图中同一时刻大多数活性位点都已被占据的画面。

words.enDefinition: A molecule acted upon by an enzyme during a reaction.

examples.en: The figure depicts an enzyme substrate entering the shaded pocket before the illustrated chemical change.
examples.zh: 图中，一种「酶底物」进入有阴影的凹槽，随后发生图示的化学变化。

examples.en: We followed the enzyme substrate from its first appearance to the later product in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上追踪「酶底物」从最初出现到形成后续产物的过程。

collocations: the shape of an enzyme substrate

words.enDefinition: The temporary complex formed when a substrate binds to an enzyme.

examples.en: The middle panel shows the enzyme-substrate complex before the model displays any released product.
examples.zh: 中间一幅图展示了模型中尚未释放产物时的「酶–底物复合物」。

examples.en: We labeled the enzyme-substrate complex where the two shapes were shown together at the binding site.
examples.zh: 我们在结合位点处两个形状靠在一起的位置标出了「酶–底物复合物」。

collocations: a diagram of an enzyme-substrate complex

words.enDefinition: a pink to red stain that colors many cytoplasmic proteins and extracellular structures in tissue sections

examples.en: The caption attributes the pink color of many fibers in the reference section to eosin staining.
examples.zh: 图注指出，参考切片中许多纤维的粉色来自「伊红」染色。

examples.en: We compared the pale pink and stronger pink regions associated with eosin in the classroom histology image.
examples.zh: 我们对照课堂组织学图中与「伊红」相关的浅粉色和较深粉色区域。

words.enDefinition: Granulocyte typically showing a two-lobed nucleus and prominent reddish cytoplasmic granules

examples.en: The textbook drawing shows an eosinophil with two prominent nuclear lobes.
examples.zh: 教材示意图展示一个具有两个明显核叶的「嗜酸性粒细胞」。

examples.en: We labeled the eosinophil beside a cell with a more segmented nucleus.
examples.zh: 我们在一个细胞核分叶更多的细胞旁标出了「嗜酸性粒细胞」。

words.enDefinition: pink to red staining caused by affinity of proteins or other tissue components for eosin

examples.en: The reference image shows eosinophilic staining in the pink fibers between the darker nuclei of the tissue.
examples.zh: 在参考图的组织中，深色细胞核间的粉红色纤维显示了「嗜伊红性着色」。

examples.en: We labeled the stronger eosinophilic staining where the teaching section showed particularly bright pink material.
examples.zh: 教学切片显示鲜明粉红色物质处，我们标注了更强的「嗜伊红性着色」。

words.enDefinition: a glial cell lining the brain ventricles and the central canal of the spinal cord

examples.en: An ependymal cell sits along the surface bordering the ventricular space in the classroom tissue drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂组织图中，一个「室管膜细胞」位于与脑室腔相接的表面。

examples.en: We marked the cilia on an ependymal cell in the enlarged drawing of the ventricular lining.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的脑室衬层图上，标出了一个「室管膜细胞」的纤毛。

words.enDefinition: the outer layer of the heart wall, incorporating the visceral layer of the serous pericardium

examples.en: The atlas draws the epicardium over the myocardium on the outside of the sectioned heart wall.
examples.zh: 图谱在心壁切面中，将「心外膜」画在心肌层外侧。

examples.en: We identified the epicardium by following the surface layer around the edge of the heart model.
examples.zh: 我们沿着心脏模型边缘的表层辨认「心外膜」。

words.enDefinition: the outer epithelial layer of the skin

examples.en: In the sectioned model, the epidermis forms the thin layer above the vascular connective tissue of the skin.
examples.zh: 在剖开的模型中，「表皮」形成皮肤内有血管结缔组织上方的一层薄层。

examples.en: We followed the epidermis across the reference image where the outer surface had several shallow folds.
examples.zh: 在外表面有几处浅褶皱的参考图上，我们沿「表皮」追踪其走向。

words.enDefinition: Upper middle area of the abdomen in the nine-region scheme

examples.en: The epigastric region occupies the top middle box on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 「腹上区」占据课堂图表最上一排的中间方格。

examples.en: We marked the epigastric region directly above the box containing the navel.
examples.zh: 我们在含肚脐方格的正上方标出了「腹上区」。

words.enDefinition: a leaf-shaped cartilage near the entrance to the larynx that helps protect the airway during swallowing

examples.en: The swallowing animation shows the epiglottis folding over the laryngeal entrance as the surrounding structures move.
examples.zh: 吞咽动画显示，周围结构移动时，「会厌」向喉入口折下。

examples.en: We recognized the epiglottis by its leaf shape above the vocal folds in the anatomy diagram.
examples.zh: 我们依据声带上方的叶片形状在解剖图中辨认「会厌」。

words.enDefinition: Hormonal signal from the adrenal medulla that helps coordinate acute stress responses

examples.en: We placed epinephrine beside the output arrow from the adrenal medulla.
examples.zh: 我们将「肾上腺素」标在肾上腺髓质的输出箭头旁。

examples.en: The lecture chart shows epinephrine as one signal in the short-term stress response.
examples.zh: 课堂图表将「肾上腺素」列为短期应激反应中的一种信号。

words.enDefinition: A line of bone marking the former location of a growth plate after lengthwise growth ends.

examples.en: The epiphyseal line marks where the growth plate previously lay in the mature teaching model.
examples.zh: 成熟骨教学模型上，「骺线」标示生长板原来的位置。

examples.en: We compared the epiphyseal line with the cartilage band shown on the growing bone diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「骺线」与生长中骨骼图上的软骨带作了比较。

collocations: epiphyseal line in a mature bone

words.enDefinition: A layer of hyaline cartilage near the end of a growing long bone where lengthwise growth occurs.

examples.en: The epiphyseal plate is shown as a narrow cartilage band on the growing bone model.
examples.zh: 生长中骨骼的模型把「骺板」画成一条窄的软骨带。

examples.en: We pointed to the epiphyseal plate before comparing the growing and mature models in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先指出「骺板」，再比较生长期模型与成熟模型。

collocations: epiphyseal plate of a long bone

words.enDefinition: An end region of a long bone, typically widened compared with the shaft.

examples.en: The epiphysis is wider than the shaft in the diagram of the upper arm bone.
examples.zh: 上臂骨示意图中，「骨骺」比骨干宽。

examples.en: We compared one epiphysis with the shaft using the labelled longitudinal bone section in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用带标注的骨纵切图比较一侧「骨骺」和骨干。

words.enDefinition: An interaction in which variation at one locus modifies the phenotypic effect of variation at another.

examples.en: The model illustrates epistasis when one labelled locus changes how the second locus affects the fictional trait.
examples.zh: 模型中，一个标记位点改变另一位点对虚构性状的影响，以此说明「上位效应」。

examples.en: We identified epistasis after comparing the effect of each locus in different model genotypes.
examples.zh: 我们比较不同模型基因型中各位点的效应后，识别出「上位效应」。

words.enDefinition: a layer of epithelial cells covering the internal surface of a cavity or tube

examples.en: The epithelial lining forms a continuous border around the central space in the classroom image of the duct.
examples.zh: 课堂导管图中的「上皮衬层」在中央空隙周围形成连续边缘。

examples.en: We identified the epithelial lining by tracing the row of cells facing the open space in the section.
examples.zh: 我们沿切片中面向空隙的一排细胞追踪，从而辨认出「上皮衬层」。

words.enDefinition: Sheets of closely arranged cells covering surfaces, lining spaces, or forming glands

examples.en: The diagram shows epithelial tissue covering the exposed surface of the example organ.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「上皮组织」覆盖在示例器官露出的表面。

examples.en: We identified the tightly packed layer as epithelial tissue in the atlas image.
examples.zh: 在图谱图像中，我们将细胞排列紧密的一层辨认为「上皮组织」。

words.enDefinition: Specific part of an antigen recognized by an antibody or lymphocyte receptor

examples.en: The model highlights one epitope as a small part of the larger shape.
examples.zh: 模型将大图形上较小的一部分高亮标为「抗原表位」。

examples.en: We labeled the epitope near the matching shape in the textbook.
examples.zh: 我们在教材中与相应形状相邻的位置标出了「抗原表位」。

words.enDefinition: A group of muscles along the vertebral column that help extend and laterally bend the spine.

examples.en: The erector spinae is marked on both sides of the spine in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图在脊柱两侧标出「竖脊肌」。

examples.en: We traced the erector spinae upward along the back on the labelled teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们在带标注的教学模型上，沿背部向上查看「竖脊肌」。

words.enDefinition: Immature red cell precursor that still contains a nucleus

examples.en: The textbook shows an erythroblast with a dark nucleus in the center.
examples.zh: 教材展示了一个中央有深色细胞核的「有核红细胞前体」。

examples.en: We placed the erythroblast before the nucleus-free stages on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们把「有核红细胞前体」放在图表中各个无核阶段之前。

words.enDefinition: Blood cell specialized to carry oxygen through its hemoglobin content

examples.en: The model shows an erythrocyte with a thinner middle than outer edge.
examples.zh: 模型展示了中央比外缘薄的「红细胞」。

examples.en: We identified the erythrocyte by its flattened outline in the textbook image.
examples.zh: 我们根据教材图中的扁平轮廓辨认出了「红细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Development of new red blood cells from precursor stages

examples.en: The erythropoiesis diagram follows the red cell branch through several stages.
examples.zh: 「红细胞生成」示意图沿红细胞分支展示了多个阶段。

examples.en: We identified the final cell type shown at the end of erythropoiesis.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出了「红细胞生成」末端所示的细胞类型。

words.enDefinition: Hormone made mainly by the kidneys that promotes red cell production

examples.en: The teaching chart connects erythropoietin with the production of red blood cells.
examples.zh: 教学图把「促红细胞生成素」与红细胞生成联系起来。

examples.en: We marked the main source of erythropoietin beside the kidney drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在肾脏图旁标出了「促红细胞生成素」的主要来源。

words.enDefinition: Muscular tube carrying swallowed material from the pharynx to the stomach

examples.en: The esophagus runs behind the airway in the model's side view.
examples.zh: 在模型侧视图中，「食管」沿气道后方延伸。

examples.en: We traced the esophagus down to the top of the stomach.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「食管」往下看到它连接胃的上端。

words.enDefinition: An amino acid that humans cannot synthesize in sufficient amounts and obtain from their diet.

examples.en: The textbook lists leucine as an essential amino acid in its table of human amino acids.
examples.zh: 教材的人体氨基酸表把亮氨酸列为「必需氨基酸」。

examples.en: We discussed why an essential amino acid appears on a chart showing sources of protein building blocks.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么说明蛋白质构成单元来源的图表会列出「必需氨基酸」。

collocations: an essential amino acid in human nutrition
the requirement for an essential amino acid

words.enDefinition: A covalent bond characteristic of an ester, such as a fatty acid attachment to glycerol.

examples.en: We marked the ester linkage joining one of the fatty acids to glycerol in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上标出了把其中一条脂肪酸连接到甘油的「酯键」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to each ester linkage when explaining the three attachments in the storage lipid illustration.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释储存脂图中的三处连接时，逐个指出了各个「酯键」。

collocations: an ester linkage in a storage lipid

words.enDefinition: A framework ranking evidence sources by their typical usefulness for a defined type of question.

examples.en: The evidence hierarchy shown in class ranks study designs for a specified question about intervention effects.
examples.zh: 课堂所示「证据层级」针对一个给定的干预效应问题，对研究设计进行分级。

examples.en: We discussed why the evidence hierarchy might look different for another kind of clinical question.
examples.zh: 我们讨论针对另一种临床问题时，「证据层级」为何可能有所不同。

collocations: evidence hierarchy for a research question

words.enDefinition: The structured process of bringing together findings from several studies to answer a question.

examples.en: The evidence synthesis compares findings across the fictional follow-up studies listed in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 「证据综合」比较课堂表上所列各项虚构随访研究的发现。

examples.en: We read the evidence synthesis before discussing why the individual studies might reach different conclusions.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「证据综合」，再讨论各项研究为何可能得出不同结论。

words.enDefinition: The physiological link between electrical excitation of a muscle fibre and activation of its contractile machinery.

examples.en: The excitation-contraction coupling diagram connects a signal on the muscle cell surface with force inside.
examples.zh: 「兴奋—收缩耦联」示意图把肌细胞表面的信号与细胞内产生的力联系起来。

examples.en: We compared two frames to distinguish excitation-contraction coupling from the subsequent shortening shown in class.
examples.zh: 我们比较两个课堂画面，区分「兴奋—收缩耦联」与之后显示的缩短。

words.enDefinition: a local postsynaptic voltage change that increases the likelihood of an action potential

examples.en: The excitatory postsynaptic potential moved the modeled membrane voltage closer to threshold in the classroom trace.
examples.zh: 课堂示例曲线上，「兴奋性突触后电位」使模型膜电位更接近阈值。

examples.en: We linked the upward voltage deflection to an excitatory postsynaptic potential in the example where spiking became likelier.
examples.zh: 在产生尖峰的可能性增加的示例中，我们把向上的电压偏转与「兴奋性突触后电位」联系起来。

words.enDefinition: a conducting passage that carries a gland's secretion from its secretory units toward an outlet

examples.en: The atlas shows the excretory duct leading from the groups of secretory cells toward the epithelial surface.
examples.zh: 图谱显示，「排泄导管」从多个分泌细胞群通向上皮表面。

examples.en: We identified the excretory duct by tracing the continuous route away from the illustrated glandular clusters.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条连续路径从图示的腺体细胞簇向外追踪，辨认出「排泄导管」。

words.enDefinition: Pancreatic tissue producing digestive secretions that leave the gland through ducts

examples.en: The exocrine pancreas connects to the ducts shown in our simplified gland drawing.
examples.zh: 我们的简化腺体图显示，「胰腺外分泌部」与导管相连。

examples.en: We identified the exocrine pancreas as the portion that sends secretions toward the intestine.
examples.zh: 我们把向肠道输送分泌物的部分辨认为「胰腺外分泌部」。

words.enDefinition: the movement of air out of the lungs when alveolar pressure exceeds atmospheric pressure

examples.en: During quiet expiration, elastic recoil reduced the lung volume and moved air out in our model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，平静「呼气」时弹性回缩使肺容积减小，空气流出。

examples.en: We marked expiration on the descending part of the lung volume trace in the breathing exercise.
examples.zh: 在呼吸练习的肺容积曲线上，我们在下降段标出「呼气」。

words.enDefinition: the additional volume that can be exhaled after an ordinary expiration

examples.en: We located expiratory reserve volume below the quiet breathing range on the lung volume chart in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在肺容积图中平静呼吸范围下方标出了「呼气储备量」。

examples.en: The lower bracket shows expiratory reserve volume between the ends of quiet exhalation and maximum exhalation.
examples.zh: 下方括号表示从平静呼气结束到最大呼气结束之间的「呼气储备量」。

collocations: expiratory reserve volume on a tracing

words.enDefinition: A trial designed to test an intervention's effect under closely specified and relatively controlled conditions.

examples.en: The explanatory trial describes the conditions for the fictional comparison in more detail than the routine records.
examples.zh: 与常规记录相比，「解释性试验」更详细地描述了虚构比较所用的条件。

examples.en: We compared the explanatory trial setting with the routine follow-up described elsewhere in the workbook.
examples.zh: 我们将「解释性试验」的环境与练习册其他部分所述的常规随访作了比较。

words.enDefinition: An outcome examined to generate questions or hypotheses rather than to support the main confirmatory conclusion.

examples.en: The exploratory outcome concerns a change in a fictional rating that the study discusses cautiously.
examples.zh: 「探索性结局」涉及一项虚构评分的变化，研究对它的讨论很谨慎。

examples.en: We kept the exploratory outcome separate when summarising the planned comparison in the classroom report.
examples.zh: 我们在总结课堂报告的预定比较时，将「探索性结局」单独列出。

words.enDefinition: Incorrect assignment of observations to exposure categories in a study.

examples.en: Exposure misclassification is possible when a fictional record places activities in the wrong category on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中的虚构记录把活动归错类时，就可能发生「暴露误分类」。

examples.en: We compared the two exposure definitions before discussing exposure misclassification in the synthetic classroom study.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两种暴露定义，再讨论课堂合成研究中的「暴露误分类」。

words.enDefinition: one of the muscles between the ribs that typically helps raise the ribs during inspiration

examples.en: The anatomy model shows an external intercostal muscle filling the space between two ribs in the chest wall.
examples.zh: 解剖模型上，一处「肋间外肌」位于胸壁的两根肋骨之间。

examples.en: We linked contraction of an external intercostal muscle with elevation of the ribs in the inhalation animation.
examples.zh: 我们在吸气动画中，将「肋间外肌」收缩与肋骨抬高联系起来。

words.enDefinition: A superficial muscle of the side of the abdominal wall that helps turn and bend the trunk.

examples.en: The external oblique muscle lies along the side of the abdomen in the model.
examples.zh: 模型里，「腹外斜肌」位于腹部侧方。

examples.en: We compared the fibre direction of the external oblique muscle with the vertical muscle nearby.
examples.zh: 我们比较「腹外斜肌」的肌纤维走向与附近竖直肌肉的走向。

collocations: action of the external oblique muscle

words.enDefinition: Water and dissolved substances occupying the body spaces outside its cells

examples.en: The chart groups the fluid outside cells as extracellular fluid in the model.
examples.zh: 图表将模型中细胞外的液体统一归作「细胞外液」。

examples.en: We divided extracellular fluid into several smaller regions on the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在教学示意图上将「细胞外液」划分为若干较小的区域。

words.enDefinition: Network of material outside cells that gives a tissue structural support

examples.en: The connective tissue diagram shows the extracellular matrix filling the spaces between cells.
examples.zh: 结缔组织示意图显示「细胞外基质」填在细胞之间。

examples.en: We labeled the visible fibers as part of the extracellular matrix in the image.
examples.zh: 我们将图中可见的纤维标为「细胞外基质」的一部分。

words.enDefinition: Branch of the classical clotting scheme beginning with a signal from tissue factor

examples.en: The simplified chart connects tissue factor with the extrinsic coagulation pathway at its beginning.
examples.zh: 简化图将组织因子连到「外源性凝血途径」的起始处。

examples.en: We traced the extrinsic coagulation pathway to the place where both branches meet.
examples.zh: 我们沿「外源性凝血途径」追踪到两个分支的汇合处。

collocations: diagram of the extrinsic coagulation pathway
factors in the extrinsic coagulation pathway

words.enDefinition: the part of an optical instrument through which a viewer looks, commonly magnifying an intermediate image

examples.en: The eyepiece is at the upper end of the viewing tube in the classroom microscope diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂显微镜图中，「目镜」位于观察镜筒的上端。

examples.en: The power printed on the eyepiece was one factor in the worksheet's total magnification calculation.
examples.zh: 「目镜」上印的倍率是练习中计算总放大倍数的一个因子。

words.enDefinition: A trial comparing combinations of levels of two or more intervention factors.

examples.en: The factorial trial table lists combinations of reminder timing and diary format in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 虚构示例的「析因试验」表列出提醒时间与日志格式的不同组合。

examples.en: We read across the factorial trial table to see which groups share the same format.
examples.zh: 我们逐项查看「析因试验」表，找出使用同一版式的组。

words.enDefinition: The reduced form of flavin adenine dinucleotide that carries electrons during metabolism.

examples.en: The diagram marks FADH2 beside the step in which an enzyme's bound carrier accepts electrons.
examples.zh: 图中在酶结合的载体接受电子的一步旁标出了「还原型 FAD」。

examples.en: We followed the electrons associated with FADH2 on the map of normal mitochondrial energy metabolism.
examples.zh: 我们在正常线粒体能量代谢图上追踪「还原型 FAD」所携带的电子。

words.enDefinition: An organic acid consisting of a hydrocarbon chain and a terminal carboxyl group.

examples.en: We recognized the fatty acid by finding the carboxyl group at one end of its carbon chain.
examples.zh: 我们在碳链一端找到羧基，据此辨认出「脂肪酸」。

examples.en: The cellular diagram shows one fatty acid tail extending toward the center of the membrane layer.
examples.zh: 细胞图显示一条「脂肪酸」尾部伸向膜层中央。

words.enDefinition: Repeated breakdown of fatty acyl chains that releases two-carbon acetyl units and transfers electrons to carriers.

examples.en: The map shows fatty acid beta-oxidation shortening a long chain as acetyl units appear in the diagram.
examples.zh: 代谢图显示，「脂肪酸 β 氧化」使长链缩短，同时出现乙酰基单元。

examples.en: We located fatty acid beta-oxidation on the pathway chart connecting stored fat to central energy metabolism.
examples.zh: 我们在连接储存脂肪与中央能量代谢的图上找到了「脂肪酸 β 氧化」。

collocations: a map of fatty acid beta-oxidation

words.enDefinition: Regulation in which a product of a metabolic pathway reduces activity at an earlier step.

examples.en: In the classroom map, feedback inhibition sends a regulatory arrow from the final product toward an earlier enzyme.
examples.zh: 课堂图用从最终产物指向上游酶的调节箭头，表示「反馈抑制」。

examples.en: We located feedback inhibition by finding where the end product reduced activity earlier in the pathway.
examples.zh: 我们找到终产物降低途径上游活性的位置，据此定位「反馈抑制」。

words.enDefinition: The thigh bone extending from the hip to the knee.

examples.en: The femur extends from the hip socket to the knee in the classroom skeleton model.
examples.zh: 课堂骨骼模型中，「股骨」从髋关节窝延伸到膝部。

examples.en: We turned the femur model to compare its upper and lower ends during the lesson.
examples.zh: 讲解时，我们转动「股骨」模型，比较它的上下端。

words.enDefinition: Insoluble protein forming strands that strengthen the structure of a blood clot

examples.en: The drawing uses fibrin strands to show how the plug is reinforced.
examples.zh: 图中用「纤维蛋白」丝表示血小板栓如何得到加固。

examples.en: We shaded the network of fibrin around the cell cluster in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上给细胞团簇周围的「纤维蛋白」网涂了阴影。

words.enDefinition: Soluble plasma protein that is converted into fibrin during clotting

examples.en: The diagram shows fibrinogen in the liquid before the strands appear.
examples.zh: 图中，在纤维丝出现之前，液体里已经有「纤维蛋白原」。

examples.en: We placed fibrinogen on the soluble side of the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂对比图中把「纤维蛋白原」放在可溶性成分的一侧。

words.enDefinition: Physiological breakdown of the fibrin network after a clot has formed

examples.en: The textbook shows fibrinolysis as the gradual disappearance of the fibrin strands.
examples.zh: 教材将纤维蛋白丝逐渐消失的过程画成「纤维蛋白溶解」。

examples.en: We labeled fibrinolysis at the stage where the illustrated network breaks apart.
examples.zh: 我们在图示纤维网分解的阶段标注了「纤维蛋白溶解」。

words.enDefinition: a layer of dense connective tissue surrounding an organ or another anatomical structure

examples.en: The fibrous capsule appears as a compact outer band at the edge of the supplied organ section.
examples.zh: 在给出的器官切片边缘，「纤维被膜」呈致密的外侧带状结构。

examples.en: We traced the fibrous capsule around the classroom image before comparing it with the internal supporting tissue.
examples.zh: 我们先在课堂图上沿「纤维被膜」描出器官周边，再与内部支持组织作比较。

words.enDefinition: A joint where bones are connected by fibrous connective tissue without a joint cavity.

examples.en: The fibrous joint is shown as a narrow connection between the two bones on the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中两块骨之间的窄连接表示「纤维性关节」。

examples.en: We compared a fibrous joint with the joint model that has a fluid-filled space.
examples.zh: 我们把「纤维性关节」与具有液体充填腔隙的关节模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the tough outer connective tissue layer of the sac surrounding the heart

examples.en: The fibrous pericardium formed the outermost layer of the heart's protective sac on the classroom drawing.
