examples.zh: 在课堂图中，「纤维心包」构成心脏保护囊的最外层。

examples.en: We labeled the fibrous pericardium outside the thinner lining on the enlarged section in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们在图谱的放大切面上，在较薄衬层外侧标出了「纤维心包」。

words.enDefinition: The slender bone running along the lateral side of the lower leg beside the tibia.

examples.en: The fibula runs alongside the larger bone on the outer side of the model leg.
examples.zh: 模型腿外侧的「腓骨」与较大的胫骨并排。

examples.en: We compared the lower end of the fibula with the adjacent ankle bones on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们在图上将「腓骨」的下端与相邻的踝部骨作比较。

words.enDefinition: a microscope illumination control that limits the area of the specimen reached by the illuminating light

examples.en: The diagram labels the field diaphragm where the illustrated aperture limits the illuminated portion of the specimen.
examples.zh: 图中在所绘开口限制标本受照范围的位置标出「视场光阑」。

examples.en: We distinguished the field diaphragm from the aperture that controls the angle of the illuminating cone.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「视场光阑」和控制照明光锥角度的那个光阑。

collocations: field diaphragm in the illumination path

words.enDefinition: the area visible through an optical instrument or within a displayed image at a given setting

examples.en: The small gland occupied most of the field of view after the instructor changed to higher magnification.
examples.zh: 老师切换到较高倍率后，小腺体占据了大部分「视野范围」。

examples.en: We marked the edge of the field of view on the circular microscope image in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在圆形显微图像上标出了「视野范围」的边缘。

collocations: structures within the field of view

words.enDefinition: the microscope control that makes small changes to the relative position of the lens and specimen for precise focusing

examples.en: The animation links the fine focus knob to a small movement and a sharper image of the section.
examples.zh: 动画将「微调焦旋钮」与微小位移及更清晰的切片图像联系起来。

examples.en: We identified the fine focus knob inside the larger focus control on the microscope illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在显微镜图中较大调焦控制件的内侧找到了「微调焦旋钮」。

collocations: short movement of the fine focus knob

words.enDefinition: the sound associated with closure of the atrioventricular valves near the beginning of ventricular systole

examples.en: The timeline places the first heart sound close to closure of the atrioventricular valves in the animation.
examples.zh: 动画时间线把「第一心音」标在房室瓣关闭的时刻附近。

examples.en: We matched the first heart sound in the supplied recording with the start of pressure buildup.
examples.zh: 我们将给定录音中的「第一心音」对应到心室压力开始升高的时刻。

collocations: timing of the first heart sound

words.enDefinition: A meta-analysis model that assumes included studies estimate one common underlying effect.

examples.en: The fixed-effect meta-analysis treats the fictional studies as estimating one underlying effect in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习的「固定效应荟萃分析」认为各虚构研究估计的是同一个潜在真实效应。

examples.en: We examined the common effect assumption before reading the fixed-effect meta-analysis estimate in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对共同效应假设，再读「固定效应荟萃分析」的估计。

words.enDefinition: A relatively thin, often curved bone such as the sternum or scapula.

examples.en: The model sternum is classified as a flat bone because of its broad thin shape.
examples.zh: 模型胸骨因形状宽而薄，被归为「扁骨」。

examples.en: We compared the thickness of a flat bone with the shaft of the long bone.
examples.zh: 我们比较了一块「扁骨」的厚度和长骨骨干的厚度。

words.enDefinition: A bending movement that generally decreases the angle between two body segments at a joint.

examples.en: The elbow model demonstrates flexion as the forearm moves closer to the upper arm.
examples.zh: 前臂靠近上臂时，肘部模型示范了「屈曲」。

examples.en: We drew an arrow for flexion on the side view of the knee model.
examples.zh: 我们在膝部模型的侧视图上用箭头标出「屈曲」。

words.enDefinition: The relationship between the body's water intake and water loss over a period, determining whether its total water content rises, falls or remains steady.

examples.en: Our classroom model shows fluid balance when total inflow equals total outflow.
examples.zh: 课堂模型显示，流入总量等于流出总量时达到「体液平衡」。

examples.en: We plotted the two totals separately before discussing fluid balance in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们分别画出两个总量，再讨论仿真中的「体液平衡」。

words.enDefinition: microscopy that forms an image from light emitted by fluorescent material after optical excitation

examples.en: The fluorescence microscopy example shows bright labeled structures on a dark background in the supplied atlas.
examples.zh: 给定图谱中的「荧光显微术」示例显示，带标记的明亮结构位于暗背景中。

examples.en: The class compared two fluorescence microscopy images to identify which parts of the teaching section emitted light.
examples.zh: 全班比较两幅「荧光显微术」图像，辨认教学切片中的哪些部位发光。

words.enDefinition: X-ray imaging that displays a continuing series of projection images to show movement over time

examples.en: The fluoroscopy example shows the outline changing position across successive frames of the teaching video.
examples.zh: 教学视频的「X线透视」示例显示，轮廓在连续帧中改变位置。

examples.en: We distinguished fluoroscopy from a single static radiograph by looking at how the lecture displayed movement.
examples.zh: 我们通过观察课件如何显示运动，区分「X线透视」与单张静态 X 线片。

words.enDefinition: in specimen viewing, the plane through the specimen that appears sharp at the current focus setting

examples.en: The simulated focal plane passed through the top of the tissue fold, bringing that layer into focus.
examples.zh: 模拟「焦平面」穿过组织褶皱顶部，使该层清楚成像。

examples.en: We compared the features visible in the two positions of the focal plane on the digital example.
examples.zh: 我们在数字示例中比较「焦平面」处于两个位置时分别可见的特征。

words.enDefinition: The interval during which participants or their records are observed for study outcomes after a defined starting point.

examples.en: The follow-up period is shown as a shaded interval on the classroom chart of fictional visits.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构访视图用阴影时段表示「随访期」。

examples.en: We compared two studies with different follow-up period lengths in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中比较两项「随访期」长短不同的研究。

words.enDefinition: Soft mass of chewed material prepared for swallowing in the mouth

examples.en: The diagram shows a food bolus forming from chewed material mixed with saliva.
examples.zh: 图中显示咀嚼后的食物和唾液混合在一起，形成「食团」。

examples.en: We traced the food bolus from the mouth toward the illustrated esophagus.
examples.zh: 我们在图中追踪「食团」从口腔向食管移动的过程。

words.enDefinition: Movement that turns the sole of the foot away from the midline of the body.

examples.en: The ankle model shows foot eversion when the sole turns away from the other foot.
examples.zh: 踝部模型的足底朝远离另一只脚的方向转时，展示的是「足外翻」。

examples.en: We used a second arrow for foot eversion on the picture of the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型图上用第二支箭头表示「足外翻」。

words.enDefinition: Movement that turns the sole of the foot toward the midline of the body.

examples.en: The ankle model shows foot inversion when the sole turns toward the other foot.
examples.zh: 踝部模型的足底转向另一只脚时，展示的是「足内翻」。

examples.en: We drew a curved arrow to represent foot inversion in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上画一支弧线箭头来表示「足内翻」。

words.enDefinition: A graph showing individual study effect estimates with their uncertainty intervals, often alongside a pooled estimate.

examples.en: The forest plot displays one row per fictional study and a pooled estimate at the bottom.
examples.zh: 「森林图」给各项虚构研究各列一行，并在底部给出合并估计。

examples.en: We read the forest plot to compare the width of the intervals in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「森林图」，比较课堂示例中各区间的宽度。

collocations: study estimates in a forest plot

words.enDefinition: Cellular and cell-derived components of blood, including platelets and both blood cell groups

examples.en: The diagram groups red cells, white cells, and platelets as formed elements.
examples.zh: 示意图将红细胞、白细胞和血小板归为「血液有形成分」。

examples.en: We labeled the formed elements separately from the liquid portion of blood.
examples.zh: 我们将「血液有形成分」与血液的液体部分分开标注。

words.enDefinition: A form of genetic drift in which a new population begins with allele frequencies reflecting a small founding group.

examples.en: The founder effect model compares symbolic allele counts in the founding group with the larger original group.
examples.zh: 「奠基者效应」模型比较创始小组与原先较大群体的等位基因符号计数。

examples.en: We used paper symbols to simulate the founder effect in a completely fictional population.
examples.zh: 我们用纸片符号模拟完全虚构群体中的「奠基者效应」。

collocations: allele frequencies after a founder effect

words.enDefinition: the cavity between the cerebellum and the brainstem that receives cerebrospinal fluid from the cerebral aqueduct

examples.en: The fourth ventricle appears between the cerebellum and the lower brainstem on the classroom midsagittal view.
examples.zh: 在课堂正中矢状面图上，「第四脑室」位于小脑与脑干下段之间。

examples.en: We followed the aqueduct to the fourth ventricle before tracing the openings toward the surrounding fluid spaces.
examples.zh: 我们沿导水管追踪至「第四脑室」，再沿各开口追踪到周围的脑脊液间隙。

words.enDefinition: the small central depression in the retinal macula specialized for sharp vision

examples.en: The diagram places the fovea centralis in the center of the area used for sharp central vision.
examples.zh: 图中将「中央凹」置于提供清晰中心视觉的区域中央。

examples.en: We linked the high cone density in the fovea centralis to resolution in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，我们将「中央凹」内较高的视锥细胞密度与视觉分辨能力联系起来。

collocations: cone density in the fovea centralis

words.enDefinition: the intrinsic tendency of the heart to eject more blood when greater ventricular filling stretches myocardial fibers within their physiological range

examples.en: The Frank-Starling mechanism explains the higher stroke volume when the model increases ventricular filling within its normal range.
examples.zh: 「弗兰克–斯塔林机制」解释了模型在正常范围内增加心室充盈时，每搏输出量为何增大。

examples.en: We traced the model curve linking end-diastolic volume to output per beat under the Frank-Starling mechanism.
examples.zh: 我们沿着模型曲线观察「弗兰克–斯塔林机制」如何联系舒张末期容积与每搏输出量。

words.enDefinition: the part of a cerebral hemisphere anterior to the central sulcus, containing areas involved in movement and planning

examples.en: The frontal lobe lies ahead of the marked central groove on the side view of the brain model.
examples.zh: 在脑模型的侧视图上，「额叶」位于标出的中央沟之前。

examples.en: We located the motor area within the frontal lobe using a colored region on the teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们根据教学图上的彩色区域，在「额叶」内找到运动区。

words.enDefinition: Vertical plane dividing the body into anterior and posterior portions

examples.en: The frontal plane separates the front and back portions of the displayed model.
examples.zh: 「额状面」将展示模型分为前、后两部分。

examples.en: Our frontal plane is drawn upright and parallel to the model's front outline.
examples.zh: 图中的「额状面」为竖直平面，与模型的正面轮廓平行。

words.enDefinition: a thin slice cut from tissue that was frozen to give it support during sectioning

examples.en: The slide description names a frozen section as the source of the image on the left.
examples.zh: 玻片说明将左侧图像的来源标为「冰冻切片」。

examples.en: We compared the frozen section and the wax-supported section using the images supplied by the instructor.
examples.zh: 我们使用老师给出的图像，对照「冰冻切片」与石蜡支撑的切片。

words.enDefinition: A six-carbon sugar distinguished from glucose by the location of the carbonyl group in its open-chain form.

examples.en: The diagram labels fructose beside glucose, showing their carbonyl groups at different positions in open chains.
examples.zh: 图中并列标出了「果糖」和葡萄糖，显示两者在开链形式下的羰基位置不同。

examples.en: We traced the arrow showing how human cells can route fructose into a central metabolic pathway.
examples.zh: 我们顺着箭头看人体细胞如何让「果糖」进入一条中央代谢途径。

words.enDefinition: the volume of air remaining in the lungs at the end of a normal quiet expiration

examples.en: The chart marks functional residual capacity at the end of each quiet expiration in the model.
examples.zh: 图表在模型每次平静呼气结束时所处的容积标出「功能残气量」。

examples.en: We found functional residual capacity by adding expiratory reserve volume and residual volume in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习中，我们将呼气储备量与残气量相加，求得「功能残气量」。

words.enDefinition: A graph of study estimates against a measure of study size or precision used to explore patterns such as asymmetry.

examples.en: The funnel plot places fictional study estimates against their precision in the classroom review example.
examples.zh: 课堂综述示例的「漏斗图」将虚构研究估计值与相应精度对照绘制。

examples.en: We discussed why asymmetry in a funnel plot can have more than one explanation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论了为什么「漏斗图」的不对称性可能有多种解释。

words.enDefinition: A six-carbon sugar differing from glucose in the arrangement at one carbon atom.

examples.en: The class compared galactose with glucose by checking the orientation of one group on the sugar ring.
examples.zh: 我们核对糖环上一个基团的朝向，用来比较「半乳糖」和葡萄糖。

examples.en: The chart showed galactose as one of the sugar units in a molecule found on human cells.
examples.zh: 图表把「半乳糖」列为人体细胞表面某分子的糖单元之一。

words.enDefinition: Small organ beneath the liver that stores and concentrates bile

examples.en: The gallbladder appears below the liver in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，「胆囊」位于肝脏下方。

examples.en: We traced the duct connecting the gallbladder to the wider biliary system.
examples.zh: 我们描出了连接「胆囊」与其他胆道结构的导管。

words.enDefinition: A reproductive cell carrying one chromosome set that can unite with another such cell at fertilization.

examples.en: The gamete carries one set of chromosomes in the simplified human inheritance diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂简化的人类遗传图中，「配子」带有一套染色体。

examples.en: We marked each gamete before combining the chromosome sets in the fictional worksheet example.
examples.zh: 在虚构练习中，我们先标出每个「配子」，再合并它们携带的染色体组。

words.enDefinition: a cluster of neuronal cell bodies in the peripheral nervous system

examples.en: The ganglion appears as a swelling on one of the roots in the classroom spinal nerve model.
examples.zh: 课堂脊神经模型中，「神经节」在其中一根神经根上表现为一处膨大。

examples.en: We labeled the ganglion after locating a cluster of peripheral neuronal cell bodies in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先在图中找出一簇周围神经元胞体，再将它标作「神经节」。

words.enDefinition: Lower stomach region that leads toward the pyloric canal and outlet

examples.en: The outline narrows beyond the gastric antrum as it approaches the stomach outlet.
examples.zh: 胃的轮廓越过「胃窦」后，接近胃出口处逐渐变窄。

examples.en: We marked the gastric antrum below the large central portion of our model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型的中央大部下方标出了「胃窦」。

words.enDefinition: Large central region of the stomach between the fundus and lower portion

examples.en: The gastric body occupies most of the central area in this simplified stomach diagram.
examples.zh: 在这张简化胃示意图中，「胃体」占据中央区域的大部分。

examples.en: We distinguished the gastric body from the rounded upper portion on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上区分了「胃体」和上方的圆隆部分。

words.enDefinition: Movement of stomach contents into the first part of the small intestine

examples.en: The animation uses arrows to represent gastric emptying through the stomach outlet.
examples.zh: 动画用箭头表示胃内容物经过出口的「胃排空」过程。

examples.en: We compared gastric emptying with mixing inside the stomach on our flowchart.
examples.zh: 我们在流程图中比较了「胃排空」与胃内混合过程。

words.enDefinition: Rounded upper part of the stomach lying above the esophageal entry

examples.en: The gastric fundus forms a dome above the esophageal opening in our model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「胃底」呈穹隆状，位于食管开口上方。

examples.en: We marked the gastric fundus near the spleen in the upper abdominal model.
examples.zh: 我们在上腹部模型中靠近脾脏的位置标出了「胃底」。

collocations: upper curve of the gastric fundus

words.enDefinition: Secretory structure in the stomach lining that opens into a gastric pit

examples.en: The gastric gland is drawn beneath the opening in the stomach lining.
examples.zh: 「胃腺」被画在胃内衬开口的下方。

examples.en: We drew an arrow from the gastric gland toward the interior of the stomach.
examples.zh: 我们画出从「胃腺」指向胃腔的箭头。

words.enDefinition: Stomach secretion containing acid and substances that participate in digestion

examples.en: The classroom diagram shows gastric juice mixing with swallowed material inside the stomach.
examples.zh: 课堂图显示「胃液」在胃内与吞下的物质混合。

examples.en: Our lesson separates gastric juice from the material later added by the pancreas.
examples.zh: 课堂把「胃液」与之后由胰腺加入消化道的物质分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: Interior space of the stomach where food mixes with gastric secretions

examples.en: The gastric lumen is the open region inside the stomach's outline on the diagram.
examples.zh: 「胃腔」是示意图中胃壁轮廓内的空间。

examples.en: We drew arrows into the gastric lumen to represent the stomach's secretions.
examples.zh: 我们画出指向「胃腔」内的箭头，表示胃的分泌物进入其中。

words.enDefinition: Small surface depression in the stomach lining into which gastric glands open

examples.en: The atlas shows a gastric pit dipping down from the stomach's inner surface.
examples.zh: 图谱显示一个「胃小凹」从胃内表面向下凹入。

examples.en: We labeled the gastric pit above the deeper gland in the enlarged drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在放大图中给深层腺体上方的「胃小凹」加了标注。

words.enDefinition: Folds of the stomach lining that flatten as the organ expands

examples.en: The empty stomach diagram shows gastric rugae as prominent folds along its inner surface.
examples.zh: 空胃示意图将「胃皱襞」画成内表面上一道道明显的褶皱。

examples.en: We compared the gastric rugae in two drawings showing different degrees of stomach expansion.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两幅胃扩张程度不同的图中的「胃皱襞」。

words.enDefinition: The superficial two-headed calf muscle that helps flex the knee and plantar flex the ankle.

examples.en: The gastrocnemius forms most of the visible upper calf on the classroom leg model.
examples.zh: 课堂腿部模型中，「腓肠肌」构成小腿后侧上部的大部分可见轮廓。

examples.en: We labelled both heads of the gastrocnemius in the posterior view of the lower leg.
examples.zh: 我们在小腿后视图上标出「腓肠肌」的两个肌头。

words.enDefinition: Innermost digestive wall layer containing surface epithelium and underlying tissue

examples.en: The gastrointestinal mucosa faces the interior space of the illustrated digestive tube.
examples.zh: 「胃肠道黏膜」朝向图示消化管的内部空间。

examples.en: We colored the gastrointestinal mucosa before marking the deeper layers of the wall.
examples.zh: 我们先给「胃肠道黏膜」上色，再标出管壁较深的各层。

words.enDefinition: A region of DNA whose information contributes to making a functional RNA or protein product.

examples.en: The gene is shown as one labelled region on the simplified chromosome drawing used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂染色体简图把「基因」画成一个有标签的区域。

examples.en: We pointed to the gene before reading the two symbolic forms assigned in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「基因」，再看练习为它指定的两种符号形式。

words.enDefinition: The movement of alleles between populations when individuals or their descendants contribute to another population's gene pool.

examples.en: The gene flow model uses arrows to show allele contributions between the two fictional populations.
examples.zh: 「基因流」模型用箭头展示两个虚构群体之间的等位基因贡献。

examples.en: We compared gene flow with chance changes within one isolated model population in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「基因流」与单个孤立模型群体内部随机发生的变化作了比较。

collocations: compare gene flow and genetic drift

words.enDefinition: A label identifying a row or generation in a pedigree, conventionally written with Roman numerals.

examples.en: The generation number appears at the left of each row in the fictional family diagram.
examples.zh: 虚构家系图的每行左侧都列出「世代编号」。

examples.en: We used the generation number and the individual's position to find the specified symbol.
examples.zh: 我们根据「世代编号」和个体位置找到指定符号。

words.enDefinition: An individual who carries a recessive variant without showing its associated phenotype in the inheritance model.

examples.en: The genetic carrier in the exercise has one labelled allele without the corresponding recessive feature.
examples.zh: 练习中的「隐性变异携带者」有一份带标记的等位基因，但没有表现相应的隐性特征。

examples.en: We identified a genetic carrier using the explicit symbols in the fictional family chart.
examples.zh: 我们根据虚构家系图中的明确标记辨认一名「隐性变异携带者」。

words.enDefinition: Change in allele frequencies across generations due to chance sampling in a finite population.

examples.en: The genetic drift simulation starts with the same frequencies but gives different outcomes across repeated runs.
examples.zh: 「遗传漂变」模拟从相同频率开始，每次重复运行则可能得到不同结果。

examples.en: We compared genetic drift in two fictional populations using randomly selected paper symbols.
examples.zh: 我们随机抽取纸片上的符号，比较两个虚构群体中的「遗传漂变」。

collocations: genetic drift in a finite population

words.enDefinition: The transmission of genetic material and its variants from parents to offspring.

examples.en: The lesson illustrates genetic inheritance by tracing symbolic chromosome copies across two fictional generations.
examples.zh: 课程通过追踪两代虚构人物的染色体副本符号，说明「遗传传递」。

examples.en: We used the family diagram to discuss genetic inheritance of the labelled example alleles.
examples.zh: 我们用家系图讨论示例中带标签等位基因的「遗传传递」。

words.enDefinition: The tendency of loci close together on the same chromosome to be inherited together more often.

examples.en: Genetic linkage explains why the two fictional markers often appear together in the classroom inheritance table.
examples.zh: 「遗传连锁」解释了为什么课堂遗传表上的两个虚构标记常一起出现。

examples.en: We compared genetic linkage with independent assortment using two symbolic chromosome drawings in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用两幅符号染色体图比较「遗传连锁」与自由组合。

words.enDefinition: A specific position on a chromosome or in a genome where a genetic feature is located.

examples.en: The genetic locus appears at the same marked position on both homologues in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，两条同源染色体的「遗传位点」出现在同一个标记位置。

examples.en: We recorded the genetic locus before comparing the two allele symbols on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先记下「遗传位点」，再比较图上两个等位基因符号。

words.enDefinition: A difference in genetic material relative to a stated reference or another copy at the same location.

examples.en: The genetic variant is shown only as a different symbol at the same classroom locus.
examples.zh: 在课堂同一个位点上，「遗传变异」只用一个不同符号表示。

examples.en: We recorded the genetic variant separately from the displayed trait in the fictional worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构练习图里，将「遗传变异」与所显示的性状分开记录。

words.enDefinition: The complete set of genetic material in a cell or organism.

examples.en: The genome diagram includes genetic material in the nucleus and in the mitochondria in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「基因组」示意图包含细胞核和线粒体中的遗传物质。

examples.en: We read the genome diagram by following the labels from the whole set to individual chromosomes.
examples.zh: 我们沿着标签，从整套遗传物质看到各条染色体，以读懂「基因组」图。

words.enDefinition: A form of parent-of-origin-dependent gene expression in which the parental origin influences which allele is active.

examples.en: The genomic imprinting figure labels expression according to which parent supplied the fictional allele copy.
examples.zh: 「基因组印记」图根据虚构等位基因副本来自哪一方亲代来标记表达情况。

examples.en: We compared genomic imprinting with a model where the labels depend only on the variant itself.
examples.zh: 我们将「基因组印记」与仅由变异本身决定标签的模型比较。

collocations: parent of origin in genomic imprinting

words.enDefinition: The genetic makeup at a specified locus or set of loci, or more broadly across an individual.

examples.en: The genotype is recorded as two allele symbols for each fictional person in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，每个虚构人物的「基因型」用两个等位基因符号记录。

examples.en: We copied the genotype from the allele column before describing the modelled visible feature.
examples.zh: 我们先从等位基因一栏抄下「基因型」，再描述模型中可观察到的特征。

words.enDefinition: A difference in how strongly or in which direction an environmental change affects different genotypes.

examples.en: The genotype-environment interaction appears when the two modelled genotypes respond differently across the fictional settings.
examples.zh: 两个模型基因型对不同虚构环境表现出不同反应时，就出现「基因型与环境互作」。

examples.en: We drew separate lines to illustrate the genotype-environment interaction in the synthetic classroom plot.
examples.zh: 我们在合成课堂图中分别画出两条线，以说明「基因型与环境互作」。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of individuals in a defined group who have a particular genotype.

examples.en: The genotype frequency uses individuals as the denominator in the fictional population table for class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构群体表中的「基因型频率」以个体总数作为分母。

examples.en: We compared genotype frequency with the fraction of allele copies in the same exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「基因型频率」与同一练习中计算的等位基因副本比例作比较。

words.enDefinition: The relative proportions of different genotype categories expected or observed in a stated group.

examples.en: The genotypic ratio summarises the different allele pairs in the fictional worksheet table for our class.
examples.zh: 「基因型比例」概括课堂虚构练习表中不同的等位基因配对。

examples.en: We calculated the genotypic ratio before combining entries with the same observable feature in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们先算「基因型比例」，再归并具有同样可观察特征的项目。

words.enDefinition: A cell in the lineage that develops into eggs or sperm, including a gamete in broad usage.

examples.en: The germ cell is identified by its position on the reproductive cell lineage diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上根据细胞在生殖细胞谱系图中的位置，将它认作「生殖系细胞」。

examples.en: We traced the germ cell through the stages shown in the simplified textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们沿简化教材图各阶段查看「生殖系细胞」的变化。

words.enDefinition: A variant present in the reproductive cell lineage that can potentially be passed to offspring.

examples.en: The germline variant is drawn within the reproductive cell lineage in the simplified classroom figure.
examples.zh: 课堂简图把「生殖系变异」画在生殖细胞谱系内。

examples.en: We compared a germline variant with a body-cell change using two fictional cell diagrams.
examples.zh: 我们用两幅虚构细胞图比较「生殖系变异」和体细胞中的变化。

collocations: potential transmission of a germline variant

words.enDefinition: a rounded group of secretory cells arranged around a small lumen in some glands

examples.en: The cross section shows a glandular acinus as a cluster of secretory cells around a tiny center.
examples.zh: 横切面显示，「腺泡」是一簇围绕微小中央腔排列的分泌细胞。

examples.en: We compared the rounded glandular acinus with the elongated duct profile beside it in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们将教学图中圆形的「腺泡」与邻近的长条形导管截面作比较。

words.enDefinition: Epithelial tissue specialized to produce and release substances from gland cells

examples.en: The diagram groups cells of glandular epithelium into clusters around a small space.
examples.zh: 示意图将「腺上皮」细胞画成围绕一个小腔的细胞簇。

examples.en: In the gland drawing, we labeled the cell clusters as glandular epithelium.
examples.zh: 我们在腺体图中将这些细胞簇标为「腺上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Protein chain of hemoglobin that carries a heme group

examples.en: The diagram assigns a different shade to each globin chain in the molecule.
examples.zh: 示意图用不同色调表示分子中的各条「珠蛋白链」。

examples.en: We highlighted the globin chain to show where the heme group sits.
examples.zh: 我们高亮标出「珠蛋白链」，说明血红素基团位于何处。

collocations: heme associated with a globin chain

words.enDefinition: Cup-shaped portion of the renal corpuscle surrounding the filtering capillaries

examples.en: The glomerular capsule wraps around the capillary tuft in the simplified illustration.
examples.zh: 在简化图中，「肾小囊」包围毛细血管团。

examples.en: We drew the glomerular capsule opening into the first tubular segment on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题图中把「肾小囊」画成通向第一段肾小管的结构。

words.enDefinition: Fluid formed by filtration into the space of the glomerular capsule

examples.en: The blue space surrounding the capillaries contains glomerular filtrate in the schematic.
examples.zh: 示意图中，毛细血管周围的蓝色区域含有「肾小球滤液」。

examples.en: We followed glomerular filtrate from the capsule into the first tubular segment.
examples.zh: 我们沿流动方向从肾小囊追踪「肾小球滤液」进入第一段肾小管。

words.enDefinition: Layered interface controlling movement from glomerular blood into the capsule space

examples.en: The atlas shows the glomerular filtration barrier between blood and the capsule space.
examples.zh: 图谱显示「肾小球滤过屏障」位于血液与肾小囊腔之间。

examples.en: We labeled several layers of the glomerular filtration barrier in the enlarged cross section.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的横截面图中标出了「肾小球滤过屏障」的多个层次。

collocations: layers of the glomerular filtration barrier
diagram of the glomerular filtration barrier
role of the glomerular filtration barrier

words.enDefinition: Movement of water and small solutes from glomerular blood into the capsule

examples.en: Our diagram shows glomerular filtration with arrows crossing from a vessel into the capsule.
examples.zh: 示意图用从血管跨入肾小囊的箭头表示「肾小球滤过」。

examples.en: The tutor discussed glomerular filtration before moving on to the tubules in the model.
examples.zh: 老师先讲解「肾小球滤过」，再介绍模型中的肾小管。

words.enDefinition: The total volume of filtrate entering the glomerular capsules of the functioning kidneys per unit time.

examples.en: The synthetic graph plots glomerular filtration rate against time for two hypothetical conditions.
examples.zh: 合成图绘出了两种假想条件下「肾小球滤过率」随时间的变化。

examples.en: We labeled glomerular filtration rate as a volume per unit time on the graph.
examples.zh: 我们在图上标明，「肾小球滤过率」的单位是每单位时间的体积。

collocations: glomerular filtration rate in a model

words.enDefinition: Tuft of capillaries within the renal corpuscle where blood filtration begins

examples.en: The glomerulus appears as a cluster of loops within the larger cup.
examples.zh: 「肾小球」在较大的杯状结构内部呈现为一团环状血管。

examples.en: We highlighted the glomerulus before tracing the surrounding space in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先高亮标出「肾小球」，再描出它周围的空隙。

words.enDefinition: the region of the larynx formed by the true vocal folds and the opening between them

examples.en: The diagram places the glottis at the level of the true vocal folds in the larynx.
examples.zh: 图中将「声门」标在喉内真声带所在的平面。

examples.en: In the animation, the opening of the glottis widened as the vocal folds moved apart.
examples.zh: 在动画中，随着声带彼此分开，「声门」的开口增大。

words.enDefinition: Pancreatic hormone that helps raise blood glucose, mainly through actions on the liver

examples.en: The flowchart connects glucagon with glucose released from the modeled liver.
examples.zh: 流程图将「胰高血糖素」与模型肝脏释放葡萄糖联系起来。

examples.en: We labeled glucagon beside the signal arrow leaving an islet alpha cell.
examples.zh: 我们在离开胰岛α细胞的信号箭头旁标出了「胰高血糖素」。

words.enDefinition: Formation of glucose from noncarbohydrate precursors such as lactate, glycerol, or certain amino acids.

examples.en: The diagram shows gluconeogenesis linking a noncarbohydrate starting molecule to glucose production in normal human metabolism.
examples.zh: 图中「糖异生」将非糖类起始分子与正常人体代谢中的葡萄糖生成联系起来。

examples.en: We traced glycerol toward the glucose label on the classroom chart that illustrates gluconeogenesis in humans.
examples.zh: 我们在展示人体「糖异生」的课堂图表上，从甘油一路追踪到葡萄糖标记。

words.enDefinition: A six-carbon sugar used as an energy source and stored in human cells as glycogen.

examples.en: The metabolism map placed glucose at the entrance to the pathway that breaks down the sugar.
examples.zh: 代谢图把「葡萄糖」标在分解这种糖的途径入口。

examples.en: We followed glucose from the single sugar symbol into the branched storage molecule on our worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题中从一个糖分子符号出发，追踪「葡萄糖」进入带分支的储存分子。

words.enDefinition: The large superficial buttock muscle that helps extend and externally rotate the hip.

examples.en: The gluteus maximus forms the broad superficial layer over the buttock in the posterior model.
examples.zh: 模型后视图中，臀部面积较大的浅层肌肉是「臀大肌」。

examples.en: We identified gluteus maximus before reviewing which muscles contribute to hip extension in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找出「臀大肌」，再回顾哪些肌肉参与髋部伸展。

words.enDefinition: A muscle on the outer side of the hip that helps abduct the thigh and stabilise the pelvis.

examples.en: The gluteus medius is highlighted on the outer side of the hip in the illustration.
examples.zh: 图上髋部外侧突出的标记表示「臀中肌」。

examples.en: We compared gluteus medius with the larger superficial muscle on the posterior model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在后方视图模型中比较「臀中肌」与一块更大的浅层肌肉。

words.enDefinition: The three-carbon glycerol framework to which other groups are attached in a lipid.

examples.en: We traced the glycerol backbone between the fatty acid tails and the polar head in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在图中沿着脂肪酸尾与极性头部之间的「甘油骨架」观察。

examples.en: The three attachment positions on the glycerol backbone were labeled in the storage lipid example.
examples.zh: 储存脂示意图标出了「甘油骨架」上的三个连接位置。

collocations: a glycerol backbone in a phospholipid
groups attached to a glycerol backbone

words.enDefinition: A branched glucose polymer used to store carbohydrate in human cells.

examples.en: The muscle cell diagram shows glycogen as a reserve of glucose units arranged in branched chains.
examples.zh: 肌细胞图将「糖原」画成由支链上的葡萄糖单元构成的储备。

examples.en: We traced the pathway arrow showing how an ordinary human cell adds glucose units to glycogen.
examples.zh: 我们顺着代谢图箭头，看普通人体细胞如何向「糖原」添加葡萄糖单元。

words.enDefinition: A discrete intracellular particle containing stored glycogen and associated proteins.

examples.en: The enlarged cell picture labels a glycogen granule as a small storage particle in the cytoplasm.
examples.zh: 放大的细胞图将「糖原颗粒」标为细胞质中的小型储存颗粒。

examples.en: We matched the glycogen granule in the tissue illustration with the branch pattern in the molecular diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将组织图中的「糖原颗粒」与分子图里的分支结构对应起来。

collocations: a glycogen granule in a cell
the surface of a glycogen granule

words.enDefinition: The cellular formation of glycogen from glucose-derived building blocks.

examples.en: The diagram represents glycogenesis with arrows adding glucose units to a branched storage molecule in muscle.
examples.zh: 图中用将葡萄糖单元加到肌肉中支链储存分子的箭头表示「糖原合成」。

examples.en: We identified glycogenesis on the muscle cell map where the glucose reserve became larger in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在肌细胞图中葡萄糖储备增加的位置辨认出了「糖原合成」。

words.enDefinition: Breakdown of glycogen, releasing most of its glucose units as glucose-1-phosphate.

examples.en: The classroom drawing shows glycogenolysis supplying glucose phosphate from a branched storage molecule in muscle.
examples.zh: 课堂图画出肌肉中的支链储存分子经「糖原分解」释放葡萄糖磷酸衍生物。

examples.en: We followed glycogenolysis in the map while locating the unit released from the stored chain.
examples.zh: 我们在代谢图中沿「糖原分解」观察，同时找出从储存链上释放的单元。

words.enDefinition: A lipid bearing an attached carbohydrate group.

examples.en: The text shows the sugar portion of a glycolipid projecting outward from the human cell membrane.
examples.zh: 教材显示，「糖脂」的糖部分从人体细胞膜向外伸出。

examples.en: We distinguished the glycolipid in the figure by following its attached sugar chain toward the cell exterior.
examples.zh: 我们在图中沿向细胞外伸展的连接糖链，认出了「糖脂」。

collocations: the sugar group of a glycolipid
a glycolipid on the cell surface

words.enDefinition: A cytoplasmic pathway converting glucose to pyruvate while producing ATP and reduced electron carriers.

examples.en: The diagram places glycolysis in the cytoplasm and labels pyruvate as the product of the pathway.
examples.zh: 图中将「糖酵解」标在细胞质内，并把丙酮酸标为该途径的产物。

examples.en: We traced glycolysis across the worksheet to see where ATP was used and later produced.
examples.zh: 我们沿习题追踪「糖酵解」，查看 ATP 在哪里被消耗，又在哪里生成。

words.enDefinition: A covalent link joining a sugar through its anomeric carbon to another group.

examples.en: We highlighted the glycosidic bond linking two glucose units in the picture of the storage chain.
examples.zh: 我们在储存糖链图中高亮了连接两个葡萄糖单元的「糖苷键」。

examples.en: The tutor marked a different glycosidic bond where the glycogen chain branched in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在课堂图里糖原链分支处标出了另一种「糖苷键」。

words.enDefinition: A structured framework for judging certainty of evidence and, in guideline settings, the strength of recommendations.

examples.en: The GRADE approach is used to label evidence certainty for each fictional outcome in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用「GRADE 评估方法」标明各虚构结局的证据确定性。

examples.en: We looked at the GRADE approach notes to understand why one model outcome was rated lower.
examples.zh: 我们查看「GRADE 评估方法」说明，了解为何某项模型结局的评级较低。

collocations: certainty rating with the GRADE approach

words.enDefinition: a local change in membrane voltage whose size varies with input strength and declines with distance

examples.en: The model produced a larger graded potential when the simulated stimulus opened more channels at the input site.
examples.zh: 模拟刺激在输入部位打开更多通道时，模型产生了更大的「渐变电位」。

examples.en: We plotted the graded potential at two positions to show how the local voltage change weakened with distance.
examples.zh: 我们在两个位置绘出「渐变电位」，展示局部电压变化如何随距离增加而减弱。

words.enDefinition: White blood cell with conspicuous cytoplasmic granules in standard tissue images

examples.en: The atlas shows a granulocyte with several visible dots inside its outline.
examples.zh: 图谱展示一个「粒细胞」，其轮廓以内有几个可见的小点。

examples.en: We assigned the picture to the granulocyte category after examining its internal granules.
examples.zh: 我们观察细胞内部的颗粒后，将图中细胞归入「粒细胞」一类。

words.enDefinition: nervous tissue rich in neuronal cell bodies, dendrites and synapses, with supporting cells and axons

examples.en: The section shows gray matter at the cerebral surface and also in deeper nuclei beneath the cortex.
examples.zh: 切面图显示，大脑表面及皮层下较深的神经核团内均有「灰质」。

examples.en: We shaded the central gray matter separately from the surrounding white matter in the spinal cord drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在脊髓图中，给中央的「灰质」和周围的白质分别着色。

words.enDefinition: Study of body structures visible without using a microscope

examples.en: Our gross anatomy class compares the visible shapes of organs on teaching models.
examples.zh: 我们的「大体解剖学」课用教学模型比较器官可见的外形。

examples.en: We used a gross anatomy atlas to label structures visible to the unaided eye.
examples.zh: 我们用「大体解剖学」图谱给肉眼可见的结构加上标注。

words.enDefinition: Nonfibrous material of connective tissue matrix that surrounds its cells and fibers

examples.en: The diagram shows ground substance between the colored fibers of the supporting tissue.
examples.zh: 图中带颜色的支撑组织纤维之间显示的是「无定形基质」。

examples.en: We distinguished ground substance from the longer fibers in the textbook image.
examples.zh: 我们把教材图中的「无定形基质」与较长的纤维区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Anterior pituitary signal that supports body growth and influences nutrient use

examples.en: The chart lists growth hormone among the signals produced by the front lobe.
examples.zh: 图表将「生长激素」列为垂体前叶产生的信号之一。

examples.en: We marked the source of growth hormone on the simplified endocrine diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化内分泌图中标出了「生长激素」的来源。

collocations: growth hormone from the anterior pituitary

words.enDefinition: a specialized cell within a taste bud that responds to dissolved substances and signals to sensory nerves

examples.en: The model shows a gustatory receptor cell responding after a dissolved substance reaches the taste bud opening.
examples.zh: 模型显示，在溶解物质到达味蕾开口后，「味觉感受细胞」产生响应。

examples.en: We drew the gustatory receptor cell next to a sensory nerve ending in the classroom taste diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「味觉感受细胞」画在课堂味觉图的一处感觉神经末梢旁。

collocations: signals from a gustatory receptor cell

words.enDefinition: the enlarged base of a hair root containing cells that contribute to hair growth

examples.en: The diagram marks the hair bulb as the enlargement of the hair root at the follicle's base.
examples.zh: 图中将毛囊底部膨大的毛根标为「毛球」。

examples.en: We identified the hair bulb as the base below the narrower root in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们在教学图像中辨认出较细毛根下方的膨大底部，即「毛球」。

words.enDefinition: a tubular structure derived from the epidermis that surrounds the hair root and supports hair growth

examples.en: The hair follicle extends from a narrow opening at the skin surface down into the classroom cross section.
examples.zh: 课堂横切图中，「毛囊」从皮肤表面的狭窄开口向下延伸。

examples.en: We traced the hair follicle along the sides of the developing hair in the enlarged skin model.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的皮肤模型中，沿生长中毛发的两侧描出「毛囊」。

words.enDefinition: the population of actively dividing cells in the hair bulb that gives rise to growing hair

examples.en: The sketch places the hair matrix near the base of the bulb in the classroom hair growth model.
examples.zh: 课堂毛发生长模型的示意图中，「毛母质」位于毛球基部附近。

examples.en: We labeled the hair matrix where the diagram shows new cells joining the forming hair structure.
examples.zh: 我们在图示新细胞进入正在形成的毛发结构处标出「毛母质」。

words.enDefinition: the portion of a hair located below the skin surface and enclosed within the follicle

examples.en: The model shows the hair root inside the follicle before the hair emerges at the surface.
examples.zh: 模型显示，毛发尚未露出皮肤表面的部分「毛根」位于毛囊内部。

examples.en: We traced the hair root toward its expanded base on the enlarged section through the follicle.
examples.zh: 我们在穿过毛囊的放大切面上，沿「毛根」追踪至其膨大的底部。

words.enDefinition: the portion of a hair projecting beyond the skin surface

examples.en: The hair shaft is visible above the surface in the labeled diagram of the intact skin model.
examples.zh: 在完整皮肤模型的标注图中，表面以上可以看到「毛干」。

examples.en: We compared the external hair shaft with the portion remaining below the surface in the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 在教学图上，我们对照外露的「毛干」与仍在皮肤表面以下的部分。

words.enDefinition: A group of posterior thigh muscles that flex the knee and mostly also extend the hip.

examples.en: The hamstring muscles are highlighted on the back of the thigh in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图在大腿后侧突出标出「腘绳肌群」。

examples.en: We compared the hamstring muscles with the group on the front of the thigh.
examples.zh: 我们把「腘绳肌群」与大腿前侧的肌群作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A cell with one complete set of chromosomes.

examples.en: The haploid cell is drawn with only one complete set of chromosomes in the lesson.
examples.zh: 课上所画的「单倍体细胞」中只有一套完整的染色体。

examples.en: We identified a haploid cell by counting one set of chromosomes on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中数到一套染色体，因此认出这是「单倍体细胞」。

words.enDefinition: A reference equilibrium in which allele and genotype frequencies remain stable across generations under specified assumptions.

examples.en: The Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium example compares expected and observed genotype proportions in the fictional population.
examples.zh: 「哈迪—温伯格平衡」示例比较虚构群体的预期与观测基因型比例。

examples.en: We listed the assumptions of Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium before interpreting the calculated classroom proportions.
examples.zh: 我们先列出「哈迪—温伯格平衡」的假设，再解读课堂算出的比例。

words.enDefinition: A ratio comparing the instantaneous event rates of two groups among people who have not yet experienced the event.

examples.en: The fictional model reports a constant hazard ratio because it assumes proportional hazards throughout the follow-up period.
examples.zh: 虚构模型假设整个随访期内两组瞬时风险成比例，所以报告一个恒定的「瞬时风险比」。

examples.en: We checked the model assumptions before interpreting the hazard ratio shown in the simulated results.
examples.zh: 我们先核对模型假设，再解释模拟结果中显示的「瞬时风险比」。

words.enDefinition: The effects of health on physical, mental, and social aspects of a person's perceived daily life.

examples.en: Health-related quality of life is represented by several questionnaire domains in the fictional follow-up table.
examples.zh: 虚构随访表用问卷的多个领域表示「健康相关生活质量」。

examples.en: We compared two health-related quality of life scores measured at different times in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂示例在不同时点测得的两个「健康相关生活质量」评分。

collocations: change in health-related quality of life

words.enDefinition: T lymphocyte that sends signals helping coordinate other immune cells' responses

examples.en: The flowchart shows a helper T cell sending signals to other immune cells.
examples.zh: 流程图显示「辅助性T细胞」向其他免疫细胞发送信号。

examples.en: We followed the arrows leaving the helper T cell in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂模型中从「辅助性T细胞」引出的箭头查看信号走向。

collocations: signals from a helper T cell
role of a helper T cell

words.enDefinition: Proportion of the total blood volume occupied by red blood cells

examples.en: The synthetic chart depicts the hematocrit as a fraction of total volume.
examples.zh: 合成图用占血液总体积的比例表示「红细胞比容」。

examples.en: We used a smaller red band to represent lower hematocrit in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们用较窄的红色带表示图中较低的「红细胞比容」。

words.enDefinition: Formation and development of the cellular components found in blood

examples.en: The chart shows hematopoiesis branching toward several different types of blood cells.
examples.zh: 图表显示，「造血」过程分出通往多种血细胞的分支。

examples.en: We discussed hematopoiesis while labeling the origins of the formed elements.
examples.zh: 我们在标注血液有形成分的来源时讨论了「造血」。

words.enDefinition: Self-renewing precursor cell able to give rise to all blood cell lineages

examples.en: The development chart places a hematopoietic stem cell above the earliest branching point.
examples.zh: 发育图把一个「造血干细胞」画在最早的分支点上方。

examples.en: We labeled the hematopoietic stem cell at the start of the textbook's lineage diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在教材谱系图的起始处标出了「造血干细胞」。

collocations: descendants of a hematopoietic stem cell
diagram of a hematopoietic stem cell

words.enDefinition: a histological staining component that commonly gives nuclei a blue or purple color in prepared sections

examples.en: The atlas explains that hematoxylin gives the dark blue nuclear structures their color in this section.
examples.zh: 图谱解释，在这份切片中，是「苏木精」使细胞核结构着深蓝色。

examples.en: We pointed out areas colored by hematoxylin before describing the pink regions around them in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先指出受「苏木精」着色的区域，再描述周围的粉色区域。

words.enDefinition: a common histology stain combination in which nuclear structures usually appear blue to purple and much cytoplasm appears pink

examples.en: The hematoxylin and eosin stain made most nuclei purple and the surrounding cytoplasm pink in the reference image.
examples.zh: 参考图中的「苏木精–伊红染色」使大多数细胞核呈紫色，周围细胞质呈粉色。

examples.en: We recognized the hematoxylin and eosin stain from the description below the normal skin section in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据正常皮肤切片下方的说明辨认出「苏木精–伊红染色」。

collocations: identify a hematoxylin and eosin stain
section with a hematoxylin and eosin stain

words.enDefinition: Iron-containing part of hemoglobin that provides a site for oxygen binding

examples.en: We marked the heme group beside each of the colored protein chains.
examples.zh: 我们在各条有颜色的蛋白质链旁标出了「血红素基团」。

examples.en: The molecular model places iron at the center of each heme group.
examples.zh: 分子模型把铁画在每个「血红素基团」的中心。

collocations: oxygen binding at a heme group

words.enDefinition: Having only one copy of a locus in a context where paired copies often occur.

examples.en: The example labels the locus hemizygous because only one copy is shown in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示例把位点标成「半合的」，因为图中只有一份副本。

examples.en: We compared a hemizygous state with the two copies shown for another fictional locus.
examples.zh: 我们把「半合的」状态与另一虚构位点所示的两份副本作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Iron-containing protein in red blood cells that reversibly binds oxygen

examples.en: The atlas places the hemoglobin symbols within the outline of the red cell.
examples.zh: 图谱将「血红蛋白」画在红细胞内部。

examples.en: We labeled hemoglobin as the oxygen-carrying protein in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中将「血红蛋白」标为携带氧的蛋白质。

words.enDefinition: Mass of hemoglobin per unit volume of blood

examples.en: The synthetic table reports hemoglobin concentration as mass per volume of blood.
examples.zh: 合成表以单位血液体积所含的质量表示「血红蛋白浓度」。

examples.en: We checked the units before comparing hemoglobin concentration across the fictional examples.
examples.zh: 我们先核对单位，再比较几个虚构示例中的「血红蛋白浓度」。

words.enDefinition: Physiological responses that limit blood loss after damage to a vessel

examples.en: The textbook groups the immediate local responses under hemostasis in the flowchart.
examples.zh: 教材在流程图中将立即发生的局部反应归到「生理性止血」。

examples.en: We used a vessel diagram to follow the major stages of hemostasis.
examples.zh: 我们用血管示意图梳理了「生理性止血」的主要阶段。

words.enDefinition: Classical structural unit of the liver organized around a central vein

examples.en: The hepatic lobule is drawn around a central vein in the textbook figure.
examples.zh: 教材图中，「肝小叶」以中央静脉为中心绘出。

examples.en: We marked the center and outer edges of one hepatic lobule on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题图上标出了一个「肝小叶」的中央和外缘。

collocations: central vein of a hepatic lobule

words.enDefinition: The proportion of variation in a trait within a population attributed to genetic differences under specified conditions.

examples.en: The heritability estimate applies to variation across the fictional population under the conditions stated in class.
examples.zh: 「遗传力」估计适用于课堂给定条件下虚构群体中性状的变异。

examples.en: We compared heritability across two model populations with different sources of variation in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习中变异来源不同的两个模型群体的「遗传力」。

words.enDefinition: Having two different alleles at a specified locus in a diploid organism.

examples.en: The genotype is heterozygous because the two allele symbols are different in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 在虚构示例中，两个等位基因符号不同，所以该基因型是「杂合的」。

examples.en: We marked the heterozygous entry on the worksheet and checked both allele symbols in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们标出练习纸中「杂合的」一项，并核对两个等位基因符号。

words.enDefinition: A monosaccharide containing six carbon atoms.

examples.en: The tutor labeled glucose as a hexose after counting all its carbon atoms on the structure diagram.
examples.zh: 辅导老师数完结构图中葡萄糖的全部碳原子后，将其标为「己糖」。

examples.en: We counted the carbon outside the glucose ring when deciding whether the molecule was a hexose.
examples.zh: 判断葡萄糖是不是「己糖」时，我们也数上了糖环以外的碳原子。

collocations: the carbon atoms of a hexose

words.enDefinition: the area visible through a microscope with a high-power objective under specified optics

examples.en: The high-power field shows a small part of the gland, with individual nuclei visible in the classroom image.
examples.zh: 课堂图像的「高倍视野」只覆盖腺体的一小部分，可见各个细胞核。

examples.en: We compared what fit inside the high-power field with the whole section shown on the adjacent page.
examples.zh: 我们把「高倍视野」内可见的部分与相邻页面显示的完整切片对照。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint that mainly permits flexion and extension about one axis.

examples.en: The hinge joint permits the model elbow to bend and straighten in one main plane.
examples.zh: 「铰链关节」使肘部模型可在一个主要平面内屈曲和伸展。

examples.en: We compared the hinge joint with the model that moves freely in several directions.
examples.zh: 我们把「铰链关节」与可向多个方向活动的关节模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Muscles on the inner thigh that help move the thigh toward the body's midline.

examples.en: The hip adductor muscles are grouped along the inner thigh on the labelled teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 带标注的教学图把「髋内收肌群」画在大腿内侧。

examples.en: We marked the hip adductor muscles before viewing the animation of the thigh moving inward.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「髋内收肌群」，再看大腿向内移动的动画。

collocations: action of the hip adductor muscles

words.enDefinition: One of the paired bones of the pelvis, formed by the fused ilium, ischium, and pubis.

examples.en: The hip bone on each side has a socket for the thigh bone in the model.
examples.zh: 模型上，每侧「髋骨」都有一个容纳大腿骨的关节窝。

examples.en: We traced the outline of one hip bone in the front view of the anatomical chart.
examples.zh: 我们沿解剖图的正视图描出一侧「髋骨」的轮廓。

words.enDefinition: Signaling substance stored by certain immune cells that affects local vessels

examples.en: The chart depicts histamine as one signal released by the illustrated cell.
examples.zh: 图表将「组胺」画成图示细胞释放的一种信号。

examples.en: We linked histamine with changes in nearby vessels on the simplified diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化图中将「组胺」与附近血管的变化联系起来。

words.enDefinition: a feature introduced during specimen preparation, handling or imaging that does not reflect the original tissue

examples.en: The instructor labeled the unexpected line a histological artifact because it crossed several unrelated structures in the image.
examples.zh: 老师把图中穿过数处无关结构的异常线条标为「组织学伪影」。

examples.en: We annotated the histological artifact separately from the normal tissue structures in the slide reading exercise.
examples.zh: 在切片读图练习中，我们将「组织学伪影」与正常组织结构分开标注。

collocations: distinguish a histological artifact from tissue

words.enDefinition: Thin slice of tissue shown for examination of its microscopic structure

examples.en: The histological section reveals the boundary between the surface layer and supporting tissue.
examples.zh: 「组织学切片」显示出表层与支撑组织之间的边界。

examples.en: We labeled two tissue types on the histological section reproduced in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们在图谱复制的「组织学切片」上标出了两种组织类型。

collocations: tissue types in a histological section

words.enDefinition: a dye or reagent used to make tissue structures distinguishable in a microscopic specimen

examples.en: The instructor named the histological stain used to make the nuclei visible in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 老师指出，在这幅教学图中用来显出细胞核的「组织学染料」是哪一种。

examples.en: We compared two sections whose captions identified a different histological stain for each pictured tissue.
examples.zh: 我们比较两份切片，其图注分别标出了各自使用的「组织学染料」。

collocations: color produced by a histological stain

words.enDefinition: Study of the microscopic structure and organization of biological tissues

examples.en: Our histology class identifies tissue types by the arrangement of their cells.
examples.zh: 我们的「组织学」课通过细胞排列方式辨认组织类型。

examples.en: The histology atlas shows what several human tissues look like when magnified.
examples.zh: 「组织学」图谱展示多种人体组织放大后的样子。

words.enDefinition: a reference collection of labeled images or diagrams of tissues and their microscopic structure

examples.en: We consulted the histology atlas to compare our teaching image with a labeled section of normal skin.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「组织学图谱」，将教学图像与有标注的正常皮肤切片作比较。

examples.en: The histology atlas shows the same tissue at two scales so students can move from layers to cells.
examples.zh: 「组织学图谱」用两个尺度展示同一组织，方便学生从组织分层转向细胞观察。

collocations: reference image in a histology atlas

words.enDefinition: A protein around which nuclear DNA is organized as part of chromatin.

examples.en: The histone is represented by a coloured shape inside the simplified chromatin diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂简化染色质图里，一个彩色形状代表「组蛋白」。

examples.en: We distinguished the histone from the strand that wraps around the group of proteins.
examples.zh: 我们把「组蛋白」与缠绕在这组蛋白质周围的细链区分开。

words.enDefinition: A comparison group observed in an earlier period than the group receiving the intervention in a study.

examples.en: The historical control in the report comes from an earlier round of fictional follow-up records.
examples.zh: 报告中的「历史对照」来自较早一轮虚构随访记录。

examples.en: We discussed changes over time when interpreting the historical control in the classroom study table.
examples.zh: 解读课堂研究表中的「历史对照」时，我们讨论了随时间发生的变化。

words.enDefinition: An enzyme in its complete form with the cofactors required for catalytic activity.

examples.en: The holoenzyme in the illustration includes the protein and its required cofactor in one assembled form.
examples.zh: 图中的「全酶」由蛋白质及其所需辅因子共同组成。

examples.en: We found the holoenzyme in the final panel where the textbook shows both components together.
examples.zh: 我们在教材最后一幅同时画出两个组分的图里找到了「全酶」。

words.enDefinition: Regulation that keeps important internal conditions within a workable range

examples.en: The model illustrates homeostasis by keeping an internal variable within a narrow range.
examples.zh: 模型通过使一个内部变量保持在较窄范围内说明「稳态」。

examples.en: We compared the graph illustrating homeostasis with the curve for an unregulated system.
examples.zh: 我们将说明「稳态」的图与无调节系统的曲线作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Component of a regulatory system that processes incoming information and directs a response

examples.en: The homeostatic control center receives information before sending an output in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「稳态调节中枢」先接收信息，再发出输出信号。

examples.en: We drew an arrow toward the homeostatic control center from the detector symbol.
examples.zh: 我们从表示感受器的符号向「稳态调节中枢」画了一个箭头。

collocations: signal to a homeostatic control center
function of the homeostatic control center

words.enDefinition: Regulatory sequence that detects changes and produces responses tending to restore internal conditions

examples.en: The homeostatic feedback loop diagram follows information from the monitored variable to the response.
examples.zh: 「稳态反馈回路」示意图展示信息如何从被监测变量传到响应环节。

examples.en: We used arrows to show how the homeostatic feedback loop counteracts the original change.
examples.zh: 我们用箭头表示「稳态反馈回路」怎样抵消最初的变化。

collocations: parts of a homeostatic feedback loop

words.enDefinition: A reference value or level around which a physiological control system regulates a variable.

examples.en: The graph uses a dashed line to mark the homeostatic set point.
examples.zh: 图中用虚线标出了「稳态设定点」。

examples.en: We observed small fluctuations around the homeostatic set point in our simulated trace.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟曲线中观察到围绕「稳态设定点」的轻微波动。

collocations: regulate around a homeostatic set point
change in the homeostatic set point

words.enDefinition: Two corresponding chromosomes with the same basic arrangement of gene loci, one from each parent in a typical human pair.

examples.en: The homologous chromosomes carry the same labelled loci even though some allele symbols differ in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「同源染色体」带有同样的标记位点，某些等位基因符号则不同。

examples.en: We paired the homologous chromosomes by comparing their lengths and corresponding markings on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂图上各条染色体的长度及相应标记，以配对「同源染色体」。

words.enDefinition: Having two matching alleles at a specified locus in a diploid organism.

examples.en: The genotype is homozygous because both allele symbols match at the marked classroom locus.
examples.zh: 课堂标记位点上的两个等位基因符号相同，因此其基因型是「纯合的」。

examples.en: We selected the homozygous example before comparing it with the pair of unlike symbols.
examples.zh: 我们先选出「纯合的」示例，再与符号不同的一对做比较。

words.enDefinition: Chemical messenger released by cells that influences activity in other cells

examples.en: The diagram follows one hormone from its source to a distant tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图追踪一种「激素」从其产生处到远处组织的路径。

examples.en: We marked the gland producing the hormone shown in the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表中标出了产生该「激素」的腺体。

words.enDefinition: Protein that recognizes a specific hormone and allows a cellular response

examples.en: Our diagram shows one hormone receptor recognizing the matching signal next to it.
examples.zh: 示意图显示一个「激素受体」识别它旁边与之匹配的信号。

examples.en: We labeled the hormone receptor separately from the signal that binds to it.
examples.zh: 我们分别标出了「激素受体」和与该受体结合的信号。

words.enDefinition: a unit on the standardized CT attenuation scale that assigns zero to water and approximately minus one thousand to air

examples.en: The example CT display reports estimated attenuation in each selected region using the Hounsfield unit scale.
examples.zh: 示例 CT 显示用「亨斯菲尔德单位」量表报告各选区估计的衰减值。

examples.en: We read the Hounsfield unit label next to the attenuation values listed for the teaching scan.
examples.zh: 我们读取教学扫描中所列衰减数值旁的「亨斯菲尔德单位」标签。

words.zhGloss: 涉及人类参与者的研究
words.enDefinition: A research category involving living people through interaction or intervention, or using their identifiable private information under relevant definitions.
acceptedZhAnswers: 涉及人类参与者的研究

examples.en: The worksheet classifies the fictional survey as human subjects research because researchers interact with living participants.
examples.zh: 练习将这项虚构调查归为「涉及人类参与者的研究」，因为研究人员与在世参与者互动。

examples.en: We discussed human subjects research while reading an example scope statement for the fictional follow-up study.
examples.zh: 阅读虚构随访研究的范围说明示例时，我们讨论了「涉及人类参与者的研究」。

words.enDefinition: The bone of the upper arm that extends from the shoulder to the elbow.

examples.en: The humerus joins the shoulder model at the rounded upper end shown in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图上，「肱骨」在圆形的上端与肩部模型接合。

examples.en: We identified the humerus before comparing the two bones that extend from the elbow.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「肱骨」，再比较从肘部延伸的两块骨。

words.enDefinition: Adaptive defense mediated mainly by antibodies released into body fluids

examples.en: The chart uses antibody symbols for the humoral immunity branch of the response.
examples.zh: 图表用抗体符号表示这一反应中的「体液免疫」分支。

examples.en: We linked humoral immunity to the antibody-producing cells in the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们将「体液免疫」与课堂图表中产生抗体的细胞联系起来。

words.enDefinition: A nonpolar region of an amphipathic molecule that tends to avoid contact with water.

examples.en: The hydrophobic tail pointed inward where it contacted other nonpolar tails in the simplified membrane diagram.
examples.zh: 在简化膜图中，「疏水尾部」朝内，与其他非极性的尾部接触。

examples.en: We labeled the hydrophobic tail where it extended toward the center of the bilayer in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中伸向双层中央的位置标出了「疏水尾部」。

collocations: a hydrophobic tail of a lipid
the position of a hydrophobic tail

words.enDefinition: an ultrasound region producing stronger echoes and usually appearing brighter than the chosen reference tissue

examples.en: The classroom diagram shows the hyperechoic region as brighter than the surrounding reference tissue on the display.
examples.zh: 课堂图的显示界面中，「高回声区」比周围作为参照的组织更亮。

examples.en: We marked the hyperechoic region after comparing its echoes with those from the adjacent structure in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们对照它与邻近结构的回声后，标出了「高回声区」。

collocations: relative brightness of a hyperechoic region

words.enDefinition: an area of an MRI image that has higher signal intensity than a stated surrounding or reference tissue

examples.en: The hyperintense region appears brighter than the surrounding tissue in this displayed teaching image.
examples.zh: 在这张展示的教学图像中，「高信号区」显得比周围组织更亮。

examples.en: We described the hyperintense region relative to the neighboring tissue shown on the same sequence.
examples.zh: 我们参照同一序列图像上显示的相邻组织，描述「高信号区」。

collocations: relative brightness of a hyperintense region
hyperintense region on a weighted image

words.enDefinition: Either upper side area beneath the ribs in the abdominal grid

examples.en: We marked the right hypochondriac region beside the center of the top row.
examples.zh: 我们在最上一排中央方格的旁边标出了右「季肋区」。

examples.en: The upper corner of the grid represents a hypochondriac region in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中网格上面的一角代表一个「季肋区」。

words.enDefinition: the layer beneath the dermis containing loose connective tissue and often varying amounts of fat

examples.en: The skin model shows the hypodermis as a lighter region with clusters of fat cells below the dermis.
examples.zh: 皮肤模型将「皮下组织」画成真皮下方较浅的区域，里面有成簇脂肪细胞。

examples.en: We drew the boundary of the hypodermis distinctly below the main skin layers in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中，将「皮下组织」边界清楚地画在皮肤主要层次下方。

words.enDefinition: an ultrasound region producing weaker echoes and usually appearing darker than the chosen reference tissue

examples.en: The hypoechoic region had faint echoes and looked darker than the adjacent brighter tissue in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，「低回声区」的回声微弱，显得比相邻的较亮组织暗。

examples.en: We labeled the hypoechoic region using neighboring tissue as a brightness reference on the classroom display.
examples.zh: 我们以课堂显示中相邻组织的亮度为参照，标出了「低回声区」。

collocations: relative brightness of a hypoechoic region

words.enDefinition: Lower middle area of the abdomen in the nine-region scheme

examples.en: The hypogastric region is the central box in the diagram's bottom row.
examples.zh: 「腹下区」是图中最下一排的中央方格。

examples.en: We marked the hypogastric region under the box that contains the navel.
examples.zh: 我们在含肚脐方格的下方标出了「腹下区」。

words.enDefinition: an area of an MRI image that has lower signal intensity than a stated surrounding or reference tissue

examples.en: The hypointense region looked darker than the adjacent structure on the classroom reference image.
examples.zh: 在课堂参考图上，「低信号区」显得比邻近结构更暗。

examples.en: We labeled the hypointense region along the tissue border and recorded which sequence produced the image.
examples.zh: 我们标出组织边界处的「低信号区」，并记录产生图像的序列。

collocations: relative darkness of a hypointense region
hypointense region on a weighted image

words.enDefinition: Blood vessels carrying hypothalamic signals directly to the anterior pituitary

examples.en: The hypothalamic-pituitary portal system links two capillary networks in the colored textbook figure.
examples.zh: 「下丘脑垂体门脉系统」在彩色教材图中连接两个毛细血管网。

examples.en: We traced the hypothalamic-pituitary portal system from the upper network to the anterior lobe.
examples.zh: 我们沿「下丘脑垂体门脉系统」从上方的血管网追踪到垂体前叶。

collocations: diagram of the hypothalamic-pituitary portal system
signaling through the hypothalamic-pituitary portal system

words.enDefinition: Signal produced by the hypothalamus that stimulates anterior pituitary hormone release

examples.en: The flowchart shows a hypothalamic releasing hormone reaching the anterior lobe through portal vessels.
examples.zh: 流程图显示一种「下丘脑释放激素」经门脉血管到达垂体前叶。

examples.en: We labeled the hypothalamic releasing hormone before tracing its downstream signal on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「下丘脑释放激素」，再沿图追踪其下游信号。

collocations: target of a hypothalamic releasing hormone
action of a hypothalamic releasing hormone

words.enDefinition: a brain region below the thalamus that coordinates many autonomic, hormonal and other internal regulatory functions

examples.en: We marked the hypothalamus below the thalamus and near the pituitary stalk in the sectioned model.
examples.zh: 在剖开的模型中，我们在丘脑下方靠近垂体柄处标出了「下丘脑」。

examples.en: The worksheet links the hypothalamus to temperature regulation and other responses that maintain internal conditions.
examples.zh: 练习将「下丘脑」与体温调节及其他维持体内条件的反应联系起来。

collocations: connection between the hypothalamus and pituitary

words.enDefinition: An estimate of the percentage of variability in study effect estimates attributable to heterogeneity rather than sampling error.

examples.en: The I-squared statistic is reported beside the plot for the set of fictional studies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂将「I² 统计量」列在这组虚构研究的图旁。

examples.en: We interpreted the I-squared statistic alongside the number and precision of the included study estimates.
examples.zh: 解读「I² 统计量」时，我们同时查看所纳入研究估计值的数量和精度。

words.enDefinition: Junctional valve regulating passage from the ileum into the cecum

examples.en: The ileocecal valve is drawn where the small intestine joins the large intestine.
examples.zh: 「回盲瓣」被画在小肠与大肠相接的位置。

examples.en: We followed the illustrated contents past the ileocecal valve into the cecum.
examples.zh: 我们在图中追踪肠内容物经过「回盲瓣」进入盲肠的路径。

words.enDefinition: Final portion of the small intestine leading to the large intestine

examples.en: The ileum leads into the first part of the large intestine in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「回肠」通入大肠的第一段。

examples.en: We marked the ileum at the far end of the small intestine.
examples.zh: 我们在小肠的末端标出了「回肠」。

collocations: junction of the ileum and cecum

words.enDefinition: Either lower side area near the hip in the abdominal grid

examples.en: The left iliac region is at one end of the lowest row.
examples.zh: 左「髂区」位于最下一排的一端。

examples.en: We marked an iliac region beside the lower central box on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们在图表下方中央方格的旁边标出了一个「髂区」。

words.enDefinition: A group formed by the iliacus and psoas major that helps flex the hip.

examples.en: The iliopsoas is shown passing toward the front of the hip joint in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「髂腰肌」向髋关节前方走行。

examples.en: We labelled both parts of the iliopsoas before reviewing the model of hip flexion.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「髂腰肌」的两个组成部分，再看屈髋模型。

words.enDefinition: The broad upper portion of the hip bone.

examples.en: The ilium forms the broad upper part of the hip bone on our pelvis model.
examples.zh: 在骨盆模型上，「髂骨」构成髋骨宽阔的上部。

examples.en: We traced the curved upper edge of the ilium in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图上沿着「髂骨」弯曲的上缘查看。

words.enDefinition: a three-dimensional volume element represented by one value in a digital image dataset

examples.en: Each image voxel has a width, height and depth in the classroom diagram of reconstructed anatomy data.
examples.zh: 课堂解剖数据重建图中，每个「影像体素」都有宽、高和深度。

examples.en: We compared the displayed pixel with the corresponding image voxel that also represented depth in the dataset.
examples.zh: 我们将显示的像素与相应「影像体素」对照，后者在数据中也表示深度。

words.enDefinition: Ability to respond differently after previous recognition of the same antigen

examples.en: The synthetic graph uses two encounters to illustrate immune memory in the class model.
examples.zh: 合成曲线用两次接触说明课堂模型中的「免疫记忆」。

examples.en: We labeled immune memory on the diagram linking earlier and later responses.
examples.zh: 我们在连接早期和后期反应的示意图中标出了「免疫记忆」。

words.enDefinition: Network of cells, tissues, and signals that recognizes and responds to threats

examples.en: The immune system diagram connects several tissues through arrows representing their interactions.
examples.zh: 「免疫系统」示意图用箭头连接几种组织，表示它们之间的相互作用。

examples.en: We grouped these cells by their roles in the immune system chart.
examples.zh: 我们在「免疫系统」图表中按作用将这些细胞分组。

words.enDefinition: Antigen-specific nonresponsiveness of the immune system, including its normal nonreaction to many of the body's own structures.

examples.en: The lecture illustrates immune tolerance with a diagram of the body's own markers.
examples.zh: 课堂通过人体自身标志的示意图说明「免疫耐受」。

examples.en: We placed immune tolerance beside the low-response outcome in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型中把「免疫耐受」标在低反应结果的旁边。

words.enDefinition: Uncertainty in an effect estimate large enough that meaningfully different conclusions remain compatible with the data.

examples.en: The imprecision of evidence is apparent because the fictional interval spans several meaningfully different possibilities in class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构区间同时包含实际意义明显不同的可能值，因此体现了「证据不精确性」。

examples.en: We considered imprecision of evidence while comparing intervals for two simulated outcomes on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 比较练习中两项模拟结局的区间时，我们考虑了「证据不精确性」。

words.enDefinition: The fraction of an initially event-free population that experiences the defined event within a specified period.

examples.en: The incidence proportion counts people with a first event out of those initially eligible in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，「累积发生比例」用首次出现所计事件的人数除以起初符合条件的人数。

examples.en: We wrote the time interval beside the incidence proportion on the synthetic results table.
examples.zh: 我们在合成结果表的「累积发生比例」旁写明所用时段。

words.enDefinition: The number of new events divided by the person-time at risk over the specified observation period.

examples.en: The incidence rate is expressed per unit of person-time in the synthetic classroom study table.
examples.zh: 课堂合成研究表中的「发生率」按单位人时表示。

examples.en: We calculated the incidence rate using only the time each fictional person was still at risk.
examples.zh: 我们仅使用各虚构人物处于风险中的时间计算「发生率」。

words.enDefinition: A relationship in which the heterozygous phenotype is intermediate between the two homozygous phenotypes for the studied trait.

examples.en: The model uses incomplete dominance to show an intermediate value between the two labelled categories.
examples.zh: 模型用「不完全显性」演示位于两个标记类别之间的中间值。

examples.en: We identified incomplete dominance in the fictional illustration using the three resulting phenotype labels.
examples.zh: 我们根据虚构插图中的三个表型标签，辨认出「不完全显性」。

words.enDefinition: The independent distribution of different chromosome pairs during meiosis, leading alleles at unlinked loci to segregate independently.

examples.en: The diagram illustrates independent assortment by showing two ways that different chromosome pairs can line up.
examples.zh: 示意图用不同染色体对的两种排列方式说明「自由组合」。

examples.en: We used independent assortment for two loci on different chromosomes in the simplified worksheet model.
examples.zh: 我们在简化练习模型中，对位于不同染色体上的两个位点应用「自由组合」。

words.enDefinition: A lack of close match between the available evidence and the population, comparison, or outcome in the question of interest.

examples.en: The indirectness of evidence arises because the fictional studies measured a different outcome from the question's target.
examples.zh: 各虚构研究测量的结局与研究问题关注的结局不同，因此存在「证据间接性」。

examples.en: We noted indirectness of evidence before comparing two outcomes in the classroom summary table.
examples.zh: 我们先注明「证据间接性」，再对比课堂汇总表中的两项结局。

words.enDefinition: A binding model in which an enzyme changes its shape as the substrate binds.

examples.en: The animation illustrates induced fit as the enzyme pocket shifts slightly after the substrate begins binding.
examples.zh: 动画中，底物开始结合后酶的凹槽略有改变，以此展示「诱导契合」。

examples.en: We compared the two frames to identify the shape change associated with induced fit in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们比较两帧画面，以辨认图中「诱导契合」所伴随的形状变化。

collocations: induced fit at an enzyme's active site

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the feet than another structure in the reference position

examples.en: The mouth is inferior to the nose in the figure we labeled.
examples.zh: 我们标注的人体图中，口部位于鼻子「下方」。

examples.en: The abdomen lies inferior to the chest even when the body model is horizontal.
examples.zh: 即使人体模型横放，解剖方位上的腹部仍位于胸部「下方」。

words.enDefinition: the large vein returning blood mainly from below the diaphragm to the right atrium

examples.en: The classroom chart shows the inferior vena cava carrying blood upward from the lower body.
examples.zh: 课堂图表显示，「下腔静脉」将下半身的血液向上运送。

examples.en: We identified the inferior vena cava as the large vessel entering the right atrium from below.
examples.zh: 我们把从下方进入右心房的大血管标为「下腔静脉」。

collocations: tributaries of the inferior vena cava
blood flowing through the inferior vena cava

words.enDefinition: Coordinated tissue and vascular changes following a local injury

examples.en: The diagram shows an inflammatory response concentrated around the shaded tissue area.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「炎症反应」集中在阴影组织区周围。

examples.en: We used a timeline to summarize the early inflammatory response shown in class.
examples.zh: 我们用时间轴概括了课堂展示的早期「炎症反应」。

words.enDefinition: The rotator cuff muscle lying below the spine of the scapula and helping rotate the arm laterally.

examples.en: The infraspinatus fills much of the area below the scapular spine on the teaching model.
examples.zh: 教学模型上，「冈下肌」占据了肩胛冈下方的大部分区域。

examples.en: We traced the infraspinatus toward its attachment near the upper arm in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中沿「冈下肌」追踪到它靠近上臂的附着处。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic influenced by genetic variants transmitted from one or both parents.

examples.en: The worksheet labels the modelled feature an inherited trait under its stated genetic assumptions.
examples.zh: 在给定遗传假设下，练习将模型中的特征标为「遗传性状」。

examples.en: We followed an inherited trait through three generations of the fictional family in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们追踪虚构家系三代中的一项「遗传性状」。

words.enDefinition: A genetic variant passed to an individual from one or both parents.

examples.en: The inherited variant has the same label in two generations of the fictional family chart.
examples.zh: 虚构家系图的两代人物中，「遗传而来的变异」用同一个标签。

examples.en: We traced the inherited variant along the connecting lines drawn on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂练习纸上的连线追踪「遗传而来的变异」。

words.enDefinition: a local postsynaptic voltage response that decreases the chance of an action potential in the receiving neuron

examples.en: The inhibitory postsynaptic potential made firing less likely in the model even while another input remained active.
examples.zh: 即使另一项输入仍然有效，「抑制性突触后电位」也使模型触发动作电位的可能性下降。

examples.en: The downward deflection in this particular trace was an inhibitory postsynaptic potential in the class discussion.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论的这条特定曲线中，向下的偏转是「抑制性突触后电位」。

collocations: effect of an inhibitory postsynaptic potential

words.enDefinition: The reaction rate measured or modeled near the start, before concentrations change substantially.

examples.en: We read the initial reaction rate from the slope at the beginning of the simulated product curve.
examples.zh: 我们从模拟产物曲线起始部分的斜率读出「初始反应速率」。

examples.en: The table listed an initial reaction rate for each example in the human enzyme model.
examples.zh: 表格列出人体酶模型中各个示例的「初始反应速率」。

collocations: an initial reaction rate on a plot
the initial reaction rate of an enzyme

words.enDefinition: Rapid defenses that respond through broadly shared recognition patterns

examples.en: The textbook lists surface barriers as part of innate immunity in its overview.
examples.zh: 教材在概述中将体表屏障列为「先天免疫」的组成部分。

examples.en: We labeled innate immunity on the early side of the classroom response chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂反应图的较早阶段标出了「先天免疫」。

words.enDefinition: the movement of air into the lungs when alveolar pressure falls below atmospheric pressure

examples.en: During quiet inspiration, the chest cavity expanded and air entered the lungs in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 课堂动画中，平静「吸气」时胸腔扩大，空气进入肺内。

examples.en: We marked inspiration on the rising part of the lung volume trace in the breathing exercise.
examples.zh: 在呼吸练习的肺容积曲线上，我们在上升段标出「吸气」。

words.enDefinition: the additional volume that can be inhaled after an ordinary inspiration

examples.en: The graph marks inspiratory reserve volume between lung volumes after a quiet breath in and maximal inhalation.
examples.zh: 图中将平静吸气后与最大吸气后的肺容积之差标为「吸气储备量」。

examples.en: We drew a bracket for inspiratory reserve volume above the normal breathing range on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习的正常呼吸范围上方用括号标出「吸气储备量」。

collocations: inspiratory reserve volume on a tracing

words.enDefinition: a region of cerebral cortex lying deep within the lateral sulcus, covered by parts of neighboring lobes

examples.en: The insula became visible when the layers covering the lateral sulcus were moved in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，覆盖外侧沟的部分移开后，「岛叶」变得可见。

examples.en: On the cutaway, we labeled the insula deep to the exposed edges of the neighboring lobes.
examples.zh: 在剖视图中，我们在相邻脑叶暴露边缘的深处标出「岛叶」。

words.enDefinition: Pancreatic hormone that helps lower blood glucose and promotes nutrient storage

examples.en: The diagram places insulin beside the arrow from the islet beta cells.
examples.zh: 示意图将「胰岛素」标在从胰岛β细胞引出的箭头旁。

examples.en: The chart shows insulin helping lower glucose in a simulated feedback loop.
examples.zh: 图表显示，在模拟反馈回路中，「胰岛素」有助于降低血糖。

words.enDefinition: the skin and associated structures such as hair, nails and cutaneous glands

examples.en: The integumentary system diagram groups the skin with hair, nails and the glands in the skin.
examples.zh: 「皮肤系统」图将皮肤与毛发、指甲和皮肤内的腺体归在一起。

examples.en: We used the integumentary system model to locate several structures that reach the outer surface in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用「皮肤系统」模型找出几种延伸到外表面的结构。

words.enDefinition: An analysis that compares all randomized participants in their originally assigned groups, regardless of adherence, with prespecified handling of unavailable outcomes.

examples.en: The intention-to-treat analysis keeps each fictional participant in the group originally assigned on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中的「意向治疗分析」将各虚构参与者保留在原分配组。

examples.en: We checked the original group labels before reading the intention-to-treat analysis results in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对原分配组标签，再看「意向治疗分析」的结果。

words.enDefinition: the partition separating the right and left atria of the heart

examples.en: The interatrial septum forms the partition between the two upper chambers on our model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂模型上，「房间隔」构成两个上方心腔之间的隔壁。

examples.en: We located the interatrial septum by tracing the medial walls of both atria on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们沿着图中两个心房的内侧壁找到「房间隔」。

words.enDefinition: A substance formed at one metabolic step and used at a subsequent step.

examples.en: The diagram labels pyruvate as an intermediate metabolite linking glucose breakdown with another set of reactions.
examples.zh: 图中把丙酮酸标为连接葡萄糖分解与另一组反应的「代谢中间产物」。

examples.en: We identified the intermediate metabolite produced by the first arrow and consumed at the next step.
examples.zh: 我们找出第一个箭头所示反应生成、又在下一步被消耗的「代谢中间产物」。

collocations: an intermediate metabolite on a pathway
an intermediate metabolite shared by pathways

words.enDefinition: a neuron that relays or processes signals between other neurons within a circuit

examples.en: The reflex model places an interneuron between the incoming sensory pathway and an outgoing motor neuron.
examples.zh: 反射模型将一个「中间神经元」放在传入感觉通路与传出运动神经元之间。

examples.en: We used an inhibitory interneuron to explain how activation of one pathway can suppress another in the example.
examples.zh: 我们在示例中用抑制性「中间神经元」解释一条通路激活后如何抑制另一条通路。

words.enDefinition: Portion of extracellular fluid occupying the spaces between tissue cells

examples.en: The diagram shows interstitial fluid in the spaces among the colored tissue cells.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「组织间液」位于彩色组织细胞之间的空隙中。

examples.en: We colored interstitial fluid differently from the fluid inside the drawn blood vessel.
examples.zh: 我们给「组织间液」与所画血管内部的液体用了不同的颜色。
