words.enDefinition: The extent to which a study intervention is delivered as intended in the study plan.

examples.en: The intervention fidelity section describes whether the fictional reminder schedule was delivered as planned in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「干预实施忠实度」部分说明虚构提醒安排是否按计划实施。

examples.en: We read the intervention fidelity notes before comparing findings across the fictional sites in the study.
examples.zh: 比较研究中各虚构地点的发现之前，我们先读了「干预实施忠实度」说明。

words.enDefinition: the partition between the right and left ventricles, mainly composed of heart muscle

examples.en: The interventricular septum appeared between the ventricular cavities on the cross section shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的横切面上，「室间隔」位于两处心室腔之间。

examples.en: We traced the muscular part of the interventricular septum down toward the tip of the heart.
examples.zh: 我们沿「室间隔」的肌性部分向下追踪到心尖附近。

collocations: membranous part of the interventricular septum

words.enDefinition: Movement of digested substances and other materials across the intestinal lining

examples.en: The diagram represents intestinal absorption with arrows moving from the lumen into the tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图用从肠腔指向组织内的箭头表示「肠道吸收」。

examples.en: We compared regions of intestinal absorption on the same simplified digestive map.
examples.zh: 我们在同一张简化消化系统图中比较了「肠道吸收」发生的不同区域。

words.enDefinition: The fringe formed by densely packed microvilli on the exposed surface of absorptive intestinal cells.

examples.en: The intestinal brush border appears as a narrow fringe along the row of absorptive cells.
examples.zh: 「肠刷状缘」在一排吸收细胞沿肠腔的一侧呈现为一道窄边。

examples.en: Our enlarged diagram shows the intestinal brush border formed by many packed microvilli.
examples.zh: 放大图显示「肠刷状缘」由许多密集的微绒毛组成。

collocations: surface of the intestinal brush border
diagram of the intestinal brush border

words.enDefinition: Tiny projections on individual intestinal epithelial cells that enlarge their surface

examples.en: The intestinal microvilli appear along the exposed side of one enlarged epithelial cell.
examples.zh: 在一个放大的上皮细胞朝向肠腔的一侧可以看见「肠上皮微绒毛」。

examples.en: The atlas zooms in beyond the villus to show intestinal microvilli on individual cells.
examples.zh: 图谱从绒毛进一步放大，展示单个细胞上的「肠上皮微绒毛」。

words.enDefinition: Small fingerlike projection enlarging the absorptive surface of the small intestine

examples.en: The tutor enlarged one intestinal villus to show the structures inside it.
examples.zh: 老师放大了一根「肠绒毛」，展示其内部结构。

examples.en: We marked an intestinal villus projecting into the open space of the intestine.
examples.zh: 我们标出一根向肠腔内突出的「肠绒毛」。

words.enDefinition: Water and dissolved substances contained inside the body's cells

examples.en: The classroom figure shades intracellular fluid inside the boundary of each illustrated cell.
examples.zh: 课堂图在各图示细胞的边界以内用阴影表示「细胞内液」。

examples.en: We labeled intracellular fluid on the inner side of the cell membrane.
examples.zh: 我们在细胞膜内侧标出了「细胞内液」。

words.enDefinition: pressure within the narrow potential space between the visceral and parietal pleura

examples.en: The graph shows intrapleural pressure becoming more negative during quiet inspiration in the simple lung model.
examples.zh: 在简化肺模型中，平静吸气时图上的「胸膜腔内压」变得更负。

examples.en: We plotted intrapleural pressure separately from the pressure inside the alveoli during the same modeled breath.
examples.zh: 在模型表现的同一次呼吸中，我们分别绘出「胸膜腔内压」和肺泡内压。

words.enDefinition: Branch of the classical clotting scheme beginning with factors present within blood

examples.en: The intrinsic coagulation pathway is drawn as one branch leading toward a shared segment.
examples.zh: 「内源性凝血途径」被画成通往一段共同途径的一个分支。

examples.en: We identified the intrinsic coagulation pathway on the classical diagram in the textbook.
examples.zh: 我们在教材的经典凝血示意图中找到了「内源性凝血途径」。

collocations: diagram of the intrinsic coagulation pathway
factors in the intrinsic coagulation pathway

words.enDefinition: Situated on the same side of the body as another structure

examples.en: The right arm and right leg are ipsilateral in the reference illustration.
examples.zh: 在参照图中，右臂和右腿位于「同侧」。

examples.en: We grouped the two marks as ipsilateral because both appear on the left.
examples.zh: 由于两个标记都在左侧，我们把它们归为「同侧」。

words.enDefinition: the colored ring of tissue in the eye that regulates the diameter of the pupil

examples.en: The iris surrounds the central opening on the front view of the classroom eye model.
examples.zh: 在课堂眼球模型的前视图上，「虹膜」围绕中央开口。

examples.en: We used arrows on the iris diagram to show how its muscles change the opening's size.
examples.zh: 我们在「虹膜」图上用箭头展示其肌肉怎样改变开口大小。

words.enDefinition: A bone with a complex shape that does not fit the long, short, or flat categories.

examples.en: A vertebra is an irregular bone with a more complex outline than the simple classroom shapes.
examples.zh: 椎骨是「不规则骨」，轮廓比课堂展示的简单形状复杂。

examples.en: We chose the irregular bone from the models and matched it to a spine drawing.
examples.zh: 我们从模型里选出「不规则骨」，把它与脊柱图对应起来。

words.enDefinition: The lower back portion of the hip bone.

examples.en: The ischium forms the lower rear portion of the hip bone in the side view.
examples.zh: 侧视图上，「坐骨」构成髋骨的后下部。

examples.en: We found the ischium by comparing the labelled front and side views in the anatomy guide.
examples.zh: 我们比较解剖指南中带标注的正视图与侧视图，找出「坐骨」。

words.enDefinition: An active muscle action generating tension with no appreciable change in overall length.

examples.en: The isometric contraction develops tension while the model keeps the muscle length nearly unchanged.
examples.zh: 「等长收缩」产生张力，同时模型中的肌肉长度基本不变。

examples.en: We identified isometric contraction in the frame where tension rises without visible movement.
examples.zh: 在张力上升却看不到动作的画面中，我们识别出「等长收缩」。

words.enDefinition: the brief rise in ventricular pressure when the ventricle contracts while both its inlet and outlet valves are closed

examples.en: During isovolumetric contraction, the ventricular pressure rose while its volume remained unchanged on the example graph.
examples.zh: 在示例图的「等容收缩」阶段，心室压力升高，而容积不变。

examples.en: We marked isovolumetric contraction between closure of the inlet valve and opening of the outlet valve.
examples.zh: 我们在入口瓣膜关闭与出口瓣膜打开之间标出了「等容收缩」。

words.enDefinition: the brief fall in ventricular pressure while the ventricle relaxes with both inlet and outlet valves closed

examples.en: After ejection, isovolumetric relaxation lowered pressure without changing ventricular volume on the classroom graph we studied.
examples.zh: 在我们研究的课堂图上，射血后「等容舒张」使压力下降，心室容积没有改变。

examples.en: We identified isovolumetric relaxation before the inlet valve opened and the next filling phase began.
examples.zh: 我们在入口瓣膜打开、下一轮充盈开始前辨认出了「等容舒张」。

words.enDefinition: Middle portion of the small intestine between the duodenum and ileum

examples.en: The model colors the jejunum differently from the two adjacent intestinal regions.
examples.zh: 模型用不同颜色区分「空肠」和相邻的两个肠段。

examples.en: We placed the label for the jejunum in the middle portion of the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「空肠」的标签放在示意图中的小肠中段。

words.enDefinition: The envelope around a synovial joint, with an outer fibrous layer and an inner synovial lining.

examples.en: The joint capsule surrounds the articulated ends of the bones in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 课堂草图中的「关节囊」包围两块骨发生关节连接的末端。

examples.en: We labelled the joint capsule before identifying its inner lining on the teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「关节囊」，再在教学模型上指出它的内衬。

collocations: fibrous layer of the joint capsule

words.enDefinition: The enclosed space between the articulating surfaces of a synovial joint.

examples.en: The joint cavity lies between the cartilage-covered bone ends on the cutaway knee model.
examples.zh: 膝部剖面模型上，「关节腔」位于覆盖软骨的两个骨端之间。

examples.en: We pointed to the joint cavity before naming the structures around it in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先指出「关节腔」，再说出周围结构的名称。

words.enDefinition: A movement that generally straightens a joint or increases the angle between the linked segments.

examples.en: The joint extension arrow points toward the position where the model elbow straightens in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「关节伸展」箭头指向模型肘部伸直的位置。

examples.en: We distinguished joint extension from flexion in the side views of the teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们在教学模型的侧视图中把「关节伸展」与屈曲区分开。

words.enDefinition: Nephron with corpuscle near the medulla and a long descending loop

examples.en: The loop of the juxtamedullary nephron extends deep into the kidney model.
examples.zh: 「近髓肾单位」的袢伸入肾脏模型的深部。

examples.en: We marked the corpuscle of the juxtamedullary nephron close to the inner region.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近肾脏内部区域的位置标出「近髓肾单位」的肾小体。

words.enDefinition: A step curve estimating the probability of remaining event-free over time while accounting for right-censoring under stated assumptions.

examples.en: The Kaplan-Meier curve remains flat between the recorded events in the synthetic time-to-event illustration.
examples.zh: 在合成事件时间图示中，「卡普兰—迈耶曲线」在两次记录事件之间保持水平。

examples.en: We checked the numbers still under observation before interpreting the end of the Kaplan-Meier curve.
examples.zh: 我们先核对仍在观察的人数，再解读「卡普兰—迈耶曲线」末端。

collocations: censoring marks on a Kaplan-Meier curve

words.enDefinition: An ordered display of chromosome images typically arranged in matched pairs by size and appearance.

examples.en: The karyogram places corresponding chromosomes side by side in the rearranged classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂重新排列的图示中，「染色体核型图」把相应染色体并排摆放。

examples.en: We located the pair numbered two on the karyogram drawn for the teaching exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在教学练习画出的「染色体核型图」中找到标为二的一对。

words.enDefinition: The number and appearance of chromosomes in a cell, also used for a display of that complement.

examples.en: The karyotype describes the chromosome complement that the worksheet illustrates with an arranged set of images.
examples.zh: 「核型」描述练习用排列好的图像所展示的染色体组合。

examples.en: We used the karyotype label to identify the chromosome count shown in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们根据「核型」标签辨认虚构示例中显示的染色体数目。

words.enDefinition: Multilayered epithelial covering with a flattened, keratin-rich outermost layer

examples.en: The skin diagram shows keratinized stratified squamous epithelium at the body's outermost boundary.
examples.zh: 皮肤示意图把「角化复层鳞状上皮」画在人体最外侧边界。

examples.en: We labeled the dry surface layer of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium in the textbook drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在教材图中标出了「角化复层鳞状上皮」的干燥表层。

collocations: surface of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium
layers of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium

words.enDefinition: the main cell type of the epidermis, which forms keratin and contributes to the outer skin barrier

examples.en: We labeled a keratinocyte in the body of the epidermal layer on the enlarged classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的课堂图上，在表皮层内部标出一个「角质形成细胞」。

examples.en: The diagram shows how the shape of a keratinocyte changes as it approaches the outer surface.
examples.zh: 图中显示，「角质形成细胞」逐渐靠近外表面时，其形状如何改变。

words.enDefinition: A water-soluble energy metabolite made mainly in the liver from fatty acid-derived acetyl-CoA.

examples.en: The human metabolism chart shows a ketone body as an alternative fuel for some body tissues.
examples.zh: 人体代谢图把一种「酮体」列为部分人体组织的另一种能量来源。

examples.en: We identified the ketone body where the diagram linked fat breakdown with another route for energy use.
examples.zh: 我们在图中把脂肪分解与另一条供能途径联系起来的位置找到了「酮体」。

collocations: a ketone body used for energy
a ketone body on a pathway diagram

words.enDefinition: Organ that filters blood and regulates body fluids while forming urine

examples.en: The kidney model shows an outer region surrounding a darker inner region.
examples.zh: 「肾脏」模型显示外部区域围绕颜色较深的内部区域。

examples.en: We labeled the kidney beside its connection to the urinary tract.
examples.zh: 我们在通往尿路的连接处旁标出了「肾脏」。

words.enDefinition: The ion of lactic acid, formed from pyruvate in human cells and usable in other metabolic pathways.

examples.en: The chart shows lactate as a product formed from pyruvate in the illustrated muscle cell.
examples.zh: 图中把「乳酸」标为所示肌细胞由丙酮酸形成的产物。

examples.en: We followed an arrow showing lactate entering another pathway in the overview of human metabolism.
examples.zh: 我们顺着人体代谢总览图中的箭头，观察「乳酸」进入另一条途径。

words.enDefinition: Small lymphatic vessel inside a villus receiving products of fat absorption

examples.en: The drawing places a lacteal near the center of the intestinal villus.
examples.zh: 图中「乳糜管」位于肠绒毛中央附近。

examples.en: We colored the lacteal separately from the small blood vessels beside it.
examples.zh: 我们给「乳糜管」及其旁边的小血管分别涂上不同颜色。

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue layer lying directly beneath the epithelium of a mucous membrane

examples.en: The lamina propria lies beneath the band of epithelial cells in the diagram.
examples.zh: 在图中，「固有层」位于带状上皮细胞的下方。

examples.en: We shaded the lamina propria to show where the supporting connective tissue begins.
examples.zh: 我们给「固有层」加上阴影，以显示支撑性结缔组织从哪里开始。

words.enDefinition: Final major region of the digestive tract, recovering water and forming feces

examples.en: The large intestine frames the loops of the smaller intestine in our model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「大肠」围绕在盘曲的小肠外侧。

examples.en: We marked the starting point of the large intestine where the ileum connects.
examples.zh: 我们在回肠相接的位置标出了「大肠」的起点。

words.enDefinition: the lowest part of the pharynx, behind the larynx and continuing into the esophagus

examples.en: The model places the laryngopharynx below the oropharynx and behind the entrance to the larynx.
examples.zh: 模型将「喉咽」标在口咽下方、喉入口的后方。

examples.en: We found the laryngopharynx just before the pharyngeal passage continued into the esophagus on the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在图上咽通道续接到食管之前的位置找到了「喉咽」。

words.enDefinition: the cartilaginous structure between the pharynx and trachea that houses the vocal folds and helps protect the airway

examples.en: The larynx lies above the trachea in the labeled side view of the classroom anatomy model.
examples.zh: 在有标注的课堂解剖模型侧视图中，「喉」位于气管上方。

examples.en: We found the vocal folds inside the larynx on the enlarged drawing used in the lecture.
examples.zh: 我们在讲座所用的放大图中，在「喉」内找到了声带。

words.enDefinition: Either side area in the middle row of the abdominal grid

examples.en: We marked the left lateral abdominal region beside the center of the middle row.
examples.zh: 我们在中间一排中央方格的旁边标出了左「腹外侧区」。

examples.en: Each lateral abdominal region is directly beside the box that contains the navel.
examples.zh: 两个「腹外侧区」各位于含有肚脐的方格的一侧。

words.enDefinition: an X-ray projection image made with the beam directed through the body from one side toward the other

examples.en: The lateral radiograph shows the curved outlines from the side in the teaching example of the skull.
examples.zh: 在颅骨教学示例中，「侧位X线片」从侧面显示弧形轮廓。

examples.en: We compared the lateral radiograph with the front view to localize the outlined object in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们对照「侧位X线片」和正面图，判断课堂模型中圈出物体的位置。

words.enDefinition: Body position lying horizontally on either the left or the right side

examples.en: Our atlas shows a lateral recumbent position with the model resting on its left side.
examples.zh: 我们的图谱展示了模型靠左侧躺卧的「侧卧位」。

examples.en: We labeled the lateral recumbent position on the figure that faces across the page.
examples.zh: 我们在面朝页面侧方的人体图上标出了「侧卧位」。

collocations: model in the lateral recumbent position

words.enDefinition: Rotation of a limb around its long axis that turns its anterior surface away from the midline.

examples.en: Lateral rotation turns the front of the model thigh outward in the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 课堂演示中，「外旋」使模型大腿前表面朝外转。

examples.en: We compared lateral rotation with the arrow showing the opposite direction on the model.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「外旋」与模型上显示相反方向的箭头。

words.enDefinition: Located farther from the body's midline than the referenced structure

examples.en: The shoulders lie lateral to the neck in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型的正视图里，肩部位于颈部「外侧」。

examples.en: We marked a point lateral to the nose near the outer cheek.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近脸颊外缘、位于鼻子「外侧」的位置标了一点。

words.enDefinition: one of the paired fluid-filled cavities located inside the cerebral hemispheres

examples.en: The lateral ventricle appears as a curved cavity inside one hemisphere in the classroom cutaway model.
examples.zh: 在课堂剖视模型中，「侧脑室」是一侧大脑半球内的弯曲腔隙。

examples.en: We traced the illustrated fluid path from a lateral ventricle toward the opening leading to the third ventricle.
examples.zh: 我们沿图示脑脊液路径，从「侧脑室」追踪至通向第三脑室的开口。

words.enDefinition: A broad muscle of the back that helps extend, adduct, and medially rotate the upper arm.

examples.en: The latissimus dorsi spans a broad area of the lower back on the labelled model.
examples.zh: 带标注的模型中，「背阔肌」覆盖下背部的一大片区域。

examples.en: We matched latissimus dorsi to its label before tracing where it attaches to the upper arm.
examples.zh: 我们将「背阔肌」与标签对应，再找它附着在上臂的部位。

words.enDefinition: the heart chamber receiving blood from the pulmonary veins and passing it to the left ventricle

examples.en: The posterior view shows several pulmonary veins entering the left atrium on the model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂模型的后视图显示，多条肺静脉进入「左心房」。

examples.en: We traced the arrow from the left atrium through the mitral valve into the ventricle below.
examples.zh: 我们沿箭头从「左心房」经过二尖瓣追踪到下方的心室。

words.enDefinition: Abdominal quadrant below the navel on the body's left side

examples.en: The left lower quadrant appears on the viewer's right in the front view.
examples.zh: 在正视图中，「左下腹象限」出现在观察者的右边。

examples.en: We shaded the left lower quadrant below the horizontal line on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型的水平线下方给「左下腹象限」涂上了阴影。

collocations: left lower quadrant of the abdomen
model of the left lower quadrant

words.enDefinition: Abdominal quadrant above the navel on the body's left side

examples.en: We shaded the left upper quadrant as seen from the front of the model.
examples.zh: 我们给模型正视图中的「左上腹象限」涂上了阴影。

examples.en: The tutor marked the left upper quadrant using the model's own left side.
examples.zh: 老师以模型自身的左侧为准标出了「左上腹象限」。

collocations: left upper quadrant of the abdomen
model of the left upper quadrant

words.enDefinition: the heart chamber that ejects blood into the aorta to supply the systemic circulation

examples.en: The left ventricle pumps blood past the aortic valve into the first part of the aorta.
examples.zh: 「左心室」泵出的血液通过主动脉瓣进入主动脉的起始段。

examples.en: In the cutaway model, a thick muscle wall surrounds the cavity of the left ventricle.
examples.zh: 在剖视模型中，较厚的肌肉壁围绕着「左心室」腔。

collocations: blood ejected by the left ventricle

words.enDefinition: Immune cell belonging to one of the body's white blood cell groups

examples.en: The drawing labels each leukocyte separately from the surrounding red cells.
examples.zh: 示意图将各个「白细胞」与周围的红细胞分开标注。

examples.en: We matched each leukocyte drawing with its category on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表中将各个「白细胞」图形与其类别配对。

words.enDefinition: Rank within the hierarchy from smaller components to more complex bodily units

examples.en: Each level of structural organization in the chart combines parts from the level below it.
examples.zh: 图表中的每个「结构层次」都由下一个较低层次的部分组合而成。

examples.en: We identified the level of structural organization represented by the collection of tissues in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们辨认了图中这些组织聚集起来所代表的「结构层次」。

collocations: identify a level of structural organization

words.enDefinition: A band of dense connective tissue that connects bones or other structures and helps stabilize a joint.

examples.en: The ligament connects the two bones across the side of the classroom knee model.
examples.zh: 课堂膝部模型上，「韧带」在关节侧面连接两块骨。

examples.en: We coloured the ligament differently from the nearby muscle on the anatomy worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在解剖练习图上用不同颜色区分「韧带」与附近的肌肉。

words.enDefinition: a membrane channel whose opening or closing changes when a chemical messenger binds to it

examples.en: The ligand-gated ion channel opens after a messenger binds to its receptor site in our synapse model.
examples.zh: 在我们的突触模型中，信使与受体位点结合后，「配体门控离子通道」打开。

examples.en: We drew a chemical messenger next to the ligand-gated ion channel on the receiving membrane in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在接收信号的膜上，于「配体门控离子通道」旁画出一个化学信使。

collocations: ligand binding to a ligand-gated ion channel

words.enDefinition: A chain of parent-to-offspring relationships connecting an ancestor to later descendants in a pedigree.

examples.en: The line of descent links the top row to one branch of the fictional family.
examples.zh: 「世代传承线」把最上面一行与虚构家系的一个分支连接起来。

examples.en: We traced the line of descent through successive generations on the classroom family chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂家系图上逐代追踪「世代传承线」。

collocations: line of descent in a pedigree

words.enDefinition: Cellular formation of fatty acids from smaller carbon-containing precursors, often followed by fat storage.

examples.en: The metabolism diagram links lipogenesis to the formation of fatty acids from smaller molecules in cells.
examples.zh: 代谢图将「脂肪生成」与细胞用小分子形成脂肪酸联系起来。

examples.en: We located lipogenesis on the normal human cell map beside the arrow pointing toward lipid storage.
examples.zh: 我们在正常人体细胞图中指向脂质储存的箭头旁找到了「脂肪生成」。

words.enDefinition: The breakdown of stored triacylglycerol, releasing fatty acids and glycerol.

examples.en: The lipolysis panel shows fatty acids and glycerol leaving a triacylglycerol molecule in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂「脂解」图显示，脂肪酸和甘油从甘油三酯分子释放出来。

examples.en: We traced lipolysis on the map before comparing the separate fates of glycerol and fatty acids.
examples.zh: 我们先在图中沿「脂解」途径追踪，再比较甘油与脂肪酸各自的去向。

words.enDefinition: Large abdominal organ that processes absorbed substances and produces bile

examples.en: Our model shows the liver above much of the digestive tract.
examples.zh: 模型中，「肝脏」位于大部分消化道的上方。

examples.en: The diagram traces the route of bile leaving the liver through ducts.
examples.zh: 示意图描出了胆汁沿导管离开「肝脏」的路径。

words.enDefinition: A systematic review updated as relevant new evidence becomes available under an ongoing update plan.

examples.en: The living systematic review has an update date beside each new fictional entry in the table.
examples.zh: 「持续更新的系统综述」的表格在每项新加入的虚构条目旁标有更新日期。

examples.en: We compared two versions of the living systematic review to see which findings had changed.
examples.zh: 我们比较「持续更新的系统综述」的两个版本，查看哪些发现发生变化。

collocations: version of a living systematic review

words.enDefinition: a branch of a main bronchus that supplies air to one lung lobe

examples.en: The airways diagram shows one lobar bronchus entering each marked lung lobe from a central branch.
examples.zh: 气道图显示，各标记肺叶中都有一条从中央分支延出的「肺叶支气管」。

examples.en: We identified the upper lobar bronchus by following the branch entering the upper lobe of the model.
examples.zh: 我们沿进入模型肺上叶的分支，找出了上叶「肺叶支气管」。

words.enDefinition: The longer arm of a chromosome, conventionally designated q in human chromosome notation.

examples.en: The long arm of a chromosome extends farther from the centromere in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「染色体长臂」从着丝粒向外延伸得更远。

examples.en: We read the label for the long arm of a chromosome before comparing its bands.
examples.zh: 我们先读「染色体长臂」的标签，再比较其区带。

collocations: identify the long arm of a chromosome
band on the long arm of a chromosome
label the long arm of a chromosome

words.enDefinition: A bone whose length exceeds its width and that typically has a shaft and two ends.

examples.en: The femur is a long bone with a distinct shaft between its two ends.
examples.zh: 股骨属于「长骨」，其两端之间有明显的骨干。

examples.en: We labelled the main regions of a long bone on the classroom cutaway model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂剖面模型上标出一块「长骨」的主要区域。

words.enDefinition: View or slice taken along the length of a body structure

examples.en: The longitudinal section shows the long axis of the tubular structure in our sketch.
examples.zh: 草图中的「纵切面」显示该管状结构的长轴。

examples.en: Parallel lines run along the longitudinal section of the model's long fibers.
examples.zh: 在模型长纤维的「纵切面」中，纤维呈平行线排列。

words.enDefinition: Connective tissue with relatively few loosely arranged fibers and abundant ground substance

examples.en: The diagram shows loose connective tissue with visible spaces between the loosely arranged fibers.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「疏松结缔组织」排列疏松的纤维之间有可见间隙。

examples.en: We marked loose connective tissue underneath the surface layer of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型表层的下方标出了「疏松结缔组织」。

words.enDefinition: The loss of outcome information when enrolled participants can no longer be contacted or observed as planned.

examples.en: The figure reports loss to follow-up for each group in the fictional participant records after enrolment.
examples.zh: 图中报告了虚构参与者入组后各组记录的「失访」。

examples.en: We examined loss to follow-up before deciding how to interpret the remaining classroom records.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「失访」情况，再决定如何解读剩余课堂记录。

words.enDefinition: a microscope view at relatively low magnification, useful for seeing overall layout over a wider area

examples.en: The low-power view showed the whole skin section before the class examined a much smaller region.
examples.zh: 全班查看更小区域之前，先用「低倍视图」看到完整的皮肤切片。

examples.en: We used the low-power view to find where the epidermis met the edge of the pictured section.
examples.zh: 我们用「低倍视图」寻找表皮与所示切片边缘相交的位置。

collocations: choose a region on the low-power view

words.enDefinition: High-pressure muscular region at the stomach entrance that limits backward flow

examples.en: The lower esophageal sphincter lies where the esophagus meets the stomach in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型中，「下食管括约肌」位于食管和胃交界处。

examples.en: The animation shows the lower esophageal sphincter relaxing briefly as the bolus passes into the stomach.
examples.zh: 动画展示了食团进入胃内时，「下食管括约肌」短暂松弛。

collocations: location of the lower esophageal sphincter
pressure at the lower esophageal sphincter
diagram of the lower esophageal sphincter

words.enDefinition: Area of the lower back between the ribs and pelvis

examples.en: We shaded the lumbar region on the back below the lower ribs.
examples.zh: 我们给背部较低肋骨以下的「腰区」涂上了阴影。

examples.en: The lumbar region appears above the pelvis in the atlas's rear view.
examples.zh: 在图谱的后视图中，「腰区」位于骨盆上方。

words.enDefinition: One of the five vertebrae in the lower back above the sacrum.

examples.en: The lumbar vertebra has a broad body in the specimen shown during the anatomy lesson.
examples.zh: 解剖课展示的标本里，「腰椎骨」有宽大的椎体。

examples.en: We fitted the lumbar vertebra above the sacrum in the teaching model of the spine.
examples.zh: 我们在脊柱教学模型里，把「腰椎骨」放在骶骨上方。

words.enDefinition: the open space inside a tube, blood vessel or other hollow anatomical structure

examples.en: The lumen is the central open space surrounded by cells in the prepared section of the duct.
examples.zh: 在已制好的导管切片中，「管腔」是被细胞包围的中央空隙。

examples.en: We traced the edge of the lumen before labeling the tissue lining it in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们先沿「管腔」边缘描线，再在图中标出覆盖它的组织。

words.enDefinition: the change in lung volume per unit change in distending pressure across the lung

examples.en: Higher lung compliance gave a greater volume change for the same pressure change in the simulated lung.
examples.zh: 模拟肺中，「肺顺应性」越高，相同压差变化对应的容积变化越大。

examples.en: We estimated lung compliance from the local slope of the volume versus transpulmonary pressure curve in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用肺容积对跨肺压曲线的局部斜率估算「肺顺应性」。

words.enDefinition: a deep cleft separating adjacent lobes of a lung

examples.en: The lung fissure appears as a groove separating two lobes in the classroom model of the lungs.
examples.zh: 课堂肺模型中，「肺裂」表现为分隔两个肺叶的沟。

examples.en: We located the lung fissure marked as oblique on the side view of the left lung.
examples.zh: 我们在左肺侧视图中找到了标为斜裂的那条「肺裂」。

words.enDefinition: the region on the medial lung surface through which the bronchi, vessels, nerves and lymphatic pathways pass

examples.en: The model places the lung hilum on the inward-facing surface where the major airway and vessels enter.
examples.zh: 模型把「肺门」标在面向内侧的表面，大气道和血管从这里出入。

examples.en: We labeled the lung hilum after locating the group of structures entering the lung in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找到出入肺部的一组结构，再标出「肺门」。

collocations: structures passing through the lung hilum

words.enDefinition: one of the major divisions of a lung, separated from neighboring lobes by fissures

examples.en: The right lung model shows each lung lobe separated from the next by a marked fissure.
examples.zh: 右肺模型用标出的裂隙将相邻的「肺叶」分别隔开。

examples.en: We identified the left upper lung lobe by its position above the oblique fissure on the model.
examples.zh: 我们依据模型上左肺斜裂以上的位置，辨认出左上「肺叶」。

words.enDefinition: Tissue-derived fluid traveling through vessels that drain into the venous circulation

examples.en: The diagram labels the fluid as lymph once it enters the small vessel.
examples.zh: 当液体进入这根小淋巴管后，示意图将其标为「淋巴液」。

examples.en: We used a distinct color for lymph in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中用一种单独的颜色表示「淋巴液」。

words.enDefinition: Small organized structure along lymphatic vessels where lymph passes through immune tissue

examples.en: The illustration shows a lymph node along one of the collecting vessels.
examples.zh: 插图在一根集合淋巴管上画出了一个「淋巴结」。

examples.en: We labeled the outer and inner regions of one lymph node in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上标出了一个「淋巴结」的内外区域。

collocations: lymph passing through a lymph node

words.enDefinition: Outer region of a lymph node containing clusters of lymphocytes

examples.en: The ring of shaded tissue represents the lymph node cortex in the section.
examples.zh: 截面图中，以阴影表示的环形组织代表「淋巴结皮质」。

examples.en: We marked several cell clusters inside the lymph node cortex on the enlarged drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在放大图的「淋巴结皮质」中标出了几个细胞群。

collocations: cells of the lymph node cortex
diagram of the lymph node cortex

words.enDefinition: Inner region of a lymph node containing lymphatic channels and cell cords

examples.en: The lymph node medulla is drawn inside the outer band of the modeled node.
examples.zh: 在淋巴结模型中，「淋巴结髓质」画在外带以内。

examples.en: We labeled the deeper channels in the lymph node medulla on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题图中标出了「淋巴结髓质」深处的管道。

collocations: channels of the lymph node medulla
diagram of the lymph node medulla

words.enDefinition: Tiny blind-ended vessel that receives fluid from the spaces between cells

examples.en: The lymphatic capillary begins with a closed end in the illustrated tissue.
examples.zh: 图示组织中，「毛细淋巴管」从一个封闭的端点开始。

examples.en: We placed the lymphatic capillary beside a small area of tissue fluid.
examples.zh: 我们把「毛细淋巴管」画在一小片组织间液旁。

words.enDefinition: Movement of fluid through lymphatic vessels from tissues toward the circulation

examples.en: The illustration uses arrows to show lymphatic drainage from the modeled tissues.
examples.zh: 插图用箭头表示来自模型组织的「淋巴回流」。

examples.en: We compared two regions by tracing their paths of lymphatic drainage.
examples.zh: 我们分别描画两个区域的「淋巴回流」路径，并作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Major channel carrying lymph from regional trunks toward the venous circulation

examples.en: The lymphatic duct joins the venous pathway near the top of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型靠近顶部的位置，「淋巴导管」汇入静脉通路。

examples.en: We followed one lymphatic duct from the trunks to the shaded vein.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「淋巴导管」从淋巴干追踪到用阴影表示的静脉。

words.enDefinition: Network of vessels and organs returning tissue fluid and supporting immune functions

examples.en: The lymphatic system diagram shows small vessels joining larger channels across the body.
examples.zh: 「淋巴系统」示意图显示人体各处的小淋巴管汇入较大的通道。

examples.en: We traced the lymphatic system alongside the blood circulation in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂插图中沿血液循环路径旁查看了「淋巴系统」。

words.enDefinition: Large vessel collecting lymph from vessels draining a particular body region

examples.en: The diagram shows smaller pathways converging to form a lymphatic trunk.
examples.zh: 示意图显示较小的通路汇合形成一条「淋巴干」。

examples.en: We marked each lymphatic trunk before following the flow into a central duct.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各条「淋巴干」，再沿流向追踪到中央的淋巴导管。

words.enDefinition: Fold within a vessel that limits backward movement of lymph

examples.en: The arrows around a lymphatic valve indicate one main direction of flow.
examples.zh: 「淋巴管瓣膜」周围的箭头标明一个主要流动方向。

examples.en: We labeled the lymphatic valve between two segments of the same vessel.
examples.zh: 我们在同一根管道的两段之间标出了「淋巴管瓣膜」。

words.enDefinition: Immune cell belonging to the B cell, T cell, or natural killer groups

examples.en: The chart uses separate branches for each major lymphocyte group in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图表用不同分支表示「淋巴细胞」的各主要类群。

examples.en: We identified a lymphocyte among several cells pictured in the node.
examples.zh: 我们在淋巴结图示的几个细胞中找到了一个「淋巴细胞」。

words.enDefinition: A large molecule in a living system, such as a protein or polysaccharide.

examples.en: The tutor used glycogen as an example of a macromolecule with many linked glucose units.
examples.zh: 辅导老师以糖原为例，说明这种「生物大分子」含有许多相连的葡萄糖单元。

examples.en: We traced the outline of the folded macromolecule in the illustration of an ordinary human cell.
examples.zh: 我们在普通人体细胞的插图上沿着折叠的「生物大分子」描出轮廓。

collocations: a macromolecule in a human cell

words.enDefinition: Large immune cell that engulfs debris and helps organize local responses

examples.en: The animation shows a macrophage surrounding a piece of cellular debris.
examples.zh: 动画显示一个「巨噬细胞」正在包围一块细胞碎片。

examples.en: We labeled a macrophage among the cells in the classroom tissue model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂组织模型的细胞群中标出了一个「巨噬细胞」。

words.enDefinition: imaging that uses magnetic fields and radiofrequency signals from atomic nuclei, usually hydrogen, to construct images

examples.en: The lecture describes magnetic resonance imaging with a diagram showing how tissue signals contribute to an image.
examples.zh: 讲义用示意图介绍「磁共振成像」，展示组织信号怎样参与形成图像。

examples.en: We compared two magnetic resonance imaging examples with different contrast patterns on the anatomy course page.
examples.zh: 我们比较了解剖学课程页上显示不同对比模式的两幅「磁共振成像」示例。

collocations: tissue contrast in magnetic resonance imaging

words.enDefinition: one of the two large airway branches carrying air from the trachea into a lung

examples.en: We followed the right main bronchus from the tracheal split to the branching passages within the lung model.
examples.zh: 我们从气管分叉沿右「主支气管」追踪到肺模型内进一步分支的通道。

examples.en: Each main bronchus leads toward one lung and gives rise to branches for its lobes.
examples.zh: 各「主支气管」均通往一侧肺，并分出通往该侧各肺叶的支气管。

words.enDefinition: Larger collecting space formed where several minor calyces join within the kidney

examples.en: Several smaller cups join to form the major calyx in the drawing.
examples.zh: 在图中，几个较小的杯状结构相汇形成「肾大盏」。

examples.en: We labeled the major calyx before the pathway opens into the renal pelvis.
examples.zh: 我们在尿路通入肾盂之前的位置标出了「肾大盏」。

words.enDefinition: Tissue-resident immune cell storing signaling substances such as histamine in granules

examples.en: The model places a mast cell among the cells in the supporting tissue.
examples.zh: 模型将一个「肥大细胞」画在支撑组织的其他细胞之间。

examples.en: We marked the granules inside the illustrated mast cell in our class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上标出了图示「肥大细胞」内部的颗粒。

words.enDefinition: The limiting reaction rate of a fixed amount of enzyme as substrate becomes saturating in the model.

examples.en: The dashed line represents maximum reaction velocity where the simulated curve approaches its upper plateau.
examples.zh: 虚线表示模拟曲线接近上方平台时对应的「最大反应速率」。

examples.en: We found half the maximum reaction velocity on the hypothetical curve used in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂使用的假设曲线上找出了「最大反应速率」的一半。

collocations: maximum reaction velocity in an enzyme model

words.enDefinition: the time average of arterial pressure over a cardiac cycle

examples.en: The simulator calculated mean arterial pressure from the arterial pressure trace over one complete heartbeat in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，模拟器用一个完整心跳内的动脉压曲线求「平均动脉压」。

examples.en: We compared mean arterial pressure with the highest point on each arterial trace in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们把「平均动脉压」与各条动脉压曲线的最高点比较。

collocations: mean arterial pressure over a beat

words.enDefinition: Average volume of a single red blood cell in a group

examples.en: We used circles of different sizes to illustrate mean corpuscular volume in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上用大小不同的圆圈说明「平均红细胞体积」。

examples.en: The table gives mean corpuscular volume separately from the number of red cells.
examples.zh: 表格将「平均红细胞体积」与红细胞数量分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a microscope stage that moves a held slide in two horizontal directions using positioning controls

examples.en: The film shows the mechanical stage moving the slide sideways while the objective stays in place.
examples.zh: 影片显示，「机械载物台」使玻片横向移动，物镜则保持在原位。

examples.en: We identified the two positioning controls for the mechanical stage on the microscope's parts diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在显微镜部件图上找出「机械载物台」的两个定位控制件。

words.enDefinition: a sensory receptor that responds to physical deformation such as pressure, vibration or stretching

examples.en: The skin model shows a mechanoreceptor responding when the soft surface above it is pressed.
examples.zh: 皮肤模型显示，上方柔软表面受到按压时，「机械感受器」产生响应。

examples.en: We compared the simulated signals of a mechanoreceptor during steady pressure and during a short vibration.
examples.zh: 我们比较恒定压力下和短暂振动下「机械感受器」的模拟信号。

words.enDefinition: Rotation of a limb around its long axis that turns its anterior surface toward the midline.

examples.en: Medial rotation turns the front surface of the model thigh inward in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂示意图里，「内旋」使模型大腿的前表面向内转。

examples.en: We labelled medial rotation with a curved arrow around the long axis of the thigh.
examples.zh: 我们沿大腿长轴画弧线箭头，标出「内旋」。

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the body's midline than the referenced structure

examples.en: The nose lies medial to either eye in the front anatomical view.
examples.zh: 在解剖正视图中，鼻子位于任一眼睛的「内侧」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks which of the two labels is medial to the eye.
examples.zh: 习题问，两个标注中哪一个位于眼睛「内侧」。

words.enDefinition: Central region of the thorax located between the two pleural sacs

examples.en: The mediastinum is shaded between the two lung compartments in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中两个肺所处的腔隙之间用阴影表示「纵隔」。

examples.en: We located the mediastinum before identifying the heart within the chest diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先定位「纵隔」，再在胸部示意图里识别心脏。

words.enDefinition: the creation of images representing structures or functions inside the body using physical signals

examples.en: The introduction compares three kinds of medical imaging using labeled pictures from the anatomy teaching collection.
examples.zh: 导论使用解剖教学集中有标注的图片，比较三种「医学影像」方式。

examples.en: We used medical imaging examples to see how the same structure appears with different physical signals.
examples.zh: 我们用「医学影像」示例观察同一结构如何通过不同物理信号呈现。

words.enDefinition: the lowest part of the brainstem, continuous with the spinal cord and involved in regulating vital functions

examples.en: The model narrows from the medulla oblongata into the upper spinal cord at the base of the brain.
examples.zh: 模型从脑底的「延髓」向上部脊髓过渡时逐渐变细。

examples.en: The classroom chart links the medulla oblongata to neural regulation of breathing and circulation in the body.
examples.zh: 课堂图将「延髓」与人体呼吸及血液循环的神经调节联系起来。

words.enDefinition: The central cavity within the shaft of a long bone that contains marrow.

examples.en: The medullary cavity runs through the shaft in the lengthwise view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型的纵切图上，「骨髓腔」贯穿骨干。

examples.en: We labelled the medullary cavity before adding the layers of bone around it on paper.
examples.zh: 我们先在纸上标出「骨髓腔」，再补画它周围的骨层。

collocations: medullary cavity of a long bone

words.enDefinition: Increase in interstitial fluid osmolality toward the inner renal medulla

examples.en: The diagram uses progressively darker colors to show the medullary osmotic gradient inside the kidney.
examples.zh: 示意图用逐渐加深的颜色表示肾内的「肾髓质渗透梯度」。

examples.en: We traced the medullary osmotic gradient from the outer region toward the inner tip.
examples.zh: 我们沿「肾髓质渗透梯度」从外侧区域追踪到内侧尖端。

collocations: diagram of the medullary osmotic gradient
role of the medullary osmotic gradient

words.enDefinition: Large marrow cell whose cytoplasm gives rise to circulating platelets

examples.en: The lineage chart shows a megakaryocyte beside its small platelet fragments.
examples.zh: 谱系图在一个「巨核细胞」旁画出了由它产生的血小板小碎片。

examples.en: We marked the megakaryocyte at the large end of the illustrated branch.
examples.zh: 我们在图示分支较大的一端标出了「巨核细胞」。

words.enDefinition: A division process with one chromosome replication followed by two divisions that reduce the number of chromosome sets.

examples.en: The meiosis overview shows two divisions after the chromosomes have been copied in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂「减数分裂」总图展示染色体复制后发生两次分裂。

examples.en: We traced the chromosome sets through meiosis in the simplified diagram used for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习用的示意图中，追踪「减数分裂」过程中的染色体组。

words.enDefinition: The first meiotic division, in which homologous chromosomes separate and chromosome set number is reduced.

examples.en: Meiosis I separates the homologous chromosomes while each remains composed of two sister chromatids in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「减数第一次分裂」分开同源染色体，而每条仍由两条姐妹染色单体组成。

examples.en: We counted the remaining sets after meiosis I in the simplified two-pair chromosome model.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的两对染色体模型中，数出「减数第一次分裂」后剩余的染色体组数。

words.enDefinition: The second meiotic division, in which sister chromatids separate without an intervening round of chromosome replication.

examples.en: Meiosis II separates the sister chromatids in the final two panels of the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 课堂图的最后两幅小图中，「减数第二次分裂」使姐妹染色单体分离。

examples.en: We marked each chromosome copy after meiosis II in the fictional classroom model of human cells.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构的人类细胞课堂模型中，标出「减数第二次分裂」后的各条染色体副本。

words.enDefinition: A structure of microtubules that organizes chromosome movement during meiotic division.

examples.en: The meiotic spindle is shown as lines extending toward the chromosomes in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，「减数分裂纺锤体」画成向染色体延伸的线。

examples.en: We labelled each end of the meiotic spindle before looking at the aligned chromosome pairs.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「减数分裂纺锤体」的两端，再观察排好序的染色体对。

words.enDefinition: a pigment-producing cell that makes melanin and transfers it to nearby keratinocytes in skin

examples.en: The drawing places a melanocyte near the base of the epidermis with processes reaching toward neighboring cells.
examples.zh: 图中，一个「黑素细胞」位于表皮底部附近，突起伸向邻近细胞。

examples.en: We used the arrows to trace pigment transfer from the melanocyte on the classroom model of skin.
examples.zh: 我们利用箭头，在课堂皮肤模型上追踪从「黑素细胞」向外转移的色素。

words.enDefinition: The differing composition or orientation of components on the two sides of a biological membrane.

examples.en: The membrane asymmetry diagram showed sugar chains exposed mainly on the outward face of the cell.
examples.zh: 「膜不对称性」图显示，糖链主要暴露在细胞的外表面。

examples.en: We explained membrane asymmetry by comparing the lipid types drawn on the inner and outer layers.
examples.zh: 我们比较内外两层中画出的脂质类型，解释「膜不对称性」。

words.enDefinition: Cholesterol incorporated among other lipids in a cell membrane, where it influences their packing and mobility.

examples.en: The drawing positions membrane cholesterol among the lipid tails in a section of the human cell membrane.
examples.zh: 人体细胞膜的切面图把「膜胆固醇」画在脂质尾部之间。

examples.en: We identified the small polar group of membrane cholesterol near the head groups on the membrane diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在膜图的头基附近，找到了「膜胆固醇」的小极性基团。

collocations: the effect of membrane cholesterol on fluidity

words.enDefinition: The ease with which lipids and other components can move within a membrane.

examples.en: The animation illustrated membrane fluidity by showing phospholipids moving sideways within the same layer of a membrane.
examples.zh: 动画让磷脂在同一膜层内横向移动，以说明「膜流动性」。

examples.en: We discussed membrane fluidity when comparing diagrams of a loosely packed layer and a more ordered layer.
examples.zh: 我们比较排列较松散的膜层与较有序的膜层图示时，讨论了「膜流动性」。

collocations: the effect of lipid composition on membrane fluidity

words.enDefinition: A lipid that forms part of a biological membrane.

examples.en: We identified one membrane lipid with a polar head projecting toward the water outside the cell.
examples.zh: 我们找到一种「膜脂」，其极性头部朝向细胞外的水相。

examples.en: The tutor grouped each membrane lipid by the shape of its polar region in the diagram.
examples.zh: 辅导老师根据极性部分的形状，为图中的各种「膜脂」分组。

words.enDefinition: Long-lived B lymphocyte that can respond rapidly when its antigen reappears

examples.en: The chart places a memory B cell on the branch that remains after the response.
examples.zh: 图表将一个「记忆B细胞」画在反应结束后仍存在的细胞分支上。

examples.en: We followed the memory B cell from the first encounter to the later example.
examples.zh: 我们沿示意图从首次接触追踪「记忆B细胞」到后续情境。

collocations: role of a memory B cell
diagram of a memory B cell

words.enDefinition: Long-lived T lymphocyte able to respond after another encounter with its antigen

examples.en: The classroom diagram keeps a memory T cell in the picture after other cells decline.
examples.zh: 在课堂示意图中，其他细胞数量减少后仍画有「记忆T细胞」。

examples.en: We marked the memory T cell on the later part of the timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在时间轴的后段标出了「记忆T细胞」。

collocations: role of a memory T cell
diagram of a memory T cell

words.enDefinition: Inheritance described by Mendel's rules for segregation and assortment of alleles, often illustrated with single-gene traits.

examples.en: The classroom model uses Mendelian inheritance to explain how its single labelled locus is transmitted.
examples.zh: 课堂模型用「孟德尔遗传」说明模型中单个标记位点如何传给下一代。

examples.en: We checked the assumptions of Mendelian inheritance before reading the expected categories in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「孟德尔遗传」的假设，再看练习中的预期类别。

words.enDefinition: the three connective tissue membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The lecturer drew three layers of meninges between the skull and the brain surface in the diagram.
examples.zh: 老师在图中颅骨与脑表面之间画出三层「脑脊膜」。

examples.en: We traced the meninges from around the brain into the canal surrounding the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 我们沿脑周围的「脑脊膜」追踪到环绕脊髓的椎管内。

words.enDefinition: A wedge-shaped fibrocartilage structure that helps distribute load between the joint surfaces of the knee.

examples.en: The meniscus rests between the thigh and shin bones in the labelled knee model.
examples.zh: 带标注的膝部模型上，「半月板」位于股骨和胫骨之间。

examples.en: We compared the shape of one meniscus with the other in the classroom top view.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂俯视图中两个「半月板」各自的形状。

words.enDefinition: The statistical combination of compatible results from two or more studies.

examples.en: The meta-analysis combines estimates measuring the same outcome from several fictional studies in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「荟萃分析」合并数项虚构研究对同一结局的估计值。

examples.en: We checked whether the meta-analysis used comparable estimates before interpreting its classroom plot.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「荟萃分析」所用估计值是否可比，再解读课堂图。

words.enDefinition: The rate at which material passes through a reaction or pathway in metabolism.

examples.en: The simulated diagram uses thicker arrows to represent higher metabolic flux through the glucose pathway.
examples.zh: 模拟图用较粗的箭头表示单位时间内有更多物质通过葡萄糖代谢途径，即更高的「代谢通量」。

examples.en: We compared metabolic flux at two branches on the classroom chart using the modeled rates.
examples.zh: 我们根据模型速率，比较课堂图上两条分支的「代谢通量」。

words.enDefinition: A series of linked cellular reactions in which products of earlier steps can serve as later reactants.

examples.en: We followed the metabolic pathway from its initial compound to the final product on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们从起始化合物沿课堂图表上的「代谢途径」追踪到最终产物。

examples.en: The metabolic pathway on the worksheet branched at a compound shared by two sets of reactions.
examples.zh: 习题中的「代谢途径」在两组反应共享的一种化合物处出现分支。

collocations: a branch in a metabolic pathway

words.enDefinition: One of the five bones of the palm between the wrist bones and the finger bones.

examples.en: The metacarpal extends from the wrist region toward the base of the marked finger.
examples.zh: 「掌骨」从腕部附近延伸到标记手指的根部。

examples.en: We labelled each metacarpal before tracing the fingers on the classroom hand diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各块「掌骨」，再沿课堂手部图上的手指查看。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome whose centromere is near the middle, giving two arms of approximately equal length.

examples.en: The metacentric chromosome has arms of similar length in the classroom set of example drawings.
examples.zh: 课堂所用示例图中，「中着丝粒染色体」的两条臂长度相近。

examples.en: We chose the metacentric chromosome by comparing the position of the constriction in each image.
examples.zh: 我们比较各图中缢缩部位的位置，选出「中着丝粒染色体」。

words.enDefinition: The meiotic stage when homologous chromosome pairs align near the middle of the cell.

examples.en: The homologous chromosome pairs line up across the middle of the model during metaphase I.
examples.zh: 模型中，各对同源染色体在「减数第一次分裂中期」排列于细胞中间。

examples.en: We compared the orientation of two pairs during metaphase I in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图示中比较两对染色体在「减数第一次分裂中期」的朝向。

words.enDefinition: The stage when individual replicated chromosomes align in each cell before sister chromatids separate.

examples.en: The individual chromosomes line up in the middle during metaphase II in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型里，各条染色体在「减数第二次分裂中期」排列在细胞中央。

examples.en: We distinguished metaphase II from the stage showing paired homologues in the earlier division.
examples.zh: 我们把「减数第二次分裂中期」与较早那次分裂中显示同源染色体成对排列的阶段区分开。

words.enDefinition: The region of a long bone between the shaft and an epiphysis, next to the growth plate in a growing bone.

examples.en: The metaphysis is labelled between the shaft and the rounded bone end in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图将「干骺端」标在骨干与圆形骨端之间。

examples.en: We identified the metaphysis on the cutaway drawing before locating the growth plate shown nearby.
examples.zh: 我们先在剖面图上找出「干骺端」，再定位旁边所画的生长板。

words.enDefinition: One of the five long bones between the tarsal bones and the toe bones.

examples.en: The first metatarsal extends toward the big toe in the classroom diagram of the foot.
examples.zh: 课堂足部图中，第一「跖骨」朝大脚趾方向延伸。

examples.en: We traced a metatarsal from its base to the rounded head on the teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们在教学模型上沿一块「跖骨」从骨底看到圆形的跖骨头。

words.enDefinition: Differences between studies in design, conduct, or methods used to measure and analyse data.

examples.en: The methodological heterogeneity comes from different study designs in the fictional evidence summary for class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构证据摘要中的「方法学异质性」源自不同的研究设计。

examples.en: We noted methodological heterogeneity while comparing how the two model studies measured their primary outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们比较两项模型研究如何测量主要结局时，记录了「方法学异质性」。

words.enDefinition: In the Michaelis-Menten model, the substrate concentration at which the reaction rate is half its maximum.

examples.en: The Michaelis constant was marked below the point where the model reached half its maximum rate.
examples.zh: 模型达到最大速率一半的那个点下方标出了「米氏常数」。

examples.en: We used the labeled concentration axis to locate the Michaelis constant in the simulated diagram.
examples.zh: 我们根据标注的浓度轴，在模拟图中找出「米氏常数」。

collocations: the Michaelis constant of a modeled enzyme

words.enDefinition: resident immune cells of the central nervous system that monitor tissue and clear cellular debris

examples.en: The classroom image shows microglia with branching processes distributed among the neurons in a tissue section.
examples.zh: 课堂图像显示，具有分支突起的「小胶质细胞」分布在组织切片的神经元之间。

examples.en: We used the diagram to relate microglia to removal of cellular debris in central nervous tissue.
examples.zh: 我们用图示说明「小胶质细胞」参与清除中枢神经组织中的细胞残骸。

words.enDefinition: a flat transparent support on which a specimen is held for microscopic viewing

examples.en: The microscope slide is the rectangular glass support under the small specimen in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图上，「载玻片」是小标本下方的矩形玻璃托片。

examples.en: We read the printed label attached to the microscope slide before matching it to a teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们阅读贴在「载玻片」上的印刷标签，然后将它与教学图像相匹配。

words.enDefinition: the platform that holds a slide or other specimen in position beneath the objective

examples.en: The microscope stage supports the prepared slide below the objective in the labeled classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂标注图中，「显微镜载物台」在物镜下方托住已制好的玻片。

examples.en: We found the microscope stage by locating the platform with a central opening for transmitted light.
examples.zh: 我们在图中找到中央有透光开口的平台，从而辨认出「显微镜载物台」。

collocations: position a slide on the microscope stage

words.enDefinition: Study of body structures that require magnification for detailed examination

examples.en: The microscopic anatomy lecture uses enlarged images of structures smaller than we can see.
examples.zh: 「显微解剖学」课堂使用肉眼难以辨清的微小结构的放大图像。

examples.en: We compared microscopic anatomy images with the larger structures shown on the model.
examples.zh: 我们把「显微解剖学」图像与模型上较大的结构作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Physiological process in which urine leaves the bladder through the urethra

examples.en: The lecture diagram represents micturition with an arrow leading out of the bladder.
examples.zh: 课堂图用一个从膀胱引出的箭头表示「排尿」。

examples.en: We compared the diagrams for bladder filling and micturition on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较了习题中膀胱充盈与「排尿」的两幅示意图。

words.enDefinition: the uppermost region of the brainstem between the pons and the diencephalon

examples.en: We identified the midbrain above the rounded pons on the cutaway view of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型的剖视图中，于圆隆的脑桥上方辨认出「中脑」。

examples.en: The diagram places a narrow passage for cerebrospinal fluid within the midbrain of the sectioned brain.
examples.zh: 剖开的脑图中，将一条脑脊液通过的狭长管道画在「中脑」内。

words.enDefinition: Vertical plane passing through the midline between equal left and right portions

examples.en: The midsagittal plane passes through the center of the nose on our model.
examples.zh: 我们模型中的「正中矢状面」穿过鼻子的中央。

examples.en: We drew the midsagittal plane to divide the body into right and left halves.
examples.zh: 我们画出「正中矢状面」，将人体分成左、右两半。

words.enDefinition: The smallest difference in an outcome that is judged meaningful to patients or for a stated clinical context.

examples.en: The minimal clinically important difference is listed as a fictional benchmark beside the classroom scores.
examples.zh: 「最小临床重要差异」作为虚构基准列在课堂评分旁。

examples.en: We compared the estimated change with the minimal clinically important difference stated for the example.
examples.zh: 我们将变化估计值与示例指定的「最小临床重要差异」作比较。

collocations: estimate a minimal clinically important difference
specify a minimal clinically important difference
compare with a minimal clinically important difference

words.enDefinition: Small cup-shaped space collecting urine discharged from a renal papilla

examples.en: One minor calyx surrounds the tip of a pyramid in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，一个「肾小盏」围住一个肾锥体的尖端。

examples.en: We drew an arrow from the minor calyx into a larger collecting space.
examples.zh: 我们从「肾小盏」画了一个指向较大集合腔的箭头。

words.enDefinition: the total volume of air moved in or out of the lungs per minute

examples.en: We found minute ventilation by multiplying the model's tidal volume by the number of breaths per minute.
examples.zh: 我们将模型的潮气量乘每分钟呼吸次数，求出「每分钟通气量」。

examples.en: The two simulations had equal minute ventilation despite using different combinations of breath size and frequency.
examples.zh: 两个模拟采用不同的单次呼吸量与频率组合，所得「每分钟通气量」相同。

words.enDefinition: The small set of genetic material found inside mitochondria.

examples.en: The mitochondrial genome appears as a labelled circle outside the nucleus in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，「线粒体基因组」画成细胞核外一个带标签的圆环。

examples.en: We compared the mitochondrial genome with the much larger nuclear genome in the textbook illustration.
examples.zh: 我们比较教材图中的「线粒体基因组」与大得多的核基因组。

words.enDefinition: Transmission of mitochondrial genetic material, which in humans usually follows the maternal line.

examples.en: The mitochondrial inheritance diagram follows the small genome shown inside mitochondria in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中的「线粒体遗传」追踪画在线粒体内的小型基因组。

examples.en: We compared mitochondrial inheritance with transmission of a numbered chromosome in the teaching exercise.
examples.zh: 在教学练习中，我们将「线粒体遗传」与编号染色体的遗传传递作比较。

words.enDefinition: Nuclear division that separates replicated chromosomes into daughter nuclei typically retaining the original chromosome number.

examples.en: The mitosis diagram shows each replicated chromosome separating into two daughter copies in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂「有丝分裂」图展示各条已复制染色体分开，两个副本分别进入子细胞核。

examples.en: We compared mitosis with the division that reduces chromosome set number in the textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们把教材图中的「有丝分裂」与使染色体组数减半的分裂作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the left atrioventricular valve, with two leaflets, between the left atrium and left ventricle

examples.en: The mitral valve opened when left atrial pressure exceeded left ventricular pressure in the simulation.
examples.zh: 模拟中，左心房压力超过左心室压力时，「二尖瓣」打开。

examples.en: We compared the two leaflets of the mitral valve with three on the right side.
examples.zh: 我们将「二尖瓣」的两片瓣叶与右侧的三片作了对比。

words.enDefinition: A protein that assists other proteins in folding or prevents inappropriate interactions between them.

examples.en: The cell diagram shows a molecular chaperone interacting temporarily with another protein as that protein folds.
examples.zh: 细胞图显示，另一种蛋白质折叠时，「分子伴侣」暂时与其相互作用。

examples.en: We identified the molecular chaperone beside the folding chain in the model of a human cell.
examples.zh: 我们在人体细胞模型中的折叠链旁找到了「分子伴侣」。

collocations: a molecular chaperone in the cytoplasm
the role of a molecular chaperone

words.enDefinition: Circulating white blood cell that can give rise to tissue macrophages

examples.en: The textbook shows a monocyte with a curved nucleus in the drawing.
examples.zh: 教材图展示一个细胞核呈弯曲形的「单核细胞」。

examples.en: We marked the monocyte in the blood portion of the development chart.
examples.zh: 我们在发育图的血液部分标出了「单核细胞」。

words.enDefinition: A small molecular building block represented as one unit of a larger polymer.

examples.en: The diagram uses a single glucose shape to represent one monomer unit of the glycogen chain.
examples.zh: 图中用一个葡萄糖形状表示糖原链的一个「单体单元」。

examples.en: We identified the monomer unit shown repeatedly along the chain in our classroom figure of glycogen.
examples.zh: 在课堂糖原图中，我们认出了沿链反复出现的「单体单元」。

collocations: the identity of a monomer unit

words.enDefinition: A carbohydrate consisting of a single sugar unit.

examples.en: We identified glucose as a monosaccharide because it had one sugar unit in the structure chart.
examples.zh: 结构图中的葡萄糖只有一个糖单元，因此我们将它归为「单糖」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to each monosaccharide separately before discussing the linked pair shown in the next panel.
examples.zh: 辅导老师先分别指出各个「单糖」，再讲解下一幅图中相连的两个糖单元。

words.enDefinition: The presence of one copy of a particular chromosome when two copies would normally be expected.

examples.en: The synthetic diagram uses monosomy for the numbered group containing only one chromosome in class.
examples.zh: 课堂合成图中，只有一条染色体的编号组用来表示「单体性」。

examples.en: We counted the chromosome copies before choosing the monosomy label on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先数染色体副本，再在练习纸上选用「单体性」标签。

words.enDefinition: A fatty acid with one carbon-carbon double bond in its hydrocarbon chain.

examples.en: The monounsaturated fatty acid in the diagram had a single bend where the marked double bond appeared.
examples.zh: 图中的「单不饱和脂肪酸」在标出的双键处有一处弯折。

examples.en: We identified a monounsaturated fatty acid by counting one carbon-carbon double bond along the pictured chain.
examples.zh: 我们数出图中链上只有一个碳碳双键，据此认出「单不饱和脂肪酸」。

words.enDefinition: The presence of two or more genetically different cell populations derived from a single fertilized egg.

examples.en: The worksheet uses mosaicism to explain why the two clusters of model cells carry different symbols.
examples.zh: 练习用「嵌合现象」解释为什么两簇模型细胞的符号不同。

examples.en: We illustrated mosaicism by marking the cell groups that arose from the same original cell.
examples.zh: 我们标记来自同一个初始细胞的细胞组，以说明「嵌合现象」。

words.enDefinition: a neuron whose activity sends commands toward a muscle, directly or through another neuron

examples.en: The labeled motor neuron in the spinal diagram sends its axon toward a skeletal muscle in the model.
examples.zh: 图中标出的脊髓「运动神经元」将轴突伸向模型的一块骨骼肌。

examples.en: We distinguished the motor neuron from the pathway bringing information from the skin in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中区分了「运动神经元」与从皮肤传入信息的通路。

words.enDefinition: One lower motor neuron and all the skeletal muscle fibres it innervates.

examples.en: The motor unit diagram connects one motor neuron with several muscle fibres in the teaching example.
examples.zh: 教学示例的「运动单位」图把一个运动神经元与数条肌纤维连在一起。

examples.en: We traced the branching neuron to see which fibres belong to the same motor unit.
examples.zh: 我们沿神经元的分支查看哪些肌纤维属于同一个「运动单位」。

words.enDefinition: Collection of immune cells organized within or beneath mucosal linings

examples.en: The drawing shows mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue close to the surface lining of the intestine.
examples.zh: 图中，「黏膜相关淋巴组织」靠近肠道的表面内衬。

examples.en: We highlighted mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue on the diagram before labeling the surrounding tissue layers.
examples.zh: 我们先在示意图中标出「黏膜相关淋巴组织」，再标注周围各层组织。

words.enDefinition: Protective boundary formed by a mucous membrane and material covering its surface

examples.en: The cutaway shows the mucosal barrier along the exposed side of the lining.
examples.zh: 剖视图显示「黏膜屏障」沿内衬朝向腔隙的一侧分布。

examples.en: We colored the mucosal barrier before labeling cells in the tissue beneath it.
examples.zh: 我们先给「黏膜屏障」上色，再标出下方组织里的细胞。

words.enDefinition: Lining of passages opening to the exterior, consisting of epithelium and connective tissue

examples.en: The mucous membrane diagram shows a surface layer attached to supporting tissue below.
examples.zh: 「黏膜」示意图展示一个表层与下方支撑组织相连。

examples.en: We identified a mucous membrane on the inner surface of the digestive tract model.
examples.zh: 我们在消化道模型内表面辨认出了「黏膜」。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic shaped by a combination of genetic and non-genetic influences.

examples.en: The model of a multifactorial trait includes both genetic contributions and differing environments in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「多因素性状」模型包括遗传影响和环境差异。

examples.en: We described a multifactorial trait after comparing the two kinds of influence on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习纸上的两类影响后，描述了「多因素性状」。

words.enDefinition: the creation of views in selected planes from existing three-dimensional imaging data

examples.en: The display uses multiplanar reconstruction to show three perpendicular views of the same dataset on one screen.
examples.zh: 显示界面使用「多平面重建」，在一个屏幕上展示同一数据集的三个正交视图。

examples.en: We recognized multiplanar reconstruction when the highlighted position appeared in two perpendicular views of the teaching model.
examples.zh: 高亮位置出现在教学模型的两个正交视图中时，我们认出了「多平面重建」。

words.enDefinition: More than two alternative forms of the same locus across a population.

examples.en: The fictional population has multiple alleles at the locus even though each person has two copies.
examples.zh: 虚构群体的该位点具有「复等位基因」，而每个个体只有两份副本。

examples.en: We counted the symbols representing multiple alleles across the full classroom table of genotypes.
examples.zh: 我们统计课堂整张基因型表里表示「复等位基因」的不同符号。

words.enDefinition: The thick, fleshy portion of a muscle containing most of its contractile fibres.

examples.en: The muscle belly is wider than the tendon in this side view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型侧视图上，「肌腹」比肌腱宽。

examples.en: We labelled the muscle belly between the two pale tendon regions on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中两个颜色较浅的肌腱区之间标出「肌腹」。

words.enDefinition: A bundle of muscle fibres grouped together by connective tissue within a skeletal muscle.

examples.en: The muscle fascicle is shown as a bundle of fibres in the enlarged teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 放大的教学图把「肌束」画成一束肌纤维。

examples.en: We traced the boundary of one muscle fascicle on the classroom cross section.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂横切图上沿着一处「肌束」的边界查看。

collocations: cross section of a muscle fascicle

words.enDefinition: A single elongated muscle cell, especially a cell of skeletal muscle in this context.

examples.en: The muscle fibre is drawn as one long cell inside the bundle on the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，「肌纤维」画成肌束内一个细长的细胞。

examples.en: We followed one muscle fibre before looking at the smaller structures inside it in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先沿一条「肌纤维」查看，再观察它内部较小的结构。

words.enDefinition: The attachment conventionally described as the more movable or distal end of a muscle.

examples.en: The muscle insertion is marked where the example tendon attaches to the forearm bone.
examples.zh: 「肌肉止点」标在示例肌腱与前臂骨相连的部位。

examples.en: We labelled the muscle insertion on the same page as the more fixed attachment.
examples.zh: 我们把「肌肉止点」与相对固定的附着点标在同一页上。

words.enDefinition: The attachment conventionally described as the more fixed or proximal end of a muscle.

examples.en: The muscle origin is marked near the shoulder on the diagram of the example arm.
examples.zh: 示例上肢图把「肌肉起点」标在肩部附近。

examples.en: We labelled the muscle origin before following the muscle toward its other attachment.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肌肉起点」，再沿肌肉查看到另一处附着点。

words.enDefinition: Tissue composed of cells specialized to contract and generate force

examples.en: We compared three forms of muscle tissue using enlarged illustrations from the textbook.
examples.zh: 我们用教材里的放大图比较了三种「肌组织」。

examples.en: The muscle tissue model shows fibers arranged to produce force along their length.
examples.zh: 「肌组织」模型显示纤维排列成可沿其长度方向产生力的方式。

words.enDefinition: Digestive wall layer whose organized muscle layers move and mix contents

examples.en: The model shows two major muscle orientations in the muscularis externa of the intestine.
examples.zh: 模型展示了肠道「外肌层」中肌纤维的两种主要排列方向。

examples.en: We shaded the muscularis externa outside the submucosa in the intestinal wall drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在肠壁图中给黏膜下层外侧的「外肌层」涂上阴影。

collocations: circular muscle in the muscularis externa

words.enDefinition: a multilayered covering formed by glial membranes that electrically insulates stretches of an axon

examples.en: The myelin sheath appears as several wrapped layers around part of the axon in the enlarged drawing.
examples.zh: 在放大图中，「髓鞘」是围在轴突一段外面的多层结构。

examples.en: We compared the timing of signal propagation in axons with and without a myelin sheath in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了有「髓鞘」和无髓鞘的轴突传递信号所用的时间。

collocations: axon covered by a myelin sheath

words.enDefinition: the inherent ability of heart muscle to generate force at a given initial length and loading condition

examples.en: The two simulations used the same filling volume and arterial pressure but different values of myocardial contractility.
examples.zh: 两个模拟采用相同充盈容积与动脉压力，但「心肌收缩性」赋值不同。

examples.en: We changed myocardial contractility in the model to observe its effect on stroke volume at fixed loading.
examples.zh: 我们改变模型中的「心肌收缩性」，观察负荷固定时它对每搏输出量的影响。

words.enDefinition: the muscular middle layer of the heart wall whose contraction pumps blood

examples.en: The myocardium was thicker around the left ventricle than around the right ventricle on the sectioned model.
examples.zh: 在剖开的模型上，左心室周围的「心肌层」比右心室周围厚。

examples.en: Our diagram shows blood vessels running into the myocardium to supply the contracting tissue with oxygen.
examples.zh: 图中血管进入「心肌层」，为收缩的组织供氧。

words.enDefinition: A contractile strand within a skeletal muscle fibre, made of sarcomeres arranged end to end.

examples.en: The myofibril runs lengthwise within the muscle fibre in the enlarged diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂放大图里，「肌原纤维」沿肌纤维的长度方向延伸。

examples.en: We marked a single myofibril before counting the repeating segments in the model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出一条「肌原纤维」，再数模型里的重复区段。

words.enDefinition: The reduced form of NAD that carries electrons between metabolic reactions.

examples.en: The chart shows NADH carrying electrons toward the inner mitochondrial membrane in the human cell model.
examples.zh: 图中显示，在人体细胞模型中，「还原型 NAD」把电子带向线粒体内膜。

examples.en: We marked NADH beside the reactions that transferred electrons onto the carrier in the pathway diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在代谢图上把「还原型 NAD」标在将电子转移给这种载体的反应旁。

words.enDefinition: The reduced form of NADP, used to supply electrons for cellular synthesis and other reactions.

examples.en: The map shows NADPH donating electrons during a reaction that builds a larger cellular molecule.
examples.zh: 代谢图显示，「还原型 NADP」在形成一个较大细胞分子的反应中提供电子。

examples.en: We marked NADPH next to the branch that supplies reducing power in the classroom metabolism diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂代谢图中提供还原能力的分支旁标出了「还原型 NADP」。

collocations: use of NADPH in cellular synthesis

words.enDefinition: the tissue directly under the nail plate that supports it along most of its length

examples.en: The nail bed appears as a narrow strip under the rigid plate on the classroom finger model.
examples.zh: 课堂手指模型上，「甲床」位于坚硬的甲板下，呈狭长条状。

examples.en: We traced the nail bed underneath the visible portion of the nail in the side-view reference diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在侧视参考图上，沿指甲可见部分下方追踪「甲床」。

words.enDefinition: the growth region beneath the proximal nail fold that produces most of the nail plate

examples.en: The nail matrix is drawn beneath the proximal skin fold in the enlarged finger model used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的放大手指模型中，「甲母质」画在近端的皮肤皱襞下方。

examples.en: We labeled the nail matrix where the diagram shows material forming at the back of the nail.
examples.zh: 我们在图中指甲后部有新物质形成的位置标出了「甲母质」。

collocations: nail plate produced by the nail matrix

words.enDefinition: the hard keratin structure forming the visible main part of a fingernail or toenail

examples.en: The nail plate is the rigid structure on top of the fingertip in the classroom sectioned model.
examples.zh: 课堂指尖切面模型上，「甲板」是指尖上方的硬质结构。

examples.en: We shaded the nail plate separately from the living skin immediately beneath it in the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 在教学图中，我们给「甲板」与紧靠它下方的活性皮肤组织分别着色。

collocations: free edge of the nail plate

words.enDefinition: A structured synthesis that explains patterns across studies mainly through text, with optional tables or other displays.

examples.en: The narrative synthesis summarises the contrasting patterns in the fictional studies in two short paragraphs.
examples.zh: 「叙述性综合」用两小段文字概括各虚构研究之间的差异。

examples.en: We read the narrative synthesis to compare which findings agree across the simulated studies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读「叙述性综合」，查看哪些发现在模拟研究之间一致。

words.enDefinition: the internal space behind the nose through which air normally passes on its way to the pharynx

examples.en: The sectioned head model shows the nasal cavity lying above the roof of the mouth.
examples.zh: 头部切面模型显示，「鼻腔」位于口腔顶部上方。

examples.en: We followed an arrow through the nasal cavity to the uppermost part of the throat.
examples.zh: 我们沿箭头穿过「鼻腔」，到达咽部最上段。

collocations: air passing through the nasal cavity

words.enDefinition: the highest part of the pharynx, behind the nasal cavity and above the soft palate

examples.en: The nasopharynx lies behind the nasal cavity and above the soft palate in the classroom section.
examples.zh: 在课堂切面图中，「鼻咽」位于鼻腔后方、软腭上方。

examples.en: We followed the airflow arrow into the nasopharynx at the back of the upper airway model.
examples.zh: 我们沿气流箭头进入上气道模型后方的「鼻咽」。

words.enDefinition: The usual three-dimensional arrangement associated with a protein's function under its normal conditions.

examples.en: The model shows the native protein conformation beside an unfolded version of the same chain.
examples.zh: 模型把「蛋白质天然构象」与同一条链的未折叠形式并列画出。

examples.en: We identified the native protein conformation by matching the drawing to the caption about the protein's function.
examples.zh: 我们将结构图与说明蛋白质功能的图注对应起来，辨认出「蛋白质天然构象」。

collocations: the shape of a native protein conformation
compare a native protein conformation with an unfolded form

words.enDefinition: A study describing how a health condition or characteristic evolves over time without the study assigning an intervention.

examples.en: The natural history study tracks changing comfort scores in a fictional follow-up table over several visits.
examples.zh: 「自然病程研究」在虚构随访表中追踪数次访视期间舒适度评分的变化。

examples.en: We read the natural history study to learn how the modelled condition changed during observation.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「自然病程研究」，了解模型中的状况在观察期间如何变化。

collocations: observations in a natural history study
follow-up in a natural history study

words.enDefinition: Innate lymphocyte capable of eliminating certain stressed or abnormal body cells

examples.en: The model places a natural killer cell next to a stressed body cell.
examples.zh: 模型将一个「自然杀伤细胞」画在处于应激状态的人体细胞旁。

examples.en: We highlighted the natural killer cell in the chart of innate cell types.
examples.zh: 我们在先天免疫细胞类型图中高亮标出了「自然杀伤细胞」。

collocations: role of a natural killer cell
diagram of a natural killer cell

words.enDefinition: Functional unit of the kidney containing a filtration structure and a tubule

examples.en: We drew a nephron with a round structure attached to several tubular segments.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个「肾单位」，其中一处圆形结构连着多段小管。

examples.en: The atlas uses different colors for successive parts of one nephron.
examples.zh: 图谱用不同颜色表示同一个「肾单位」中依次相连的各部分。

words.enDefinition: U-shaped tubule segment between the proximal and distal portions of the nephron

examples.en: The nephron loop dips into the darker region shown in our kidney model.
examples.zh: 在肾脏模型中，「肾单位袢」伸入颜色较深的区域。

examples.en: We traced the two limbs of the nephron loop down and back up.
examples.zh: 我们描绘了「肾单位袢」一支向下、另一支折返向上的路径。

words.enDefinition: Tissue composed of neurons and supporting cells that process or transmit signals

examples.en: The nervous tissue illustration shows signal-carrying cells with long branches and nearby supporting cells.
examples.zh: 「神经组织」示意图显示了带长突起的传递信号细胞及旁边的支持细胞。

examples.en: We labeled nervous tissue in the model of the brain and spinal cord.
examples.zh: 我们在脑和脊髓模型上标出了「神经组织」。

words.enDefinition: A case-control study whose cases and controls are drawn from an established cohort.

examples.en: The nested case-control study draws both comparison groups from the same fictional cohort in the figure.
examples.zh: 图中的「巢式病例对照研究」从同一虚构队列中抽取两个比较组。

examples.en: We checked the parent cohort before interpreting the records in the nested case-control study example.
examples.zh: 解读「巢式病例对照研究」示例中的记录前，我们先核对了原队列。

collocations: parent cohort of a nested case-control study
findings from a nested case-control study

words.enDefinition: a bundle of axons within the central nervous system that follows an identifiable pathway

examples.en: The illustrated neural tract extends through the spinal white matter between different levels of the model.
examples.zh: 图示的「中枢神经束」穿过脊髓白质，连接模型内不同高度的部位。

examples.en: We traced an ascending neural tract toward the brain on the classroom map of sensory pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂感觉通路图上沿一条上行「中枢神经束」追踪至脑。

words.enDefinition: the non-neuronal cells of nervous tissue that support, insulate and help maintain the environment of neurons

examples.en: The slide compares neurons with neuroglia that surround them and perform several different supporting functions in the model.
examples.zh: 课件对比了神经元和围绕它们、在模型中发挥多种支持作用的「神经胶质细胞」。

examples.en: We shaded the neuroglia separately from the signaling cells in the drawing of nervous tissue.
examples.zh: 我们在神经组织图上为「神经胶质细胞」和传递信号的细胞分别着色。

words.enDefinition: The chemical synapse where a motor neuron communicates with a skeletal muscle fibre.

examples.en: The neuromuscular junction is marked where the nerve ending meets the muscle fibre in the schematic.
examples.zh: 示意图在神经末梢与肌纤维相接处标出「神经肌肉接头」。

examples.en: We labelled the neuromuscular junction on a diagram of normal signalling from nerve to muscle.
examples.zh: 我们在神经向肌肉传递正常信号的示意图上标出「神经肌肉接头」。

words.enDefinition: a cell specialized to receive, process or transmit information using electrical signals and often chemical signals

examples.en: The illustrated neuron receives signals on its branches and carries electrical activity along a longer process.
examples.zh: 图中的「神经元」从短分支接收信号，再沿一条较长的突起传递电活动。

examples.en: We drew a neuron at a larger scale to show the arrangement of its main processes.
examples.zh: 我们把一个「神经元」放大绘制，以显示其主要突起的排列。

words.enDefinition: the part of a neuron containing its nucleus and much of its protein-producing machinery

examples.en: The neuronal cell body is the expanded region around the nucleus in the prepared teaching image.
examples.zh: 在制好的教学图像中，「神经元胞体」是细胞核周围较宽大的区域。

examples.en: We drew the axon emerging from one side of the neuronal cell body in the sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图上画出从「神经元胞体」一侧延出的轴突。

collocations: nucleus in the neuronal cell body

words.enDefinition: a shift of neuronal membrane voltage toward a less negative or more positive value

examples.en: The upward deflection in the figure shows neuronal depolarization as the cell interior becomes less negative.
examples.zh: 图中向上的偏转表示「神经元去极化」，此时细胞内电位变得没那么负。

examples.en: We observed neuronal depolarization before the spike in the simplified model of action potential initiation.
examples.zh: 在简化的动作电位起始模型中，我们观察到尖峰之前发生「神经元去极化」。

words.enDefinition: the return of neuronal membrane voltage toward its resting level following depolarization

examples.en: The falling phase of the simulated spike shows neuronal repolarization after the voltage reaches its peak.
examples.zh: 模拟尖峰的下降阶段显示，在电压达到峰值后发生「神经元复极化」。

examples.en: We labeled neuronal repolarization where the membrane voltage moved back toward its resting value in the trace.
examples.zh: 我们在曲线上膜电位向静息值恢复的那一段标出「神经元复极化」。

words.enDefinition: a substance released by a neuron to signal to a target cell by acting on its receptors

examples.en: The classroom model shows a neurotransmitter binding to receptors on the receiving side of a chemical synapse.
examples.zh: 课堂模型显示，「神经递质」与化学突触接收侧的受体结合。

examples.en: We traced the neurotransmitter from the release site to a matching receptor drawn across the gap.
examples.zh: 我们从释放部位沿「神经递质」追踪到画在间隙另一侧的对应受体。

words.enDefinition: Abundant granulocyte with a segmented nucleus that can engulf cellular debris

examples.en: The model shows a neutrophil with its nucleus divided into several lobes.
examples.zh: 模型展示一个细胞核分为多叶的「中性粒细胞」。

examples.en: We marked the neutrophil in the atlas after examining its segmented nucleus.
examples.zh: 我们观察它的分叶细胞核后，在图谱中标出了「中性粒细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Grid of three rows and three columns used to describe abdominal locations

examples.en: Our diagram of the nine abdominal regions has a square centered on the navel.
examples.zh: 我们的「腹部九区」图有一个以肚脐为中心的方格。

examples.en: We used the nine abdominal regions to label a position more specifically than a quadrant.
examples.zh: 相比四分法，我们用「腹部九区」更具体地标明一个位置。

collocations: chart of the nine abdominal regions

words.enDefinition: a sensory receptor that responds to stimuli capable of damaging tissue

examples.en: The diagram distinguishes a nociceptor detecting potential tissue damage from a receptor for light touch in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图把感知潜在组织损伤的「伤害感受器」与感知轻触的感受器区分开来。

examples.en: We traced the incoming signal from a nociceptor to the spinal cord in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型上，从「伤害感受器」沿传入信号追踪到脊髓。

words.enDefinition: a short gap between adjacent myelin segments where the exposed axon membrane regenerates the action potential

examples.en: We marked a node of Ranvier where two segments of the insulation left a small exposed gap.
examples.zh: 我们在两段绝缘层之间露出一小段轴突的位置标出「郎飞结」。

examples.en: The classroom diagram highlights each node of Ranvier when the simulated electrical signal reaches it in sequence.
examples.zh: 模拟电信号依次抵达各「郎飞结」时，课堂示意图逐一高亮相应位置。

collocations: electrical activity at a node of Ranvier
