words.enDefinition: In the pure noncompetitive model, reversible inhibition in which the inhibitor binds free enzyme and enzyme already bound to substrate with equal affinity.

examples.en: The diagram shows noncompetitive inhibition with the regulatory shape binding whether the substrate is present or absent.
examples.zh: 图中无论底物是否已结合，调节分子形状都可与酶结合，用以展示「非竞争性抑制」。

examples.en: Our class read the noncompetitive inhibition panel as an ideal model with equal binding in both states.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「非竞争性抑制」图解读为两种状态下结合能力相同的理想模型。

words.enDefinition: Failure of homologous chromosomes or sister chromatids to separate as expected during cell division.

examples.en: The nondisjunction diagram shows two labelled chromosome copies moving to the same side in the simplified model.
examples.zh: 简化模型的「不分离」图显示，两份带标记的染色体副本移到同一侧。

examples.en: We counted the copies in both resulting model cells after nondisjunction in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们数出练习中发生「不分离」后两个模型细胞各自的副本数。

words.enDefinition: An amino acid the body can normally synthesize in sufficient amounts.

examples.en: The chart uses alanine as a nonessential amino acid that ordinary human cells can make.
examples.zh: 图表以丙氨酸为「非必需氨基酸」示例，普通人体细胞能够生成它。

examples.en: Our tutor explained that a nonessential amino acid still has important roles in human proteins.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释，「非必需氨基酸」在人体蛋白质中仍发挥重要作用。

collocations: formation of a nonessential amino acid

words.enDefinition: Multilayered epithelium whose flattened surface cells retain nuclei and lack keratinization

examples.en: The atlas labels the lining of the esophagus as nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium.
examples.zh: 图谱将食管内衬标注为「非角化复层鳞状上皮」。

examples.en: Surface cells in the drawing of nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium still contain visible nuclei.
examples.zh: 「非角化复层鳞状上皮」的图中，表层细胞仍有可见的细胞核。

collocations: lining of nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium
surface of nonkeratinized stratified squamous epithelium

words.enDefinition: An amino acid side chain lacking strongly polar groups and interacting weakly with water.

examples.en: The example shows a nonpolar side chain tucked inside the folded protein away from surrounding water.
examples.zh: 示例把一条「非极性侧链」画在折叠蛋白质内部，远离周围的水。

examples.en: We traced the carbon groups in the nonpolar side chain shown on the amino acid chart.
examples.zh: 我们沿氨基酸图表找出了「非极性侧链」上的各个碳基团。

collocations: packing of a nonpolar side chain

words.enDefinition: Chromatids belonging to different homologous chromosomes rather than to the same replicated chromosome.

examples.en: The nonsister chromatids are coloured differently because they belong to different homologues in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「非姐妹染色单体」属于不同的同源染色体，因此用不同颜色表示。

examples.en: We pointed to nonsister chromatids on the paired chromosome model before reading the crossing diagram.
examples.zh: 查看交叉图前，我们先在配对染色体模型上指出「非姐妹染色单体」。

words.enDefinition: Interval within which a physiological variable commonly varies under the stated conditions

examples.en: The chart shows a shaded band representing the normal physiological range for its internal variable.
examples.zh: 图中用阴影带表示该内部变量的「正常生理范围」。

examples.en: We compared simulated fluctuations within the normal physiological range on two different graphs.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两张图中「正常生理范围」以内的模拟波动。

collocations: remain within the normal physiological range

words.enDefinition: The set of genetic material located in the nucleus of a cell.

examples.en: The nuclear genome is represented by the chromosomes drawn inside the nucleus in our cell diagram.
examples.zh: 在细胞示意图中，细胞核内所画的染色体代表「核基因组」。

examples.en: We distinguished the nuclear genome from the small set of genetic material inside mitochondria in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「核基因组」与线粒体内少量遗传物质区分开。

words.enDefinition: the size, shape and structural appearance of a cell nucleus

examples.en: We recorded nuclear morphology by noting whether the visible nuclei were round or elongated in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们通过记录可见细胞核呈圆形还是长形来描述「细胞核形态」。

examples.en: The supplied teaching images show contrasting nuclear morphology in two different normal cell types from the atlas.
examples.zh: 给出的教学图显示，图谱中两种不同正常细胞的「细胞核形态」各异。

words.enDefinition: A basic chromatin unit in which a segment of DNA is wrapped around histone proteins.

examples.en: The nucleosome appears as a small rounded unit in the enlarged chromatin model for class.
examples.zh: 课堂放大的染色质模型把「核小体」画成小圆形单位。

examples.en: We pointed to each nucleosome before identifying the thread joining the units in the illustration.
examples.zh: 我们先指出各个「核小体」，再辨认图中连接这些单位的细线。

words.enDefinition: An estimate of how many people would need the intervention for one additional beneficial outcome relative to a comparison group over a stated period.

examples.en: The number needed to treat is presented as an illustrative estimate in the fictional evidence table.
examples.zh: 「需治疗人数」作为示范性估计值列在虚构证据表中。

examples.en: We recorded the stated follow-up period alongside the number needed to treat in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示例中，将给定的随访期记录在「需治疗人数」旁。

collocations: calculate the number needed to treat
number needed to treat over a stated period
interpret the number needed to treat

words.enDefinition: a dimensionless quantity equal to the refractive index on the specimen side times the sine of the accepted light cone's half-angle

examples.en: The objective with the larger numerical aperture collects light over a wider angle in the model immersion medium.
examples.zh: 在同一种模拟浸液中，「数值孔径」较大的物镜能收集角度范围更宽的光。

examples.en: We read the numerical aperture beside the magnification on the diagram of an objective barrel in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在物镜镜筒示意图所标的放大倍率旁读出了「数值孔径」。

words.enDefinition: the lens assembly nearest the specimen that forms the microscope's primary magnified image

examples.en: The diagram shows the objective lens directly above the slide on the classroom microscope illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂显微镜图中，「物镜」位于玻片正上方。

examples.en: We read the power engraved on the objective lens before identifying the matching teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们先读出「物镜」上刻的倍率，再辨认相应的教学图像。

words.enDefinition: An individual who must carry a specified allele under the stated inheritance assumptions and family relationships.

examples.en: The worksheet labels one fictional person an obligate carrier under the stated rules for the model.
examples.zh: 在模型给定规则下，练习将一名虚构人物标为「必然携带者」。

examples.en: We checked which assumptions support the obligate carrier label in this simplified classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们核查哪些假设支持课堂简图中的「必然携带者」标记。

collocations: identify an obligate carrier in a pedigree

words.enDefinition: Plane passing diagonally relative to the standard horizontal or vertical planes

examples.en: The oblique plane crosses the model at an angle to the horizontal line.
examples.zh: 「斜切面」与水平线成一定角度，穿过模型。

examples.en: We labeled the tilted plane in the atlas as an oblique plane.
examples.zh: 我们将图谱中倾斜的平面标为「斜切面」。

words.enDefinition: A study in which researchers record exposures and outcomes without assigning the exposure or intervention.

examples.en: The observational study records participants' usual activities and their responses on the fictional well-being questionnaire.
examples.zh: 「观察性研究」记录参与者的日常活动和他们在虚构身心状态问卷上的回答。

examples.en: We labelled the example an observational study because the report describes activities that participants chose themselves.
examples.zh: 报告描述的是参与者自己选择的活动，因此我们把示例标为「观察性研究」。

words.enDefinition: the cerebral lobe at the back of the hemisphere that contains major visual processing areas

examples.en: The classroom drawing marks the occipital lobe at the posterior end of the cerebral hemisphere.
examples.zh: 课堂图在大脑半球的后端标出「枕叶」。

examples.en: We followed the modeled visual pathway toward an area of the occipital lobe in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中沿模拟的视觉通路追踪至「枕叶」内一个区域。

collocations: visual processing in the occipital lobe

words.enDefinition: the transparent flexible structure behind the iris that changes shape to help focus light on the retina

examples.en: Light rays bend again at the ocular lens after passing through the cornea in the diagram.
examples.zh: 在图中，光线穿过角膜后，在「眼晶状体」处再次折射。

examples.en: We marked the ocular lens on the cross section before tracing the light path to the retina.
examples.zh: 我们在切面图上先标出「眼晶状体」，再追踪至视网膜的光路。

words.enDefinition: The odds of an outcome in one group divided by the odds in the comparison group.

examples.en: The odds ratio is based on the ratio of events to nonevents within each fictional group.
examples.zh: 「比值比」以各虚构组内事件数与非事件数之比为计算依据。

examples.en: We checked whether the table reports an odds ratio before describing the group comparison in words.
examples.zh: 我们先确认表格是否报告「比值比」，再用文字描述组间比较。

collocations: confidence interval for an odds ratio

words.enDefinition: the structure above the nasal cavity that receives signals from olfactory receptor neurons

examples.en: The diagram shows small fibers entering the olfactory bulb from the sensory lining in the upper nose.
examples.zh: 图中显示，细小纤维由鼻腔上部的感觉衬里进入「嗅球」。

examples.en: We identified the olfactory bulb before following the tract toward other brain regions on the class model.
examples.zh: 我们先辨认出「嗅球」，再沿通路追踪至课堂模型上的其他脑区。

words.enDefinition: the specialized lining high in the nasal cavity that contains sensory neurons for smell

examples.en: The olfactory epithelium is marked near the roof of the nasal cavity in the classroom head section.
examples.zh: 在课堂头部切面图上，「嗅上皮」标在鼻腔顶部附近。

examples.en: We drew axons leaving the olfactory epithelium toward the structure just above it on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上画出从「嗅上皮」发出、通向其正上方结构的轴突。

words.enDefinition: a glial cell that forms myelin around axon segments in the central nervous system

examples.en: One oligodendrocyte extends several processes to different axon segments in the diagram of central nervous tissue.
examples.zh: 在中枢神经组织图中，一个「少突胶质细胞」伸出数条突起，连至不同的轴突节段。

examples.en: We identified the oligodendrocyte in the diagram showing myelin formed on several central axon segments.
examples.zh: 我们在显示多段中枢轴突形成髓鞘的图中辨认出「少突胶质细胞」。

words.enDefinition: A short carbohydrate chain made of a small number of linked sugar units.

examples.en: The small chain on the outside of the human cell membrane was labeled as an oligosaccharide.
examples.zh: 人体细胞膜外侧的一条短链被标为「寡糖」。

examples.en: We compared the oligosaccharide drawing with a longer branched carbohydrate in the model of cell surface molecules.
examples.zh: 在细胞表面分子示意图中，我们把「寡糖」图与较长的支链糖类进行了比较。

collocations: an oligosaccharide attached to a lipid

words.enDefinition: A trial in which participants and those delivering the interventions know the assignments.

examples.en: The open-label trial states that both fictional participants and programme staff knew the assigned diary format.
examples.zh: 「开放标签试验」明确说明，虚构参与者和项目人员都知道分配的日志版式。

examples.en: We checked whether outcomes were measured separately when reading the simulated open-label trial report in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们读模拟「开放标签试验」报告时，核对结局是否另由评估者独立测量。

words.enDefinition: the region where some optic nerve fibers cross to the opposite side of the brain

examples.en: The optic chiasm was the crossing point for only some fibers in the classroom visual pathway model.
examples.zh: 在课堂视觉通路模型中，只有一部分纤维在「视交叉」处交叉。

examples.en: We traced the fibers from the nasal half of each retina through the optic chiasm in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们追踪来自每侧视网膜鼻侧半部的纤维如何经过「视交叉」。

collocations: fibers passing through the optic chiasm

words.enDefinition: the area of the retina where optic nerve fibers exit and photoreceptors are absent

examples.en: The model marks the optic disc where the optic nerve leaves the back of the eye.
examples.zh: 模型在视神经离开眼球后部的位置标出「视盘」。

examples.en: We used the optic disc to explain the blind spot in the classroom visual field illustration.
examples.zh: 在课堂视野图上，我们用「视盘」解释盲点。

collocations: nerve fibers at the optic disc

words.enDefinition: the ability of an optical system to distinguish nearby features as separate details

examples.en: The simulated image lost optical resolution when the two fine features blended into a single mark.
examples.zh: 两个细小特征融合成一个斑点时，模拟图像的「光学分辨率」有所降低。

examples.en: We compared optical resolution using the finest pair of clearly separated lines on the supplied test image.
examples.zh: 我们用给出的测试图中间距最小且仍能清楚辨认的一对线比较「光学分辨率」。

words.enDefinition: Space inside the mouth containing the tongue and enclosed by surrounding tissues

examples.en: The side view shows the oral cavity beneath the roof of the mouth.
examples.zh: 侧视图显示「口腔」位于上腭下方。

examples.en: We identified the tongue as a structure within the oral cavity on our model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上辨认出舌是「口腔」内的一个结构。

words.enDefinition: Organizational level where multiple tissue types form a structure with specialized functions

examples.en: The organ level diagram shows several different tissues contributing to one distinct structure.
examples.zh: 「器官层次」示意图显示多种不同组织共同构成一个独立结构。

examples.en: We moved from the tissue examples to the organ level during the lecture.
examples.zh: 课堂从组织的例子过渡到了「器官层次」。

words.enDefinition: the sensory structure in the cochlea that contains the hair cells involved in hearing

examples.en: The enlarged section places the organ of Corti on the basilar membrane inside the model cochlea.
examples.zh: 放大的切面图将「柯蒂器」画在模型耳蜗内的基底膜上。

examples.en: We labeled the hearing receptor cells within the organ of Corti on the classroom ear diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂耳部图的「柯蒂器」内标出听觉感受细胞。

collocations: hair cells of the organ of Corti
structure of the organ of Corti

words.enDefinition: Group of organs working together to perform major bodily functions

examples.en: The diagram groups several connected organs into one organ system for the lesson.
examples.zh: 教学示意图把几个彼此相连的器官归入同一个「器官系统」。

examples.en: We traced the organ system across several regions on the whole body model.
examples.zh: 我们在全身模型上查看了该「器官系统」在多个体区的分布。

words.enDefinition: the part of the pharynx behind the mouth through which air and swallowed material can pass

examples.en: The oropharynx appears directly behind the oral cavity on the side-view anatomy illustration shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的侧面解剖图上，「口咽」紧接在口腔后面。

examples.en: We marked the section where both paths crossed the oropharynx on the swallowing and breathing diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在吞咽和呼吸示意图上标出两条路径都经过「口咽」的这一段。

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical structural unit of compact bone with concentric layers arranged around a central canal.

examples.en: The osteon appears as concentric rings around a canal in the classroom cross section.
examples.zh: 课堂横切图上，「骨单位」表现为围绕一条管道的同心环。

examples.en: We labelled the centre of an osteon in the enlarged image of compact bone.
examples.zh: 我们在密质骨放大图上标出一个「骨单位」的中心。

words.enDefinition: a portion of an image that appears blurred because features there lie outside the range of sharp focus

examples.en: The nuclei in the out-of-focus region were less sharply defined than the neighboring structures in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 教学图的「离焦区域」里，细胞核的轮廓不如相邻结构清晰。

examples.en: We excluded the out-of-focus region from a classroom comparison that required clearly visible details of cell boundaries.
examples.zh: 课堂比较需要清楚观察细胞边界细节，因此我们排除了「离焦区域」。

words.enDefinition: Keeping people who measure or rate outcomes unaware of participants' assigned study groups.

examples.en: The report describes outcome assessor blinding for the people who rated the fictional activity records.
examples.zh: 报告说明对虚构活动记录评分的人员是否实行了「结局评估者设盲」。

examples.en: We checked outcome assessor blinding before comparing the two columns of ratings in the classroom summary.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「结局评估者设盲」，再比较课堂摘要中的两列评分。

words.enDefinition: A synthesis that uses existing systematic reviews as its main units of inclusion.

examples.en: The overview of reviews compares conclusions from three fictional systematic reviews in the classroom summary.
examples.zh: 课堂摘要的「综述的综述」比较三篇虚构系统综述所得出的结论。

examples.en: We checked whether the same study appeared in several sources within the overview of reviews.
examples.zh: 我们核查「综述的综述」的多个来源中有没有重复出现同一项研究。

collocations: overlap in an overview of reviews
evidence from an overview of reviews

words.enDefinition: A four-carbon intermediate that accepts an acetyl group in the first step of the citric acid cycle.

examples.en: The diagram shows oxaloacetate regenerated at the end of one turn of the citric acid cycle.
examples.zh: 图中显示，「草酰乙酸」在柠檬酸循环每完成一轮时再生。

examples.en: We colored oxaloacetate before tracing its four carbons through the first drawn step of the cycle.
examples.zh: 我们先给「草酰乙酸」着色，再沿循环图第一步追踪它的四个碳原子。

collocations: oxaloacetate in the citric acid cycle

words.enDefinition: ATP synthesis powered by the proton electrochemical gradient maintained by mitochondrial electron transport.

examples.en: The classroom map connects oxidative phosphorylation with the electron carriers that release electrons at the inner membrane.
examples.zh: 课堂图把「氧化磷酸化」与在线粒体内膜释放电子的电子载体联系起来。

examples.en: We placed oxidative phosphorylation next to the model showing ATP formation driven by proton movement.
examples.zh: 我们在表示质子移动驱动 ATP 形成的模型旁标出「氧化磷酸化」。

words.enDefinition: The electron-accepting form of the coenzyme NAD, also written NAD plus.

examples.en: The textbook labels oxidized NAD where the carrier accepts electrons during glucose breakdown in the cytoplasm.
examples.zh: 教材在细胞质内葡萄糖分解中该载体接受电子的位置标出了「氧化型 NAD」。

examples.en: We found oxidized NAD on the diagram after the electron carrier released its electrons at another step.
examples.zh: 当电子载体在另一个步骤释放电子后，我们在图上找出了「氧化型 NAD」。

words.zhGloss: 氧合血红蛋白解离曲线
words.enDefinition: a graph showing the relationship between oxygen partial pressure and hemoglobin oxygen saturation under stated conditions
acceptedZhAnswers: 氧合血红蛋白解离曲线

examples.en: We read the saturation at the marked oxygen pressure on the oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation curve in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在「氧合血红蛋白解离曲线」上，读出标记氧分压对应的饱和度。

examples.en: The oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation curve had a steeper middle section than the plateau in the model plot.
examples.zh: 模型图上的「氧合血红蛋白解离曲线」在中段比平台段更陡。

collocations: shift of the oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation curve

words.enDefinition: Form of hemoglobin with oxygen bound at one or more heme sites

examples.en: The colored diagram represents oxyhemoglobin by placing oxygen beside the binding sites.
examples.zh: 彩色示意图通过在结合位点旁画出氧，表示「氧合血红蛋白」。

examples.en: The worksheet labels oxyhemoglobin in the model whose heme sites hold oxygen.
examples.zh: 习题将血红素位点结合着氧的模型标为「氧合血红蛋白」。

words.enDefinition: the electrocardiogram deflection representing atrial depolarization

examples.en: We marked the P wave before the larger ventricular deflections on the classroom's example recording.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示例记录中，在较大的心室相关偏转之前标出了「P 波」。

examples.en: The P wave on the trace appeared when the animation showed electrical activity crossing both atria.
examples.zh: 动画显示电活动扫过两个心房时，曲线上出现了「P 波」。

words.enDefinition: Front surface of the hand in the standard reference position

examples.en: The hand model shows the palmar surface with the fingers pointing downward.
examples.zh: 手部模型的手指朝下，显示的是「手掌面」。

examples.en: We colored the palmar surface on the same side as the palm creases.
examples.zh: 我们给与掌纹同一侧的「手掌面」涂上了颜色。

words.enDefinition: Cell in a pancreatic islet that produces and releases glucagon

examples.en: The pancreatic alpha cell has an arrow leading to glucagon in our diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，从「胰岛α细胞」画出的箭头指向胰高血糖素。

examples.en: We colored one pancreatic alpha cell to identify its location in the islet.
examples.zh: 我们给一个「胰岛α细胞」涂上颜色，标出它在胰岛内的位置。

collocations: secretion by a pancreatic alpha cell
diagram of a pancreatic alpha cell

words.enDefinition: Cell in a pancreatic islet that produces and releases insulin

examples.en: We labeled a pancreatic beta cell beside the arrow for insulin in the illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在插图中胰岛素的箭头旁标出了一个「胰岛β细胞」。

examples.en: The worksheet groups each pancreatic beta cell with other cells of the same islet.
examples.zh: 习题将各个「胰岛β细胞」与同一胰岛内的其他细胞画在一起。

collocations: secretion by a pancreatic beta cell
diagram of a pancreatic beta cell

words.enDefinition: Passage carrying digestive secretions from the pancreas toward the duodenum

examples.en: The pancreatic duct runs through the elongated gland in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，「胰管」贯穿这个细长的腺体。

examples.en: We traced the pancreatic duct to the intestinal wall on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上沿着「胰管」追踪到肠壁。

words.enDefinition: Cluster of hormone-secreting cells within the endocrine portion of the pancreas

examples.en: The pancreatic islet looks like a pale cluster in the textbook illustration.
examples.zh: 教材插图中的「胰岛」呈现为浅色细胞簇。

examples.en: We enlarged one pancreatic islet to show several different cell types inside it.
examples.zh: 我们放大一个「胰岛」，展示其中的多种细胞类型。

words.enDefinition: Digestive secretion containing enzymes and bicarbonate, released by the exocrine pancreas

examples.en: The flowchart shows pancreatic juice entering the duodenum after leaving the gland.
examples.zh: 流程图显示「胰液」离开胰腺后进入十二指肠。

examples.en: We labeled pancreatic juice as one of the secretions that arrive from outside the intestine.
examples.zh: 我们把「胰液」标为从肠道外进入肠腔的分泌物之一。

words.enDefinition: the superficial dermal layer of loose connective tissue that interlocks with the epidermis

examples.en: The papillary dermis is the loose connective tissue immediately below the epidermis in our prepared slide.
examples.zh: 在这张制好的切片中，「真皮乳头层」是紧邻表皮下方的疏松结缔组织。

examples.en: We identified the papillary dermis by its proximity to the epidermis in the labeled skin section.
examples.zh: 我们根据它紧邻表皮这一点，在有标注的皮肤切片中辨认出「真皮乳头层」。

collocations: connective tissue of the papillary dermis

words.enDefinition: a ventricular muscle projection that pulls on chordae tendineae during contraction to help prevent valve leaflet prolapse

examples.en: The drawing shows each papillary muscle projecting from the ventricular wall beneath the valve leaflets.
examples.zh: 图中，各「乳头肌」从瓣叶下方的心室壁突出。

examples.en: We watched the papillary muscle contract as the ventricular wall began squeezing in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中心室壁开始收缩时，我们观察到「乳头肌」收缩。

words.enDefinition: a thin tissue slice obtained from a specimen supported by paraffin wax during sectioning

examples.en: The classroom atlas identifies the skin specimen as a paraffin section in its explanatory caption.
examples.zh: 课堂图谱在说明图注中将这份皮肤标本标为「石蜡切片」。

examples.en: We read the label on the paraffin section before comparing it with the nearby reference drawing.
examples.zh: 我们先读「石蜡切片」标签，再与邻近的参考图作比较。

words.enDefinition: A trial in which comparison groups follow their assigned interventions during the same overall study period.

examples.en: In the parallel-group trial, each fictional group follows one assigned diary format throughout the observation period.
examples.zh: 在「平行组试验」中，各虚构组在整个观察期内沿用各自分配的日志格式。

examples.en: We read the parallel-group trial diagram to identify the groups observed over the same period.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「平行组试验」图，找出在同一时段接受观察的各组。

words.enDefinition: Plane parallel to the midsagittal plane but offset from the midline

examples.en: The parasagittal plane runs parallel to the center plane a little to its left.
examples.zh: 「旁矢状面」与正中平面平行，位于稍偏左的位置。

examples.en: We used a parasagittal plane to show structures away from the exact center.
examples.zh: 我们用「旁矢状面」显示偏离正中央的结构。

words.enDefinition: the autonomic division with pathways arising in the brainstem and sacral spinal cord, often supporting rest and digestion

examples.en: The model links the parasympathetic division to changes in digestive activity during the resting phase of the animation.
examples.zh: 动画进入休息阶段时，模型将消化活动的变化与「副交感神经分部」联系起来。

examples.en: We colored the brainstem origins of the parasympathetic division separately from its sacral pathways on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中用不同颜色区分「副交感神经分部」的脑干起源和骶部通路。

words.enDefinition: Small endocrine organ usually behind the thyroid that helps regulate blood calcium

examples.en: We found a parathyroid gland on the back view of the neck model.
examples.zh: 我们在颈部模型的后视图上找到了一个「甲状旁腺」。

examples.en: The diagram marks each parathyroid gland separately from the surrounding thyroid tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图将各个「甲状旁腺」与周围的甲状腺组织分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Parathyroid signal that raises blood calcium through effects on several organs

examples.en: The teaching diagram connects parathyroid hormone with the regulation of calcium in blood.
examples.zh: 教学图把「甲状旁腺激素」与血钙调节联系起来。

examples.en: We marked the source of parathyroid hormone on the back view of the thyroid.
examples.zh: 我们在甲状腺后视图上标出了「甲状旁腺激素」的来源。

words.enDefinition: the specialized tissue of an organ that carries out its characteristic functions

examples.en: The lesson labels the secretory units as parenchyma and the surrounding supporting tissue in a different color.
examples.zh: 课程图将分泌单位标为「实质组织」，把周围的支持组织标为另一颜色。

examples.en: We identified the parenchyma on the diagram by finding where the organ's characteristic cells were located.
examples.zh: 我们通过在图中找出器官特征性细胞的位置，辨认出「实质组织」。

words.enDefinition: Portion of a serous membrane that lines the surrounding cavity wall

examples.en: The parietal layer follows the cavity wall in the magnified textbook diagram.
examples.zh: 放大的教材图中，「壁层」沿着腔壁分布。

examples.en: We labeled the parietal layer at the boundary next to the body wall.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近体壁的边界标出了「壁层」。

collocations: parietal layer of a serous membrane
line the wall with the parietal layer

words.enDefinition: the cerebral lobe behind the central sulcus and above much of the temporal lobe, involved in somatic sensation and spatial processing

examples.en: The parietal lobe extends behind the central sulcus across the upper side of the model hemisphere.
examples.zh: 「顶叶」从中央沟后方延伸，覆盖模型大脑半球的上侧一带。

examples.en: We identified the touch-processing region of the parietal lobe on a classroom map of cortical areas.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂皮层区域图上找到了「顶叶」内处理触觉的区域。

words.enDefinition: the serous membrane lining the inside of the chest wall, diaphragm and sides of the mediastinum

examples.en: The parietal pleura follows the inside of the chest wall in the labeled drawing for class.
examples.zh: 课堂标注图显示，「壁层胸膜」沿胸壁内侧分布。

examples.en: We drew the parietal pleura against the inner chest boundary, opposite the layer covering the lung.
examples.zh: 我们将「壁层胸膜」画在胸腔内壁，位于肺表面那层膜的对侧。

collocations: parietal pleura lining the chest wall

words.enDefinition: An affirmative agreement to take part in research by someone who cannot provide full consent under the applicable framework.

examples.en: The fictional information sheet describes participant assent in plain language suitable for the classroom ethics example.
examples.zh: 虚构信息说明用平实语言描述「参与者赞同」，适合课堂伦理示例。

examples.en: We discussed participant assent and the separate permission described in the model study information sheet.
examples.zh: 我们讨论「参与者赞同」以及研究信息说明示例中另行提到的许可。

words.enDefinition: Keeping participants unaware of their assigned study intervention or group after allocation.

examples.en: The report states whether participant blinding was maintained throughout the fictional study's follow-up period.
examples.zh: 报告说明在虚构研究的整个随访期间是否维持了「参与者设盲」。

examples.en: We looked for participant blinding in the methods summary before discussing the self-reported outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们先在方法摘要中查找「参与者设盲」说明，再讨论自报结局。

words.enDefinition: Protection of identifiable participant information in how a study handles, shares, and reports records.

examples.en: The classroom report describes participant confidentiality without showing any individual identities in the synthetic results table.
examples.zh: 课堂报告说明「参与者信息保密」，合成结果表中没有展示任何个体身份。

examples.en: We read the participant confidentiality statement before discussing which fictional records could appear in the report.
examples.zh: 我们先读「参与者信息保密」声明，再讨论报告中可以展示哪些虚构记录。

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing how many people enter, progress through, and are included in a trial's analysis.

examples.en: The participant flow diagram shows the fictional group counts from initial recruitment to the analysis table.
examples.zh: 「参与者流程图」展示虚构各组从最初招募到纳入分析表的人数。

examples.en: We used the participant flow diagram to locate where the two classroom group totals changed.
examples.zh: 我们用「参与者流程图」找出课堂两组人数在哪个阶段发生变化。

collocations: counts in a participant flow diagram

words.enDefinition: The bone at the front of the knee, embedded in the quadriceps tendon.

examples.en: The patella is shown at the front of the knee in the side view.
examples.zh: 侧视图上，「髌骨」画在膝关节前面。

examples.en: We watched the patella move on the articulated model as the knee was gently bent.
examples.zh: 轻轻屈曲关节模型的膝部时，我们观察「髌骨」如何移动。

words.enDefinition: A health outcome that directly matters to patients, such as function, symptoms, or quality of life.

examples.en: The classroom review identifies everyday functioning as a patient-important outcome in its fictional example table.
examples.zh: 课堂综述在虚构示例表中把日常功能列为「患者重视的结局」。

examples.en: We discussed why asking about daily comfort could capture a patient-important outcome in this model.
examples.zh: 我们讨论为什么询问日常舒适度能在这个模型中反映「患者重视的结局」。

words.enDefinition: An assessment of health status that comes directly from a patient's report without another person's interpretation.

examples.en: The patient-reported outcome comes directly from the fictional participant's answers about comfort during everyday activity.
examples.zh: 「患者报告结局」直接来自虚构参与者对日常活动舒适度问题的回答。

examples.en: We distinguished the patient-reported outcome from the rating assigned by another person in the example.
examples.zh: 我们在示例中区分「患者报告结局」与他人给出的评分。

words.enDefinition: The large superficial chest muscle that helps draw the upper arm toward the body and rotate it inward.

examples.en: The pectoralis major forms the large superficial muscle on the front of the chest model.
examples.zh: 胸部模型前方一大块浅层肌肉是「胸大肌」。

examples.en: We traced pectoralis major toward the arm on the labelled chart in our anatomy lesson.
examples.zh: 解剖课上，我们在有标注的挂图上沿「胸大肌」向手臂方向查看。

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing relationships and the distribution of a genetic trait or variant across generations.

examples.en: The pedigree chart uses lines to link relatives in the fictional three-generation classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂三代虚构示例的「家系图」用线连接亲属。

examples.en: We read the pedigree chart from its first generation before looking at the trait symbols.
examples.zh: 我们从第一代开始读「家系图」，再看性状符号。

words.enDefinition: An individual in a pedigree whose parents are not represented in that pedigree.

examples.en: The pedigree founder appears without parental symbols above in the simplified classroom family chart.
examples.zh: 在简化课堂家系图上，「家系始祖」上方没有亲代符号。

examples.en: We identified each pedigree founder as defined by the boundaries of the fictional chart.
examples.zh: 我们根据虚构图的范围，辨别各「家系始祖」。

words.enDefinition: The key explaining the shapes, marks, and colours used in a particular pedigree chart.

examples.en: The pedigree legend explains what the shaded and unshaded symbols mean in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 「家系图图例」解释虚构示例中涂色与未涂色符号的含义。

examples.en: We checked the pedigree legend before reading the labels beside the second generation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对「家系图图例」，再看第二代旁的标签。

words.enDefinition: A mark used in a pedigree to represent an individual or information about that individual.

examples.en: The pedigree symbol is shaded for the fictional person with the feature defined in the legend.
examples.zh: 对于具备图例所定义特征的虚构人物，图中将其「家系图符号」涂色。

examples.en: We checked each pedigree symbol against the key before reading the family relationships in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先对照图例核对各个「家系图符号」，再读亲属关系。

words.enDefinition: Lower trunk compartment enclosed by the bones and muscles of the pelvis

examples.en: The pelvic cavity is the lowest major space shown in the trunk model.
examples.zh: 「盆腔」是躯干模型上最低的主要腔隙。

examples.en: We marked the bony outline around the pelvic cavity in the side view.
examples.zh: 我们在侧视图中标出了围绕「盆腔」的骨性轮廓。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of individuals with a specified genotype who show its associated phenotype under stated conditions.

examples.en: The penetrance depends on how many fictional individuals with the label display the stated feature.
examples.zh: 「外显率」取决于带该标签的虚构人物中有多少表现给定特征。

examples.en: We calculated penetrance using the genotype group defined in the synthetic table for class.
examples.zh: 我们根据课堂合成表规定的基因型群组计算「外显率」。

words.enDefinition: A glucose-linked pathway producing NADPH and sugar phosphates, including five-carbon intermediates.

examples.en: The pentose phosphate pathway appears as a branch from glucose metabolism on our classroom human cell diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂人体细胞图把「磷酸戊糖途径」画成葡萄糖代谢的一条分支。

examples.en: We located NADPH among the products shown beside the pentose phosphate pathway in the textbook chart.
examples.zh: 我们在教材图上「磷酸戊糖途径」旁所列的产物中找到了 NADPH。

collocations: the oxidative part of the pentose phosphate pathway
NADPH from the pentose phosphate pathway
a diagram of the pentose phosphate pathway

words.enDefinition: The amide linkage between the carboxyl carbon of one amino acid residue and the nitrogen of another.

examples.en: We marked the peptide bond between the first two residues in the short chain diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在短链图中标出了前两个残基之间的「肽键」。

examples.en: The tutor showed where the peptide bond sat along the shared backbone of the pictured segments.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出，「肽键」在图示各片段共同的骨架上处于哪里。

collocations: a peptide bond in the backbone

words.enDefinition: An analysis targeting the effect under adherence to the study protocol, under stated definitions and assumptions.

examples.en: The per-protocol analysis applies the adherence criteria explained in the fictional report used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构报告说明了依从条件，「符合方案分析」应用这些条件。

examples.en: We checked the assumptions of the per-protocol analysis before comparing it with the main estimate.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「符合方案分析」的假设，再把其结果与主要估计比较。

words.enDefinition: Potential space between the two layers of serous pericardium around the heart

examples.en: The pericardial cavity lies between two layers in the simplified heart drawing.
examples.zh: 在简化的心脏图中，「心包腔」位于两层膜之间。

examples.en: We marked the pericardial cavity beside the lining directly over the model's heart.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中紧贴心脏的膜旁标出了「心包腔」。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of a defined population that had a condition at any time during a specified interval.

examples.en: The period prevalence counts participants who had the fictional characteristic at any time during the interval.
examples.zh: 「期间患病率」计入在所定时段任何时候具有该虚构特征的参与者。

examples.en: We checked how the population was defined before comparing period prevalence between the two classroom tables.
examples.zh: 我们先核对总体的定义，再比较两张课堂表中的「期间患病率」。

collocations: period prevalence over a defined interval

words.enDefinition: a histological stain that can highlight certain carbohydrate-rich tissue structures in magenta

examples.en: The periodic acid-Schiff stain highlighted the basement membrane in magenta on the prepared reference image.
examples.zh: 在已制好的参考图像上，「过碘酸–希夫染色」使基底膜呈品红色。

examples.en: We noted the colored border on the periodic acid-Schiff stain example during the slide reading exercise.
examples.zh: 在切片读图练习中，我们留意到「过碘酸–希夫染色」示例上的着色边界。

words.enDefinition: The connective tissue covering the outer surface of bone except at surfaces covered by articular cartilage.

examples.en: The periosteum is drawn as a thin covering along the shaft in the cutaway model.
examples.zh: 剖面模型上，「骨膜」画成沿着骨干的一层薄覆盖物。

examples.en: We placed the periosteum label outside the dense bony layer on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「骨膜」标签放在课堂示意图的致密骨层外面。

words.enDefinition: a bundle of axons and supporting tissue occurring outside the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The cross section of a peripheral nerve showed several groups of axons surrounded by connective tissue.
examples.zh: 「周围神经」横切面显示，结缔组织围绕着若干组轴突。

examples.en: We followed a peripheral nerve from the spinal region toward the hand in the labeled illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在标注图上沿一条「周围神经」从脊柱附近追踪到手部。

words.enDefinition: the nerves, ganglia and related neural structures outside the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The branch reaching the hand belongs to the peripheral nervous system in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，伸向手部的分支属于「周围神经系统」。

examples.en: We used the model of the peripheral nervous system to trace signals between the spine and arm.
examples.zh: 我们用「周围神经系统」模型追踪脊柱与手臂之间的信号。

collocations: signals carried by the peripheral nervous system

words.enDefinition: Coordinated traveling waves of muscular contraction moving material along a tubular organ

examples.en: The animation illustrates peristalsis by moving a contraction wave along the esophagus.
examples.zh: 动画通过食管中向前传播的收缩波来说明「蠕动」。

examples.en: We used arrows to show the direction of peristalsis in the tube model.
examples.zh: 我们用箭头标出管道模型中「蠕动」波前进的方向。

words.enDefinition: Potential space between layers of peritoneum within the abdominopelvic region

examples.en: The peritoneal cavity is shown as a thin space between two colored layers.
examples.zh: 「腹膜腔」被画成两层带颜色的膜之间的一道窄隙。

examples.en: The tutor marked the peritoneal cavity separately from the larger abdominal compartment.
examples.zh: 老师分别标出了「腹膜腔」和包含它的较大腹腔。

words.enDefinition: Small vessels surrounding kidney tubules and exchanging water and solutes with them

examples.en: The peritubular capillaries form a fine network around the coiled tubules in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中的「管周毛细血管」围绕弯曲的小管形成细密的血管网。

examples.en: Our animation shows fluid entering the peritubular capillaries from the surrounding tissue.
examples.zh: 我们的动画显示液体从周围组织进入「管周毛细血管」。

words.enDefinition: a specimen enclosed and sealed for long-term storage and repeated microscopic examination

examples.en: The atlas identifies the reference section as a permanent mount intended for repeated classroom observations.
examples.zh: 图谱将该参考切片标为供课堂反复观察的「永久封片」。

examples.en: We compared the listed age of the permanent mount with the date on its storage label.
examples.zh: 我们将「永久封片」列出的存放年限与保管标签上的日期作比较。

collocations: permanent mount of a tissue section

words.enDefinition: The sum of time that individuals contribute while being observed and eligible to experience an event.

examples.en: Person-time combines the differing observation lengths of all eligible fictional participants in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 「人时」将课堂表中所有符合条件的虚构参与者各自不同的观察时长加总。

examples.en: We checked how person-time was counted after several people stopped contributing observations in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中有几人不再贡献观测数据后，我们核对「人时」的计算方式。

words.enDefinition: A unit equivalent to one person contributing one year of observation time.

examples.en: The table uses a person-year as the unit for combined observation time in the fictional study.
examples.zh: 虚构研究的表格用「人年」作为合计观察时长的单位。

examples.en: We converted shorter observation periods to a fraction of a person-year in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习将短于一年的观测时段换算为「人年」的相应分数。

words.enDefinition: Cell capable of surrounding and taking solid material into its interior

examples.en: The drawing shows a phagocyte around a small fragment of damaged tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图展示一个「吞噬细胞」围住一小块受损组织碎片。

examples.en: We labeled the phagocyte in the sequence showing debris being taken inside.
examples.zh: 我们在碎片被摄入的连续示意图中标出了「吞噬细胞」。

words.enDefinition: Process by which a cell encloses solid material and takes it inside

examples.en: The teaching animation illustrates phagocytosis using a piece of old cellular material.
examples.zh: 教学动画用一块老化的细胞碎片说明「吞噬作用」。

examples.en: We drew arrows to indicate phagocytosis in the diagram of debris removal.
examples.zh: 我们用箭头在清理碎片的示意图中表示「吞噬作用」。

words.enDefinition: One of the bones in a finger or toe.

examples.en: The phalanx at the tip of the finger is marked with an arrow in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，箭头指着手指尖端的「指骨」。

examples.en: We located one phalanx in the big toe and checked where it meets the next bone.
examples.zh: 我们找出大脚趾中的一块「趾骨」，再看它与相邻骨在哪里相接。

words.enDefinition: the muscular passage behind the nasal and oral cavities that connects them with lower throat structures

examples.en: The side view shows the pharynx behind both the nasal cavity and the mouth in the head model.
examples.zh: 侧视图显示，在头部模型中，「咽」位于鼻腔和口腔的后方。

examples.en: We labeled the three regions of the pharynx before tracing the paths of air and swallowed food.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「咽」的三个区域，再追踪空气与吞咽食物各自的路径。

words.enDefinition: microscopy that converts optical phase shifts introduced by transparent structures into visible variations in brightness

examples.en: The teaching image uses phase-contrast microscopy to make the outline of transparent structures easier to distinguish.
examples.zh: 教学图用「相差显微术」使透明结构的轮廓更容易辨认。

examples.en: We compared a brightfield view of the same unstained model with its phase-contrast microscopy image in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将同一未染色模型的明场图与其「相差显微术」图像作比较。

words.enDefinition: An observable characteristic resulting from genetic effects, environmental effects, or their interaction.

examples.en: The phenotype is the observable feature recorded for each fictional person on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习中，「表型」是为各虚构人物记录的可观察特征。

examples.en: We kept the phenotype in a different column from the allele symbols in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「表型」和等位基因符号放在不同的列中。

words.enDefinition: The relative proportions of different observable trait categories in a stated group.

examples.en: The phenotypic ratio groups the fictional entries by visible feature in the classroom inheritance table.
examples.zh: 「表型比例」在课堂遗传表中按可见特征归类各虚构项目。

examples.en: We compared the phenotypic ratio with the distribution of genotype labels in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「表型比例」与练习里基因型标签的分布作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A lipid containing a phosphate-bearing polar group and a hydrophobic region.

examples.en: The diagram shows each phospholipid with a polar head facing water and tails pointing toward the center.
examples.zh: 图中每个「磷脂」的极性头朝向水相，脂肪链尾朝向中央。

examples.en: We traced the phosphate group on the phospholipid in the close-up drawing of a human cell membrane.
examples.zh: 我们在人体细胞膜放大图上找出「磷脂」中的磷酸基团。

collocations: the head group of a phospholipid

words.enDefinition: Two opposing layers of phospholipids whose tails face inward and heads face the surrounding water.

examples.en: The classroom model shows the phospholipid bilayer separating the surrounding fluid from the inside of a cell.
examples.zh: 课堂模型展示了「磷脂双层」如何将周围液体与细胞内部隔开。

examples.en: We placed the tail arrows in the middle of the phospholipid bilayer in our sketch of the membrane.
examples.zh: 我们在膜的草图中把尾部箭头画在「磷脂双层」的中央。

collocations: the inner side of a phospholipid bilayer

words.enDefinition: a sensory cell that converts light into an electrical response, such as a rod or cone in the retina

examples.en: The enlarged retinal model shows one photoreceptor where incoming light changes the cell's electrical response.
examples.zh: 放大的视网膜模型中，入射光使所示「感光细胞」的电响应发生改变。

examples.en: We used a photoreceptor diagram to compare the two main types of light-sensitive cells in the retina.
examples.zh: 我们用「感光细胞」图比较视网膜内两种主要的光敏细胞。

words.enDefinition: the total ventilated volume that does not effectively exchange gases, including conducting airway volume and alveolar dead space

examples.en: The model's physiological dead space included both the conducting airways and alveoli with ineffective gas exchange.
examples.zh: 模型中的「生理无效腔」既包括传导气道，也包括不能有效交换气体的肺泡。

examples.en: We compared physiological dead space with anatomical dead space in a classroom diagram showing uneven blood flow.
examples.zh: 我们用显示血流分布不均的课堂图，对比「生理无效腔」与解剖无效腔。

collocations: compare physiological dead space with anatomical dead space

words.enDefinition: Structure that carries out a response to a signal from a control system

examples.en: The diagram shows the physiological effector carrying out the response indicated by an arrow.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「生理效应器」执行由箭头标明的响应。

examples.en: We labeled a muscle on the model as the physiological effector in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，我们把模型上的一块肌肉标为「生理效应器」。

words.enDefinition: Structure that detects changes in a bodily condition and conveys that information

examples.en: The diagram shows a physiological sensor detecting a change in the monitored variable.
examples.zh: 示意图显示一个「生理感受器」正在感知被监测变量的变化。

examples.en: We labeled the physiological sensor at the beginning of the classroom feedback loop.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂反馈回路的起始处标出了「生理感受器」。

words.enDefinition: the thin innermost meningeal layer closely following the surface of the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The pia mater follows the small grooves on the brain surface in the enlarged classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在放大的课堂图中，「软膜」随脑表面的小沟起伏。

examples.en: We identified the pia mater as the inner layer directly touching the surface in the spinal model.
examples.zh: 在脊髓模型中，我们把与表面直接接触的内层标为「软膜」。

collocations: pia mater on the spinal cord

words.enDefinition: A framework specifying the population, intervention, comparator, and outcomes of a clinical evidence question.

examples.en: The PICO framework separates the fictional study question into four parts on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂练习用「PICO 框架」把虚构研究问题拆成四个部分。

examples.en: We used the PICO framework to compare two questions about a simulated follow-up programme.
examples.zh: 我们用「PICO 框架」比较关于模拟随访项目的两个问题。

collocations: question structured with the PICO framework

words.enDefinition: A small preliminary trial that rehearses aspects of a planned larger trial and examines feasibility.

examples.en: The pilot trial summary focuses on whether the fictional participants could complete the planned follow-up visits.
examples.zh: 「先导试验」摘要着重考察虚构参与者是否能按计划完成随访。

examples.en: We checked which feasibility questions the pilot trial answered before reading its exploratory outcome table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「先导试验」回答了哪些可行性问题，再看其探索性结局表。

collocations: feasibility results from a pilot trial

words.enDefinition: Small endocrine organ at the base of the brain with distinct lobes

examples.en: The pituitary gland is shown beneath the brain in the sagittal diagram.
examples.zh: 矢状面图把「垂体」画在脑的下方。

examples.en: We identified the pituitary gland before labeling its two major subdivisions.
examples.zh: 我们先辨认了「垂体」，再标出它的两个主要部分。

words.enDefinition: Narrow connection between the hypothalamus and pituitary at the brain base

examples.en: The pituitary stalk links the small gland to the brain region above it.
examples.zh: 「垂体柄」把这个小腺体与其上方的脑区连接起来。

examples.en: We marked the pituitary stalk before labeling the two lobes on the model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「垂体柄」，再标注模型中的两个叶。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint allowing one bone to rotate around a single axis relative to another.

examples.en: The pivot joint allows the turn shown by the curved arrow on the forearm model.
examples.zh: 「车轴关节」允许前臂模型上的曲箭头所示转动。

examples.en: We located the pivot joint near the upper ends of the two forearm bones.
examples.zh: 我们在两块前臂骨上端附近找出了「车轴关节」。

words.enDefinition: A comparison condition designed to resemble the intervention experience without its specific active component.

examples.en: The placebo control is described separately in the teaching table on how comparison groups are reported.
examples.zh: 有关比较组报告方式的教学表单独描述了「安慰剂对照」。

examples.en: We identified the placebo control from the terminology in the fictional trial summary for class.
examples.zh: 我们根据课堂虚构试验摘要中的术语辨认出「安慰剂对照」。

words.enDefinition: a projection image produced by transmission of X-rays through the body, generally without added contrast material

examples.en: The plain radiograph shows several overlapping bones projected onto one flat image in the classroom atlas.
examples.zh: 课堂图谱中的「普通X线片」显示，多块相互重叠的骨被投射到同一平面图像上。

examples.en: We compared the plain radiograph with a cross-sectional image that separates structures at different depths.
examples.zh: 我们把「普通X线片」与一幅能分开显示不同深度结构的横断图作比较。

collocations: structure visible on a plain radiograph

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint with relatively flat surfaces that mainly permit small gliding movements.

examples.en: The plane joint allows small sliding movements between the two flat surfaces in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中的「平面关节」允许两个平坦表面之间发生小幅滑动。

examples.en: We identified a plane joint between the labelled wrist bones shown on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图的标记腕骨之间找出一处「平面关节」。

words.enDefinition: Movement at the ankle that points the foot downward away from the front of the lower leg.

examples.en: The foot model shows plantar flexion as the toes point downward in the side view.
examples.zh: 足部模型在侧视图中脚趾向下指时，展示的是「跖屈」。

examples.en: We marked plantar flexion with the opposite arrow to dorsiflexion in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图示中用与背屈相反的箭头标出「跖屈」。

words.enDefinition: Lower surface of the foot that faces the ground when standing

examples.en: The plantar surface appears on the underside of the foot model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂足部模型的底面显示了「足底面」。

examples.en: We marked the plantar surface beneath the toes and heel in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中标出了脚趾和足跟下方的「足底面」。

words.enDefinition: Differentiated B-lineage cell specialized for producing and secreting large amounts of antibody

examples.en: The textbook shows a plasma cell with antibody symbols around its outline.
examples.zh: 教材展示一个「浆细胞」，其轮廓周围有表示抗体的符号。

examples.en: We placed the plasma cell at the end of the antibody-producing branch.
examples.zh: 我们把「浆细胞」放在产生抗体的分支末端。

collocations: antibody secretion by a plasma cell

words.enDefinition: Group of plasma proteins with diverse roles, including transport and immune defense

examples.en: The table divides plasma globulins into groups with different roles in the body.
examples.zh: 表格将「血浆球蛋白」按人体内的作用分成几组。

examples.en: We listed an antibody as one example among the plasma globulins in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上列举了一种抗体，作为「血浆球蛋白」的一个例子。

words.enDefinition: Protein present in plasma with roles such as transport, defense, or clotting

examples.en: The worksheet assigns a distinct role to each plasma protein shown in the table.
examples.zh: 习题为表中每种「血浆蛋白」列出相应的作用。

examples.en: We matched the name of a plasma protein to its role in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把一种「血浆蛋白」的名称与它在示意图中的作用配对。

words.enDefinition: Enzyme that breaks down fibrin in the body's normal clot removal process

examples.en: The flowchart connects plasmin with the breakdown of the pictured fibrin mesh.
examples.zh: 流程图将「纤溶酶」与图中的纤维蛋白网分解联系起来。

examples.en: We marked plasmin on the active side of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中将活性形式的一侧标为「纤溶酶」。

words.enDefinition: Inactive precursor that can be converted into the enzyme plasmin

examples.en: The textbook places plasminogen before the active form on the diagram.
examples.zh: 教材把「纤溶酶原」画在活性形式之前。

examples.en: We identified the label for plasminogen beside the arrow leading to plasmin.
examples.zh: 我们在通向纤溶酶的箭头旁找到了「纤溶酶原」的标签。

words.enDefinition: Small cell fragment in blood that participates in forming a plug

examples.en: The platelet is drawn smaller than the red cell beside it.
examples.zh: 图中，「血小板」比旁边的红细胞小。

examples.en: We labeled each platelet in the textbook's diagram of formed elements.
examples.zh: 我们在教材的血液有形成分示意图上标出了各个「血小板」。

words.enDefinition: Change in platelet shape and behavior associated with a local hemostatic response

examples.en: The textbook represents platelet activation with protrusions on the platelet's surface.
examples.zh: 教材通过在血小板表面画出突起表示「血小板活化」。

examples.en: We drew platelet activation between initial attachment and the growing cluster.
examples.zh: 我们将「血小板活化」画在初始附着与团簇逐渐增大之间。

collocations: signs of platelet activation in a model

words.enDefinition: Attachment of platelets to a damaged vessel surface or exposed supporting material

examples.en: The drawing shows platelet adhesion where the platelet first contacts the exposed surface.
examples.zh: 示意图在血小板最初接触外露表面的位置显示了「血小板黏附」。

examples.en: We marked platelet adhesion at the wall before drawing links between platelets.
examples.zh: 我们先标出血管壁处的「血小板黏附」，再画血小板之间的联接。

words.enDefinition: Joining of activated platelets to one another during plug formation

examples.en: The platelet aggregation diagram shows several platelets joining into a larger group.
examples.zh: 「血小板聚集」示意图显示几个血小板连成一个较大的团簇。

examples.en: We traced platelet aggregation from a few attached platelets to the larger cluster.
examples.zh: 我们从几个已附着的血小板沿图追踪到较大团簇，观察「血小板聚集」。

words.enDefinition: Small compartment inside a platelet storing substances released during its response

examples.en: The enlarged model shows each platelet granule inside the outline of a platelet.
examples.zh: 放大模型在血小板轮廓内画出了各个「血小板颗粒」。

examples.en: We labeled a platelet granule on the diagram of the platelet interior.
examples.zh: 我们在血小板内部示意图中标出了一个「血小板颗粒」。

words.enDefinition: Temporary seal formed when platelets collect at a damaged vessel site

examples.en: The platelet plug appears as a small cluster at the vessel wall.
examples.zh: 「血小板栓」在血管壁处呈现为一个小团簇。

examples.en: We highlighted the platelet plug before discussing the fibers shown around it.
examples.zh: 我们先高亮标出「血小板栓」，再讨论图中它周围的纤维。

words.enDefinition: The influence of one gene on more than one phenotypic characteristic.

examples.en: The pleiotropy diagram connects one fictional locus to both measured features on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂练习的「一因多效」图把一个虚构位点同时连接到两项实测特征。

examples.en: We distinguished pleiotropy from several genes contributing to one feature in the example table.
examples.zh: 我们在示例表里将「一因多效」与多个基因影响一个特征区分开。

words.enDefinition: Potential space between the two serous membrane layers surrounding each lung

examples.en: The textbook exaggerates the pleural cavity to show the two layers clearly.
examples.zh: 教材把「胸膜腔」画得较宽，以便清楚显示两层膜。

examples.en: Our diagram shows one pleural cavity on each side of the central chest region.
examples.zh: 图中胸部中央区域两侧各画出一个「胸膜腔」。

words.enDefinition: the small amount of liquid between the pleural layers that allows them to slide with low friction

examples.en: The model shows pleural fluid as a thin film between the moving lung and chest wall layers.
examples.zh: 模型中的「胸膜液」表现为移动的肺表面膜与胸壁内衬膜之间的一层薄膜状液体。

examples.en: We used pleural fluid to explain how the two surfaces slide smoothly in the classroom breathing model.
examples.zh: 我们用「胸膜液」解释课堂呼吸模型中的两个表面如何平滑滑动。

words.enDefinition: The number of complete sets of chromosomes in a cell.

examples.en: The ploidy stays the same after the chromosomes are copied in this classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，染色体复制后，「倍性」保持不变。

examples.en: We checked ploidy by counting sets instead of counting the chromatids drawn in the model.
examples.zh: 我们通过数染色体组来核对「倍性」，而不是数模型上的染色单体。

words.enDefinition: Specialized epithelial cell with processes covering glomerular capillaries as part of filtration

examples.en: The enlarged figure shows a podocyte wrapping its processes around a capillary.
examples.zh: 放大图显示一个「足细胞」的突起包绕毛细血管。

examples.en: We marked the extensions of one podocyte on the filtration diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在滤过示意图上标出了一个「足细胞」的突起。

words.enDefinition: The proportion of a population with a defined condition or characteristic at a specified instant.

examples.en: The point prevalence counts people with the fictional characteristic on one named date in the table.
examples.zh: 表格中，「时点患病率」计算指定日期具有该虚构特征的人所占比例。

examples.en: We selected the same date for both groups before comparing point prevalence in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们先为两组选定同一日期，再比较「时点患病率」。

collocations: point prevalence on a specified date

words.enDefinition: A polar part of a membrane lipid that interacts with the surrounding water.

examples.en: The polar head group faced the watery cytoplasm in the diagram of the inner membrane layer.
examples.zh: 膜内层的图中，「极性头基」朝向富含水分的细胞质。

examples.en: We compared the polar head group structures shown on two phospholipids in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂插图中两种磷脂所带的「极性头基」结构。

collocations: the size of a polar head group

words.enDefinition: An amino acid side chain containing groups that can interact strongly with water.

examples.en: The polar side chain on the protein diagram faced the water surrounding the folded molecule.
examples.zh: 蛋白质图中的「极性侧链」朝向折叠分子周围的水相。

examples.en: We marked a polar side chain beside the diagram's example of a hydrogen bond with water.
examples.zh: 我们在图中与水形成氢键的示例旁标出一条「极性侧链」。

collocations: a polar side chain on a protein surface

words.enDefinition: microscopy using polarized illumination to reveal how materials alter the polarization of light

examples.en: The comparison uses polarized light microscopy to reveal bright bands in the classroom fiber image.
examples.zh: 对照示例用「偏振光显微术」显示课堂用纤维图像中的明亮条带。

examples.en: We read the caption to identify why the polarized light microscopy image differed from the brightfield view.
examples.zh: 我们阅读图注，了解「偏振光显微术」图像与明场图像为何不同。

words.enDefinition: A trait influenced by genetic variation at more than one locus.

examples.en: The worksheet represents a polygenic trait with several labelled loci contributing to the modelled measurement.
examples.zh: 练习用多个标记位点共同影响模型测量值表示「多基因性状」。

examples.en: We compared a polygenic trait with the single-locus example on the preceding page.
examples.zh: 我们将「多基因性状」与前一页的单位点示例作比较。

words.enDefinition: A chain of amino acid residues linked by peptide bonds.

examples.en: The illustration shows a polypeptide as a continuous chain with side groups drawn along its backbone.
examples.zh: 插图把「多肽」画成一条连续的链，侧基沿骨架分布。

examples.en: We followed the polypeptide through the drawing to see where it folded back toward its center.
examples.zh: 我们沿图中的「多肽」观察，看它在哪里折回自身中央。

words.enDefinition: A carbohydrate polymer made of many linked monosaccharide units.

examples.en: The body stores glucose in glycogen, a branched polysaccharide illustrated in the chapter on human metabolism.
examples.zh: 人体以糖原储存葡萄糖，这种支链「多糖」画在人体代谢一章中。

examples.en: We traced several branches of the polysaccharide before identifying the repeating sugar units in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先沿「多糖」看了几条分支，再找出图中反复出现的糖单元。

words.enDefinition: A fatty acid with two or more carbon-carbon double bonds in its hydrocarbon chain.

examples.en: The polyunsaturated fatty acid had several marked double bonds in the enlarged illustration we studied.
examples.zh: 我们观察的放大图中，「多不饱和脂肪酸」标出了多个双键。

examples.en: We followed the bends on the polyunsaturated fatty acid drawing to compare it with the straighter chain.
examples.zh: 我们沿「多不饱和脂肪酸」图中的弯折观察，将它与较直的链作比较。

collocations: a polyunsaturated fatty acid in membrane lipids

words.enDefinition: the bulging region of the brainstem between the midbrain and medulla, containing pathways and nuclei

examples.en: The rounded front surface of the pons was visible just above the medulla in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，在延髓的正上方可看到「脑桥」圆隆的前表面。

examples.en: We traced a pathway from the pons toward the cerebellum on the labeled side view in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在标注侧视图中追踪从「脑桥」通往小脑的一条通路。

words.enDefinition: A combined effect estimate calculated from studies included together in a statistical synthesis.

examples.en: The pooled effect estimate appears below the individual fictional study estimates in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 课堂图将「合并效应估计值」列在各项虚构研究估计值的下方。

examples.en: We checked which studies contributed to the pooled effect estimate before describing it in words.
examples.zh: 我们先核对哪些研究纳入「合并效应估计值」，再用文字描述它。

collocations: uncertainty around a pooled effect estimate

words.enDefinition: Area behind the knee between the back of the thigh and calf

examples.en: In the rear view, the popliteal region lies directly behind the knee joint.
examples.zh: 在后视图中，「膝后区」就在膝关节后方。

examples.en: We marked the popliteal region on the back of the bent leg model.
examples.zh: 我们在弯曲的腿部模型背面标出了「膝后区」。

collocations: posterior view of the popliteal region

words.enDefinition: The people eligible to experience the event being counted during a defined interval or at its start.

examples.en: The population at risk includes only people eligible for a first recorded event in the fictional table.
examples.zh: 虚构表的「处于风险中的人群」只包括可能首次出现所计事件的人。

examples.en: We identified the population at risk before dividing the event count by the appropriate denominator.
examples.zh: 我们先确定「处于风险中的人群」，再将事件数除以相应分母。

collocations: size of the population at risk

words.enDefinition: A marked reduction in population size that leaves later generations descended from a smaller subset of individuals.

examples.en: The population bottleneck is shown as a sharp drop in the synthetic population size chart.
examples.zh: 合成群体规模图中，「群体瓶颈」表现为规模骤降。

examples.en: We compared diversity before and after the population bottleneck in the fictional classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 我们比较虚构课堂模拟里「群体瓶颈」前后的遗传多样性。

collocations: genetic diversity after a population bottleneck

words.enDefinition: Group of small portal vein, hepatic artery, and bile duct branches

examples.en: The diagram places a portal triad at one corner of the classical lobule.
examples.zh: 示意图将一个「门管三联体」画在经典肝小叶的一个角上。

examples.en: We identified the duct and both vessel branches within the portal triad.
examples.zh: 我们在「门管三联体」中辨认出胆管和两条血管分支。

words.enDefinition: An analysis formulated after the relevant data or results have been examined.

examples.en: The report labels a post hoc analysis that followed inspection of the fictional subgroup results.
examples.zh: 报告把查看虚构亚组结果之后发起的一项分析标为「事后分析」。

examples.en: We distinguished the post hoc analysis from the main comparison named in the written plan.
examples.zh: 我们区分「事后分析」与书面方案指定的主要比较。

words.enDefinition: the cortical ridge just posterior to the central sulcus, containing the primary somatosensory cortex

examples.en: The postcentral gyrus lies immediately behind the central sulcus on the side view of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型的侧视图中，「中央后回」紧接在中央沟后面。

examples.en: We marked the body sensation map along the postcentral gyrus on the large diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在放大图的「中央后回」上标出身体感觉图谱。

collocations: somatosensory cortex in the postcentral gyrus

words.enDefinition: Back portion of the pituitary releasing hormones produced by the hypothalamus

examples.en: The posterior pituitary is shaded behind the glandular front lobe in the model.
examples.zh: 模型用阴影表示位于腺性前叶后方的「垂体后叶」。

examples.en: Our chart shows signals released from the posterior pituitary into nearby blood vessels.
examples.zh: 图表显示，信号由「垂体后叶」释放到附近血管中。

collocations: hormone release from the posterior pituitary

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the back of the human body than another structure

examples.en: The model places the spine posterior to the heart when viewed from the side.
examples.zh: 从侧面观察，模型中的脊柱位于心脏「后方」。

examples.en: The ear lies posterior to the outer corner of the eye in this drawing.
examples.zh: 在这幅图里，耳朵位于眼外角「后方」。

words.enDefinition: an X-ray projection in which the beam passes through the body from back to front

examples.en: The posteroanterior projection diagram shows the beam entering the posterior side of the classroom torso model.
examples.zh: 「后前位投照」图显示，射线从课堂躯干模型的后侧进入。

examples.en: We located the detector on the anterior side of the posteroanterior projection illustration in the handout.
examples.zh: 我们在讲义的「后前位投照」图中，于前侧找到探测器。

words.enDefinition: the part of a target cell membrane that receives a signal at a synapse

examples.en: The postsynaptic membrane contains the labeled receptors on the receiving side of the classroom synapse model.
examples.zh: 课堂突触模型中，接收侧标出的受体位于「突触后膜」。

examples.en: We followed the messenger arrows from the gap to the postsynaptic membrane on the diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们沿信使箭头从间隙追踪到图中的「突触后膜」。

words.enDefinition: the time from the start of the P wave to the start of the QRS complex on an electrocardiogram

examples.en: We marked the PR interval from P wave onset to the onset of the corresponding QRS complex.
examples.zh: 我们标出了从 P 波起点到相应 QRS 波群起点的「PR 间期」。

examples.en: The class measured PR interval durations from the time grid on a supplied sample recording.
examples.zh: 全班用给出的示例记录上的时间网格，测量「PR 间期」的时长。

words.enDefinition: A trial designed to assess an intervention under conditions relevant to usual practice and routine decisions.

examples.en: The pragmatic trial example reports observations collected during routine visits at the fictional study sites.
examples.zh: 「实用性试验」示例报告在虚构研究场所日常访视中收集的观察结果。

examples.en: We examined the setting of the pragmatic trial when discussing whether its findings would apply elsewhere.
examples.zh: 讨论结果能否用于其他场合时，我们查看了「实用性试验」的实施环境。

words.enDefinition: the cortical ridge immediately anterior to the central sulcus, containing the primary motor cortex

examples.en: The precentral gyrus is the raised strip just in front of the central sulcus on our model.
examples.zh: 在模型上，「中央前回」是紧靠中央沟前方的隆起条带。

examples.en: We marked the movement-related region along the precentral gyrus on the classroom chart of cortical functions.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂皮层功能图上标出「中央前回」中与运动相关的区域。

collocations: primary motor cortex in the precentral gyrus

words.enDefinition: The period before meiosis I that includes copying DNA before the two divisions.

examples.en: The premeiotic interphase comes before both divisions in the timeline on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂练习的时间轴中，「减数分裂前间期」位于两次分裂之前。

examples.en: We marked chromosome copying during premeiotic interphase on the simple stage diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂阶段简图上标出了「减数分裂前间期」发生的染色体复制。

words.enDefinition: a slide bearing a specimen already mounted for viewing, often preserved as a teaching reference

examples.en: The prepared slide was labeled as normal skin in the classroom collection shown on the course page.
examples.zh: 课程页展示的课堂玻片集中，「已制标本玻片」标注为正常皮肤。

examples.en: We matched the reference image with the prepared slide listed under the same tissue name.
examples.zh: 我们把参考图像与列在同一组织名称下的「已制标本玻片」对应起来。

words.enDefinition: An analysis defined in the recorded study plan before examination of the relevant results.

examples.en: The prespecified analysis uses the groups and comparison listed in the fictional plan for class.
examples.zh: 「预先设定的分析」采用课堂虚构方案列出的组别与比较。

examples.en: We matched the prespecified analysis to its description before reading the additional classroom results.
examples.zh: 我们先将「预先设定的分析」与其描述对应起来，再读课堂的补充结果。

words.enDefinition: the signal-sending part of a neuron, usually an axon ending, at a synapse

examples.en: On the chemical synapse model, the presynaptic terminal contains small vesicles close to the cell membrane.
examples.zh: 在化学突触模型中，「突触前末梢」含有靠近细胞膜的小囊泡。

examples.en: The animation shows the signal arriving at the presynaptic terminal before chemical messengers cross the gap.
examples.zh: 动画显示，信号先到达「突触前末梢」，之后化学信使才跨过间隙。

words.enDefinition: a region of the temporal lobe receiving major auditory input from the thalamus and processing sound features

examples.en: The primary auditory cortex is marked on the upper surface of the temporal lobe in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图把「初级听觉皮层」标在颞叶的上表面。

examples.en: We followed the ascending hearing pathway toward the primary auditory cortex on the final diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在最后一张图里沿听觉上行通路追踪到「初级听觉皮层」。

collocations: input to the primary auditory cortex
representation in the primary auditory cortex

words.enDefinition: Early blood loss control involving formation of a temporary platelet plug

examples.en: The diagram ends primary hemostasis with a temporary seal made of platelets.
examples.zh: 示意图将血小板形成临时封堵画为「一期止血」的结果。

examples.en: We placed primary hemostasis before the appearance of the reinforcing fibrin network.
examples.zh: 我们将「一期止血」标在增强封堵的纤维蛋白网出现之前。

words.enDefinition: Organ providing a site for the development and maturation of lymphocytes

examples.en: The class lists the thymus as one example of a primary lymphoid organ.
examples.zh: 课堂将胸腺列为「初级淋巴器官」的一个例子。

examples.en: We placed a primary lymphoid organ near the beginning of the lymphocyte development chart.
examples.zh: 我们将「初级淋巴器官」放在淋巴细胞发育图的起始位置附近。

collocations: example of a primary lymphoid organ
function of a primary lymphoid organ

words.enDefinition: a cortical area in the precentral gyrus that contributes to control of voluntary movement

examples.en: The map places the primary motor cortex along a narrow strip in front of the central sulcus.
examples.zh: 图中将「初级运动皮层」放在中央沟前方的一条狭长区域。

examples.en: We compared regions of the primary motor cortex associated with the hand and foot on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上比较「初级运动皮层」中与手和足相对应的区域。

collocations: representation in the primary motor cortex

words.enDefinition: The outcome designated as the main one for answering a study question.

examples.en: The primary outcome concerns completion of the fictional follow-up questionnaire at the stated assessment time.
examples.zh: 「主要结局」关注是否在指定评估时点完成虚构随访问卷。

examples.en: We found the primary outcome in the protocol summary before opening the simulated results table.
examples.zh: 我们先在方案摘要中找到「主要结局」，再打开模拟结果表。

words.enDefinition: a cortical area in the postcentral gyrus that receives and processes somatic sensory input

examples.en: The chart maps touch from different body regions onto the primary somatosensory cortex behind the central sulcus.
examples.zh: 图中将身体各区域的触觉映射到中央沟后的「初级躯体感觉皮层」。

examples.en: We followed a sensory pathway to the primary somatosensory cortex on the final panel of the handout.
examples.zh: 在讲义最后一图，我们沿感觉通路追踪至「初级躯体感觉皮层」。

collocations: activation of the primary somatosensory cortex
input to the primary somatosensory cortex

words.enDefinition: an occipital cortical region that receives major visual input from the thalamus and begins cortical visual processing

examples.en: The primary visual cortex appears in the back of the model brain where the illustrated visual pathway ends.
examples.zh: 「初级视觉皮层」出现在模型脑后部，也就是图示视觉通路到达之处。

examples.en: We compared the regions of the primary visual cortex representing two parts of the visual field in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了「初级视觉皮层」中代表视野两个部分的区域。

collocations: input to the primary visual cortex
representation in the primary visual cortex

words.enDefinition: A reporting guideline with checklists and flow diagram templates for systematic reviews.

examples.en: PRISMA 2020 is listed next to the review checklist on the classroom evidence reading worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂证据研读的练习纸在综述清单旁列有「PRISMA 2020 报告规范」。

examples.en: We used PRISMA 2020 while reading how the fictional review documented its selection of studies.
examples.zh: 我们借助「PRISMA 2020 报告规范」，阅读虚构综述如何记录研究选择过程。

words.enDefinition: The individual through whom a family first comes to attention for a genetics study or investigation.

examples.en: The arrow points to the proband in the fictional pedigree on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 课堂练习的虚构家系图上，箭头指向「先证者」。

examples.en: We located the proband before identifying the relatives shown on either side of the chart.
examples.zh: 我们先找到「先证者」，再辨认图表两侧所示的亲属。

words.enDefinition: Forearm rotation that turns the palm toward the rear from anatomical position, or downward when the forearm is held horizontally in front.

examples.en: The forearm model shows pronation as its palm turns downward with the forearm held horizontally.
examples.zh: 在前臂水平摆放的模型上，手掌向下翻转，展示了「旋前」。

examples.en: We watched the forearm bones change position during pronation in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂动画中观察前臂骨在「旋前」时如何改变相对位置。

words.enDefinition: Body position lying horizontally with the front of the trunk facing downward

examples.en: The figure in prone position faces downward on the horizontal reference surface.
examples.zh: 处于「俯卧位」的人体图在水平参照面上面朝下方。

examples.en: We labeled the back of the model while it was in prone position.
examples.zh: 模型处于「俯卧位」时，我们标出了它的背部。

words.enDefinition: The first stage of meiosis I, when chromosomes condense, homologues pair, and crossing over can occur.

examples.en: The homologous chromosomes pair during prophase I in the simplified diagram shown in our lesson.
examples.zh: 课上所示简图中，同源染色体在「减数第一次分裂前期」配对。

examples.en: We identified prophase I by locating the paired homologues in the classroom set of figures.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂组图中找到已配对的同源染色体，以辨认「减数第一次分裂前期」。

words.enDefinition: The stage preceding chromosome alignment in meiosis II, when a new division apparatus forms in each cell.

examples.en: The prophase II illustration shows each cell preparing for a second division in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「减数第二次分裂前期」示意图显示课堂模型中各细胞在为第二次分裂做准备。

examples.en: We compared prophase II with the earlier stage that showed homologues pairing in the textbook.
examples.zh: 我们把「减数第二次分裂前期」与教材中较早的同源染色体配对阶段作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a sensory receptor that provides information about body position, movement or the force generated by muscles

examples.en: The classroom animation links a proprioceptor in a muscle to information about the limb's changing position.
examples.zh: 课堂动画将肌肉中的「本体感受器」与肢体位置变化的信息联系起来。

examples.en: We drew a proprioceptor at the start of the model pathway for sensing joint position.
examples.zh: 我们在用于感知关节位置的模型通路起点画出一个「本体感受器」。

words.enDefinition: A cohort study that defines its group and records outcomes as they occur after the study starts.

examples.en: The prospective cohort study records questionnaire responses after the fictional participants enter the study group.
examples.zh: 「前瞻性队列研究」在虚构参与者进入研究群组后记录其问卷回答。

examples.en: We drew a timeline for the prospective cohort study to show when follow-up observations begin.
examples.zh: 我们为「前瞻性队列研究」画出时间线，标明何时开始记录随访观察结果。

collocations: outcomes of a prospective cohort study
results from a prospective cohort study

words.enDefinition: A nonprotein cofactor that remains tightly bound to its associated protein.

examples.en: The textbook marks the prosthetic group as a small component held firmly inside the folded protein.
examples.zh: 教材把「辅基」标为牢固结合在折叠蛋白质内部的小组分。

examples.en: We compared the prosthetic group with a separate cofactor drawn moving between steps in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「辅基」与图中画成在不同步骤之间移动的独立辅因子作比较。

collocations: the function of a prosthetic group

words.enDefinition: A change in a protein's three-dimensional arrangement without a change in its amino acid sequence.

examples.en: The animation illustrates a protein conformational change as two regions shift closer together during ordinary cellular activity.
examples.zh: 动画中，细胞正常活动时蛋白质的两个区域彼此靠近，展示了「蛋白质构象变化」。

examples.en: We compared the two drawings to identify the protein conformational change within the same folded chain.
examples.zh: 我们对比两幅图，辨认同一折叠链中发生的「蛋白质构象变化」。

collocations: a protein conformational change during binding

words.enDefinition: Loss of a protein's native three-dimensional structure, typically with its primary chain sequence intact.

examples.en: The diagram illustrates protein denaturation by showing a compact folded shape becoming less ordered in the model.
examples.zh: 示意图把紧凑的折叠形状逐渐变得无序的过程画出，以说明「蛋白质变性」。

examples.en: We compared the two textbook panels to see which structural levels changed during protein denaturation.
examples.zh: 我们对比教材中的两幅图，查看「蛋白质变性」时哪些结构层次发生了变化。

collocations: a loss of structure during protein denaturation

words.enDefinition: A distinct region of a protein that folds as a unit and may have a particular function.

examples.en: The labeled model showed one protein domain as a compact region within a much longer chain.
examples.zh: 标注模型将一个「蛋白质结构域」画成较长链中紧凑的一部分。

examples.en: We colored each protein domain separately to highlight the two organized regions in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们给图中各「蛋白质结构域」分别着色，以突出两个成形的区域。

collocations: the structure of a protein domain

words.enDefinition: The process by which a polypeptide acquires its usual three-dimensional shape.

examples.en: The animation illustrates protein folding by bringing distant regions of one polypeptide close to each other.
examples.zh: 动画让同一条多肽上相距很远的区域靠近，以展示「蛋白质折叠」。

examples.en: We discussed protein folding after comparing the straight sequence drawing with the folded molecular shape.
examples.zh: 我们比较了直线排列的序列图和折叠后的分子形状，随后讨论了「蛋白质折叠」。

collocations: protein folding in a human cell

words.enDefinition: The sequence of amino acid residues in a protein's polypeptide chain or chains.

examples.en: The figure represents protein primary structure as a line of residue names in their sequence order.
examples.zh: 图中用按序排列的一行残基名称表示「蛋白质一级结构」。

examples.en: We compared protein primary structure before looking at the folded shapes shown in the next panel.
examples.zh: 我们先比较「蛋白质一级结构」，再看下一幅图中的折叠形状。

collocations: a diagram of protein primary structure

words.enDefinition: The arrangement of multiple polypeptide subunits in one functional protein assembly.

examples.en: The multicolored figure used a different shade for each chain to illustrate protein quaternary structure.
examples.zh: 多色图给每条链用了不同颜色，以展示「蛋白质四级结构」。

examples.en: We discussed protein quaternary structure when the diagram showed two separate chains forming one assembly.
examples.zh: 图中两条独立的链组成一个复合结构，我们借此讨论了「蛋白质四级结构」。

collocations: a model of protein quaternary structure

words.enDefinition: Local patterns in a protein backbone, such as helices or sheets stabilized by backbone hydrogen bonds.

examples.en: The spiral and the sheet illustrate two kinds of protein secondary structure in the textbook drawing.
examples.zh: 教材图中的螺旋和片层说明了两种「蛋白质二级结构」。

examples.en: We found protein secondary structure by locating repeated backbone shapes in the classroom model of the chain.
examples.zh: 我们在链的课堂模型中寻找反复出现的骨架形态，以辨认「蛋白质二级结构」。

collocations: common patterns of protein secondary structure
a region of protein secondary structure

words.enDefinition: An individual polypeptide component of a protein complex with multiple chains.

examples.en: The diagram assigned a different color to each protein subunit in the normal human protein assembly.
examples.zh: 图中给正常人体蛋白质复合物的每个「蛋白质亚基」用了不同颜色。

examples.en: We followed one protein subunit from the side view to its matching label in the top view.
examples.zh: 我们从侧视图追踪一个「蛋白质亚基」，在俯视图中找到对应标记。

collocations: a protein subunit in a complex

words.enDefinition: The overall three-dimensional arrangement of one folded polypeptide chain.

examples.en: The instructor used a folded chain model to show protein tertiary structure from several viewing angles.
examples.zh: 老师用一个折叠链模型，从多个角度展示「蛋白质三级结构」。

examples.en: The protein tertiary structure diagram showed two regions of the same chain lying close together after folding.
examples.zh: 「蛋白质三级结构」图显示，折叠后同一条链上的两个区域靠在一起。

collocations: the stability of protein tertiary structure
a model of protein tertiary structure

words.enDefinition: Inactive precursor in plasma that is converted into thrombin during clotting

examples.en: The flowchart lists prothrombin before thrombin in the shared pathway segment.
examples.zh: 流程图在共同途径那一段把「凝血酶原」列在凝血酶之前。

examples.en: We labeled prothrombin on the precursor side of the classroom arrow.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂箭头指示的转变中，将前体一侧标为「凝血酶原」。

words.enDefinition: A documented change to the approved or recorded plan for a study.

examples.en: The protocol amendment changes the stated assessment date in the fictional classroom version of the study.
examples.zh: 「方案修订」更改了课堂虚构版研究所列的评估日期。

examples.en: We checked the date of the protocol amendment before comparing the two versions of the plan.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「方案修订」日期，再比较两个版本的计划。

words.enDefinition: An instance in which study conduct differs from the stated protocol.

examples.en: The protocol deviation is recorded when a fictional assessment falls outside the scheduled time window.
examples.zh: 虚构评估落在预定时间窗外时，研究记录了「方案偏离」。

examples.en: We distinguished a protocol deviation from an approved change to the written plan in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「方案偏离」与对书面计划作出的获批更改。

words.enDefinition: A difference in proton concentration between two sides of a membrane.

examples.en: The textbook depicts a proton gradient by drawing more protons on one side of the inner membrane.
examples.zh: 教材在线粒体内膜一侧画出较多的质子，以表示「质子梯度」。
