examples.en: We marked the proton gradient on the mitochondrial model beside the labels for its two compartments.
examples.zh: 我们在线粒体模型两个区室的标记旁标出了「质子梯度」。

collocations: a proton gradient across a membrane
a diagram of a proton gradient

words.enDefinition: Coiled first segment of the renal tubule that receives glomerular filtrate

examples.en: The proximal convoluted tubule begins next to the glomerular capsule in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「近曲小管」起自肾小囊旁边。

examples.en: We marked the proximal convoluted tubule before drawing the long loop beneath it.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「近曲小管」，再绘制它下方的长袢。

collocations: reabsorption in the proximal convoluted tubule
diagram of the proximal convoluted tubule

words.enDefinition: Located nearer a limb's attachment or another specified point of origin

examples.en: The diagram places the elbow proximal to the wrist along the upper limb.
examples.zh: 图中显示，在同一条上肢上，肘部「比腕部更近躯干」。

examples.en: We marked the upper point as proximal to the lower point on the forearm.
examples.zh: 对于前臂上的两个点，我们标明上方一点「比下方一点更近躯干」。

words.enDefinition: Single epithelial layer appearing multilayered because its nuclei lie at different heights

examples.en: The nuclei appear at different heights in the drawing of pseudostratified columnar epithelium.
examples.zh: 在「假复层柱状上皮」图中，细胞核位于不同的高度。

examples.en: We checked that every cell in the pseudostratified columnar epithelium touched the basement membrane.
examples.zh: 我们确认了「假复层柱状上皮」中的每个细胞都接触基底膜。

words.enDefinition: The anterior portion of the hip bone that meets the corresponding part on the other side.

examples.en: The pubis is marked at the front of each hip bone on the pelvis model.
examples.zh: 骨盆模型将「耻骨」标在各侧髋骨的前部。

examples.en: We labelled the pubis before comparing the three parts of the hip bone in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出「耻骨」，再比较髋骨的三个组成部分。

words.enDefinition: Distortion that occurs when whether studies are published depends on the nature or direction of their results.

examples.en: The classroom review discusses publication bias because studies with certain results might be absent from the literature.
examples.zh: 课堂综述讨论「发表偏倚」，因为具有某些结果的研究可能没有出现在文献中。

examples.en: We considered publication bias before interpreting the combined estimate from the fictional studies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先考虑「发表偏倚」，再解读虚构研究的合并估计。

words.enDefinition: one of the tiny air sacs in the lungs whose thin walls allow exchange of gases with capillaries

examples.en: Each pulmonary alveolus in the enlarged model is surrounded by a network of very small blood vessels.
examples.zh: 放大的模型中，每个「肺泡」都由极细的血管网包围。

examples.en: We drew oxygen crossing the wall of a pulmonary alveolus toward an adjacent capillary in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们画出氧穿过一个「肺泡」的壁，进入邻近毛细血管。

collocations: gas exchange in a pulmonary alveolus

words.enDefinition: a vessel carrying blood from the right side of the heart toward a lung

examples.en: In the adult circulation diagram, the pulmonary artery carries blood with relatively low oxygen content.
examples.zh: 在成人血液循环图中，「肺动脉」输送的是氧含量相对较低的血液。

examples.en: We found the right pulmonary artery by following the branch from the pulmonary trunk toward that lung.
examples.zh: 我们从肺动脉干沿通往右肺的分支找到右「肺动脉」。

words.enDefinition: a tiny blood vessel in the lungs that forms part of the exchange network around alveoli

examples.en: We drew a pulmonary capillary close to the alveolar wall to illustrate the short distance for gas exchange.
examples.zh: 我们在肺泡壁旁画出一条「肺毛细血管」，展示气体交换距离很短。

examples.en: The animation shows blood gaining oxygen as it crosses a pulmonary capillary beside the modeled alveolus.
examples.zh: 动画显示，血液经过模型肺泡旁的一条「肺毛细血管」时获得氧。

collocations: blood flowing through a pulmonary capillary

words.enDefinition: blood flow from the right ventricle through the lungs and back to the left atrium

examples.en: The pulmonary circulation starts at the right ventricle and returns blood to the left atrium in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们的图中，「肺循环」始于右心室，将血液送回左心房。

examples.en: We traced pulmonary circulation through the capillaries surrounding the alveoli on the model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在模型上沿肺泡周围的毛细血管追踪「肺循环」。

words.enDefinition: the diffusion of oxygen and carbon dioxide between the alveoli and the pulmonary capillary blood

examples.en: The arrows for pulmonary gas exchange show oxygen entering the blood and carbon dioxide entering the alveoli.
examples.zh: 「肺气体交换」的箭头显示，氧进入血液，二氧化碳进入肺泡。

examples.en: We used the short distance between air and blood to explain pulmonary gas exchange in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们用气腔和血液之间的短距离来解释课堂模型中的「肺气体交换」。

words.enDefinition: a mixture lining the alveoli that lowers surface tension and helps stabilize these airspaces

examples.en: The lecture model showed how pulmonary surfactant lowers surface tension at the air-liquid boundary in each alveolus.
examples.zh: 课堂模型演示「肺表面活性物质」如何降低各肺泡气液界面的表面张力。

examples.en: We labeled the layer containing pulmonary surfactant at the boundary between alveolar air and lining fluid.
examples.zh: 我们在肺泡内空气与衬层液体的交界处标出含「肺表面活性物质」的一层。

collocations: effect of pulmonary surfactant on surface tension

words.enDefinition: the large vessel leaving the right ventricle before dividing into the right and left pulmonary arteries

examples.en: The pulmonary trunk branches into two large vessels just beyond the heart in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「肺动脉干」离开心脏不远便分成两条大血管。

examples.en: We followed blood through the pulmonary valve before it entered the pulmonary trunk on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上追踪血液先经过肺动脉瓣，再进入「肺动脉干」。

words.enDefinition: the semilunar valve between the right ventricle and the pulmonary trunk

examples.en: The pulmonary valve opens when right ventricular pressure exceeds pressure in the trunk during the animation.
examples.zh: 动画中，右心室压力高于肺动脉干压力时，「肺动脉瓣」打开。

examples.en: We located the pulmonary valve directly above the outlet of the right ventricle in the cutaway.
examples.zh: 我们在剖视图右心室出口的正上方找到了「肺动脉瓣」。

collocations: blood passing through the pulmonary valve

words.enDefinition: a vessel carrying blood from a lung to the left atrium

examples.en: The pulmonary vein returns oxygenated blood to the heart in the adult circulation diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂所用的成人血液循环图中，「肺静脉」将含氧血送回心脏。

examples.en: We traced a pulmonary vein from its lung attachment to an opening in the left atrium.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「肺静脉」从肺侧连接处追踪到左心房上的一个开口。

collocations: blood carried by a pulmonary vein

words.enDefinition: the movement of air between the atmosphere and the lungs through inhalation and exhalation

examples.en: The animation illustrates pulmonary ventilation by showing air moving into and out of the expanding lungs.
examples.zh: 动画通过展示空气进出正在扩张和回缩的肺，演示「肺通气」。

examples.en: We separated pulmonary ventilation from gas diffusion across the alveolar wall when labeling the two diagrams.
examples.zh: 给两张图作标记时，我们区分了「肺通气」与气体通过肺泡壁扩散。

words.enDefinition: the difference between systolic and diastolic arterial pressures

examples.en: We found pulse pressure by subtracting the minimum arterial pressure from the peak in the model trace.
examples.zh: 我们用模型曲线上的动脉压力峰值减去最低值，求得「脉压」。

examples.en: The two traces had different pulse pressure values even though they shared a similar average pressure.
examples.zh: 两条曲线的平均压力相近，但「脉压」不同。

words.enDefinition: A grid combining possible parental alleles to show expected offspring genotype proportions under stated assumptions.

examples.en: The Punnett square lists the allele symbols along two edges of the grid in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「庞纳特方格」沿方格两条边列出等位基因符号。

examples.en: We read the Punnett square as a diagram of possible outcomes for the fictional family.
examples.zh: 我们将「庞纳特方格」作为展示虚构家系可能结果的图来阅读。

words.enDefinition: the opening in the center of the iris through which light enters the eye

examples.en: On the model, the pupil is the dark opening in the middle of the colored ring.
examples.zh: 模型上，「瞳孔」是彩色圆环中央的深色开口。

examples.en: We compared the size of the pupil in two classroom drawings made under different light conditions.
examples.zh: 我们比较了不同照明条件下两幅课堂图中「瞳孔」的大小。

words.enDefinition: a specialized cardiac conduction fiber that rapidly carries electrical activation through parts of the ventricular walls

examples.en: The atlas shows a Purkinje fiber near the inner surface of the ventricle in the stained section.
examples.zh: 图谱的染色切片中，「浦肯野纤维」位于心室内表面附近。

examples.en: We traced a Purkinje fiber from the conduction network toward nearby cardiac muscle cells in the sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图上从传导网络沿一条「浦肯野纤维」追踪到附近的心肌细胞。

words.enDefinition: Muscular ring controlling passage from the stomach into the duodenum

examples.en: The model places the pyloric sphincter at the outlet of the stomach.
examples.zh: 模型将「幽门括约肌」画在胃的出口处。

examples.en: The diagram shows chyme moving past the pyloric sphincter into the duodenum.
examples.zh: 示意图显示食糜经过「幽门括约肌」进入十二指肠。

words.enDefinition: The three-carbon end product of glycolysis, present mainly as the ion of pyruvic acid in cells.

examples.en: The simplified pathway shows pyruvate at the end of glycolysis and before its different possible fates.
examples.zh: 简化代谢图将「丙酮酸」放在糖酵解的终点、不同后续去向之前。

examples.en: We circled pyruvate at the branch connecting the sugar pathway to the mitochondrion in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中连接糖代谢途径与线粒体的分支处圈出了「丙酮酸」。

words.enDefinition: The conversion of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA, releasing carbon dioxide and producing NADH in human mitochondria.

examples.en: The metabolism map places pyruvate oxidation between glycolysis and the citric acid cycle in human cells.
examples.zh: 人体细胞代谢图把「丙酮酸氧化」标在糖酵解与柠檬酸循环之间。

examples.en: We located the carbon dioxide symbol on the arrow labeled pyruvate oxidation in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中标着「丙酮酸氧化」的箭头上找到了二氧化碳符号。

words.enDefinition: the group of deflections on an electrocardiogram representing ventricular depolarization

examples.en: The QRS complex coincided with electrical activation of the ventricles on our synchronized classroom display.
examples.zh: 在同步展示的课堂图上，「QRS 波群」与心室电激动同时出现。

examples.en: We drew a bracket around the QRS complex to distinguish it from the waves before and after.
examples.zh: 我们用括号标出「QRS 波群」，以便与前后的波形区分。

words.enDefinition: A group of four muscles at the front of the thigh that extends the knee.

examples.en: The quadriceps femoris occupies the front of the thigh in the labelled classroom model.
examples.zh: 带标注的课堂模型上，「股四头肌」占据大腿前方。

examples.en: We identified the four parts of quadriceps femoris using the coloured anatomy chart in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用彩色解剖图指出了「股四头肌」的四个组成部分。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic measured numerically along a scale instead of grouped solely into named categories.

examples.en: The quantitative trait is represented by a numerical measurement for each fictional person in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，每名虚构人物各有一个数值测量结果来表示「数量性状」。

examples.en: We plotted the quantitative trait on a continuous scale for the synthetic dataset in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把合成数据中的「数量性状」绘在一条连续数轴上。

words.enDefinition: the orientation of the X-ray beam through the body relative to the image detector

examples.en: The radiographic projection affects which structures overlap in the two illustrated views of the anatomy model.
examples.zh: 「X线投照方向」会影响解剖模型两个示意视图中哪些结构发生重叠。

examples.en: We read an arrow on the reference diagram to determine the radiographic projection used for the example.
examples.zh: 我们读取参考图上的箭头，判断示例采用的「X线投照方向」。

words.enDefinition: an area transmitting relatively more X-rays and usually appearing darker on a conventional radiographic display

examples.en: The radiolucent region looked dark because the air in that part of the model transmitted more X-rays.
examples.zh: 「X线透亮区」呈暗色，因为模型该部分的空气让更多 X 线穿过。

examples.en: We labeled the radiolucent region separately from the lighter bone outlines on the classroom reference print.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂参考印图上，将「X线透亮区」和颜色较浅的骨轮廓分别标记。

words.enDefinition: a structure that attenuates X-rays relatively strongly and usually appears lighter on a conventional radiograph

examples.en: The atlas identifies dense bone as a radiopaque structure on the reference image printed for class.
examples.zh: 课堂参考图的图谱把致密骨标为「阻射结构」。

examples.en: We compared the light area of the radiopaque structure with the darker region containing air in the model.
examples.zh: 我们将「阻射结构」的浅色区与模型中包含空气的较暗区域比较。

words.enDefinition: The forearm bone lying on the thumb side in the anatomical position.

examples.en: The radius is marked on the thumb side of the forearm in the front view.
examples.zh: 正视图上，「桡骨」标在前臂的拇指侧。

examples.en: We followed the radius toward the wrist while looking at the labelled forearm model.
examples.zh: 我们看着有标签的前臂模型，沿「桡骨」向腕部追踪。

words.enDefinition: A meta-analysis model that allows underlying true effects to vary across studies and estimates their average.

examples.en: The random-effects meta-analysis allows the fictional studies to have different underlying effects in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的「随机效应荟萃分析」允许各虚构研究具有不同的真实效应。

examples.en: We interpreted the random-effects meta-analysis estimate as an average across the studied settings in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「随机效应荟萃分析」的估计解释为各研究场景的平均效应。

words.enDefinition: A trial assigning participants or groups by chance to intervention and comparison conditions.

examples.en: The randomised controlled trial in the worksheet compares two formats for a fictional activity diary.
examples.zh: 练习里的「随机对照试验」比较虚构活动日志的两种格式。

examples.en: We checked how the randomised controlled trial describes its comparison groups in the methods summary.
examples.zh: 我们核对「随机对照试验」在方法摘要中如何描述比较组。

collocations: evidence from a randomised controlled trial

words.enDefinition: An evidence review that streamlines selected review methods to produce a timely synthesis and reports the shortcuts.

examples.en: The rapid review states which review steps were shortened in the fictional methods table for class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构方法表里的「快速综述」说明缩减了哪些综述环节。

examples.en: We discussed how the chosen limits affect the rapid review in the example summary.
examples.zh: 我们讨论选定的限制怎样影响示例摘要中的「快速综述」。

words.enDefinition: One event rate divided by another rate measured using a comparable person-time basis.

examples.en: The rate ratio compares two rates expressed per person-year in the fictional teaching table.
examples.zh: 虚构教学表里的「率比」比较两个按人年表示的事件发生率。

examples.en: We located the denominator for each rate before interpreting the rate ratio in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们先找出各率的分母，再解释「率比」。

collocations: confidence interval for a rate ratio

words.enDefinition: Systematic differences in the accuracy or completeness of past information recalled by comparison groups.

examples.en: Recall bias is possible if the fictional groups remember past activities differently in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 课堂案例中，如果虚构各组回忆过去活动的方式不同，就可能出现「回忆偏倚」。

examples.en: We considered recall bias when comparing retrospectively reported activities with the records in the example.
examples.zh: 将回顾性报告的活动与示例记录相比较时，我们考虑了「回忆偏倚」。

words.enDefinition: the area of sensory input within which a stimulus can alter the response of a particular sensory neuron

examples.en: The diagram shades the receptive field of one neuron on a map of the surface of the skin.
examples.zh: 图中在皮肤表面图上用阴影标出了一个神经元的「感受野」。

examples.en: We compared each receptive field to find where a single touch could influence both modeled neurons.
examples.zh: 我们对比两个「感受野」，找出触碰哪里能影响两个模型神经元。

words.enDefinition: a graded change in the voltage of a sensory receptor produced by a stimulus

examples.en: In the class model, a dissolved substance produces a receptor potential in a taste receptor cell.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，溶解物质使味觉感受细胞产生「感受器电位」。

examples.en: We plotted the receptor potential separately from the action potentials of the associated neuron in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们分别绘制「感受器电位」和相关神经元的动作电位。

words.enDefinition: An allele whose associated phenotype is masked by a dominant allele in a heterozygote for the trait.

examples.en: In the simplified model, a recessive allele is present in some entries without the recessive phenotype.
examples.zh: 在简化模型中，某些未表现隐性表型的项目仍有「隐性等位基因」。

examples.en: We traced the recessive allele across the fictional family even where the feature was absent.
examples.zh: 即使可见特征没有表现，我们仍在虚构家系里追踪「隐性等位基因」。

words.enDefinition: Final major section of the large intestine between sigmoid colon and anal canal

examples.en: The rectum lies below the curved end of the colon in our diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，「直肠」位于结肠弯曲末段的下方。

examples.en: We drew the rectum as the segment above the anal canal.
examples.zh: 我们把肛管上方的一段画成「直肠」。

words.enDefinition: A paired muscle of the front abdominal wall that helps flex the trunk.

examples.en: The rectus abdominis runs vertically beside the midline in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型正视图中，「腹直肌」在正中线两侧竖直走行。

examples.en: We identified rectus abdominis on the chart before checking the illustrated trunk movement.
examples.zh: 我们先在挂图上找出「腹直肌」，再观察图示躯干动作。

words.enDefinition: Number of red blood cells per unit volume of blood

examples.en: The synthetic table reports two red blood cell count values using the same volume unit.
examples.zh: 表中两列合成的「红细胞计数」使用相同的体积单位。

examples.en: We labeled the red blood cell count separately from the fraction of volume occupied.
examples.zh: 我们将「红细胞计数」与红细胞占据的体积比例分开标注。

collocations: report a red blood cell count
units for a red blood cell count

words.enDefinition: Marrow tissue where blood cells are produced.

examples.en: The diagram shows red bone marrow within spaces of spongy bone on the adult model.
examples.zh: 成人模型图把「红骨髓」画在松质骨的空隙中。

examples.en: We distinguished red bone marrow from the surrounding bone tissue in the labelled classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在带标注的课堂示意图上区分「红骨髓」与周围的骨组织。

collocations: blood cell production in red bone marrow

words.enDefinition: Molecular marker on a red cell surface that antibodies can recognize

examples.en: The card depicts a red cell surface antigen as a small shape on the cell edge.
examples.zh: 卡片把「红细胞表面抗原」画成细胞边缘的一个小图形。

examples.en: We labeled the red cell surface antigen beside the matching marker symbol in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中相应的标志符号旁标出了「红细胞表面抗原」。

collocations: identify a red cell surface antigen
diagram of a red cell surface antigen
recognition of a red cell surface antigen

words.enDefinition: A situation in which only some individuals with a genotype show the associated phenotype.

examples.en: The reduced penetrance example has matching genotypes but different records of whether the trait is present.
examples.zh: 「外显不全」示例里的基因型相同，性状是否出现的记录却不同。

examples.en: We marked reduced penetrance because some people with the model genotype did not show the feature.
examples.zh: 我们标出「外显不全」，因为具有模型给定基因型的部分人物未表现该特征。

words.enDefinition: the neural pathway connecting a sensory receptor to an effector in a reflex response

examples.en: We followed the reflex arc from a sensory receptor to the spinal cord and out to a muscle.
examples.zh: 我们沿「反射弧」从感觉感受器追踪到脊髓，再从脊髓追踪到肌肉。

examples.en: The completed reflex arc diagram includes the pathway that leaves the cord as well as the incoming fibers.
examples.zh: 完整的「反射弧」图既包括传入纤维，也包括离开脊髓的通路。

words.enDefinition: Study of body structures grouped together within a specified physical region

examples.en: In regional anatomy, we studied several different structures found within the same body region.
examples.zh: 在「局部解剖学」课上，我们学习了人体同一区域内的多种结构。

examples.en: The regional anatomy diagram brings together the layers and structures of the neck.
examples.zh: 「局部解剖学」示意图把颈部的层次和结构集中画出。

words.enDefinition: A study that uses data from an organized register of people or events defined by shared criteria.

examples.en: The registry-based study uses a fictional register that groups records by agreed categories in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「基于登记库的研究」使用按约定类别整理记录的虚构登记库。

examples.en: We read the coverage notes for the registry-based study before interpreting the follow-up table in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读「基于登记库的研究」的覆盖范围说明，再解读随访表。

words.enDefinition: Bodily condition monitored and adjusted by a regulatory system

examples.en: We marked temperature as the regulated physiological variable on our classroom feedback diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂反馈图上将温度标为「受调节的生理变量」。

examples.en: The line for the regulated physiological variable stays near the model's target over time.
examples.zh: 表示「受调节的生理变量」的曲线随时间保持在模型目标附近。

collocations: change in a regulated physiological variable

words.enDefinition: T lymphocyte that restrains immune responses and helps maintain tolerance

examples.en: The flowchart shows a regulatory T cell limiting the response of another cell group.
examples.zh: 流程图显示一个「调节性T细胞」限制另一组细胞的反应。

examples.en: We marked the regulatory T cell next to the inhibitory symbol in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型的抑制符号旁标出了「调节性T细胞」。

collocations: role of a regulatory T cell
diagram of a regulatory T cell

words.enDefinition: the interval after absolute refractoriness in which a stronger than usual stimulus can start another action potential

examples.en: The simulated neuron required a stronger input to spike again during the relative refractory period.
examples.zh: 模拟神经元在「相对不应期」需要较平时更强的输入才能再次产生尖峰。

examples.en: We marked the relative refractory period where a larger input produced a second spike in the worksheet trace.
examples.zh: 在练习曲线中，较大输入仍能产生第二个尖峰的所示时段被标为「相对不应期」。

collocations: stimulus threshold in the relative refractory period

words.enDefinition: A decrease in risk expressed as a fraction of the comparison group's risk, equal to one minus the risk ratio.

examples.en: The relative risk reduction uses the comparison group's risk as the reference in the synthetic table.
examples.zh: 合成表中的「相对风险降低」以比较组的风险为参照。

examples.en: We compared relative risk reduction with the difference in percentage points shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「相对风险降低」与练习纸上的百分点差异作比较。

words.enDefinition: Fibrous covering directly surrounding the outer surface of the kidney

examples.en: The renal capsule appears as a thin line around the model kidney.
examples.zh: 「肾被膜」在肾脏模型外周呈现为一条细线。

examples.en: We outlined the renal capsule separately from the broader layer of surrounding fat.
examples.zh: 我们分别勾画出「肾被膜」和周围较厚的脂肪层。

collocations: outer surface of the renal capsule

words.enDefinition: Extension of cortical tissue between adjacent renal pyramids in the kidney

examples.en: The renal column separates two triangular regions in our cutaway kidney model.
examples.zh: 在肾脏剖视模型中，「肾柱」隔开两个三角形区域。

examples.en: We followed the renal column outward to the band of cortical tissue.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「肾柱」向外描画，直到带状皮质组织。

words.enDefinition: Nephron component composed of the glomerulus and its surrounding capsule

examples.en: The renal corpuscle includes the capillary tuft and its outer cup in our model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「肾小体」包括毛细血管团和包围它的杯状结构。

examples.en: We marked the renal corpuscle at the beginning of the nephron diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在肾单位示意图的起始处标出了「肾小体」。

words.enDefinition: Outer region of the kidney containing the renal corpuscles and convoluted tubules

examples.en: The renal cortex forms an outer band around the darker region in our drawing.
examples.zh: 在图中，「肾皮质」形成环绕较深色区域的一圈外带。

examples.en: We placed the tiny filtration units within the renal cortex on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中把微小的滤过单位画在「肾皮质」内。

words.enDefinition: Indented area where the kidney's vessels, nerves, and urinary passage connect

examples.en: The renal hilum is marked along the curved inward border of the kidney.
examples.zh: 「肾门」标在肾脏向内凹陷的边缘。

examples.en: Our diagram groups several structures at the renal hilum using different colored lines.
examples.zh: 示意图用不同颜色的线条标出汇集在「肾门」的几种结构。

words.enDefinition: Inner region of the kidney containing the pyramids and parts of tubules

examples.en: We shaded the renal medulla deeper inside the kidney model than the cortex.
examples.zh: 我们在肾脏模型比皮质更深的位置以阴影表示「肾髓质」。

examples.en: The diagram groups the triangular structures within the renal medulla of the section.
examples.zh: 剖面图将三角形结构标在「肾髓质」内。

words.enDefinition: Tip of a kidney pyramid from which collecting ducts release urine

examples.en: The renal papilla points into the small cup drawn on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 习题图中，「肾乳头」伸向一个小杯状结构内部。

examples.en: We marked the renal papilla at the narrow end of the pyramid.
examples.zh: 我们在锥体的窄端标出了「肾乳头」。

words.enDefinition: Funnel-shaped collecting area of the kidney that continues into the ureter

examples.en: The renal pelvis narrows into a tube leaving the kidney in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，「肾盂」变窄成为离开肾脏的管道。

examples.en: We traced the renal pelvis back toward the larger cups of the kidney.
examples.zh: 我们从「肾盂」向上追踪到肾内较大的肾盏。

words.enDefinition: Cone-shaped region of kidney medulla ending at a papilla

examples.en: The illustration shows a renal pyramid with its narrow tip pointing inward.
examples.zh: 插图显示一个尖端朝内的「肾锥体」。

examples.en: We colored one renal pyramid to distinguish it from the surrounding tissue.
examples.zh: 我们为一个「肾锥体」上色，将其与周围组织区分开来。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome consisting of two sister chromatids after its DNA has been copied.

examples.en: The replicated chromosome is still counted as one chromosome in this panel of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂图的这幅小图里，「已复制的染色体」仍计为一条染色体。

examples.en: We labelled the two chromatids of the replicated chromosome before comparing it with the earlier stage.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「已复制的染色体」的两个染色单体，再将它与较早阶段比较。

collocations: two chromatids of a replicated chromosome

words.enDefinition: A checklist or structured set of recommendations about information to include in a research report.

examples.en: The reporting guideline helps readers check whether the fictional trial report describes its main study methods.
examples.zh: 「报告规范」帮助读者核查虚构试验报告是否描述了主要研究方法。

examples.en: We distinguished a reporting guideline from a judgement about bias in the classroom review example.
examples.zh: 在课堂综述示例中，我们将「报告规范」与对偏倚的判断区分开。

words.enDefinition: a selected microscope view that illustrates features typical of the tissue or category under discussion

examples.en: We chose a representative field showing the cell layers that were visible throughout the supplied teaching section.
examples.zh: 我们选取一个能显示整张教学切片上均可见细胞层的「代表性视野」。

examples.en: The instructor explained why one representative field could illustrate the arrangement but could not capture all variations.
examples.zh: 老师解释，单个「代表性视野」能够展示排列方式，但无法包含所有变异。

words.enDefinition: A formal favourable decision from the relevant ethics review body about a specified research proposal.

examples.en: The fictional report states the research ethics approval reference beside its description of the study setting.
examples.zh: 虚构报告在研究场景描述旁列出「研究伦理批准」编号。

examples.en: We checked what the research ethics approval covered before reading the fictional follow-up results in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核查「研究伦理批准」涵盖哪些内容，再读虚构随访结果。

words.enDefinition: An independent body that reviews research involving people for ethical acceptability and participant safeguards.

examples.en: The research ethics committee is identified at the end of the fictional study's methods section.
examples.zh: 虚构研究的方法部分末尾写明了「研究伦理委员会」。

examples.en: We located the research ethics committee statement before reading the model participant information sheet in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找到有关「研究伦理委员会」的声明，再阅读参与者信息说明示例。

collocations: review by a research ethics committee
approval from a research ethics committee

words.enDefinition: the air volume remaining in the lungs after the fullest possible expiration

examples.en: The diagram labels residual volume below the level reached at the end of a maximal exhalation.
examples.zh: 示意图将最大呼气后仍留在肺内的气体容积标为「残气量」。

examples.en: We noted that the simple simulated spirometer trace could not directly show the residual volume.
examples.zh: 我们注意到，模拟的普通肺量计曲线无法直接显示「残气量」。

words.enDefinition: a small airway with alveoli opening from its wall, marking the beginning of the respiratory zone

examples.en: The first scattered wall alveoli identify the respiratory bronchiole in the classroom model of lung branches.
examples.zh: 课堂肺分支模型中，管壁上最先零散出现的肺泡标示出「呼吸性细支气管」。

examples.en: We followed the respiratory bronchiole toward the alveolar ducts at the ends of the model pathways.
examples.zh: 我们沿「呼吸性细支气管」追踪至模型通路末端的肺泡管。

words.enDefinition: the thin barrier through which oxygen and carbon dioxide diffuse between alveolar air and capillary blood

examples.en: We marked the respiratory membrane between the airspace and the capillary lumen in the enlarged model.
examples.zh: 我们在放大模型上，标出气腔与毛细血管腔之间的「呼吸膜」。

examples.en: The diagram shows carbon dioxide crossing the respiratory membrane in the opposite direction from oxygen.
examples.zh: 图中二氧化碳穿过「呼吸膜」的方向与氧相反。

words.enDefinition: the organs and passageways that move air and enable gas exchange between the lungs and blood

examples.en: The respiratory system drawing divides the airflow pathway into upper and lower portions for study.
examples.zh: 「呼吸系统」图将气流通路分成上下两部分供学习。

examples.en: We used an arrow on the respiratory system model to follow air from the nose to the lungs.
examples.zh: 我们在「呼吸系统」模型上用箭头追踪空气从鼻部到肺部的路径。

words.enDefinition: the lung regions containing alveoli where respiratory gases are exchanged with the blood

examples.en: We highlighted the respiratory zone where the airspaces lie next to networks of pulmonary capillaries in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们突出显示了气腔与肺毛细血管网相邻的「呼吸区」。

examples.en: The alveolar ducts and sacs appear within the respiratory zone on the diagram beside the model.
examples.zh: 在模型旁的图中，肺泡管与肺泡囊都位于「呼吸区」内。

collocations: gas exchange in the respiratory zone

words.enDefinition: the voltage inside a cell relative to outside when the cell is not actively signaling

examples.en: The baseline represents resting membrane potential before a brief input changes the voltage in the neuron model.
examples.zh: 在神经元模型中，短暂输入改变电压前的基线代表「静息膜电位」。

examples.en: We compared the resting membrane potential with the marked threshold on the synthetic recording in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将合成记录中的「静息膜电位」与标出的阈值作比较。

collocations: resting membrane potential of a neuron

words.enDefinition: a downward projection of epidermis into the dermis between adjacent dermal papillae

examples.en: We marked the rete ridge extending downward between two dermal projections in the classroom section of skin.
examples.zh: 在课堂皮肤切片图上，我们标出向下伸入两个真皮突起之间的「表皮突」。

examples.en: We traced the sides of a rete ridge where it joined surrounding epidermis on the enlarged image.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的图上沿一处「表皮突」与周围表皮相连的两侧辨认其轮廓。

words.enDefinition: the deeper dermal layer, largely made of dense irregular connective tissue with thick fiber bundles

examples.en: The reticular dermis shows thicker bundles of fibers than the superficial region in the classroom section.
examples.zh: 在课堂切片中，「真皮网状层」里的纤维束比浅层区域的更粗。

examples.en: We labeled the reticular dermis beneath the superficial layer and above the subcutaneous fat in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中，于表浅层下方和皮下脂肪上方标出「真皮网状层」。

words.enDefinition: Thin connective tissue strands that form a supporting mesh around cells

examples.en: The model shows reticular fibers forming a fine network around the illustrated cells.
examples.zh: 模型显示「网状纤维」在图示细胞周围形成细密网络。

examples.en: We labeled the delicate mesh of reticular fibers in the supporting tissue drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在支撑组织图中标出了细密的「网状纤维」网。

words.enDefinition: Young red blood cell retaining residual ribosomal material after losing its nucleus

examples.en: The diagram places a reticulocyte just before the fully mature red cell.
examples.zh: 示意图把「网织红细胞」放在完全成熟的红细胞之前。

examples.en: The illustrated reticulocyte retains ribosomal material even after the nucleus disappears.
examples.zh: 图中「网织红细胞」失去细胞核后仍留有核糖体成分。

words.enDefinition: A cohort study that reconstructs group membership, exposures, and later outcomes from records available at study initiation.

examples.en: The retrospective cohort study uses fictional records that already contain dates for activities and later outcomes.
examples.zh: 「回顾性队列研究」采用已记录活动和后续结局日期的虚构资料。

examples.en: We compared the starting date of the retrospective cohort study with the dates in its records.
examples.zh: 我们将「回顾性队列研究」的启动日期与其中的记录日期作了比较。

collocations: records for a retrospective cohort study
evidence from a retrospective cohort study

words.enDefinition: the rotating microscope part holding several objectives and bringing one at a time into the light path

examples.en: The revolving nosepiece holds three objective lenses in the labeled drawing of the classroom microscope.
examples.zh: 在课堂显微镜标注图上，「物镜转换器」装有三个物镜。

examples.en: We followed the circular arrow beside the revolving nosepiece to see how another objective enters the light path.
examples.zh: 我们沿「物镜转换器」旁的圆弧箭头，观察另一物镜如何进入光路。

words.enDefinition: Classification of blood based on a group of red cell surface proteins

examples.en: The Rh blood group system table highlights one named marker on the classroom card.
examples.zh: 「Rh血型系统」的表格突出显示了课堂卡片上的一个有名称的标志。

examples.en: We read the Rh blood group system label separately from the ABO label on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中分别读取了「Rh血型系统」标签和 ABO 标签。

collocations: antigens in the Rh blood group system
diagram of the Rh blood group system
marker in the Rh blood group system

words.enDefinition: Blood whose red cells lack the D marker of the Rh system

examples.en: The Rh-negative blood card shows the red cells without the D symbol.
examples.zh: 「Rh阴性血」卡片上的红细胞图形没有 D 标志。

examples.en: We matched the minus sign to Rh-negative blood on the fictional label.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构标签上把减号与「Rh阴性血」配对。

words.enDefinition: Blood whose red cells carry the D marker of the Rh system

examples.en: The Rh-positive blood card includes a D symbol on each illustrated red cell.
examples.zh: 「Rh阳性血」卡片上的每个红细胞图形都带有 D 标志。

examples.en: We matched the plus sign to Rh-positive blood on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表上把加号与「Rh阳性血」配对。

words.enDefinition: Red cell surface protein determining the commonly used positive or negative Rh label

examples.en: The chart draws the RhD antigen as a separate symbol beside the ABO markers.
examples.zh: 图表在 ABO 标志旁用一个独立符号表示「RhD抗原」。

examples.en: We located the RhD antigen on the fictional red cell illustration in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂使用的虚构红细胞插图上找到了「RhD抗原」。

words.enDefinition: the heart chamber that receives blood from systemic veins and passes it to the right ventricle

examples.en: The two large systemic veins enter the right atrium at different levels on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型上，两条较大的体循环静脉从不同高度进入「右心房」。

examples.en: An arrow shows blood passing from the right atrium through the tricuspid valve in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中箭头表示血液从「右心房」经过三尖瓣。

words.enDefinition: Follow-up that ends while the event has not been observed, leaving its later occurrence time unknown.

examples.en: The diagram marks right-censored follow-up when the fictional record ends before any event is observed.
examples.zh: 虚构记录在观测到事件之前就已结束时，图中标为「右删失随访」。

examples.en: We distinguished right-censored follow-up from an event recorded at the final visit in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「右删失随访」与末次访视记录到事件的情况区分开。

words.enDefinition: Abdominal quadrant below the navel on the body's right side

examples.en: The chart puts the right lower quadrant below the crossing at the navel.
examples.zh: 图表将「右下腹象限」画在肚脐处十字交点的下方。

examples.en: We located the right lower quadrant before checking the labels on the reverse side.
examples.zh: 我们先定位「右下腹象限」，再查看背页的标注。

collocations: right lower quadrant of the abdomen
model of the right lower quadrant

words.enDefinition: Duct typically draining the right upper region of the body into veins

examples.en: The chart shows the right lymphatic duct as a short channel near the neck.
examples.zh: 图表将「右淋巴导管」画成颈部附近的一条短通道。

examples.en: We shaded the region connected to the right lymphatic duct in our model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型中给与「右淋巴导管」相连的区域涂上阴影。

collocations: drainage into the right lymphatic duct
diagram of the right lymphatic duct

words.enDefinition: Abdominal quadrant above the navel on the body's right side

examples.en: The right upper quadrant appears on our left when we face the model.
examples.zh: 当我们面对模型时，「右上腹象限」出现在我们的左边。

examples.en: We placed the arrow in the right upper quadrant above the model's navel.
examples.zh: 我们把箭头画在模型肚脐上方的「右上腹象限」内。

collocations: right upper quadrant of the abdomen
model of the right upper quadrant

words.enDefinition: the heart chamber that pumps blood into the pulmonary trunk toward the lungs

examples.en: We followed the right ventricle outlet to the pulmonary trunk on the labeled model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在有标记的模型中从「右心室」出口追踪至肺动脉干。

examples.en: The wall of the right ventricle is thinner than the wall of the left in our section.
examples.zh: 在我们观察的切面上，「右心室」壁比左心室壁薄。

collocations: blood ejected by the right ventricle

words.enDefinition: The difference between the event probabilities of two groups over the same defined period.

examples.en: The risk difference is expressed in percentage points in the classroom table of synthetic event proportions.
examples.zh: 课堂合成事件比例表用百分点表示「风险差」。

examples.en: We calculated the risk difference by subtracting the comparison group's proportion from the first group's proportion.
examples.zh: 我们用第一组的比例减去比较组的比例，计算「风险差」。

collocations: confidence interval for a risk difference

words.enDefinition: An appraisal of whether a study's methods or conduct could systematically distort a specified result.

examples.en: The risk of bias assessment links each judgement to a feature of the fictional study report.
examples.zh: 「偏倚风险评估」将每项判断与虚构研究报告中的一处特征相联系。

examples.en: We read the risk of bias assessment before comparing the estimates from the modelled studies.
examples.zh: 我们先读「偏倚风险评估」，再比较模型研究给出的估计值。

collocations: conduct a risk of bias assessment
document a risk of bias assessment
domain of a risk of bias assessment

words.enDefinition: The risk of an event in one group divided by the risk in a comparison group over the same period.

examples.en: The risk ratio compares two fictional event proportions measured over the same follow-up interval in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「风险比」比较在同一随访时段测得的两个虚构事件比例。

examples.en: We checked the reference group before interpreting a risk ratio greater than one in the table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对参照组，再解读表中一个大于一的「风险比」。

collocations: confidence interval for a risk ratio

words.enDefinition: a retinal sensory cell that is highly sensitive to light and supports vision under dim conditions

examples.en: The rod photoreceptor responded at a lower light level than the cone in our simplified classroom model.
examples.zh: 在简化的课堂模型中，「视杆感光细胞」能在低于视锥细胞所需的光照强度下响应。

examples.en: We labeled one rod photoreceptor in the retinal drawing showing cells outside the central fovea.
examples.zh: 我们在显示中央凹外区域的视网膜图上标出一个「视杆感光细胞」。

collocations: light detected by a rod photoreceptor

words.enDefinition: The four shoulder muscles and their tendons that help stabilise the head of the humerus in the socket.

examples.en: The rotator cuff is highlighted around the shoulder joint in the supplied classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 给定课堂示意图在肩关节周围突出标出「肩袖」。

examples.en: We labelled the four muscles of the rotator cuff on the model of the shoulder.
examples.zh: 我们在肩部模型上标出组成「肩袖」的四块肌肉。

words.enDefinition: an inner-ear vestibular sac especially sensitive to vertical linear acceleration when the head is upright

examples.en: We labeled the saccule below the utricle on the enlarged diagram of the classroom inner ear model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂内耳模型的放大图中，在椭圆囊下方标出「球囊」。

examples.en: The model links the saccule to vertical linear acceleration with the head in an upright position.
examples.zh: 模型把「球囊」与头部直立时感知垂直线加速度联系起来。

words.enDefinition: The triangular bone at the base of the vertebral column, formed from fused sacral vertebrae.

examples.en: The sacrum appears between the two hip bones in the rear view of the pelvis model.
examples.zh: 骨盆模型的后视图上，「骶骨」位于左右髋骨之间。

examples.en: We identified the sacrum before putting the lower spine and the pelvis together on the model.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「骶骨」，再在模型上把脊柱下部与骨盆拼合起来。

words.enDefinition: A synovial joint in which each surface curves inward in one direction and outward in another.

examples.en: The saddle joint is shown where the thumb meets the wrist on our teaching model.
examples.zh: 教学模型把「鞍状关节」画在拇指与腕部相接的部位。

examples.en: We looked at both curved surfaces of the saddle joint in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们观察课堂示意图中「鞍状关节」的两个曲面。

words.enDefinition: Vertical plane dividing the body into left and right portions

examples.en: A sagittal plane divides the model into a left portion and a right portion.
examples.zh: 「矢状面」把模型分成左部和右部。

examples.en: Our sagittal plane is drawn slightly to the left of the body's center.
examples.zh: 图中的「矢状面」画在人体正中线稍偏左的位置。

words.enDefinition: Enzyme in saliva that begins breaking starch into smaller carbohydrates

examples.en: The lecture places salivary amylase at the beginning of starch digestion in humans.
examples.zh: 课堂将「唾液淀粉酶」的作用放在人体淀粉消化的起始阶段。

examples.en: Our flowchart shows that salivary amylase starts breaking down starch in the mouth.
examples.zh: 流程图显示，「唾液淀粉酶」在口腔内开始分解淀粉。

words.enDefinition: Gland that produces saliva and releases it into the oral cavity

examples.en: The chart marks a salivary gland with a duct leading into the mouth.
examples.zh: 图表标出一处「唾液腺」，它的导管通入口腔。

examples.en: We followed the illustrated duct from the salivary gland to its opening.
examples.zh: 我们沿图示导管，从「唾液腺」一直看到它的开口。

words.enDefinition: propagation along a myelinated axon in which action potentials are regenerated at successive nodes

examples.en: The animation represents saltatory conduction by showing electrical spikes regenerated at gaps between the myelinated segments.
examples.zh: 动画通过显示电尖峰在有髓轴突节段之间的间隙处再生，表示「跳跃式传导」。

examples.en: We compared saltatory conduction with propagation along the entire length of an unmyelinated model axon.
examples.zh: 我们把「跳跃式传导」与模拟无髓轴突沿全长进行的传导作比较。

words.enDefinition: The repeating contractile unit of a myofibril, extending from one Z disc to the next.

examples.en: The sarcomere on the diagram begins and ends at the two dark boundary lines.
examples.zh: 示意图中的「肌节」以两条深色边界线为起点和终点。

examples.en: We compared the length of a sarcomere in the two frames of the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂动画的两个画面里一个「肌节」的长度。

words.enDefinition: A fatty acid with no carbon-carbon double bonds along its hydrocarbon chain.

examples.en: We identified the saturated fatty acid by checking that the carbon chain contained only single bonds.
examples.zh: 我们确认碳链上只有单键，认出了「饱和脂肪酸」。

examples.en: The saturated fatty acid appeared as a comparatively straight chain in the classroom model of membrane lipids.
examples.zh: 在课堂膜脂模型中，「饱和脂肪酸」对应的链条比较直。

collocations: a saturated fatty acid in a lipid

words.enDefinition: a labeled line on an image representing a known real distance

examples.en: We used the scale bar in the corner of the image to estimate the width of the gland.
examples.zh: 我们利用图像角落的「比例尺标线」估计腺体宽度。

examples.en: The enlarged image kept a scale bar so readers could compare real distances despite different displayed sizes.
examples.zh: 放大图保留了「比例尺标线」，让读者即使面对不同显示尺寸也能比较实际距离。

collocations: measure a feature using a scale bar

words.enDefinition: an image made from signals generated as a focused electron beam scans the specimen's surface

examples.en: The scanning electron micrograph reveals ridges on the surface rather than internal layers of the pictured tissue.
examples.zh: 「扫描电子显微图」呈现所示组织表面的隆起，可与内部各层图像区分。

examples.en: We compared surface textures in the scanning electron micrograph using the labeled regions in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们依据图谱中标出的区域，对照了「扫描电子显微图」中的表面纹理。

collocations: scanning electron micrograph of a surface
scale bar on a scanning electron micrograph

words.enDefinition: The flat triangular bone at the back of the shoulder that articulates with the humerus and clavicle.

examples.en: The scapula is triangular in the posterior view of the classroom shoulder model.
examples.zh: 在课堂肩部模型的后视图中，「肩胛骨」呈三角形。

examples.en: We located the scapula before fitting the upper arm bone to the shoulder model.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「肩胛骨」，再将上臂骨与肩部模型接合。

words.enDefinition: a peripheral glial cell that supports axons and can form one segment of a myelin sheath

examples.en: The peripheral nerve drawing places one Schwann cell around a single myelinated segment of the axon.
examples.zh: 周围神经图中，一个「施万细胞」围绕轴突的一处有髓节段。

examples.en: We labeled the Schwann cell in the peripheral nerve illustration before comparing it with central myelin.
examples.zh: 我们在周围神经图上标出「施万细胞」，再与中枢神经系统的髓鞘作对照。

collocations: Schwann cell wrapped around an axon

words.enDefinition: A review that systematically maps the types, concepts, and coverage of evidence in a broad area.

examples.en: The scoping review maps the kinds of activity measures reported across the fictional studies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「范围综述」梳理各项虚构研究报告了哪些类型的活动指标。

examples.en: We read the scoping review to identify areas with little research in the textbook example.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「范围综述」，找出教材示例中研究较少的领域。

collocations: evidence map from a scoping review

words.enDefinition: a skin gland that secretes an oily substance, usually into a hair follicle

examples.en: The sebaceous gland appears as rounded clusters connected to the hair follicle on the class reference section.
examples.zh: 课堂参考切片中，「皮脂腺」呈与毛囊相连的圆形细胞簇。

examples.en: We followed the short opening from the sebaceous gland into the follicle drawn on the skin model.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「皮脂腺」通入皮肤模型所画毛囊的短通道追踪。

words.enDefinition: the oily mixture secreted by sebaceous glands onto the skin or into hair follicles

examples.en: The arrows in the diagram show sebum passing from its gland into the channel around the hair.
examples.zh: 图中箭头表示，「皮脂」从其腺体流入毛发周围的通道。

examples.en: We identified sebum as the oily secretion pictured beside the gland in the classroom model of skin.
examples.zh: 在课堂皮肤模型上，我们将腺体旁所示的油性分泌物标为「皮脂」。

words.enDefinition: the sound associated with closure of the aortic and pulmonary valves near the end of ventricular ejection

examples.en: The class aligned the second heart sound with closure of the outlet valves on the model timeline.
examples.zh: 全班把「第二心音」对齐到模型时间线上的出口瓣膜关闭处。

examples.en: On the sample recording, the second heart sound followed the period during which the ventricles ejected blood.
examples.zh: 在示例录音中，「第二心音」出现在心室射血阶段之后。

collocations: timing of the second heart sound
components of the second heart sound

words.enDefinition: Physiological stage in which fibrin stabilizes the earlier platelet plug

examples.en: The flowchart shows secondary hemostasis adding a network around the platelet plug.
examples.zh: 流程图显示，「二期止血」给血小板栓加上一层网状结构。

examples.en: We used secondary hemostasis to label the fibrin stage of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型中用「二期止血」标注出现纤维蛋白的阶段。

words.enDefinition: Organ where mature lymphocytes encounter antigens and can mount responses

examples.en: The table lists a lymph node as a secondary lymphoid organ in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型中，表格把淋巴结列为「次级淋巴器官」。

examples.en: We marked where cells gather within a secondary lymphoid organ in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中标出了细胞在「次级淋巴器官」内聚集的位置。

collocations: example of a secondary lymphoid organ
function of a secondary lymphoid organ

words.enDefinition: An additional outcome identified in a study alongside the main outcome.

examples.en: The secondary outcome records how participants described the clarity of the fictional questionnaire in class.
examples.zh: 「次要结局」记录参与者如何描述课堂虚构问卷的清晰度。

examples.en: We compared the secondary outcome with the main outcome listed at the top of the table.
examples.zh: 我们把「次要结局」与表格顶部列出的主要结局作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an artifact where part of a tissue slice bends back or overlaps, often creating a darker region

examples.en: The section fold appeared as an unusually dark stripe where two layers overlapped in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 教学图中，两层重叠的位置出现一条异常深色的条纹，即「切片褶皱」。

examples.en: We marked the section fold before comparing the unobscured cells on either side in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们先标出「切片褶皱」，再比较其两边未被遮盖的细胞。

collocations: dark band from a section fold
area obscured by a section fold

words.enDefinition: a gap or split in a tissue slice caused by damage during preparation or handling

examples.en: The section tear cut across several structures and had uneven edges in the supplied classroom image.
examples.zh: 给出的课堂图中，「切片撕裂」横穿数处结构，边缘不规则。

examples.en: We compared the section tear with a true opening whose sides were lined by cells.
examples.zh: 我们对比「切片撕裂」与一个由细胞衬在两侧的真实开口。

collocations: image affected by a section tear

words.enDefinition: a branch of a lobar bronchus that supplies a bronchopulmonary segment

examples.en: The labeled segmental bronchus enters the smaller outlined region within the lobe on our diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们的图中，标注的「肺段支气管」进入肺叶内勾画出的较小区域。

examples.en: We used a color key to link each segmental bronchus with the region it supplies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用颜色图例将各「肺段支气管」与其供气区域对应起来。

collocations: air supplied by a segmental bronchus

words.enDefinition: Reporting only some measured outcomes or results depending on their findings.

examples.en: The classroom review considers selective outcome reporting when the fictional results omit a prespecified outcome.
examples.zh: 虚构结果漏掉一个预先设定的结局时，课堂综述考虑「选择性结局报告」。

examples.en: We compared the fictional plan and report to discuss the possibility of selective outcome reporting.
examples.zh: 我们把虚构方案与报告作比较，讨论「选择性结局报告」的可能性。

words.enDefinition: one of three curved bony channels housing the ducts whose receptors sense angular head acceleration

examples.en: The model displays each semicircular canal as a loop oriented in a different plane inside the inner ear.
examples.zh: 模型将各「半规管」画成内耳中分别处于不同平面的环。

examples.en: We traced a semicircular canal to the expanded end of the membranous duct inside it.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「半规管」追踪至其中膜性管的膨大端。

words.enDefinition: one of the valves at the ventricular outlets, with pocket-shaped cusps that prevent backward blood flow

examples.en: Three pocket-shaped cusps form the semilunar valve shown at the ventricular outlet in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，心室出口所示的「半月瓣」由三个袋形瓣尖构成。

examples.en: We compared a semilunar valve with a valve between an atrium and its ventricle in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们对比了「半月瓣」与位于心房和心室之间的一处瓣膜。

words.enDefinition: a change, typically a decrease, in the sensory response to a stimulus that remains present

examples.en: The firing rate declined during constant pressure in the model used to illustrate sensory adaptation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂用来说明「感觉适应」的模型中，即使压力保持恒定，放电频率也下降。

examples.en: We compared two receptor responses to show that sensory adaptation can occur at different rates in the model.
examples.zh: 我们比较两种感受器响应，显示模型中的「感觉适应」可有不同速率。

words.enDefinition: a neuron that conveys information from a sensory receptor toward the central nervous system or a local circuit

examples.en: The sensory neuron carries information from the skin toward the spinal cord in the classroom reflex model.
examples.zh: 在课堂反射模型中，「感觉神经元」将信息从皮肤传向脊髓。

examples.en: We traced the sensory neuron from a stretch receptor to a synapse in the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 我们从一个牵张感受器沿「感觉神经元」追踪到脊髓中的一个突触。

collocations: signal carried by a sensory neuron

words.enDefinition: a specialized cell or nerve ending that detects a stimulus and starts a sensory signal

examples.en: The skin diagram shows a sensory receptor that responds when the model deforms the surrounding tissue.
examples.zh: 皮肤图显示，模型使周围组织变形时，一处「感觉感受器」发生响应。

examples.en: We identified the sensory receptor at the starting point of the pathway in the classroom schematic.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图通路的起点辨认出「感觉感受器」。

words.enDefinition: conversion of stimulus energy or a chemical stimulus into an electrical change in a sensory cell or ending

examples.en: The diagram illustrates sensory transduction by connecting a change in light with a change in receptor voltage.
examples.zh: 图中将光照变化与感受器电压变化联系起来，展示「感觉转导」。

examples.en: We used sensory transduction to explain why the simulated nerve signal begins only after the receptor responds.
examples.zh: 我们用「感觉转导」解释为什么模拟的神经信号在感受器作出反应之后才开始。

collocations: sensory transduction in a receptor cell

words.enDefinition: one of a sequence of thin slices taken from neighboring levels of the same specimen

examples.en: The atlas shows each serial section in order so students can follow the shape through the tissue.
examples.zh: 图谱按顺序显示每张「连续切片」，让学生能沿着组织观察结构形状的变化。

examples.en: We compared a serial section with the next image to see where the lumen first appeared.
examples.zh: 我们对照一张「连续切片」与下一张图，观察管腔首次出现的位置。

collocations: compare a serial section with its neighbor

words.enDefinition: An adverse event that meets a specified seriousness criterion based on its outcome or consequences.

examples.en: The serious adverse event category is defined separately from symptom intensity in the fictional report.
examples.zh: 虚构报告将「严重不良事件」类别与症状强度分别定义。

examples.en: We read the serious adverse event definition before comparing the two example report tables in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读「严重不良事件」的定义，再比较两张示例报告表。

words.enDefinition: A specified rule for classifying an adverse event by its outcome or consequences rather than by intensity alone.

examples.en: The seriousness criterion is listed beside the event categories in the fictional study's reporting guide.
examples.zh: 虚构研究的报告指南在事件类别旁列出「严重性判定标准」。

examples.en: We checked which seriousness criterion the simulated event category illustrates in the classroom report.
examples.zh: 我们核对课堂报告的模拟事件类别说明的是哪项「严重性判定标准」。

collocations: apply a seriousness criterion in a report

words.enDefinition: Thin lubricating liquid present between layers of a serous membrane

examples.en: The textbook shows serous fluid as a thin film between the membrane layers.
examples.zh: 教材把「浆液」画成两层膜之间的一层薄薄液体。

examples.en: We discussed how serous fluid reduces friction as the illustrated surfaces move.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了图示表面相对运动时，「浆液」怎样减少摩擦。

words.enDefinition: Thin membrane lining certain internal cavities and covering organs within them

examples.en: The diagram shows a serous membrane lining a wall and folding over an organ.
examples.zh: 示意图显示「浆膜」衬在腔壁上，并反折包覆一个器官。

examples.en: We colored both portions of the serous membrane in the teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们在教学模型中给「浆膜」的两部分都涂上了颜色。

words.enDefinition: the two-layered serous membrane lining the fibrous sac and covering the outer surface of the heart

examples.en: The model shows the serous pericardium reflected from the inner sac onto the surface of the heart.
examples.zh: 模型显示，「浆膜心包」从囊内衬向心脏表面反折。

examples.en: We colored both layers of the serous pericardium before labeling the narrow space between them in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先给「浆膜心包」的两层着色，再标出两层间的狭窄空间。

collocations: parietal layer of the serous pericardium
visceral layer of the serous pericardium

words.enDefinition: A muscle running from the upper ribs to the scapula that helps move it forward around the chest wall.

examples.en: The serratus anterior is shown along the ribs in the side view of the torso model.
examples.zh: 躯干模型的侧视图上，「前锯肌」沿肋骨排列。

examples.en: We located serratus anterior before following its line toward the inner edge of the scapula.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「前锯肌」，再沿着它查看至肩胛骨的内侧缘。

words.enDefinition: Abundant blood protein that transports substances and supports colloid osmotic pressure

examples.en: The chart lists serum albumin among the proteins that carry substances in blood.
examples.zh: 图表将「血清白蛋白」列为在血液中运载物质的蛋白之一。

examples.en: We discussed serum albumin when reading about the osmotic effect of plasma proteins.
examples.zh: 阅读血浆蛋白的渗透作用时，我们讨论了「血清白蛋白」。

words.enDefinition: A bone that develops within a tendon, such as the patella.

examples.en: The patella provides an example of a sesamoid bone in the classroom knee diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂膝部图以髌骨为「籽骨」的例子。

examples.en: We compared the position of a sesamoid bone with the tendon that surrounds it.
examples.zh: 我们观察「籽骨」的位置，并与包裹它的肌腱作比较。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome involved in chromosomal sex determination, such as X or Y in humans.

examples.en: The diagram labels each sex chromosome separately from the numbered autosomal pairs in the teaching example.
examples.zh: 教学示例图将每条「性染色体」与编号的常染色体对分开标注。

examples.en: We found the sex chromosome labels at the end of the arranged human chromosome chart.
examples.zh: 我们在排好的人类染色体图末尾找到了标注「性染色体」的标签。

words.enDefinition: A trait whose expression varies with sex-related biology even when the genotype is the same.

examples.en: The sex-influenced trait differs between the modelled groups despite their matching genotype labels in this exercise.
examples.zh: 本练习的模型组虽然基因型标签相同，「从性性状」的表现却不同。

examples.en: We used a fictional sex-influenced trait to separate expression patterns from the location of the gene.
examples.zh: 我们用虚构「从性性状」区分表型表达模式与基因所在位置。

words.enDefinition: A trait expressed in individuals of only one sex even though its alleles can be present in others.

examples.en: The sex-limited trait appears in one group even though both groups can carry its fictional allele.
examples.zh: 虚构等位基因可在两组中都存在，但「限性性状」只在一组表现。

examples.en: We compared the sex-limited trait with the chromosome-linked feature in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂表中比较「限性性状」与染色体连锁的特征。

words.enDefinition: A trait influenced by a locus on a sex chromosome.

examples.en: The example labels a sex-linked trait because its locus is placed on the X chromosome.
examples.zh: 因为示例位点画在 X 染色体上，示例将该性状标为「伴性性状」。

examples.en: We traced the sex-linked trait through the fictional family diagram using the given allele symbols.
examples.zh: 我们利用给定等位基因符号，在虚构家系图中追踪「伴性性状」。

words.enDefinition: The shorter arm of a chromosome, conventionally designated p in human chromosome notation.

examples.en: The short arm of a chromosome is labelled with a lowercase letter on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图用一个小写字母标出「染色体短臂」。

examples.en: We pointed to the short arm of a chromosome before locating the indicated band on it.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「染色体短臂」，再在上面找到所指的区带。

collocations: label the short arm of a chromosome
band on the short arm of a chromosome
identify the short arm of a chromosome

words.enDefinition: A bone whose length, width, and thickness are roughly similar, such as many wrist bones.

examples.en: The tutor used a wrist bone to illustrate the shape of a typical short bone.
examples.zh: 老师用一块腕骨说明典型「短骨」的形状。

examples.en: We compared a short bone with a long bone using the two classroom models.
examples.zh: 我们用两个课堂模型比较「短骨」与长骨。

words.enDefinition: The group of siblings sharing the same recorded parents within a pedigree.

examples.en: The sibship is drawn under one pair of parental symbols in the fictional pedigree.
examples.zh: 在这张虚构家系图上，「同胞组」画在同一对亲代符号下方。

examples.en: We counted the members of the sibship before comparing their labels in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先数「同胞组」内成员，再比较练习图中的各个标签。

words.enDefinition: Curved final section of the colon leading into the rectum

examples.en: The sigmoid colon forms a curve before joining the rectum in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「乙状结肠」在与直肠相接之前形成一处弯曲。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the sigmoid colon after labeling the straight descending portion above it.
examples.zh: 老师先标出其上方较直的降结肠段，再标出「乙状结肠」。

collocations: junction of the sigmoid colon and rectum

words.enDefinition: the value of the reconstructed MRI signal at an image location under stated acquisition settings

examples.en: The instructor asked us to compare signal intensity between adjacent structures within the same teaching image.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在同一张教学图像中比较相邻结构的「信号强度」。

examples.en: We compared relative signal intensity within each displayed sequence using nearby tissue as a reference.
examples.zh: 我们以邻近组织为参照，在各序列内部比较相对「信号强度」。

words.enDefinition: Single epithelial layer with cells taller than they are wide

examples.en: In the intestine drawing, simple columnar epithelium appears as a single row of tall cells.
examples.zh: 在肠道示意图中，「单层柱状上皮」呈现为一排高细胞。

examples.en: We identified the simple columnar epithelium by looking for one continuous layer of columns.
examples.zh: 我们根据一层连续的柱形细胞辨认出了「单层柱状上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Single layer of epithelial cells roughly equal in height and width

examples.en: The simple cuboidal epithelium forms a single ring around the opening in our drawing.
examples.zh: 在图中，「单层立方上皮」围绕开口形成单独的一圈。

examples.en: We labeled simple cuboidal epithelium around a small tubule on the textbook illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在教材插图中的一段小管周围标出了「单层立方上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Epithelial sheet composed of one layer of cells along the basement membrane

examples.en: The model shows simple epithelium as one continuous row of closely spaced cells.
examples.zh: 模型将「单层上皮」画成一排连续、排列紧密的细胞。

examples.en: We identified simple epithelium after seeing a single cell layer from base to surface.
examples.zh: 看到从基底到表面只有一层细胞后，我们辨认出这是「单层上皮」。

words.enDefinition: Single layer of flattened epithelial cells, often forming a thin barrier

examples.en: The atlas shows simple squamous epithelium as a remarkably thin layer in the lung model.
examples.zh: 图谱把肺模型中的「单层鳞状上皮」画成很薄的一层。

examples.en: We recognized simple squamous epithelium by the single row of flat cells in section.
examples.zh: 我们根据切面上单排扁平细胞辨认出了「单层鳞状上皮」。

words.enDefinition: A characteristic whose inheritance is governed primarily by variation in one gene.

examples.en: The exercise uses a single-gene trait so the class can follow one locus through the diagram.
examples.zh: 练习使用一种「单基因性状」，使全班可沿图追踪一个位点。

examples.en: We labelled the fictional single-gene trait before comparing its two observable categories in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出虚构的「单基因性状」，再比较两种可观察类别。

words.enDefinition: the cluster of cells in the right atrium that normally initiates each heartbeat

examples.en: The animation starts electrical activation at the sinoatrial node near the upper right atrium in the model.
examples.zh: 模型动画中的电激动从靠近右心房上部的「窦房结」开始。

examples.en: We marked the sinoatrial node before tracing the signal across the atrial walls in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出「窦房结」，再沿心房壁追踪信号。

words.enDefinition: The two replicated copies of a chromosome that remain joined until they separate during division.

examples.en: The sister chromatids are drawn as two adjoining copies of one chromosome in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「姐妹染色单体」画成同一条染色体彼此相连的两个副本。

examples.en: We traced the sister chromatids after the model shows each copy moving to a different side.
examples.zh: 模型展示两个副本分别移向两侧时，我们继续追踪原先的「姐妹染色单体」。

words.enDefinition: the contribution of skeletal muscle contractions and venous valves to moving venous blood toward the heart

examples.en: The model of the skeletal muscle pump shows calf muscles squeezing nearby veins as they shorten.
examples.zh: 「骨骼肌泵」模型显示，小腿肌肉缩短时挤压附近静脉。

examples.en: We added arrows to show how valves guide flow during the action of the skeletal muscle pump.
examples.zh: 我们添加箭头，展示「骨骼肌泵」活动时静脉瓣如何引导血流。

collocations: action of the skeletal muscle pump

words.enDefinition: Muscle composed of long striated fibers involved in voluntary body movement

examples.en: The skeletal muscle tissue image shows long parallel fibers with visible bands across them.
examples.zh: 「骨骼肌组织」图像呈现出平行排列的长纤维，横向有清晰条纹。

examples.en: We labeled skeletal muscle tissue in the region attached to the model's bone.
examples.zh: 我们在与模型骨相连的部位标出了「骨骼肌组织」。

words.enDefinition: A generation in a pedigree where a trait is unobserved between generations in which it appears.

examples.en: The skipped generation is unshaded between two shaded entries in the fictional classroom pedigree.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构家系图中，两个涂色项目之间是「未表现性状的一代」，因此未涂色。

examples.en: We compared the skipped generation with the allele labels retained in the fictional family model.
examples.zh: 我们把「未表现性状的一代」与虚构家系模型中保留的等位基因标记作对照。

words.enDefinition: the extent of a selected or reconstructed imaging slice in the direction perpendicular to its plane

examples.en: The metadata lists slice thickness alongside the orientation for each view of the teaching scan in class.
examples.zh: 课堂教学扫描的元数据在各视图的方位旁列出「层厚」。

examples.en: We compared slice thickness with the distance between adjacent slice centers, which differed in one example.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「层厚」和相邻层面中心之间的距离，两者在一个示例中并不相同。

words.enDefinition: a small overview image of a digitized microscope slide used to locate a magnified region

examples.en: The slide thumbnail marked the current viewing area with a rectangle on the small overview image.
examples.zh: 「切片缩略图」在缩小的全图上用一个矩形标出当前查看的区域。

examples.en: We selected a new corner of the tissue on the slide thumbnail during the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习时，我们在「切片缩略图」上选择组织的另一个角落。

collocations: current position on the slide thumbnail
select a region on the slide thumbnail

words.enDefinition: The model in which a sarcomere shortens as actin and myosin filaments slide past each other.

examples.en: The sliding filament theory explains why the boundaries of the sarcomere move closer in the animation.
examples.zh: 「肌丝滑行学说」解释了为什么动画里的两个肌节边界会彼此靠近。

examples.en: We drew two frames to illustrate the sliding filament theory on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习纸上画出两个画面，说明「肌丝滑行学说」。

collocations: diagram of the sliding filament theory

words.enDefinition: Digestive tube between stomach and large intestine where most nutrient absorption occurs

examples.en: The small intestine is drawn in loops between the stomach and large intestine.
examples.zh: 「小肠」在胃与大肠之间画成多段盘曲的肠襻。

examples.en: We labeled three successive regions of the small intestine on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题图上标出了「小肠」依次相连的三个肠段。

collocations: nutrient absorption in the small intestine

words.enDefinition: A pattern in which smaller studies tend to report systematically different effects from larger studies.

examples.en: The classroom graph suggests small-study effects because smaller fictional studies tend to report larger differences.
examples.zh: 课堂图提示「小样本研究效应」，因为样本较小的虚构研究往往报告较大的差异。

examples.en: We discussed several possible explanations for small-study effects before drawing conclusions about the simulated figure.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「小样本研究效应」的几种可能解释，再对模拟图下结论。

words.enDefinition: Muscle without visible striations that forms parts of hollow organ walls

examples.en: The gut wall model marks a layer of smooth muscle tissue beneath the lining.
examples.zh: 肠壁模型在内衬下方标出一层「平滑肌组织」。

examples.en: We recognized smooth muscle tissue from the narrow cells lacking obvious bands in the illustration.
examples.zh: 图中细长的细胞没有明显条纹，据此我们辨认出了「平滑肌组织」。

words.enDefinition: a CT display setting that emphasizes attenuation differences among soft tissues

examples.en: The soft-tissue window made neighboring soft tissue regions easier to distinguish on the classroom display.
examples.zh: 课堂展示中，「软组织窗」使相邻软组织区域更易辨认。

examples.en: We compared the soft-tissue window with another display made from the same reconstructed scan in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们把「软组织窗」与同一重建扫描的另一种显示作对照。

collocations: image shown in a soft-tissue window

words.enDefinition: A broad calf muscle beneath the gastrocnemius that helps plantar flex the ankle.

examples.en: The soleus lies beneath the more superficial calf muscle in the classroom cutaway view.
examples.zh: 课堂剖面图中，「比目鱼肌」位于较浅层小腿后侧肌肉下方。

examples.en: We identified the soleus by comparing the deep and superficial views of the leg model.
examples.zh: 我们比较腿部模型的深层与浅层视图，找出「比目鱼肌」。

words.enDefinition: A body cell outside the reproductive germ line.

examples.en: The worksheet uses a skin cell as an example of a typical human somatic cell.
examples.zh: 练习用皮肤细胞作为一种典型人类「体细胞」的示例。

examples.en: We compared the chromosome sets in a somatic cell and a gamete in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂图中一个「体细胞」与一个配子的染色体组。

words.enDefinition: the division that carries information from bodily senses and sends motor signals to skeletal muscles

examples.en: The somatic nervous system sends commands to skeletal muscles during a voluntary movement in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，「躯体神经系统」在随意运动时向骨骼肌发出指令。

examples.en: We mapped a skin sensory signal and an arm motor signal within the somatic nervous system.
examples.zh: 我们在「躯体神经系统」图中标出了皮肤感觉信号和手臂运动信号。

collocations: motor signals in the somatic nervous system

words.enDefinition: A genetic variant arising in a body cell lineage outside the reproductive germ line.

examples.en: The somatic variant is marked in one branch of the fictional body cell lineage chart.
examples.zh: 虚构体细胞谱系图在一个分支里标出了「体细胞变异」。

examples.en: We followed the somatic variant through its labelled descendant cells in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂示意图带标记的后代细胞追踪「体细胞变异」。

collocations: somatic variant in a cell lineage

words.enDefinition: the combination of simultaneous or overlapping postsynaptic effects from inputs arriving at different sites

examples.en: The drawing shows spatial summation when signals from two different branches combine at the model neuron.
examples.zh: 图中两条不同分支的信号在模型神经元中合并，显示了「空间总和作用」。

examples.en: We marked the two active synapses on separate branches in the worksheet illustration of spatial summation.
examples.zh: 我们在「空间总和作用」习题图的不同分支上，分别标出两个活跃的突触。

words.enDefinition: A lipid built around a sphingoid base rather than a glycerol backbone.

examples.en: Our worksheet labeled the sphingolipid by pointing to its distinct backbone on the membrane comparison chart.
examples.zh: 习题在膜成分比较图中指向特有骨架，为「鞘脂」作出标注。

examples.en: We compared the head groups of one sphingolipid and one glycerol-based lipid in the textbook illustration.
examples.zh: 我们比较了教材图中一种「鞘脂」和一种以甘油为骨架的脂质的头基。

words.enDefinition: a peripheral nerve formed by the union of a dorsal and a ventral root at a spinal level

examples.en: The dorsal and ventral roots unite near an intervertebral foramen to form a spinal nerve.
examples.zh: 后根与前根在椎间孔附近会合，形成一条「脊神经」。

examples.en: We identified the spinal nerve beyond the junction before following its branches on the model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先辨认会合处外侧的「脊神经」，再在模型上追踪其各条分支。

words.enDefinition: A reporting guideline specifying essential items for protocols of randomised trials.

examples.en: SPIRIT 2025 is cited in the model protocol provided for the classroom trial reading exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂试验阅读练习提供的方案示例中，引用了「SPIRIT 2025 方案报告规范」。

examples.en: We used SPIRIT 2025 to distinguish a documented protocol from the separate final trial report.
examples.zh: 我们借助「SPIRIT 2025 方案报告规范」区分成文方案与另行编写的试验结果报告。

words.enDefinition: Lymphoid organ that filters blood and helps remove aging red cells

examples.en: The spleen sits high on the left side of the abdominal model.
examples.zh: 在腹部模型中，「脾脏」位于左侧较高的位置。

examples.en: We colored the spleen next to the stomach in the torso diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在躯干图中给胃旁的「脾脏」上色。

words.enDefinition: Blood-rich region of the spleen involved in filtering aging red cells

examples.en: The section shows splenic red pulp across much of the enlarged model's interior.
examples.zh: 截面图显示「脾红髓」占放大模型内部的大部分。

examples.en: We located vessels within the splenic red pulp on the colored atlas figure.
examples.zh: 我们在彩图图谱的「脾红髓」中找到了血管。

collocations: blood vessels of the splenic red pulp
diagram of the splenic red pulp

words.enDefinition: Immune tissue of the spleen arranged around branches of its arteries

examples.en: The splenic white pulp forms pale islands around small arterial branches in the figure.
examples.zh: 图中，「脾白髓」在小动脉分支周围形成浅色岛状区域。

examples.en: We marked the splenic white pulp separately from the larger blood-rich region.
examples.zh: 我们分别标出了「脾白髓」和较大的富血区域。

collocations: lymphocytes in the splenic white pulp
diagram of the splenic white pulp

words.enDefinition: Bone tissue formed by a network of thin struts with marrow spaces between them.

examples.en: The spongy bone has a network pattern in the enlarged picture of the bone end.
examples.zh: 骨端的放大图上，「松质骨」呈网状。

examples.en: We shaded the spongy bone differently from the denser outer layer on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习图上用不同阴影区分「松质骨」与较致密的外层。

words.enDefinition: A statement describing the sponsor's involvement in a study's design, conduct, analysis, or reporting.

examples.en: The sponsor role statement describes whether the fictional funder took part in analysing the study data.
examples.zh: 「申办方角色说明」交代虚构资助方是否参与研究数据的分析。

examples.en: We read the sponsor role statement before discussing the independence of the fictional report in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先读「申办方角色说明」，再讨论虚构报告的独立性。

collocations: sponsor role statement in a report

words.enDefinition: Flat epithelial cell whose width exceeds its height in side view

examples.en: The drawing shows a squamous epithelial cell as a thin shape with a flattened outline.
examples.zh: 图中将「鳞状上皮细胞」画成轮廓扁平的薄片状结构。

examples.en: We found a squamous epithelial cell near the exposed surface of the illustrated layer.
examples.zh: 我们在图示组织层朝外的表面附近找到了一个「鳞状上皮细胞」。

collocations: outline of a squamous epithelial cell

words.enDefinition: the visible strength of staining in a specified tissue region under stated imaging conditions

examples.en: The staining intensity was greater in the nucleus than in the surrounding area of the reference cells.
examples.zh: 在参考细胞中，细胞核的「染色强度」大于周边区域。

examples.en: We compared staining intensity only between prepared sections with matched staining and imaging conditions.
examples.zh: 我们只在染色和成像条件一致的已制切片之间比较「染色强度」。

words.enDefinition: A document specifying how study data and outcomes will be analysed and reported.

examples.en: The statistical analysis plan states how the fictional report will summarise the main outcome in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「统计分析计划」说明虚构报告将怎样汇总主要结局。

examples.en: We checked the statistical analysis plan before interpreting the comparisons in the example results table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「统计分析计划」，再解读示例结果表中的各项比较。

words.enDefinition: Variation among observed study effect estimates beyond what their sampling variability would alone be expected to explain.

examples.en: We discussed statistical heterogeneity after comparing the spread of the estimates with each study's uncertainty interval.
examples.zh: 我们将各估计值的离散程度与各项研究的不确定性区间作对照后，讨论了「统计异质性」。

examples.en: We examined statistical heterogeneity before deciding how to describe the combined effect in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「统计异质性」，再决定怎样描述课堂示例的合并效应。

words.enDefinition: The flat bone at the front of the chest that joins many ribs through costal cartilage.

examples.en: The sternum lies at the centre of the chest in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型正视图中，「胸骨」位于胸部中央。

examples.en: We located the sternum first and then followed the neighbouring costal cartilages on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们先在挂图上找出「胸骨」，再沿着相邻的肋软骨看过去。

words.enDefinition: Epithelium with multiple cell layers, with basal cells attached to the basement membrane

examples.en: The drawing shows several stacked layers of stratified epithelium above the supporting membrane.
examples.zh: 图中支撑膜上方示出了由好几层细胞叠成的「复层上皮」。

examples.en: We focused on the surface cells to classify the stratified epithelium in the image.
examples.zh: 我们重点观察图中的表层细胞，以确定「复层上皮」的类型。

words.enDefinition: Multilayered epithelium with flattened cells at its exposed surface

examples.en: The stratified squamous epithelium has several layers, and the cells become flatter near the top.
examples.zh: 「复层鳞状上皮」有多层细胞，细胞越靠近表面越扁平。

examples.en: We recognized stratified squamous epithelium by its multiple layers and flattened surface cells.
examples.zh: 我们根据多层结构和扁平的表层细胞辨认出了「复层鳞状上皮」。

words.enDefinition: the deepest layer of the epidermis adjacent to the basement membrane

examples.en: The stratum basale appears as the deepest row of epidermal cells in the labeled classroom skin section.
examples.zh: 在有标注的课堂皮肤切片中，「基底层」是最深的一排表皮细胞。

examples.en: We identified the stratum basale between the basement membrane and the thicker layer just above it.
examples.zh: 我们在基底膜与其上较厚的一层之间辨认出「基底层」。

words.enDefinition: the outermost epidermal layer made of flattened dead cells that help form the skin's barrier

examples.en: The stratum corneum forms the laminated outer covering in the reference image of skin used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂所用皮肤参考图中的「角质层」是呈叠层状的外部覆盖层。

examples.en: We compared the stratum corneum in two anatomical regions and noted the difference in its thickness.
examples.zh: 我们对照两个解剖区域的「角质层」，记录其厚度差异。

collocations: skin barrier of the stratum corneum

words.enDefinition: an epidermal layer containing flattened cells with prominent keratohyalin granules

examples.en: On the enlarged thick skin slide, the stratum granulosum lies immediately beneath the clear layer.
examples.zh: 在放大的厚皮肤切片中，「颗粒层」紧邻透明层下方。

examples.en: We marked the dark granules within cells of the stratum granulosum on the stained classroom reference image.
examples.zh: 我们在染色的课堂参考图中，标记「颗粒层」细胞内的深色颗粒。

words.enDefinition: a thin clear epidermal layer between the granular and outer layers in thick skin, such as palms and soles

examples.en: The stratum lucidum appears as a pale strip below the outermost layer in the thick skin teaching example.
examples.zh: 在课堂厚皮肤示例中，「透明层」呈最外层下方的一道浅色细带。

examples.en: We looked for the stratum lucidum only on the thick skin image when comparing the two reference sections.
examples.zh: 对照两张参考切片时，我们只在厚皮肤图像上寻找「透明层」。

words.enDefinition: the epidermal layer above the basal layer, characterized in many sections by cells with spiny-looking outlines

examples.en: The classroom image labels the stratum spinosum above the single deeper row in the epidermis of the skin.
examples.zh: 课堂图在皮肤表皮中较深的单排细胞上方标出「棘层」。

examples.en: We compared cell shapes in the stratum spinosum with those in the flatter layer above it.
examples.zh: 我们将「棘层」细胞与上方一层较扁平的细胞作形状对照。

words.enDefinition: a reflex contraction of a skeletal muscle in response to its own stretch

examples.en: The animation shows a stretch reflex in which lengthening of the modeled muscle is followed by contraction.
examples.zh: 动画显示一种「牵张反射」，模型肌肉被拉长后发生收缩。

examples.en: We traced the stretch reflex from the muscle length sensor to a spinal motor neuron in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中沿「牵张反射」从肌肉长度感受器追踪至一个脊髓运动神经元。

words.enDefinition: the volume of blood ejected by one ventricle during a single heartbeat

examples.en: We found stroke volume by subtracting the volume after ejection from the volume before ventricular contraction.
examples.zh: 我们从心室收缩前的容积减去射血后的容积，得到「每搏输出量」。

examples.en: We compared stroke volume across two model beats while keeping the simulated heart rate the same.
examples.zh: 在模拟心率不变时，我们对照了两次模拟心跳的「每搏输出量」。

words.enDefinition: the supporting cells and connective framework of an organ or tissue around its specialized structures

examples.en: The drawing shades the stroma around the glandular units to show the tissue that supports them.
examples.zh: 图中为腺体单位周围的「组织间质」涂上阴影，展示起支持作用的组织。

examples.en: We compared the denser stroma near the ducts with the regions occupied by specialized gland cells.
examples.zh: 我们对照了导管旁较致密的「组织间质」和特化腺细胞所在的区域。

words.enDefinition: A precisely defined outcome, often including what is measured and when it is evaluated in a study.

examples.en: The study endpoint is the completion of a fictional activity diary by the last recorded visit.
examples.zh: 「研究终点」是在最后一次记录的访视前完成虚构活动日志。

examples.en: We read the study endpoint definition before comparing the numbers reported for the two groups.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「研究终点」的定义，再比较报告的两组数值。

words.enDefinition: A written plan describing a study's objectives, design, eligibility, outcomes, and intended methods.

examples.en: The study protocol lists the planned follow-up period for the fictional activity diary study in class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构活动日志研究的「研究方案」列出预定随访期。

examples.en: We compared the study protocol with the results paper to see how the outcome was described.
examples.zh: 我们将「研究方案」与结果论文比较，查看其中如何描述该结局。

words.enDefinition: A review diagram documenting how records progress from identification to inclusion, with counts and exclusions at relevant stages.
