examples.en: The study selection flow diagram lists counts of fictional records at successive stages in the review.
examples.zh: 「研究选择流程图」列出虚构记录在综述各连续阶段的数量。

examples.en: We located the exclusions on the study selection flow diagram before reading the classroom synthesis.
examples.zh: 我们先在「研究选择流程图」上找到被排除记录的情况，再读课堂综合结果。

collocations: read a study selection flow diagram
counts in a study selection flow diagram
exclusions in a study selection flow diagram

words.enDefinition: the space between the arachnoid and pia that contains cerebrospinal fluid and blood vessels

examples.en: The diagram shades the subarachnoid space between two named meningeal layers around the modeled brain.
examples.zh: 图中将模型脑周围两层已标注的脑膜之间的「蛛网膜下腔」涂上阴影。

examples.en: We followed the subarachnoid space around the brain and cord on the simplified anatomy map in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在简化解剖图中沿「蛛网膜下腔」追踪到脑和脊髓周围。

words.enDefinition: Lymph-filled channel directly beneath the outer capsule of a lymph node

examples.en: The subcapsular sinus follows the node's outer edge beneath the drawn capsule.
examples.zh: 图中，「被膜下窦」位于被膜下方，沿淋巴结外缘延伸。

examples.en: We placed the subcapsular sinus just inside the capsule on our labeled diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「被膜下窦」标在图中靠近被膜内侧的位置。

words.enDefinition: A chromosome with an off-centre centromere and arms of noticeably different lengths.

examples.en: The submetacentric chromosome has one noticeably longer arm in the simplified diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂简化图上的「亚中着丝粒染色体」有一条明显较长的臂。

examples.en: We compared a submetacentric chromosome with the example whose two arms are approximately equal in length.
examples.zh: 我们将「亚中着丝粒染色体」与两条臂长度大致相等的示例作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Supporting connective tissue layer beneath the mucosa in many tubular organs

examples.en: The submucosa is shown directly beneath the inner lining of the intestinal wall.
examples.zh: 示意图显示，「黏膜下层」就在肠壁内衬的下方。

examples.en: We identified small vessels within the submucosa in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中辨认了「黏膜下层」内的小血管。

words.enDefinition: The rotator cuff muscle on the front surface of the scapula that helps rotate the upper arm medially.

examples.en: The subscapularis is visible on the front surface of the detached scapula model shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的单独肩胛骨模型上，「肩胛下肌」位于前表面。

examples.en: We labelled subscapularis as the cuff muscle on the rib-facing side of the scapula.
examples.zh: 我们标明「肩胛下肌」是肩胛骨朝向肋骨一侧的肩袖肌。

words.enDefinition: The amount of substrate per unit volume in a reaction system.

examples.en: The horizontal axis shows substrate concentration in our simulated graph of the human enzyme reaction.
examples.zh: 模拟人体酶反应图的横轴表示「底物浓度」。

examples.en: We found the substrate concentration corresponding to a labeled point on the curve in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型上找出曲线某个标记点所对应的「底物浓度」。

collocations: reaction rate at a particular substrate concentration

words.enDefinition: Direct formation of ATP or an equivalent nucleotide by transferring a phosphate from a metabolic intermediate.

examples.en: The pathway figure shows substrate-level phosphorylation at a step that directly transfers a phosphate group to ADP.
examples.zh: 代谢图把将磷酸基团直接转移到 ADP 的一步画成「底物水平磷酸化」。

examples.en: We marked substrate-level phosphorylation on the glycolysis diagram beside the arrow showing ATP formation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在糖酵解图中表示 ATP 形成的箭头旁标注了「底物水平磷酸化」。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which an enzyme recognizes particular substrates rather than acting equally on others.

examples.en: The diagram demonstrates substrate specificity by showing one illustrated molecule recognized and another left unbound.
examples.zh: 图中一个分子被识别，另一个未结合，以此展示「底物特异性」。

examples.en: We used the labeled shapes to explain substrate specificity in the simplified model of a human enzyme.
examples.zh: 我们用标明的形状解释简化人体酶模型中的「底物特异性」。

words.enDefinition: A structured review table presenting key outcomes, effect estimates, and certainty judgments for a comparison.

examples.en: The summary of findings table lists each fictional outcome alongside its effect estimate and certainty rating.
examples.zh: 「证据概要表」把各虚构结局与对应的效应估计及确定性评级并列展示。

examples.en: We used the summary of findings table to compare outcomes measured at the same follow-up time.
examples.zh: 我们用「证据概要表」比较在同一随访时点测量的结局。

collocations: read a summary of findings table
prepare a summary of findings table
interpret a summary of findings table

words.enDefinition: Located nearer the external surface of the body than another structure

examples.en: The skin is superficial to the muscle layer in our model of the arm.
examples.zh: 在手臂模型中，皮肤「比肌层更靠近体表」。

examples.en: In the diagram, the thin covering lies superficial to the colored tissue layer.
examples.zh: 在图中，薄薄的覆盖层「比带颜色的组织层更靠近体表」。

words.enDefinition: Located closer to the head than another structure in the reference position

examples.en: The eyes are superior to the mouth in the model's front view.
examples.zh: 在模型的正视图中，双眼位于口部「上方」。

examples.en: We labeled the chest as superior to the abdomen on the upright figure.
examples.zh: 我们在直立人体图中标明，胸部位于腹部「上方」。

words.enDefinition: the large vein returning blood mainly from tissues above the diaphragm to the right atrium

examples.en: The superior vena cava enters the right atrium from above in the labeled front view.
examples.zh: 在有标记的前视图中，「上腔静脉」从上方进入右心房。

examples.en: We traced the superior vena cava upward toward veins that drain the head and upper limbs.
examples.zh: 我们从「上腔静脉」向上追踪到引流头部与上肢的静脉。

collocations: tributaries of the superior vena cava
blood flowing through the superior vena cava

words.enDefinition: Forearm rotation that returns the palm toward the forward-facing anatomical position, or upward when the forearm is held horizontally in front.

examples.en: The forearm model shows supination as its palm turns upward with the forearm held horizontally.
examples.zh: 在前臂水平摆放的模型上，手掌向上翻转，展示了「旋后」。

examples.en: We showed supination on the teaching model and compared the positions of its forearm bones.
examples.zh: 我们在教学模型上示范「旋后」，并比较它的两块前臂骨的位置。

words.enDefinition: Body position lying horizontally with the front of the trunk facing upward

examples.en: The figure in supine position lies on its back with the face upward.
examples.zh: 处于「仰卧位」的人体图躺在背上，脸朝上方。

examples.en: The drawing shows supine position beside a model lying on its side.
examples.zh: 这幅图在侧卧模型旁边画出了「仰卧位」。

words.enDefinition: The rotator cuff muscle lying above the spine of the scapula and helping abduct the arm.

examples.en: The supraspinatus lies above the scapular spine in the posterior view of the model.
examples.zh: 模型后视图上，「冈上肌」位于肩胛冈上方。

examples.en: We marked supraspinatus on the sheet that lists muscles involved in lifting the arm sideways.
examples.zh: 我们在列出参与侧举手臂的肌肉练习纸上标出「冈上肌」。

words.enDefinition: Study of external features and their relationships to structures beneath them

examples.en: The surface anatomy drawing identifies the visible outlines on the front of the model.
examples.zh: 「体表解剖学」图标出了模型前面可见的外形轮廓。

examples.en: We used surface anatomy to relate a visible ridge to the structure underneath.
examples.zh: 我们用「体表解剖学」把可见的隆起与其下方的结构联系起来。

words.enDefinition: A measure used in place of a direct outcome, with an intended relationship to that outcome.

examples.en: The surrogate endpoint is a model measurement used in place of a later fictional functioning outcome.
examples.zh: 「替代终点」是代替虚构后续功能结局的一项模型测量值。

examples.en: We checked whether the report explained the relationship between the surrogate endpoint and everyday function.
examples.zh: 我们查看报告是否解释了「替代终点」和日常功能之间的关系。

words.enDefinition: Automatic sequence that moves swallowed material through the pharynx toward the esophagus

examples.en: The swallowing reflex diagram shows the passage of a food bolus through the pharynx.
examples.zh: 「吞咽反射」示意图显示食团经过咽部的过程。

examples.en: The animation shows the swallowing reflex taking over as the bolus enters the pharynx.
examples.zh: 动画显示，食团进入咽部时，「吞咽反射」开始主导接下来的运动。

words.enDefinition: the passage that carries the secretion of a sweat gland toward its outlet

examples.en: The sweat duct winds upward through the skin layers on the enlarged reference drawing used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的放大参考图中，「汗腺导管」蜿蜒向上穿过各皮肤层。

examples.en: We traced the sweat duct separately from the deeper coiled secretory portion on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型上，将「汗腺导管」与较深的盘曲分泌部区分并分别追踪。

collocations: sweat passing through a sweat duct

words.enDefinition: the autonomic division with preganglionic neurons in thoracic and upper lumbar spinal cord, involved in mobilizing resources

examples.en: The activity diagram connects the sympathetic division with increased heart rate during the modeled exercise response.
examples.zh: 活动图把模拟运动反应中的心率加快与「交感神经分部」联系起来。

examples.en: We marked the spinal origins of the sympathetic division on the lecture slide of autonomic pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在自主神经通路课件上标出「交感神经分部」在脊髓中的起始部位。

words.enDefinition: A cartilaginous joint in which bones are joined by fibrocartilage.

examples.en: The symphysis between two vertebral bodies includes a disc in the simplified spine drawing.
examples.zh: 简化脊柱图里，两个椎体之间的「纤维软骨联合」含有一个椎间盘。

examples.en: We located the symphysis at the front of the pelvis on the labelled model.
examples.zh: 我们在带标注模型的骨盆前部找出「纤维软骨联合」。

words.enDefinition: The close pairing of homologous chromosomes during prophase I of meiosis.

examples.en: The diagram shows synapsis as two homologous chromosomes coming together in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂示意模型用两条同源染色体彼此靠拢表示「联会」。

examples.en: We labelled synapsis before following what happens to the paired chromosomes in the next panel.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「联会」，再查看下一幅小图里成对染色体的变化。

words.enDefinition: the narrow space between the sending and receiving membranes at a chemical synapse

examples.en: The synaptic cleft is represented by the narrow strip between the two cell membranes on our sketch.
examples.zh: 在我们的示意图中，两层细胞膜之间的窄带代表「突触间隙」。

examples.en: We drew messenger molecules moving across the synaptic cleft from the sending cell to the receiving surface.
examples.zh: 我们画出信使分子跨过「突触间隙」，从发送细胞移向接收表面。

words.enDefinition: a small membrane-bound compartment that contains neurotransmitter in a presynaptic terminal

examples.en: The enlarged drawing shows several synaptic vesicles near the membrane on the sending side of the synapse.
examples.zh: 放大图显示，突触发送侧细胞膜附近有几个「突触小泡」。

examples.en: We followed one synaptic vesicle in the animation as it fused with the illustrated sending membrane.
examples.zh: 在动画中，我们观察一个「突触小泡」与图示发送侧细胞膜融合。

words.enDefinition: A protein structure that forms between paired homologous chromosomes during meiotic prophase.

examples.en: The synaptonemal complex is drawn between the paired homologues in the enlarged textbook figure.
examples.zh: 教材放大图把「联会复合体」画在配对的同源染色体之间。

examples.en: We matched the synaptonemal complex label to the structure connecting the two aligned chromosome axes.
examples.zh: 我们把「联会复合体」标签与连接两条已对齐染色体轴的结构配对。

words.enDefinition: A cartilaginous joint in which hyaline cartilage directly connects the bones.

examples.en: The first rib connection is shown as a synchondrosis in the classroom diagram of the chest.
examples.zh: 课堂胸部图把第一肋与胸骨的连接画成「软骨结合」。

examples.en: We used the tissue label to distinguish a synchondrosis from another kind of cartilaginous joint.
examples.zh: 我们根据组织标签，把「软骨结合」与另一种软骨性关节区分开。

words.enDefinition: A fibrous joint where bones are connected by a ligament or an interosseous membrane.

examples.en: The syndesmosis is highlighted where the lower leg bones meet near the ankle in the chart.
examples.zh: 图上在小腿两骨靠近踝部的连接处突出标出了「韧带联合」。

examples.en: We compared a syndesmosis with a skull suture using two diagrams in the anatomy lesson.
examples.zh: 解剖课上，我们用两张图比较「韧带联合」与颅缝。

words.enDefinition: A muscle that assists the main mover by adding force or limiting unwanted movement.

examples.en: The synergist muscle contributes to elbow bending in the animation shown during the lesson.
examples.zh: 课上展示的动画里，「协同肌」帮助屈曲肘部。

examples.en: We located the synergist muscle on the diagram after identifying the main mover in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先确定主要主动肌，再在图中找出「协同肌」。

words.enDefinition: The lubricating fluid found within a synovial joint cavity.

examples.en: The synovial fluid is represented by blue shading between the cartilage surfaces on the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中软骨表面之间的蓝色阴影表示「滑液」。

examples.en: We discussed how synovial fluid helps the two joint surfaces move smoothly in the model.
examples.zh: 我们讨论「滑液」如何帮助模型中的两个关节面平顺移动。

words.enDefinition: A joint whose articulating bones are separated by a fluid-containing cavity enclosed by a capsule.

examples.en: The synovial joint diagram shows the space between the surfaces of the two bones.
examples.zh: 「滑膜关节」示意图显示两块骨的表面之间有一处腔隙。

examples.en: We labelled the main features of a synovial joint on the classroom cutaway model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂剖面模型上标出一个「滑膜关节」的主要结构。

words.enDefinition: The layer lining the inner capsule and other noncartilaginous surfaces within a synovial joint.

examples.en: The synovial membrane lines the inner side of the capsule in the classroom cutaway diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂剖面图中，「滑膜」衬在关节囊的内侧。

examples.en: We distinguished the synovial membrane from the cartilage covering each bone in the model.
examples.zh: 我们把「滑膜」与模型中覆盖各块骨表面的软骨区分开。

words.enDefinition: A review that uses explicit, prespecified methods to find, select, appraise, and synthesize eligible studies.

examples.en: The systematic review states its eligibility criteria before summarising the fictional studies in the textbook.
examples.zh: 「系统综述」先说明纳入标准，再汇总教材里的虚构研究。

examples.en: We examined the systematic review methods to see how the authors selected the evidence in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们查看「系统综述」的方法，了解作者怎样选择证据。

words.enDefinition: Study of body structures organized by the organ systems they belong to

examples.en: The systemic anatomy chapter groups structures by the body system they belong to.
examples.zh: 「系统解剖学」这一章按各结构所属的人体系统将它们分组。

examples.en: We used systemic anatomy to follow one system across several different body regions.
examples.zh: 我们通过「系统解剖学」追踪一个系统在多个不同体区的分布。

words.enDefinition: blood flow from the left ventricle through the body tissues and back to the right atrium

examples.en: The large aortic arrow marks the beginning of systemic circulation in the classroom heart model.
examples.zh: 课堂心脏模型上，那支较大的主动脉箭头标出「体循环」的起点。

examples.en: We traced systemic circulation from the left ventricle through a tissue capillary bed to the right atrium.
examples.zh: 我们从左心室经组织毛细血管床追踪到右心房，观察「体循环」。

words.enDefinition: Adaptive immune cell that matures in the thymus and performs specialized responses

examples.en: The diagram links a developing T lymphocyte with the thymus in the model.
examples.zh: 示意图把发育中的「T淋巴细胞」与模型里的胸腺联系起来。

examples.en: We placed the T lymphocyte at the start of several branches in the chart.
examples.zh: 我们把「T淋巴细胞」放在图表的几个分支起点处。

words.enDefinition: the electrocardiogram wave representing ventricular repolarization

examples.en: The T wave appeared after the main ventricular complex in the sample trace discussed in class.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论的示例曲线上，「T 波」出现在主要的心室波群之后。

examples.en: We linked the T wave to the return of ventricular cells toward their resting electrical state.
examples.zh: 我们把「T 波」与心室细胞逐渐恢复到静息电状态联系起来。

words.enDefinition: an MRI image whose contrast is designed to emphasize differences in longitudinal relaxation time

examples.en: The instructor placed a T1-weighted image beside another view to compare how the regions appeared at different intensities.
examples.zh: 老师将一张「T1加权图像」放在另一视图旁，对照各区域呈现的不同信号强度。

examples.en: We read the label identifying a T1-weighted image before comparing the fluid spaces in the two examples.
examples.zh: 我们先读出标明「T1加权图像」的标签，再比较两个示例中的含液空间。

words.enDefinition: an MRI image whose contrast is designed to emphasize differences in transverse relaxation time

examples.en: The T2-weighted image shows a brighter fluid space than the neighboring tissue in the selected teaching example.
examples.zh: 在选定的教学示例中，「T2加权图像」里的含液空间比相邻组织亮。

examples.en: We compared a T2-weighted image with a different image of the same plane in the classroom atlas.
examples.zh: 我们将「T2加权图像」与课堂图谱中同一平面的另一幅图像作比较。

words.enDefinition: The tarsal bone between the lower leg bones and the heel bone that helps form the ankle joint.

examples.en: The talus sits above the heel bone and below the tibia in the ankle model.
examples.zh: 踝部模型上，「距骨」位于跟骨上方、胫骨下方。

examples.en: We identified the talus before tracing the joint surface on the supplied ankle diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先指出「距骨」，再沿给定踝部图查看关节面。

words.enDefinition: One of the seven bones in the rear and middle part of the foot.

examples.en: The tarsal bone in the model lies behind the long bones of the forefoot.
examples.zh: 模型中的「跗骨」位于前足较长的骨后方。

examples.en: We chose one tarsal bone and located its position on the side view in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们选取一块「跗骨」，在侧视图上找到它的位置。

words.enDefinition: a cluster of taste receptor cells and supporting cells involved in sensing dissolved substances

examples.en: The enlarged tongue section shows a taste bud in the epithelium near the surface in our model.
examples.zh: 模型的放大舌切面图显示，靠近表面的上皮内有一个「味蕾」。

examples.en: We marked the small opening at the top of a taste bud in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上标出一个「味蕾」顶部的小开口。

words.enDefinition: A protective structure containing repetitive DNA and proteins at the end of a linear chromosome.

examples.en: The telomere is highlighted at the chromosome tip in the labelled drawing for class.
examples.zh: 课堂带标注的图把「端粒」突出画在染色体末端。

examples.en: We labelled the telomere separately from the narrow region near the middle of the chromosome.
examples.zh: 我们把「端粒」与染色体中部附近的狭窄区域分别标注。

words.enDefinition: The end stage of meiosis I, when separated homologues reach opposite sides of the dividing cell.

examples.en: The telophase I panel shows a separated chromosome set at each side of the simple model.
examples.zh: 「减数第一次分裂末期」小图显示，简化模型两侧各有一组分开的染色体。

examples.en: We checked which chromosome sets are shown at telophase I before looking at the next division.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「减数第一次分裂末期」所示各套染色体，再看下一次分裂。

collocations: compare telophase I with earlier stages

words.enDefinition: The final meiotic stage, when separated chromosomes reach opposite ends and new nuclei can form.

examples.en: The telophase II panel shows the chromosomes grouped at opposite sides in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂图的「减数第二次分裂末期」小图显示染色体分组位于相反两侧。

examples.en: We compared the chromosome groups at telophase II with those after the first division.
examples.zh: 我们比较「减数第二次分裂末期」的染色体分组与第一次分裂后的情况。

words.enDefinition: the cerebral lobe below the lateral sulcus, containing areas involved in hearing, language and memory

examples.en: The temporal lobe lies beneath the lateral groove in the side view of the classroom brain model.
examples.zh: 在课堂脑模型的侧视图上，「颞叶」位于外侧沟下方。

examples.en: We marked an auditory region within the temporal lobe on the map supplied by the instructor.
examples.zh: 我们在老师提供的图上标出了「颞叶」内的一个听觉区域。

words.enDefinition: the combination of postsynaptic effects from repeated inputs close together in time

examples.en: The second input arrived before the first response decayed, producing temporal summation in the simplified neuron model.
examples.zh: 在简化神经元模型中，首次响应衰减前第二次输入已到达，从而产生「时间总和作用」。

examples.en: We modeled temporal summation by showing two closely spaced pulses arriving from the same input pathway.
examples.zh: 我们用来自同一输入通路的两个时间间隔很短的脉冲来模拟「时间总和作用」。

words.enDefinition: A band or sheet of dense connective tissue that typically transmits muscle force to bone.

examples.en: The tendon joins the lower end of the muscle to the bone on the model.
examples.zh: 模型里，「肌腱」把肌肉下端连到骨上。

examples.en: We coloured the tendon differently from the muscle fibres on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习图上用不同颜色区分「肌腱」与肌纤维。

words.enDefinition: A rotator cuff muscle along the lateral scapula that helps rotate the upper arm laterally.

examples.en: The teres minor lies below the infraspinatus in the rear view of the shoulder chart.
examples.zh: 肩部挂图的后视图上，「小圆肌」位于冈下肌下方。

examples.en: We matched teres minor to the smaller muscle shown along the scapula's lateral edge.
examples.zh: 我们把「小圆肌」与沿肩胛骨外侧缘所画的较小肌肉对应起来。

words.enDefinition: the smallest branch of the conducting zone, immediately preceding the respiratory bronchioles

examples.en: We marked the terminal bronchiole where the last purely conducting airway ends on the class diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上最后一段单纯传导气道的末端标出「终末细支气管」。

examples.en: The sketch shows the terminal bronchiole giving rise to smaller branches with occasional alveoli in their walls.
examples.zh: 示意图显示，「终末细支气管」分出的较小支气管，在管壁上间或出现肺泡。

words.enDefinition: A paired set of two replicated homologous chromosomes containing four chromatids in total.

examples.en: The tetrad is drawn with four distinguishable chromatids in the enlarged classroom diagram for this example.
examples.zh: 这个示例的课堂放大图把「四分体」画成四条可区分的染色单体。

examples.en: We counted the chromatids in a tetrad before labelling the two homologues in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先数「四分体」中的染色单体，再标出两条同源染色体。

words.enDefinition: a deep brain structure that processes and relays many sensory and motor signals to the cerebral cortex

examples.en: The pathway diagram shows a sensory signal relayed by the thalamus on its way toward the cortex.
examples.zh: 通路图显示，感觉信号传向皮层途中，经过「丘脑」中继。

examples.en: We labeled the thalamus beside the third ventricle in the classroom cross section of the brain.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂脑横切面图的第三脑室旁标出了「丘脑」。

words.enDefinition: a sensory receptor that responds to temperature or to changes in temperature

examples.en: The model shows a thermoreceptor changing its firing rate as the illustrated skin cools in the example.
examples.zh: 示例模型显示，所绘皮肤冷却时，「温度感受器」的放电频率发生改变。

examples.en: We marked the thermoreceptor at the start of the classroom diagram for sensing mild warmth.
examples.zh: 在感知温和热刺激的课堂图上，我们在起点标出「温度感受器」。

words.enDefinition: A sarcomere filament composed mainly of myosin proteins.

examples.en: The thick filament occupies the middle region of the repeating unit shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂所示重复单位的中部区域有「粗肌丝」。

examples.en: We used a different colour for the thick filament in our diagram of the sarcomere.
examples.zh: 我们在肌节示意图上用另一种颜色标出「粗肌丝」。

words.enDefinition: A sarcomere filament composed primarily of actin together with associated regulatory proteins.

examples.en: The thin filament is shown attached to the boundary structure in the classroom sarcomere model.
examples.zh: 课堂肌节模型显示，「细肌丝」附着在边界结构上。

examples.en: We followed the thin filament toward the centre of the repeating segment in the animation.
examples.zh: 我们在动画中沿着「细肌丝」查看到重复区段的中央。

words.enDefinition: the narrow midline cavity in the diencephalon connecting the lateral ventricles to the cerebral aqueduct

examples.en: The diagram places the third ventricle between the paired thalamic regions in the central brain section.
examples.zh: 在脑中央的切面图中，「第三脑室」位于成对的丘脑区域之间。

examples.en: We traced fluid from the third ventricle down the narrow aqueduct in the classroom brain model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂脑模型上沿狭窄的导水管向下追踪由「第三脑室」流出的脑脊液。

words.enDefinition: The bony and cartilaginous framework of the chest formed by the thoracic vertebrae, ribs, costal cartilages, and sternum.

examples.en: The thoracic cage is shown from the side so both the ribs and sternum are visible.
examples.zh: 「胸廓」采用侧面视图，因此肋骨和胸骨都能看见。

examples.en: The class labelled three structures that form the thoracic cage in the skeleton diagram.
examples.zh: 全班在骨骼图上标出构成「胸廓」的三处结构。

words.enDefinition: Internal compartment of the chest above the diaphragm containing the lungs and mediastinum

examples.en: The thoracic cavity lies above the diaphragm in the trunk model's side view.
examples.zh: 躯干模型的侧视图中，「胸腔」位于横隔上方。

examples.en: Our diagram shows the lungs on either side of the center within the thoracic cavity.
examples.zh: 我们的示意图显示双肺位于「胸腔」内中央区域的两侧。

words.enDefinition: Largest lymphatic duct returning lymph from most of the body

examples.en: The thoracic duct rises through the chest in the whole body diagram.
examples.zh: 全身示意图中，「胸导管」穿过胸部向上延伸。

examples.en: We labeled the thoracic duct after tracing the larger of the central routes.
examples.zh: 我们沿两条中央通路中较大的一条描画，并标出了「胸导管」。

words.enDefinition: One of the twelve vertebrae in the chest region, which articulate with the ribs.

examples.en: Each thoracic vertebra on the chart is shown beside its corresponding pair of ribs.
examples.zh: 图上每块「胸椎骨」都画在与它相应的一对肋骨旁。

examples.en: We located a thoracic vertebra by matching its rib connection to the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把肋骨连接处与课堂图对应起来，定位一块「胸椎骨」。

words.enDefinition: the membrane voltage at which enough regenerative channel activity starts to produce an action potential under stated conditions

examples.en: When the modeled membrane reached threshold potential, the gradual voltage rise was followed by a rapid spike.
examples.zh: 模型膜电位达到「阈电位」后，缓慢升高的电压紧接着出现快速尖峰。

examples.en: We marked threshold potential on the vertical axis of the classroom graph for this neuron model.
examples.zh: 我们在该神经元模型的课堂图纵轴上标出「阈电位」。

collocations: threshold potential for an action potential

words.enDefinition: Enzyme formed during clotting that converts soluble fibrinogen into fibrin

examples.en: The textbook diagram connects thrombin with the formation of fibrin strands.
examples.zh: 教材图把「凝血酶」与纤维蛋白丝的形成联系起来。

examples.en: We placed thrombin after its precursor on the simplified pathway chart.
examples.zh: 我们在简化途径图中把「凝血酶」放在其前体之后。

words.enDefinition: Physiological process producing platelets from developing marrow cells called megakaryocytes

examples.en: The thrombopoiesis chart ends with many small fragments entering the circulation.
examples.zh: 「血小板生成」图以许多小碎片进入血液循环作为最后一环。

examples.en: We followed thrombopoiesis on a separate branch from red cell development.
examples.zh: 我们沿不同于红细胞发育的另一条分支查看了「血小板生成」。

words.enDefinition: Movement that brings the pad of the thumb across the palm toward the fingertips.

examples.en: Thumb opposition brings the pad of the model thumb toward the pad of another digit.
examples.zh: 「拇指对掌」使模型拇指的指腹朝另一指的指腹靠拢。

examples.en: We labelled thumb opposition on the hand model after comparing it with simple thumb flexion.
examples.zh: 我们先比较该动作与单纯拇指屈曲，再在手部模型上标出「拇指对掌」。

words.enDefinition: Lymphoid organ where developing T lymphocytes mature and undergo selection

examples.en: The model places the thymus high in the chest behind the breastbone.
examples.zh: 模型中的「胸腺」位于胸部上方、胸骨后方。

examples.en: We marked the thymus above the heart in the diagram's front view.
examples.zh: 我们在正视图中将「胸腺」标在心脏上方。

collocations: T cell development in the thymus

words.enDefinition: Spherical unit of thyroid tissue surrounding a central storage space

examples.en: The atlas shows each thyroid follicle as a ring of cells in section.
examples.zh: 图谱显示，每个「甲状腺滤泡」在切面中呈一圈细胞。

examples.en: We marked the center of the thyroid follicle before labeling the cell layer.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「甲状腺滤泡」的中央，再标出围绕它的一层细胞。

words.enDefinition: Endocrine organ in the front of the neck that produces thyroid hormones

examples.en: The thyroid gland lies across the front of the airway in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「甲状腺」横跨气道的前方。

examples.en: We labeled the thyroid gland before identifying the neighboring structures in the neck.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「甲状腺」，再辨认颈部邻近结构。

words.enDefinition: Thyroid-produced messenger that helps regulate metabolic activity, growth, and development

examples.en: The model connects thyroid hormone with changes in activity across several tissues.
examples.zh: 模型将「甲状腺激素」与多种组织的活动变化联系起来。

examples.en: We placed thyroid hormone at the peripheral end of the endocrine feedback diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「甲状腺激素」放在内分泌反馈图的外周末端。

words.enDefinition: Anterior pituitary signal stimulating the thyroid to produce and release thyroid hormones

examples.en: The arrow for thyroid-stimulating hormone runs from the pituitary toward the thyroid.
examples.zh: 表示「促甲状腺激素」的箭头从垂体指向甲状腺。

examples.en: We labeled thyroid-stimulating hormone as the intervening signal in this endocrine diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「促甲状腺激素」标为这张内分泌图中的中间信号。

words.enDefinition: Major thyroid hormone, also called T4, that can be converted to T3

examples.en: The teaching chart identifies thyroxine as the hormone labeled T4 beside the thyroid.
examples.zh: 教学图表将甲状腺旁标为 T4 的激素辨认为「甲状腺素」。

examples.en: We placed thyroxine before T3 on the simplified hormone relationship diagram.
examples.zh: 在简化的激素关系图中，我们把「甲状腺素」放在 T3 前面。

words.enDefinition: The larger of the two lower leg bones, on the medial side.

examples.en: The tibia is the larger bone on the inner side of the model lower leg.
examples.zh: 模型小腿内侧较大的那块骨是「胫骨」。

examples.en: We labelled the tibia first and then traced its lower end to the ankle.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「胫骨」，再沿它的下端查看到踝部。

words.enDefinition: A muscle at the front of the lower leg that helps dorsiflex and invert the foot.

examples.en: The tibialis anterior runs along the front of the lower leg in the labelled chart.
examples.zh: 带标注的挂图中，「胫骨前肌」沿小腿前侧走行。

examples.en: We located tibialis anterior before viewing the animation of the foot moving upward at the ankle.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「胫骨前肌」，再观看踝部动作带动足部向上的动画。

words.enDefinition: the volume of air inhaled or exhaled in one breath, commonly referring to an ordinary quiet breath

examples.en: We measured tidal volume on the simulated trace by comparing its level before and after quiet inspiration.
examples.zh: 我们比较模拟曲线在平静吸气前后的数值，测得「潮气量」。

examples.en: The classroom model showed a larger tidal volume when each simulated breath moved more air.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，每次模拟呼吸移动的空气更多时，「潮气量」也更大。

words.enDefinition: the spatial arrangement of cells, supporting structures and other components within a tissue

examples.en: The low-power image showed the tissue architecture of the gland before we examined individual cells in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，在辨认各细胞之前，我们先通过低倍图像观察腺体的「组织构筑」。

examples.en: We described tissue architecture by noting the arrangement of ducts and the surrounding supporting tissue in the image.
examples.zh: 我们记录图中的导管与周围支持组织的排列，用以描述「组织构筑」。

words.enDefinition: Cell-associated protein that helps initiate clotting when exposed to circulating blood

examples.en: The illustration places tissue factor at the exposed edge of the vessel wall.
examples.zh: 插图将「组织因子」画在血管壁外露的边缘处。

examples.en: We marked tissue factor at the beginning of one branch on the flowchart.
examples.zh: 我们在流程图其中一个分支的起点标出了「组织因子」。

words.enDefinition: Organizational level where cells and surrounding material perform shared functions

examples.en: At the tissue level, the diagram groups similar cells by their shared role.
examples.zh: 在「组织层次」，示意图按共同作用给相似细胞分组。

examples.en: We used the tissue level diagram to show cells and material between them.
examples.zh: 我们用「组织层次」示意图展示细胞和它们之间的物质。

words.enDefinition: the direction of a tissue sample or section relative to its normal anatomical surfaces and axes

examples.en: We determined tissue orientation by locating the outer surface and deeper structures in the classroom skin section.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂用皮肤切片中找到外表面与较深结构，借此确定「组织取向」。

examples.en: The instructor added arrows to indicate tissue orientation on the paired teaching images in the atlas.
examples.zh: 老师在图谱中成对的教学图上加了箭头，用来表示「组织取向」。

words.enDefinition: an internal connective partition separating parts or compartments of a tissue or organ

examples.en: A thin tissue septum separates two clusters in the low-power image provided for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习给出的低倍图像中，一层薄「组织隔」将两簇结构分开。

examples.en: We followed the tissue septum from the outer covering toward the center of the illustrated gland.
examples.zh: 我们从外层被膜沿「组织隔」追踪至所绘腺体的中央。

words.enDefinition: Lymphoid tissue mass in the throat region associated with its lining

examples.en: The diagram shows a tonsil beside the opening to the throat.
examples.zh: 示意图在咽部开口旁画出了一个「扁桃体」。

examples.en: We highlighted the tonsil in the model of the upper throat.
examples.zh: 我们在上部咽腔模型中高亮标出了「扁桃体」。

words.enDefinition: the volume of air contained in the lungs at the end of a maximal inspiration

examples.en: The top dashed line represents total lung capacity on the classroom chart for the modeled lung.
examples.zh: 课堂模型肺的图表上，最上面的虚线代表「肺总量」。

examples.en: We calculated total lung capacity by adding vital capacity to residual volume in the example exercise.
examples.zh: 在示例练习中，我们用肺活量加残气量求得「肺总量」。

words.enDefinition: the product of the contributing magnifications, commonly the objective and eyepiece powers in direct microscope viewing

examples.en: We calculated total magnification from the two powers printed on the classroom objective and eyepiece labels.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂物镜和目镜标签上印出的两个倍率计算「总放大倍数」。

examples.en: Two images had the same total magnification but showed different amounts of fine detail in the comparison.
examples.zh: 对照中，两幅图的「总放大倍数」相同，但显示的精细细节数量不同。

words.enDefinition: A small strut or plate of bone forming part of the supporting network in spongy bone.

examples.en: Each trabecula is drawn with a space on either side in the enlarged bone diagram.
examples.zh: 放大的骨示意图上，每根「骨小梁」两侧都画有空隙。

examples.en: We traced one trabecula through the network shown on the classroom image of spongy bone.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂松质骨图中的网络查看一根「骨小梁」。

words.enDefinition: the airway supported by cartilage that runs from the larynx to the two main bronchi

examples.en: The trachea descends from the larynx and divides near the bottom of the classroom airway model.
examples.zh: 在课堂气道模型中，「气管」起于喉部向下延伸，并在接近底部处分叉。

examples.en: We traced the trachea along the front of the esophagus on the side-view anatomy illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在侧面解剖图上，沿食管前面的「气管」追踪它的走向。

words.enDefinition: the cartilage making up the incomplete rings that help keep the tracheal airway open

examples.en: The classroom cross section shows tracheal cartilage forming most of a ring around the airway.
examples.zh: 课堂横切图显示，「气管软骨」在气道周围形成不完整的环。

examples.en: We saw that the tracheal cartilage opens toward the esophagus in the model of the airway.
examples.zh: 我们看到，气道模型中「气管软骨」环的缺口朝向食管。

words.enDefinition: Transfer of an amino group from one amino acid to a keto acid.

examples.en: The classroom chart illustrates transamination by showing an amino group move from one molecule to another.
examples.zh: 课堂图画出一个氨基从一个分子转至另一个分子，以说明「转氨作用」。

examples.en: We marked transamination where the worksheet linked an amino acid with its corresponding keto acid.
examples.zh: 我们在习题把氨基酸与相应酮酸联系起来的位置标明「转氨作用」。

collocations: an amino group transferred by transamination

words.enDefinition: Specialized portion of extracellular fluid separated from other compartments by tissue boundaries

examples.en: The chart lists fluid in joint cavities as an example of transcellular fluid.
examples.zh: 图表把关节腔内的液体列为「跨细胞液」的例子。

examples.en: We marked transcellular fluid in the small specialized spaces on the model diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在模型图的小型专门腔隙里标出了「跨细胞液」。

words.enDefinition: Preferential stabilization of a reaction's transition state relative to its starting state, lowering the barrier.

examples.en: The textbook illustrates transition state stabilization with a lower peak on the catalyzed reaction diagram.
examples.zh: 教材用催化反应图上较低的峰表示「过渡态稳定化」。

examples.en: We discussed transition state stabilization after comparing the peak heights in the two energy diagrams.
examples.zh: 我们比较两幅能量图的峰高后，讨论了「过渡态稳定化」。

collocations: a model of transition state stabilization
transition state stabilization by an enzyme

words.enDefinition: Layered lining of parts of the urinary tract that changes shape when stretched

examples.en: The atlas shows transitional epithelium lining a simplified model of the urinary bladder.
examples.zh: 图谱把「移行上皮」画在简化膀胱模型的内表面。

examples.en: The surface cells of transitional epithelium look flatter in the stretched model.
examples.zh: 在拉伸状态模型中，「移行上皮」的表层细胞看起来更扁平。

words.enDefinition: an image formed from electrons passing through a thin specimen in a transmission electron microscope

examples.en: The transmission electron micrograph shows internal features of the cell in the high-resolution classroom atlas.
examples.zh: 高分辨率课堂图谱中的「透射电子显微图」显示细胞内部结构。

examples.en: We used the scale bar to compare membrane thicknesses on the supplied transmission electron micrograph.
examples.zh: 我们用比例尺比较给出的「透射电子显微图」上几处膜的厚度。

collocations: transmission electron micrograph of a thin section
scale bar on a transmission electron micrograph

words.enDefinition: the difference between alveolar pressure and pleural pressure, representing a distending pressure across the lung

examples.en: We calculated transpulmonary pressure from the difference between alveolar pressure and pleural pressure in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用示例中肺泡压与胸膜腔内压之差算出「跨肺压」。

examples.en: The model plot links a higher transpulmonary pressure with a larger lung volume at static equilibrium.
examples.zh: 模型图显示，在静态平衡时，较高的「跨肺压」对应较大的肺容积。

words.enDefinition: Portion of the colon crossing the abdomen between ascending and descending parts

examples.en: The transverse colon runs across the upper part of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂示意图上，「横结肠」横过上部。

examples.en: We labeled the transverse colon between the two bends shown in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型所示的两个弯曲处之间标出了「横结肠」。

words.enDefinition: Plane dividing the upright body into upper and lower portions

examples.en: The transverse plane crosses the standing model horizontally through the level of its waist.
examples.zh: 「横断面」在腰部高度水平穿过直立模型。

examples.en: We drew a transverse plane to compare the structures above and below it.
examples.zh: 我们画出一个「横断面」，比较它上方与下方的结构。

words.enDefinition: A broad muscle of the neck and upper back that moves and stabilises the scapula.

examples.en: The trapezius muscle covers part of the neck and upper back on the teaching model.
examples.zh: 教学模型上，「斜方肌」覆盖部分颈部和上背部。

examples.en: We labelled the trapezius muscle before comparing the arrows showing different movements of the scapula.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「斜方肌」，再比较表示肩胛骨不同动作的箭头。

collocations: upper fibres of the trapezius muscle

words.enDefinition: A storage lipid consisting of glycerol linked by ester bonds to three fatty acids.

examples.en: The diagram shows triacylglycerol with one glycerol backbone and three attached fatty acid chains in total.
examples.zh: 图中「甘油三酯」包含一个甘油骨架，总共连接三条脂肪酸链。

examples.en: We identified triacylglycerol in the textbook illustration of stored lipid droplets inside a human fat cell.
examples.zh: 我们在人体脂肪细胞内储存脂滴的教材图上找到了「甘油三酯」。

words.enDefinition: A group of participants assigned to a particular intervention or comparison condition in a clinical trial.

examples.en: The trial arm in the first column is assigned a different reminder format in the fictional report.
examples.zh: 在虚构报告中，第一列的「试验组」被分配了一种不同的提醒格式。

examples.en: We followed each trial arm from assignment to the last observation in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上追踪各「试验组」从分配到末次观测的全过程。

words.enDefinition: A unique label used to link a trial with its registry record or other documentation.

examples.en: The trial identifier matches on the fictional registry entry and the classroom results table.
examples.zh: 虚构登记条目和课堂结果表的「试验识别编号」一致。

examples.en: We copied the trial identifier from the model report to locate its matching registry record.
examples.zh: 我们从报告示例抄下「试验识别编号」，以找到对应的登记记录。

words.enDefinition: Recording key details of a trial in a publicly accessible registry, including its planned design and outcomes.

examples.en: The trial registration record gives the planned primary outcome for the fictional study used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构研究的「试验登记」记录列出预定主要结局。

examples.en: We checked the trial registration date against the dates in the classroom study timeline.
examples.zh: 我们将「试验登记」日期与课堂研究时间线中的日期核对。

words.enDefinition: A database that provides searchable records of trials and their declared study details.

examples.en: The trial registry entry contains the design summary for the fictional diary study used in class.
examples.zh: 「试验注册平台」条目包含课堂虚构日志研究的设计摘要。

examples.en: We compared the trial registry entry with the outcome descriptions in the example report.
examples.zh: 我们将「试验注册平台」条目与示例报告中的结局描述作比较。

words.enDefinition: Making study results publicly available, for example in a registry or report.

examples.en: The trial results disclosure includes a summary table for each group in the fictional classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构示例的「试验结果公开」材料包含各组的汇总表。

examples.en: We located trial results disclosure separately from the original registration record in the simulated example.
examples.zh: 在模拟示例中，我们先后找到「试验结果公开」材料和原始登记记录。

words.enDefinition: A three-headed muscle at the back of the upper arm that extends the elbow.

examples.en: The triceps brachii lies behind the upper arm bone in the classroom side view.
examples.zh: 课堂侧视图上，「肱三头肌」位于上臂骨后方。

examples.en: We identified triceps brachii while the articulated model showed the elbow straightening slowly.
examples.zh: 可活动模型缓慢伸直肘部时，我们找出了「肱三头肌」。

words.enDefinition: a group of staining approaches using three dyes to distinguish tissue components, often muscle from collagen

examples.en: The teaching caption identifies a trichrome stain that colors muscle and collagen differently in the example section.
examples.zh: 教学图注指出，示例切片使用「三色染色」，使肌肉和胶原呈不同颜色。

examples.en: We traced the boundary between two colors on the trichrome stain image from the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们在图谱的「三色染色」图像上，沿两种颜色之间的边界追踪。

collocations: collagen highlighted by a trichrome stain

words.enDefinition: the right atrioventricular valve, typically with three leaflets, between the right atrium and right ventricle

examples.en: The tricuspid valve separates the two right heart chambers in the colored cross section shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的彩色切面中，「三尖瓣」将两个右侧心腔分隔开。

examples.en: We counted the three leaflets of the tricuspid valve on the enlarged model of the right heart.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的右心模型上数出了「三尖瓣」的三片瓣叶。

words.enDefinition: Active thyroid hormone known as T3, often formed from circulating T4

examples.en: The chart labels triiodothyronine as the active hormone indicated by T3.
examples.zh: 图表将「三碘甲状腺原氨酸」标为缩写 T3 所指的活性激素。

examples.en: We identified triiodothyronine after following the arrow leading from T4 on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们沿图中从 T4 出发的箭头，找到了「三碘甲状腺原氨酸」。

words.enDefinition: The presence of three copies of a particular chromosome when two would normally be expected.

examples.en: The classroom trisomy example shows three copies in one group of the synthetic chromosome chart.
examples.zh: 在课堂的「三体性」示例里，合成染色体图的某个编号组有三份副本。

examples.en: We identified trisomy by counting the copies in one numbered set of the fictional diagram.
examples.zh: 我们统计虚构图某个编号组的副本数，以辨认「三体性」。

words.enDefinition: a gland whose secretory portion forms an elongated tube, which can be straight, branched or coiled

examples.en: The tubular gland in the drawing has a long secretory part that extends below the tissue surface.
examples.zh: 图中「管状腺」的分泌部呈长条形，伸入组织表面以下。

examples.en: We followed the coiled portion of the tubular gland across several views in the teaching atlas.
examples.zh: 我们在教学图谱的几个视图中沿「管状腺」的盘曲部分追踪。

words.enDefinition: Return of water or solutes from kidney tubular fluid toward the blood

examples.en: The diagram shows tubular reabsorption with arrows pointing out of the nephron tube.
examples.zh: 示意图用从肾单位小管向外指的箭头表示「肾小管重吸收」。

examples.en: We marked the direction of tubular reabsorption before comparing it with tubular secretion.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肾小管重吸收」的方向，再与肾小管分泌作比较。

words.enDefinition: Movement of certain substances from blood or surrounding tissue into kidney tubular fluid

examples.en: The tubular secretion arrows point into the tubular space in our schematic.
examples.zh: 示意图中表示「肾小管分泌」的箭头指向小管内部。

examples.en: We used a different color for tubular secretion in the transport diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在转运图中用另一种颜色表示「肾小管分泌」。

words.enDefinition: the thin membrane between the outer and middle ear that vibrates in response to sound

examples.en: The animation shows the tympanic membrane vibrating when a sound wave reaches the end of the ear canal.
examples.zh: 动画显示，声波到达耳道末端时，「鼓膜」振动。

examples.en: We marked the tympanic membrane between the ear canal and the chamber holding the small bones.
examples.zh: 我们在耳道与容纳小骨的腔之间标出「鼓膜」。

words.enDefinition: ABO category with A markers and no B markers on red cells

examples.en: The classroom card labels type A blood beside a red cell bearing A symbols.
examples.zh: 课堂卡片在带 A 标志的红细胞旁标出「A型血」。

examples.en: We found type A blood in the column with only A markers on cells.
examples.zh: 我们在细胞表面只有 A 标志的那一列找到了「A型血」。

collocations: surface marker in type A blood

words.enDefinition: ABO category with both A and B markers on red cells

examples.en: The model shows type AB blood with both marker shapes on each red cell.
examples.zh: 模型中，「AB型血」的各个红细胞上都有两种标志形状。

examples.en: We labeled type AB blood in the column containing both sets of symbols.
examples.zh: 我们把「AB型血」标在同时包含两组符号的那一列。

collocations: surface markers in type AB blood

words.enDefinition: ABO category with B markers and no A markers on red cells

examples.en: The diagram uses square B symbols on cells labeled type B blood in class.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图在标为「B型血」的细胞上使用方形 B 标志。

examples.en: We placed the type B blood card beneath the matching surface marker drawing.
examples.zh: 我们把「B型血」卡片放在对应的表面标志图下方。

collocations: surface marker in type B blood

words.enDefinition: a thin alveolar lining cell that covers most of the alveolar surface and supports gas diffusion

examples.en: The flattened type I pneumocyte lies along the thin gas exchange surface in the magnified lung diagram.
examples.zh: 放大的肺组织图中，扁平的「Ⅰ型肺泡上皮细胞」沿薄薄的气体交换面排列。

examples.en: We identified the type I pneumocyte by its broad surface and thin profile on the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们依据图中宽大的表面与很薄的侧面轮廓，辨认「Ⅰ型肺泡上皮细胞」。

collocations: surface covered by a type I pneumocyte

words.enDefinition: an alveolar cell that produces pulmonary surfactant and can contribute to repair of the alveolar lining

examples.en: The cuboidal type II pneumocyte stood out beside thin lining cells in the enlarged alveolar diagram.
examples.zh: 在放大的肺泡图中，立方形的「Ⅱ型肺泡上皮细胞」在薄薄的衬里细胞旁很醒目。

examples.en: We linked the type II pneumocyte to surfactant production in a diagram summarizing alveolar cell functions.
examples.zh: 在概括肺泡细胞功能的图中，我们将「Ⅱ型肺泡上皮细胞」与表面活性物质的生成相联系。

collocations: surfactant from a type II pneumocyte

words.enDefinition: ABO category with neither A nor B markers on red cells

examples.en: The type O blood card shows cells without either of the two ABO markers.
examples.zh: 「O型血」卡片所示的细胞上没有这两种 ABO 标志。

examples.en: We wrote type O blood under the diagram with no A or B symbols.
examples.zh: 我们在没有 A 或 B 符号的图下写上了「O型血」。

collocations: ABO marker pattern in type O blood

words.enDefinition: The forearm bone lying on the little finger side in the anatomical position.

examples.en: The ulna is marked on the side of the forearm nearest the little finger.
examples.zh: 「尺骨」标在前臂靠小指的一侧。

examples.en: We compared the upper end of the ulna with the other bone on the model.
examples.zh: 我们比较了模型上「尺骨」的上端和另一块骨。

words.enDefinition: imaging that uses echoes of high-frequency sound waves to represent structures or motion

examples.en: The ultrasonography diagram traces the returning echoes and shows how they contribute to the displayed teaching image.
examples.zh: 「超声成像」示意图追踪返回的回声，展示它们如何参与形成教学显示图像。

examples.en: We compared ultrasonography with radiography by identifying the different physical signal that each method uses.
examples.zh: 我们通过辨认两种方法使用的不同物理信号，比较「超声成像」与 X 线成像。

words.enDefinition: a component that converts electrical signals to sound pulses and returning echoes back into electrical signals

examples.en: The ultrasound transducer is the labeled component sending pulses into the illustrated classroom model.
examples.zh: 「超声换能器」是图中标明的、向课堂模型发出脉冲的部件。

examples.en: We followed the two arrows showing outgoing pulses and incoming echoes at the ultrasound transducer.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「超声换能器」处表示外发脉冲与返回回声的两个箭头追踪。

collocations: echo received by an ultrasound transducer

words.enDefinition: Central area of the abdominal grid surrounding the navel

examples.en: The navel sits inside the umbilical region in the model's abdominal grid.
examples.zh: 在模型的腹部网格中，肚脐位于「脐区」以内。

examples.en: We labeled the umbilical region at the center of the chart's middle row.
examples.zh: 我们在图表中间一排的中央标出了「脐区」。

words.enDefinition: Reversible inhibition in which the inhibitor binds only to the enzyme-substrate complex.

examples.en: The uncompetitive inhibition panel shows the second shape binding only after the substrate is already present.
examples.zh: 「反竞争性抑制」图中，底物已经结合后，第二个形状才发生结合。

examples.en: We identified uncompetitive inhibition by noting which enzyme state was shown with the bound regulatory molecule.
examples.zh: 我们观察调节分子结合时酶处于何种状态，据此辨认出「反竞争性抑制」。

words.enDefinition: Present or described on only one side of the body

examples.en: The worksheet uses a unilateral view showing the left arm by itself.
examples.zh: 习题用一幅只显示左臂的「单侧」图。

examples.en: Our tutor drew a unilateral mark on the right side of the model.
examples.zh: 老师在模型右侧画了一个「单侧」标记。

words.enDefinition: a thin tissue slice that has not been given color by adding a histological stain

examples.en: The supplied unstained section image had little contrast between the neighboring transparent structures in the tissue.
examples.zh: 给出的「未染色切片」图像中，组织内相邻透明结构之间的反差很小。

examples.en: We used the unstained section as a visual comparison beside the colored image in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们把「未染色切片」放在图谱的着色图旁作为视觉参照。

collocations: compare an unstained section with a stained section

words.enDefinition: Muscular tube that carries urine from one kidney to the bladder

examples.en: We followed the ureter from the kidney down to the bladder.
examples.zh: 我们沿「输尿管」从肾脏向下追踪到膀胱。

examples.en: The diagram shows a separate ureter leaving each side of the model.
examples.zh: 图中，模型两侧各有一根「输尿管」从肾脏引出。

words.enDefinition: Tube carrying urine from the bladder to the outside of the body

examples.en: The figure shows the urethra leaving the bladder through its lower opening.
examples.zh: 图示显示「尿道」从膀胱下方开口引出。

examples.en: We labeled the urethra after tracing the final part of the urinary pathway.
examples.zh: 我们沿尿路末段看到其出口后，标出了「尿道」。

words.enDefinition: Hollow muscular organ storing urine before it leaves through the urethra

examples.en: The urinary bladder is drawn below both kidneys in the model's front view.
examples.zh: 在模型正视图中，「膀胱」画在两侧肾脏的下方。

examples.en: We labeled the incoming tubes at the base of the urinary bladder.
examples.zh: 我们在「膀胱」底部标出了通入其中的管道。

words.enDefinition: Organs forming, transporting, storing, and eliminating urine

examples.en: The urinary system model connects both kidneys to the bladder through two tubes.
examples.zh: 「泌尿系统」模型用两根管道将两侧肾脏与膀胱相连。

examples.en: We traced the urinary system downward from the kidneys in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上从肾脏向下描画「泌尿系统」。

words.enDefinition: A comparison condition in which participants continue to receive the care ordinarily available in that setting.

examples.en: The usual-care control group receives the routine follow-up described in the fictional study summary for the class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构研究摘要中，「常规照护对照」组接受所述的日常随访。

examples.en: We checked what the report included under usual-care control before comparing the outcomes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先确认报告将哪些项目归入「常规照护对照」，再对比结局。

words.enDefinition: an inner-ear vestibular sac most sensitive to horizontal linear acceleration and changes in head tilt when upright

examples.en: The model draws the utricle beside the saccule within the vestibular portion of the inner ear.
examples.zh: 模型在内耳的前庭部分，将「椭圆囊」画在球囊旁。

examples.en: We linked the utricle to horizontal linear acceleration in the example with the head normally upright.
examples.zh: 在头部正常直立的示例中，我们把「椭圆囊」与水平线加速度相联系。

words.enDefinition: Differences in degree or form of a phenotype among individuals who show it and share a genotype.

examples.en: The worksheet shows variable expressivity through different degrees of the same fictional trait in one group.
examples.zh: 练习用同一组中虚构性状的不同表现程度展示「可变表现度」。

examples.en: We distinguished variable expressivity from whether the example feature appeared at all in the table.
examples.zh: 我们把「可变表现度」与表里示例特征是否出现区分开。

words.enDefinition: Straight capillary loops accompanying long nephron loops in the renal medulla

examples.en: The vasa recta run beside the long nephron loop on the enlarged diagram.
examples.zh: 在放大图中，「直小血管」沿较长的肾单位袢旁边延伸。

examples.en: We used blue lines to separate the vasa recta from the tubular pathway.
examples.zh: 我们用蓝色线条将「直小血管」与小管通路区分开来。

collocations: blood flow through the vasa recta

words.enDefinition: Brief narrowing of a vessel through contraction of its wall muscle

examples.en: The model represents vascular spasm by showing a narrower vessel at the marked site.
examples.zh: 模型通过画出标记处变窄的血管来表示「血管痉挛」。

examples.en: We labeled vascular spasm before the platelet stage in the classroom sequence.
examples.zh: 在课堂顺序图中，我们将「血管痉挛」标在血小板阶段之前。

words.enDefinition: the flow of blood back to the heart through veins, often expressed as a volume per unit time

examples.en: The venous return arrow points into the right atrium on the systemic circulation diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的体循环图中，「静脉回流」箭头指向右心房。

examples.en: We compared venous return with cardiac output at steady state in the simplified whole-body model.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的全身模型中比较稳态下的「静脉回流」与心输出量。

collocations: effect of venous return on cardiac filling

words.enDefinition: a fold or set of leaflets in a vein that helps keep blood flowing toward the heart

examples.en: The venous valve opened toward the heart as the pressure below it rose in the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，下方压力升高时，「静脉瓣」朝心脏方向打开。

examples.en: We drew the position of a closed venous valve to show where reverse flow was limited.
examples.zh: 我们画出关闭的「静脉瓣」位置，标明反向血流受限之处。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of alveolar ventilation to blood flow through the same lung region or whole lung

examples.en: In the model, the ventilation-perfusion ratio rose when ventilation increased while the local blood flow stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 在模型中，局部血流保持不变且通气量增加时，「通气血流比」升高。

examples.en: We compared the ventilation-perfusion ratio in two regions using modeled alveolar airflow and pulmonary blood flow rates.
examples.zh: 我们用模型中的肺泡气流量和肺血流量比较两个区域的「通气血流比」。

words.enDefinition: Large anterior compartment divided into the thoracic and abdominopelvic cavities

examples.en: The ventral body cavity extends from the chest down into the pelvic region.
examples.zh: 「腹侧体腔」从胸部向下延伸到骨盆区域。

examples.en: We drew the diaphragm across the ventral body cavity to show its major subdivisions.
examples.zh: 我们在「腹侧体腔」中画出横隔，表示它的主要分区。

collocations: subdivisions of the ventral body cavity
organs in the ventral body cavity

words.enDefinition: the anterior projection of spinal gray matter containing cell bodies of many skeletal motor neurons

examples.en: The model places large motor neuron cell bodies in the ventral horn of the spinal gray matter.
examples.zh: 模型将较大的运动神经元胞体放在脊髓灰质的「前角」内。

examples.en: We shaded the ventral horn on each side of the classroom cross section of the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂脊髓横切面图上，为左右两侧的「前角」着色。

collocations: gray matter of the ventral horn

words.enDefinition: the anterior root carrying motor fibers out of the spinal cord

examples.en: The ventral root carries motor fibers away from the spinal cord in the classroom wiring diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂神经连线图中，运动神经纤维经「前根」从脊髓传出。

examples.en: We marked the ventral root before its junction with the posterior root in the spinal nerve model.
examples.zh: 我们在脊神经模型上，于神经前后根会合之前的部位标出「前根」。

collocations: motor signals through the ventral root

words.enDefinition: Surface facing the front of the human trunk

examples.en: We colored the ventral surface on the front of the torso model.
examples.zh: 我们给躯干模型前面的「腹侧面」涂上了颜色。

examples.en: The diagram shows the ventral surface from the chest down to the abdomen.
examples.zh: 示意图展示了从胸部到腹部的「腹侧面」。

words.enDefinition: electrical activation spreading across the ventricular muscle before its coordinated contraction

examples.en: The tall group of deflections on our example trace corresponds to ventricular depolarization in the heart model.
examples.zh: 示例曲线上一组较大的波形偏转，对应心脏模型中的「心室去极化」。

examples.en: We placed ventricular depolarization before the pressure rise on the combined electrical and mechanical timeline.
examples.zh: 在综合电活动与机械活动的时间线上，我们把「心室去极化」标在压力上升之前。

collocations: ventricular depolarization on an ECG trace

words.enDefinition: the phase when the ventricles relax and then fill with blood

examples.en: During early ventricular diastole, the ventricular pressure fell before the filling valves opened on the model.
examples.zh: 在模型上，「心室舒张期」初段的心室压力在充盈所经的瓣膜打开前下降。

examples.en: The classroom chart shows ventricular volume increasing during the filling portion of ventricular diastole.
examples.zh: 课堂图显示，在「心室舒张期」的充盈阶段，心室容积增加。

words.enDefinition: the phase when blood exits the ventricle through its open semilunar valve

examples.en: The volume curve fell during ventricular ejection because blood left the chamber in the animated model.
examples.zh: 在动画模型中，血液离开心室，因此「心室射血」期间的容积曲线下降。

examples.en: We marked the start of ventricular ejection where the outlet valve opened on the combined diagram.
examples.zh: 在组合图上，我们在出口瓣膜打开的位置标出「心室射血」的起点。

words.enDefinition: the return of ventricular muscle cells toward their resting electrical state after depolarization

examples.en: The last broad wave in the classroom trace reflects ventricular repolarization after the earlier activation of the ventricles.
examples.zh: 课堂曲线的最后一个宽波表示先前受电激动的心室发生「心室复极化」。

examples.en: We colored ventricular repolarization separately from activation on the simplified timeline of electrical events in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在简化的电活动时间线上用不同颜色标记「心室复极化」与激动。

collocations: ventricular repolarization on an ECG trace

words.enDefinition: the phase when the ventricles contract, first raising pressure and then ejecting blood

examples.en: The animation divides ventricular systole into pressure buildup and ejection through the valves at the ventricular outlets.
examples.zh: 动画把「心室收缩期」分为压力升高和血液经心室出口瓣膜射出两个阶段。

examples.en: We traced the ventricular pressure curve as it rose during the early part of ventricular systole.
examples.zh: 我们沿着心室压力曲线观察「心室收缩期」初段的压力升高。

words.enDefinition: a small vessel that collects blood from capillaries and drains it into larger veins

examples.en: The classroom diagram shows the venule collecting blood from several capillaries before joining a larger vein.
examples.zh: 课堂图显示，「微静脉」从多条毛细血管汇集血液，然后汇入较大的静脉。

examples.en: We followed flow from the capillary network toward the venule using the arrows on the model.
examples.zh: 我们顺着模型里的箭头，追踪从毛细血管网络流向「微静脉」的血液。

words.enDefinition: One of the individual bones that make up the vertebral column.

examples.en: The tutor turned one vertebra around to show its shape from the side.
examples.zh: 老师转动一块「椎骨」，展示它从侧面看是什么形状。

examples.en: We matched each vertebra from the model set to its region on the spine chart.
examples.zh: 我们把模型组中的各块「椎骨」与脊柱图中的相应区段配对。

words.enDefinition: Continuous passage within the vertebral column that contains the spinal cord

examples.en: We traced the vertebral canal down the spine on the sagittal diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在矢状面示意图上沿脊柱向下描画「椎管」。

examples.en: The vertebral canal connects with the space inside the skull in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「椎管」与颅骨内的空间相通。

words.enDefinition: The central bony column formed by the vertebrae, sacrum, and coccyx, with discs between many adjacent vertebrae.

examples.en: The vertebral column curves in several places in the side view of the skeleton.
examples.zh: 骨骼侧视图上的「脊柱」有几处弯曲。

examples.en: We marked the three main movable regions of the vertebral column on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂挂图上标出「脊柱」三个主要可动区段。

words.enDefinition: the inner-ear structures that sense head movement and orientation, including the semicircular ducts, utricle and saccule

examples.en: The vestibular apparatus appears beside the cochlea in the model comparing balance and hearing structures.
examples.zh: 对比平衡和听觉结构的模型中，「前庭器官」位于耳蜗旁。

examples.en: We highlighted the vestibular apparatus on the diagram before tracing signals related to head motion.
examples.zh: 我们先在图中突出「前庭器官」，再追踪与头部运动有关的信号。

collocations: sensory signals from the vestibular apparatus

words.enDefinition: Portion of a serous membrane that lies directly on an organ

examples.en: The visceral layer follows the organ's outline closely in the colored figure.
examples.zh: 在彩色图中，「脏层」紧贴器官的外轮廓。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed to the visceral layer directly covering the model organ.
examples.zh: 老师指向直接覆盖模型器官的「脏层」。

collocations: visceral layer of a serous membrane

words.enDefinition: the thin serous membrane covering the surface of a lung and extending into its fissures

examples.en: The visceral pleura follows the lung surface into the fissure drawn on the classroom cross section.
examples.zh: 在课堂横切图中，「脏层胸膜」沿肺表面进入肺裂。

examples.en: We shaded the visceral pleura directly on the model lung before marking the membrane lining the chest wall.
examples.zh: 我们先给模型肺表面的「脏层胸膜」着色，再标出胸壁内侧的那一层膜。

collocations: surface covered by the visceral pleura

words.enDefinition: the maximum volume of air that can be exhaled after a maximal inhalation

examples.en: The bracket shows vital capacity between the maximum and minimum lung volumes on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 课程图表上的括号标出了最大与最小肺容积之差，也就是「肺活量」。

examples.en: We compared vital capacity with tidal volume to distinguish the full movable volume from one quiet breath.
examples.zh: 我们将「肺活量」和潮气量作比较，区分最大可出入气量与一次平静呼吸的气量。

words.enDefinition: one of two tissue folds in the larynx that vibrate during voice production

examples.en: The sound animation shows each vocal fold vibrating as air passes through the narrowed opening.
examples.zh: 发声动画显示，空气通过变窄的开口时，各「声带」发生振动。

examples.en: We labeled each vocal fold on the diagram before marking the space between the two folds.
examples.zh: 我们在图中先标出各「声带」，再标出两者间的空隙。

words.enDefinition: a membrane protein whose likelihood of opening or closing is affected by membrane voltage

examples.en: The model shows a voltage-gated ion channel changing its state as membrane voltage rises during the animation.
examples.zh: 动画中，模型显示「电压门控离子通道」随膜电压上升改变状态。

examples.en: We linked the sensor symbol on a voltage-gated ion channel to the voltage across the membrane.
examples.zh: 我们把「电压门控离子通道」图上的感应部分符号与跨膜电压联系起来。

collocations: activation of a voltage-gated ion channel

words.enDefinition: Blood protein helping platelets attach to exposed structures at a damaged vessel

examples.en: Our diagram depicts von Willebrand factor as a link between the wall and platelets.
examples.zh: 示意图把「血管性血友病因子」画成连接血管壁和血小板的桥梁。

examples.en: We labeled von Willebrand factor where the first platelets attach in the textbook figure.
examples.zh: 我们在教材图中最先附着血小板的位置标出了「血管性血友病因子」。

collocations: platelet interaction with von Willebrand factor

words.enDefinition: nervous tissue rich in axons, many of them myelinated, along with supporting glial cells

examples.en: The white matter surrounds the central butterfly-shaped gray region in the cross section of the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 在脊髓横切图中，「白质」围绕中央呈蝶形的灰质区域。

examples.en: We traced pathways through white matter between distant regions on the simplified brain drawing used in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂使用的简化脑图上，沿「白质」追踪连接相距较远区域的通路。

words.enDefinition: Blood considered together with its plasma, cells, and platelets

examples.en: The chart represents whole blood as a mixture of liquid and suspended components.
examples.zh: 图表将「全血」表示为液体和悬浮成分的混合物。

examples.en: We used separate colors for the main components shown in the whole blood diagram.
examples.zh: 我们用不同颜色表示「全血」示意图中的各主要成分。

words.enDefinition: a high-resolution digital scan covering the tissue on a microscope slide as a continuous view

examples.en: The whole-slide image includes the entire tissue outline and permits magnification of the marked corner.
examples.zh: 「全切片图像」包括完整的组织轮廓，并可放大标出的角落。

examples.en: We opened the whole-slide image to see how the cropped field fit within the rest of the section.
examples.zh: 我们打开「全切片图像」，查看裁出的局部在整张切片中的位置。

words.enDefinition: A participant's decision to stop taking part in some or all aspects of a study.

examples.en: The fictional information sheet explains withdrawal from a study in a separate section for participants.
examples.zh: 虚构信息说明有一个单独面向参与者的部分，解释「退出研究」。

examples.en: We read how withdrawal from a study was recorded in the classroom flow chart for participants.
examples.zh: 我们查看课堂参与者流程图如何记录「退出研究」。

collocations: information about withdrawal from a study

words.enDefinition: a reflex movement that draws part of the body away from a potentially harmful stimulus

examples.en: In the model animation, the withdrawal reflex moved the foot away after a sensory signal reached the cord.
examples.zh: 在模型动画中，感觉信号抵达脊髓后，「屈曲反射」使脚移开。

examples.en: We traced the withdrawal reflex through several connected neurons on the classroom illustration of spinal circuits.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂脊髓环路图中的多个相连神经元追踪「屈曲反射」。

words.enDefinition: the distance from the front of a microscope objective to the cover glass or specimen surface at focus

examples.en: We compared working distance between two objective lenses using the spacing shown in their specification drawings.
examples.zh: 我们用两个物镜规格图中所示的间距来比较各自的「工作距离」。

examples.en: The working distance is marked as the gap immediately below the objective in the focused model.
examples.zh: 对好焦的模型中，紧靠物镜正下方的间距标为「工作距离」。

words.enDefinition: Inheritance in which an associated phenotype can be expressed with a single copy of a dominant allele on X.

examples.en: The classroom chart describes X-linked dominant inheritance using a fictional allele on the X chromosome.
examples.zh: 课堂图利用 X 染色体上的虚构等位基因描述「X 连锁显性遗传」。

examples.en: We compared X-linked dominant inheritance with the other X-linked pattern shown in the teaching table.
examples.zh: 我们把「X 连锁显性遗传」与教学表里的另一种 X 连锁模式作比较。

words.enDefinition: Inheritance involving a locus on the X chromosome.

examples.en: X-linked inheritance concerns the locus drawn on the X chromosome in our fictional example.
examples.zh: 「X 连锁遗传」涉及虚构示例中画在 X 染色体上的位点。

examples.en: We labelled X-linked inheritance before comparing the diagrams that apply different dominance assumptions.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「X 连锁遗传」，再比较采用不同显隐性假设的图示。

words.enDefinition: Inheritance involving a recessive allele on X that can be expressed when no contrasting dominant copy masks it.

examples.en: The lesson uses X-linked recessive inheritance to interpret the symbols in a fictional chromosome complement.
examples.zh: 课程用「X 连锁隐性遗传」解释虚构染色体组合中的符号。

examples.en: We applied the stated copy rules for X-linked recessive inheritance in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型里应用「X 连锁隐性遗传」的给定副本规则。

words.enDefinition: Transmission of variants at loci in regions unique to the Y chromosome.

examples.en: The example of Y-linked inheritance follows a labelled locus unique to the modelled Y chromosome.
examples.zh: 「Y 连锁遗传」示例追踪模型中 Y 染色体特有的一个标记位点。

examples.en: We used the chromosome labels to recognise Y-linked inheritance in the simplified family diagram.
examples.zh: 我们根据染色体标签，在简化家系图里辨认出「Y 连锁遗传」。

words.enDefinition: Marrow rich in fat cells, commonly found in the shafts of adult long bones.

examples.en: The yellow bone marrow is shown inside the shaft cavity on the adult bone diagram.
examples.zh: 成人骨示意图把「黄骨髓」画在骨干的骨髓腔内。

examples.en: We used the legend to locate yellow bone marrow on the cutaway teaching model.
examples.zh: 我们根据图例，在剖面教学模型上找到「黄骨髓」。

words.enDefinition: The structure at a sarcomere boundary to which the thin filaments attach.

examples.en: The Z disc marks one end of the repeating unit in the muscle diagram.
examples.zh: 肌肉示意图上的「Z 盘」标出重复单位的一端。

examples.en: We used a line to mark each Z disc in the enlarged classroom muscle illustration.
examples.zh: 我们用一条线标出课堂肌肉放大图上的各个「Z 盘」。

collocations: sarcomere boundary at the Z disc
thin filaments attached to a Z disc

words.enDefinition: A molecule with both positively and negatively charged groups and a net charge of zero.

examples.en: The glycine drawing shows a zwitterion with opposite charges on two groups and no overall charge.
examples.zh: 甘氨酸图所示的「两性离子」在两个基团上带相反电荷，净电荷为零。

examples.en: We recognized the zwitterion by checking both marked charges in the classroom drawing of the molecule.
examples.zh: 我们核对课堂分子图标出的两处电荷，认出了「两性离子」。

words.enDefinition: The cell formed when two gametes unite, normally restoring two chromosome sets in humans.

examples.en: The zygote contains both chromosome sets in the first panel of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图第一幅小图中的「合子」含有两套染色体。

examples.en: We counted the labelled chromosome sets in the zygote before reading the next panel.
examples.zh: 我们先数「合子」中标出的染色体组，再看下一幅图。
